translation:
The ancestors of the Zhao family and the Qin people have the same ancestor.
When it was passed to Zhongyan, he became the person who drove horses and chariots for Emperor Taiwu of the Shang Dynasty.
His descendant Feilian had two sons. One son was named Eilai and served King Zhou. He was later killed by the Zhou people. His descendants were the Ying Qin family.
Erlai's younger brother was named Ji Sheng, and his descendants were the Zhao people.
Ji Sheng gave birth to Meng Zeng.
Meng Zeng was favored by King Zhou Cheng, and this was Zhai Gaolang.
Gaolang begat Hengfu, and Hengfu begat Zaofu.
Zaofu was favored by King Mu of Zhou.
Cepheus selected eight horses and presented them to King Mu along with the famous horses such as Robber, Hualiu, and Luer obtained in Taolin.
King Mu asked Zaofu to drive his chariot to the west for inspection. He met the Queen Mother of the West and was so happy that he forgot to go back.
Soon, King Xu Yan launched a rebellion. King Mu rode a carriage and traveled thousands of miles a day to attack King Xu Yan and completely defeat him.
So he gave the city of Zhao to Zaofu, and he became the Zhao family from then on.
From Zaofu down through six generations, it was passed down to Yanfu, whose courtesy name was Gongzhong. When King Xuan of Zhou attacked the Rong people, he drove his chariot for King Xuan.
In the Battle of Thousand Acres, Yanfu saved King Xuan from danger.
Am's father gave birth to his uncle.
During the reign of his uncle, King You of Zhou was debauched and immoral, so he left the Zhou Dynasty and went to Jin, where he served Marquis Wen of Jin and began to establish the Zhao family in Jin.
From the uncle down, the Zhao family became more and more prosperous, and after five generations it was passed down to Zhao Su.
Zhao Su, in the 16th year of Duke Xian of Jin, conquered the three kingdoms of Huo, Wei, and Geng. He led the army to conquer the Huo Kingdom.
Huo Gongqiu fled to Qi State.
This year there was a severe drought in the Jin State, and the divination result said: The gods of Mount Huo Tai are causing trouble.
So Zhao Su was sent to Qi State to welcome back the king of Huo State, restored his status, and asked him to preside over the sacrifices at Mount Huo Tai. Only then did Jin State have a good harvest again.
Duke Xian of Jin gave the land of Geng to Zhao Su.
The year when Zhao Su came down to share the throne with Meng was the first year of Lu Min.
Mencius was born in the same family as Zhao Shui, whose courtesy name was Ziyu.
Zhao Shui used divination to decide whether to serve Duke Xian of Jin or other princes, but the result was unlucky. When the divination revealed that he was serving Prince Chong'er, the result was auspicious, so he went to serve Chong'er.
Chong'er fled to Zhai State due to the Liji Rebellion, and Zhao Shui followed him.
The Zhai people attacked Yao Jiuru and got two women. Zhai Jun gave the young girl to Chong'er as his wife, and the older girl to Zhao Shui as his wife, and they gave birth to Zhao Dun.
When Chong'er was in Jin, Zhao Shuai's first wife had already given birth to Zhao Tong, Zhao Kuo and Zhao Yingqi.
Zhao Shui fled with Chong'er for a total of nineteen years before he was able to return to Jin.
Chong'er became Duke Wen of Jin, and Zhao Shui became the official of Yuan. He lived in Yuan City and presided over state affairs.
summary: The Zhao family shares a common ancestor with the Qin people. Their lineage traces back to Zhongyan, who served as a charioteer for Emperor Taiwu of the Shang Dynasty. His descendant Feilian had two sons: Eilai, who served King Zhou and was killed by the Zhou people, becoming the ancestor of the Ying Qin family; and Ji Sheng, whose descendants became the Zhao family. Ji Sheng's line included Meng Zeng, favored by King Cheng of Zhou, and eventually Zaofu, who served King Mu of Zhou. Zaofu presented eight fine horses to King Mu and drove his chariot westward, where the king met the Queen Mother of the West. When King Xu Yan rebelled, Zaofu drove King Mu thousands of miles in a day to crush the rebellion, and was rewarded with the city of Zhao, establishing the Zhao family name. Six generations later, Yanfu served King Xuan of Zhou as a charioteer and saved him at the Battle of Thousand Acres. His son Shudai left the debauched court of King You of Zhou to serve Marquis Wen of Jin, beginning the Zhao family's rise in Jin. Five generations later, Zhao Su conquered the states of Huo, Wei, and Geng for Duke Xian of Jin. When a drought struck Jin, divination revealed the god of Mount Huo Tai was angry, so Zhao Su restored the king of Huo to appease the god, and the drought ended. Zhao Shui, a descendant, used divination to decide to serve Prince Chong'er, following him into exile for nineteen years. After Chong'er became Duke Wen of Jin, Zhao Shui became a high official and helped him become hegemon.

translation:
The reason why Duke Wen of Jin was able to return and become the overlord was mostly due to Zhao Shuai's strategy. These things are all recorded in "Jin Family".
After Zhao Shui returned to Jin, his first wife in Jin insisted on welcoming back the wife he married in Zhai, and made Zhai's wife's son Zhao Dun the official heir, while his three sons served him in lower positions.
In the sixth year of Duke Xianggong of Jin Dynasty, Zhao Shui passed away, and his posthumous title was Cheng Ji.
Two years after Zhao Dun succeeded Cheng Ji in presiding over the state affairs, Duke Xianggang of Jin passed away and Prince Yigao was young.
Because the country was in trouble, Zhao Dun wanted to make Yong, the younger brother of Duke Xiang, the king of the country.
Yong was in Qin at that time, so he sent envoys to meet him.
The prince's mother cried day and night, kowtowed to Zhao Dun and said: "What sin did the late king have? Why did he abandon his legitimate son and establish another king?"
Zhao Dun was worried about this and was afraid that her clan members and officials would attack and kill her, so he appointed the crown prince, Duke Linggong of Jin, and sent troops to intercept the group of people who came to Qin to meet Duke Xianggong's younger brother.
After Duke Linggong ascended the throne, Zhao Dun took more control of the political affairs of Jin.
Fourteen years after Ling Gong succeeded to the throne, Zhao Lai became more and more arrogant.
Zhao Dun remonstrated many times, but Duke Linggong did not listen.
Once he ate bear paws, but because they were not cooked properly, he killed the catering officer and had his body carried out, where Zhao Dun happened to see him.
Duke Ling was frightened and wanted to kill Zhao Dun.
Zhao Dun was always kind and kind to others. He once gave food to a man who was hungry and fell under a mulberry tree. The man stepped forward to rescue Zhao Dun, and Zhao Dun was able to escape.
Before he could escape from the country, Zhao Chuan killed Duke Ling and made Heihui, the younger brother of Duke Xiang, the king. This was Duke Cheng of Jin.
Zhao Dun returned to preside over state affairs.
The gentleman ridiculed Zhao Dun: As a minister, he fled without leaving the country, and did not punish the rebels when he returned. Therefore, the historian recorded that Zhao Dun killed his king.
Zhao Dun died during the reign of Duke Jinggong of Jin Dynasty. His posthumous title was Xuan Meng, and his son Zhao Shuo inherited the title.
In the third year of Duke Jinggong of Jin Dynasty, Zhao Shuo led the Jin army to rescue Zheng State and fought with King Zhuang of Chu on the Yellow River.
Zhao Shuo married Jin Chenggong's sister as his wife.
In the third year of Duke Jinggong's reign in Jin Dynasty, the official Tu Anjia wanted to kill the entire Zhao family.
When Zhao Dun was still alive, he once dreamed that his uncle was hugging his waist and crying bitterly. He was very sad; then he laughed and clapped his hands and sang.
Zhao Dun performed a divination for this purpose, and the cracks burned on the tortoise shell were interrupted and then intact.
A historian named Yuan of Zhao State judged: This dream is unlucky. It did not come true on you, but on your son, but it was also because of your fault.
By your grandson's generation, the Zhao family will be even more in decline.
Tu Anjia was favored by Duke Lin at first. When he arrived at Jinggong, he became a scourge. When he was about to cause trouble, he first punished the rebels who killed Duke Lin in order to implicate Zhao Dun. At the same time, he informed all the generals that although Zhao Dun did not know about it, he was still the chief culprit.
summary: After Zhao Shui's death, his son Zhao Dun succeeded him. When Duke Xiang of Jin died, Zhao Dun initially planned to install a younger brother as ruler due to the young age of the crown prince, but the prince's mother's pleas led him to install the crown prince as Duke Ling of Jin. Duke Ling grew tyrannical, and when he tried to kill Zhao Dun, Zhao Dun fled. Before he could escape the country, Zhao Chuan killed Duke Ling. Zhao Dun returned to preside over state affairs, but historians recorded that he killed the king because he did not punish the rebels. Zhao Dun's son Zhao Shuo married Duke Cheng of Jin's sister. During Duke Jing's reign, the official Tu Anjia, seeking to destroy the Zhao family, falsely accused Zhao Dun of regicide and attacked the Zhao residence, killing Zhao Shuo and his brothers, though Zhao Shuo's pregnant wife escaped to the palace.

translation:
However, the real Zhao orphan was still alive, and Cheng Ying ended up hiding in the mountains with him.
Fifteen years later, Jin Jinggong fell ill and performed a divination. The divination revealed that Daye's descendants were causing trouble due to the cessation of sacrifices.
Jinggong asked Han Jue. Han Jue knew that the orphan of the Zhao family was still alive, so he said: Among the descendants of Daye who have now cut off their incest in Jin, isn't it the Zhao family?
The descendants descended from it all bear the surname Ying.
Zhongyan, a man with a human face and a bird's beak, came to the world to assist Emperor Taiwu of Yin, and the several emperors of Zhou assisted by his descendants all had good virtues.
Further down to King Li and King You, who were ignorant and ignorant, Shudai left the Zhou Dynasty and came to the Jin Dynasty to serve the ancestor Wenhou. Until they became dukes, they established achievements for generations and never stopped their incense.
Now only you, the monarch, have destroyed the Zhao clan, and the people of Jin are mourning for them, so it was revealed in the divination.
I hope you will consider this!
Jinggong asked: "Does the Zhao family have any descendants?"
Han Jue told Jinggong completely the truth.
So Jinggong discussed with Han Jue to create an orphan of the Zhao family, and first found him and hid him in the palace.
The generals entered the palace to inquire about Jinggong's condition. Jinggong relied on Han Jue's many followers to force the generals to meet the Zhao orphans.
The orphan of the Zhao family is named Zhao Wu.
The generals had no choice but to say: The incident in the palace was instigated by Tu'anjia. He falsely conveyed the emperor's orders and issued orders to the ministers. If not, who would dare to initiate a rebellion!
Even if the monarch is not sick, we ministers must support the descendants of the Zhao family.
Now that you have given the order, this is also our wish!
So Zhao Wu and Cheng Ying were asked to thank the generals one by one. The generals in turn joined Cheng Ying and Zhao Wu to attack Tu'anjia and annihilate his family.
Jinggong gave Zhao Wu the fiefdom that originally belonged to the Zhao family.
When Zhao Wu had the crowning ceremony and he was already an adult, Cheng Ying said goodbye to all the officials, and then said to Zhao Wu: "Everyone can die for the Lord because of what happened in the palace."
It's not that I can't die, I just want to support the descendants of the Zhao family.
Now that Zhao Wu has inherited his ancestral legacy, grown up, and restored his original title, I will go underground to report to Zhao Xuan and Gongsun Chujiu.
Zhao Wu cried and kowtowed, and insisted on requesting: "I would rather suffer my own bones and muscles to repay you until my death. Do you have the heart to leave me and die?"
Cheng Ying said: No.
Gongsun Chujiu thought that I could accomplish great things, so he died before me; if I don't come back to life now, he will think that I haven't accomplished this yet.
So he committed suicide.
Zhao Wu kept mourning for Cheng Ying for three years and arranged land for him to use for sacrifices. Spring and Autumn sacrifices have been passed down from generation to generation.
Eleven years after Zhao's title was restored, Duke Li of Jin killed three senior officials of the Que family.
Luan Shu was afraid that he would be implicated, so he killed Duke Li, the king of Jin, and replaced him with Duke Xiang's great-grandson Zhou, who was Duke Ao of Jin.
summary: Zhao Shuo's wife gave birth to a son, Zhao Wu. Tu Anjia searched for the baby, but it was hidden. Zhao Shuo's retainers, Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu, devised a plan: Chujiu hid with a substitute baby, and Cheng Ying "betrayed" him to the generals. The generals killed Chujiu and the substitute, believing the Zhao line extinct. Cheng Ying then hid the real Zhao Wu in the mountains for fifteen years. When Duke Jing fell ill, divination revealed the Zhao family's sacrifices were causing trouble. Han Jue, knowing the truth, told the duke, who then restored Zhao Wu and destroyed Tu Anjia's family. After Zhao Wu came of age, Cheng Ying committed suicide to report to his fallen comrades.

translation:
Yuan Guo followed Xiangzi and fell behind. When he arrived at Wangze, he saw three people. They could be seen from above the belt, but not from below.
The three of them gave Yuan a bamboo stick with two sections, but there was no passage in the middle.
He said to him: Give this bamboo stick to Zhao Wuxie for us.
After Yuan Guo arrived, he told Xiangzi the situation.
Xiangzi fasted for three days and cut open the bamboo stick himself. Inside, there were vermilion characters written: Zhao Wuxie, we are the angels of the Yanghou of Mount Huotai.
On Bingxu day of March, we will ask you to destroy Zhishi in turn.
You will also build temples for our hundreds of cities, and we will give you the land of Linhu.
Your descendants will have a brave and strong king with red and black skin, a dragon face and a bird's beak, sideburns and eyebrows, a mustache and cheeks, a broad chest and a big belly, a slender lower body, a strong upper body, a left skirt, wearing armor and riding a horse. All the raccoon tribesmen who occupied the middle reaches of the Yellow River and the Xiumun area went south to attack other cities in Jin and went north to destroy Heigu.
Xiangzi worshiped again and accepted the orders of the three gods.
The Three Kingdoms' attack on Jinyang lasted for more than a year, causing Fenshui to flood the city. Only three walls of the city wall were not flooded.
People in the city hang up pots to cook and exchange their children for them to eat.
All the ministers were disloyal and their etiquette became more and more neglectful. Only the Communist Party of China did not dare to be rude to Xiangzi.
Xiangzi was afraid, so he sent Prime Minister Zhang Mengtong to secretly make friends with Han and Wei in the middle of the night.
Han, Wei and Zhao conspired. On Bingxu in March, the three countries in turn destroyed the Zhi family and jointly divided his land.
So Xiangzi made a reward, and the Gao Communist Party ranked first in merit.
Zhang Mengtong said: During the time of trouble in Jinyang, only the Communist Party of China did not make meritorious deeds.
Xiangzi said: When Jinyang was in crisis, all the ministers were indifferent. Only the Communist Party of Gao did not dare to violate the etiquette of ministers, so he will receive a reward.
At this time, Zhao occupied Dai territory in the north and annexed the Zhi clan in the south, becoming stronger than Han and Wei.
So he built a temple to offer sacrifices to the three gods in Baiyi, and sent Yuan Guo to preside over the sacrifices at the Hotai Mountain Temple.
Later, Xiangzi married Kongtong and gave birth to five sons.
Because Bolu failed to succeed to the throne, Xiangzi refused to make his own son the crown prince, and insisted on passing the throne to Bolu's son Dai Chengjun.
Chengjun died first, so he chose Zhao Huan, Chengjun's son, as the crown prince.
Xiangzi died in the 33rd year of his reign, and Zhao Huan came to the throne. He became the Marquis of Xian.
Xianhou came to the throne at a young age, and his capital was Zhongmu.
Xiangzi's younger brother Huanzi expelled Xianhou and established himself as a marquis in Dai. He died a year later.
The people of Zhao thought that Huanzi's accession to the throne was not Xiangzi's wish, so they jointly killed his son and welcomed Xianhou to the throne.
In the tenth year of Xianhou's reign, Duke Wu of Zhongshan State began to ascend the throne.
In the thirteenth year, a city was built in Pingyi.
In the fifteenth year, Xianhou died, and his son Liehou Zhao Ji came to the throne.
summary: Zhao Wu's descendants grew powerful. His son Zhao Yang, Zhao Jianzi, became a dominant minister. He defeated the Fan and Zhonghang clans, expanded Zhao territory, and was named Shangqing, effectively monopolizing Jin's government. His son Zhao Wuxie, Zhao Xiangzi, succeeded him. Xiangzi killed the king of Dai and annexed his land. When Zhibo demanded territory, Xiangzi refused, leading to a siege of Jinyang. With divine guidance from the gods of Mount Huotai, Xiangzi allied with Han and Wei to destroy Zhibo and divide his lands. Zhao became stronger than Han and Wei.

translation:
In the 16th year, Suhou visited Daling and passed by Lumen. Prime Minister Tai Wuwu held the horse's head and said: When farming is busy, if you don't cultivate for one day, you will have no food for a hundred days.
After hearing this, Suhou immediately got out of the car and admitted his mistake.
For seventeen years, Huangcheng, which besieged Wei State, was not conquered.
Build the Great Wall.
In the eighteenth year, Qi and Wei conquered the State of Zhao. The State of Zhao used water from the Yellow River to flood the enemy troops, and the enemy troops withdrew.
In the 22nd year, Zhang Yi was appointed prime minister of Qin.
Zhao Zun fought with the Qin army and failed. The Qin army killed Zhao Zun in Hexi and captured Lin and Lishi of Zhao State.
In the twenty-third year, Han Ju fought with the Qi and Wei armies and died in Sangqiu.
In the twenty-fourth year, Suhou died.
Qin, Chu, Yan, Qi, and Wei each sent 10,000 elite soldiers to attend the funeral.
Suhou's son, King Wuling, ascended the throne.
In the first year of King Wuling, Yang Wenjun Zhao Bao was appointed prime minister.
King Xiang of Liang, Prince Si, King Xuan of Han and Prince Cang came to Xin Palace to congratulate.
King Wu Ling is young and cannot handle political affairs yet. He has three learned masters and three left and right officials.
When it comes to handling government affairs, the first thing to do is to greet the noble ministers of the late king, and to increase their rank and salary. The virtuous elderly people in the country who are over 80 years old give them gifts every month.
In the third year of King Wuling's reign, Ha City was built.
In the fourth year, he made an alliance with the King of Han in the District Rat Meeting.
Five years later, he married a Korean clan daughter.
In eight years, South Korea attacked Qin and withdrew without victory.

Qi defeated Zhao Jun in Guanze.

The state of Qi defeated the state of Yan, and the prime minister of the state of Yan, Zizhi, became the king, but the king instead became a minister.
In the eleventh year, King Wuling summoned the son of Yan State from South Korea, made him King of Yan, and sent Yuechi to escort him back to Yan State.
In the thirteenth year, the Qin army captured Zhao Ta's Lincheng and captured the general Zhao Zhuang.
The kings of Chu and Wei came to Zhao and reached Handan.
In the fourteenth year, Zhao He attacked Wei.
In the sixteenth year, King Qin Hui passed away.
King Wuling visited Daling.
One day, King Wu Ling dreamed of a girl playing the piano and singing a song: She is so beautiful, her appearance is like a wildflower.

summary: Xiangzi refused to make his own son heir, instead passing rule to his grandson Zhao Huan, who became Marquis Xian. After a brief usurpation by Xiangzi's brother, Xianhou's line continued. Subsequent rulers included Liehou, Jinghou, Chenghou, and Suhou. During Suhou's reign, Shang Yang of Qin attacked Wei. Suhou's son, King Wuling, ascended the throne. King Wuling, seeking to strengthen Zhao against enemies like Zhongshan and the Hu tribes, famously adopted Hu clothing and cavalry archery, overcoming opposition from nobles. He conquered Zhongshan and expanded Zhao's territory significantly. He later abdicated in favor of his son, King Huiwen, but a succession struggle led to his death by starvation after his son Zhao Zhang rebelled. Under King Huiwen and his successor King Xiaocheng, Zhao faced the rising power of Qin. King Xiaocheng accepted the surrender of Shangdang from Korea, provoking Qin. This led to the disastrous Battle of Changping, where Zhao Kuo replaced Lian Po and was defeated by Bai Qi, with over 400,000 Zhao soldiers killed. Qin besieged Handan, but Zhao was saved by reinforcements from Chu and Wei. Later, King Xiaocheng's son, King Daoxiang, and his grandson, King Youmiao, ruled as Qin's power grew. Li Mu, a capable general, won victories against Qin, but was killed due to slander. Finally, in 228 BCE, Qin captured Handan, ending the Zhao state. Zhao Jia, a brother of the last king, briefly ruled in Dai before being defeated, and Zhao was made into a Qin commandery.

translation:

After more than twenty generations of reproduction, it was passed down to Yunchang.
When Yunchang was in power, he and King Wu Helu had resentment and attacked each other.
After Yunchang's death, his son Gou Jian came to the throne and became the king of Yue.
In the first year of King Goujian of Yue, King Helu of Wu heard that Yunchang had passed away, so he raised troops to attack Yue.
King Gou Jian of Yue sent warriors who dared to die to challenge the Wu army. The warriors lined up in three lines and rushed into the Wu army's position, shouting that they would kill themselves.

When Helu was dying, he warned his son Fucha: Never forget the country of Yue.

The King of Yue only gathered 5,000 remaining soldiers and the defeated generals retreated to Kuaiji.
King Wu took advantage of the victory to pursue and surrounded Kuaiji.
The King of Yue said to Fan Li: I ended up in this situation because I didn't listen to your advice. What should I do?
Fan Li replied: Those who can protect themselves must imitate the way of heaven, which is full but not overflowing; those who can calm down crises and overturns must understand that humanity advocates humility; those who can control things will follow the way and adapt to local conditions.
Now, you must be humble and courteous to the King of Wu, and send people to give generous gifts to the King of Wu. If he does not agree, go and serve him personally, and pledge yourself to the King of Wu. Gou Jian said: OK!
So he sent the official Zhong to ask for peace from Wu. Zhong knelt on the ground and kowtowed as he walked forward and said: Gou Jian, the king's subjugated subject, asked me to boldly tell your subordinates: Gou Jian asks you to allow him to be your slave and his wife to be your concubine.
King Wu will agree to plant it.

Zane returned to Echigo and told Gou Jian about the situation.
Gou Jian wanted to kill his wife and children, burn his treasures, and go to the battlefield to fight to the death.

His descendants tattooed their bodies, cut their hair short, developed wasteland, and built cities. After more than twenty generations, rule passed to Yunchang, who had conflicts with King Helu of Wu. After Yunchang's death, his son Gou Jian became king. In Gou Jian's first year, King Helu of Wu attacked Yue. Gou Jian sent death-defying warriors who lined up in three rows and rushed into Wu's position, shouting they would kill themselves. translation:
Zhong stopped Gou Jian and said, "Pu, the chief minister of Wu State, is very greedy. We can seduce him with a lot of money. Please allow me to contact him secretly to negotiate peace."

Seven years after Gou Jian returned from Kuaiji, he always comforted his soldiers and people, hoping to take revenge on Wu.

Besides, isn’t it just for the sake of the Kingdom of Wu that the king goes to court in the morning and leaves the court in the evening?
I have been planning to conquer Wu for twenty-two years. Once I give up, can I do this?
If you don't take what God has given you, you will be punished. Use an ax to chop wood to make an ax handle. The pattern of the ax handle is always around.
Has the king forgotten the suffering of Kuaiji?
Gou Jian said: I want to follow your advice, but I cannot bear to treat his envoys like this.
Fan Li then beat the drum and marched, saying: "The king has entrusted me with the government affairs. The envoy from the State of Wu must leave as soon as possible, otherwise he will be punished."
The envoy from Wu State cried sadly and left.
Gou Jian took pity on him and sent someone to tell King Wu: "I will arrange for you to go to Yongdong!" Rule a hundred families.
King Wu declined and said: I am already old and can no longer serve you!
After saying this, he committed suicide. When he committed suicide, he covered his face and said: I have no shame to see Zixu!
The king of Yue buried the king of Wu and killed Dazai Pei.

The next spring, while Wu's elite troops were at Huangchi with King Wu, Yue attacked, killed Wu's prince, and defeated Wu's forces. King Wu hid the news and sought peace. translation:

Fan Li then left the King of Yue and sent a letter to Dr. Zhong from Qi. The letter said: When the birds are gone, the good bow is hidden; when the cunning rabbit dies, the running dogs are cooked.
The King of Yue is a long-necked bird with a beak. You can only share adversity with him, but you cannot share happiness with him. Why don't you leave?
After reading the letter, Zhong claimed that he was ill and would no longer go to court.
Someone slandered Zhong and was about to cause rebellion. The King of Yue rewarded Zhong with a sword and said: You taught me seven strategies to attack Wu. I only used three of them to defeat Wu. The four are still with you. Go to the late king for me and try those four!
Zhong then committed suicide.
Gou Jian died, and his son Wang Yaoyu ascended the throne.
Wang Junyu died, and his son Wang Bushou came to the throne.
Wang Bushou died and his son Wang Weng came to the throne.
Wang Weng died and his son Wang Yi came to the throne.
When Wang Yi died, his son Wang Zhihou came to the throne. When Wang Zhihou died, his son Wang Wuqiang came to the throne.
When King Wuqiang of Yue was on the throne, Yue sent troops to attack Qi to the north and Chu to the west, competing with other countries in the Central Plains for victory.
During the reign of King Wei of Chu, the State of Yue attacked the State of Qi. King Qi Wei sent people to persuade the King of Yue, saying: If the State of Yue does not attack the State of Chu, it will not be able to become king in a big way, and it will not be hegemonic in a small way.
It is estimated that the reason why Yue did not attack Chu was because it could not get the support of Han and Wei. Han and Wei did not attack Chu in the first place.
If South Korea attacks Chu, its army will be destroyed, its generals will be killed, and Ye and Yangzhai will be in danger; if Wei attacks Chu, its army will be destroyed, its generals will be killed, and Chen and Shangcai will not be stable.
Therefore, if Han and Wei serve Yue, their army will not be destroyed, their generals will not be killed, and their hard work will not be revealed. Why do you value the support of Han and Wei?
The King of Yue said: What I ask of Han and Wei is not to engage in a life-and-death fight with the Chu army, let alone to allow them to attack the city and besiege the city.
I hope that the Wei army will gather under Daliang City, and the Qi army will train in Nanyang and Ju, and gather at the border of Chang and Tan. Then the Chu army outside Fangcheng will no longer go south, and the Chu army between Huai and Si will no longer go east.
Then, the four kingdoms of Qi, Qin, Han, and Wei can realize their wishes in Chu. In this way, Han and Wei can expand their territory without fighting, and can harvest without cultivating.
Now, Han and Wei do not do this, but they attack each other between the Yellow River and Huashan, and are used by Qi and Qin. The expected Han and Wei were so misguided, how could they rely on them to become kings!
The envoy of Qi State said: It's a lucky thing that Yue State did not perish!
summary: After pacifying Wu, Gou Jian marched north, met with Qi and Jin princes at Xuzhou, and paid tribute to Zhou. King Yuan of Zhou rewarded him. Gou Jian donated land to Chu, Song, and Lu. The Yue army marched unimpeded, and Gou Jian became overlord. Fan Li then left, sending a letter to Zhong from Qi, saying: "When birds are gone, the good bow is hidden; when cunning rabbit dies, running dogs are cooked. You can only share adversity with the king, not happiness." Zhong claimed illness but was slandered as rebellious. The king sent him a sword, saying he had used three of Zhong's seven strategies against Wu and should try the remaining four with the late king. Zhong committed suicide.

translation:
I don't value their use of wisdom, because that wisdom is like eyes. Although they can see the hairs, they cannot see their own eyelashes.
Today the king knows that Han and Wei made a mistake, but does not know his own fault. This is the metaphor of eyes that can see the hair but cannot see their own eyelashes.
What the king expected from Han and Wei was not to gain their contribution, nor to unite with the Han and Wei coalition forces, but to disperse the strength of the Chu army.
Now that the Chu army has dispersed, why should it ask for help from Han and Wei?
The king of Yue said: What should I do?
The envoy said: The three great officers of the Chu State have divided all their troops and surrounded Quwo and Yuzhong to the north until Wuxiaguan. The total length of the battle line is 3,700 miles. Jingcui's army has gathered in the north of Lu, Qi, and Nanyang. Is there any force that can exceed this dispersion?
Moreover, what the king wants is to make Jin and Chu fight. If Jin and Chu do not fight, and Yue does not send troops, then he only knows two fives but does not know ten.
At this time, I did not attack the Chu State. Therefore, I judged that the King of Yue did not want to be king in a big way, but he did not want to be hegemony in a small way.
Besides, Jiu, Pang, and Changsha are areas rich in grain in Chu State, and Jingzeling is an area rich in timber in Chu State.
If the State of Yue sends troops to clear the Wuxian Pass, these four places will no longer be able to contribute food and materials to the capital of Ying.
I've heard that people who plan to be king can't be king, but they can still be king.
However, those who cannot dominate will lose their royal power completely.
Therefore, I sincerely hope that you will attack Chu instead.
So Yue gave up Qi and attacked Chu.
King Chu Wei sent troops to attack the Yue army, defeated the Yue army, killed the Yue King Wuqiang, captured all the land from Wu to Zhejiang, and defeated the Qi army in Xuzhou in the north.
From then on, the Yue Kingdom fell apart, and the children of various ethnic groups competed for power. Some claimed the title of king, and some claimed the title of emperor. They lived on the coast south of the Yangtze River and paid tribute to the Chu Kingdom obediently.
Seven generations later, the throne passed to Fujian Junyao, who assisted the princes to overthrow the Qin Dynasty.
Emperor Gao of the Han Dynasty resumed his role as the king of Yue and continued the worship of the country of Yue.
Dongyue and Minjun are both descendants of Yue.
Fan Li served King Gou Jian of Yue, worked hard physically and mentally, and tried his best to plan with Gou Jian for more than 20 years. Finally, he destroyed the state of Wu and wiped out the shame of Kuaiji. The Vietnamese army marched north to the Huaihe River and approached the borders of Qi and Shanxi. They ordered all the countries in the Central Plains to respect the Zhou Dynasty and make Gou Jian the hegemon. Fan Li became the general.
After returning home, Fan Li thought that it would be difficult to live long under such a great reputation. Moreover, Gou Jian was a man who could share hardships with him but not happiness with him. He wrote a farewell letter to Gou Jian and said: I heard that when the king is worried, his ministers will work hard, and when the king is insulted, his ministers will die.
You were humiliated in Kuaiji in the past, and the reason why I didn't die was to avenge you.
Now that I have avenged my humiliation, I beg you to grant me the death penalty for the humiliation my lord suffered in Kuaiji.
Gou Jian said: I will divide the country of Yue equally with you. Otherwise, you will be blamed.
Fan Li said: The monarch can carry out your orders, but the ministers still follow their own wishes.
So he packed up the fine jewelry and left by boat with his entourage, never returning to Yue. In recognition of Fan Li, Gou Jian made Kuaiji Mountain his fief.
Fan Li took a boat and drifted across the sea to the state of Qi. He changed his name and surname and called himself "Gui Yi Zipi". He farmed on the seaside, endured hardships and worked hard to produce, and his father and son worked together to manage the industry.
summary: Gou Jian died, and his descendants ruled for generations until King Wuqiang. During King Wei of Chu's reign, Yue attacked Qi. Qi's envoy persuaded Yue to attack Chu instead, arguing that Chu's forces were dispersed. Yue abandoned Qi and attacked Chu. King Wei of Chu defeated Yue, killed King Wuqiang, and seized all land from Wu to Zhejiang. Yue disintegrated, with various descendants competing for power, some claiming kingship, living south of the Yangtze and paying tribute to Chu. Seven generations later, Fujian Junyao helped princes overthrow Qin. Emperor Gao of Han restored Yue's kingship. Dongyue and Minjun were both Yue descendants.

translation:
After living there for a short time, he accumulated hundreds of thousands of property.
The people of Qi heard that he was a virtuous man and made him prime minister.
Fan Li sighed and said: If you live at home, you can accumulate thousands of gold and property, and if you become an official, you can reach the high position of minister. This is the highest status that ordinary people can achieve.
It is unlucky to enjoy a distinguished name for a long time.
So he returned the seal and distributed all his property to his close friends, fellow villagers and neighbors. He took the valuables with him and left secretly to live in Taodi.
He believed that this was the center of the world, with smooth roads for transactions and that one could make a fortune by doing business.
So he called himself Tao Zhu Gong.
It was also agreed that both father and son would farm and raise livestock, and wait for the opportunity when buying and selling, so as to obtain one-tenth of the profit.
Soon after, the family assets accumulated to tens of millions.
Everyone in the world praises Tao Zhugong.
Zhu Gong lived in Taodi and gave birth to a young son.
When the younger son became an adult, Zhu Gong's second son killed someone and was arrested by the state of Chu.
Zhu Gong said: It is common sense that those who kill will be punished by death.
But I heard that children with rich families will not be killed in the busy city.
So he asked his youngest son to visit Chu State.
So he took out a thousand yi of gold, put them in brown utensils, and carried them on an ox cart.
When he was about to send his younger son to go on an errand, Zhu Gong's eldest son firmly requested to go, but Zhu Gong did not agree.
The eldest son said: The eldest son in the family is called the family governor. Now that the younger brother has committed a crime, the father does not send the eldest son, but the younger brother. This shows that I am an unworthy son.
The eldest son said that he wanted to commit suicide.
His mother then said for him: If you send your younger son now, you may not be able to save your second son's life, but you will lose your eldest son first. How can that be okay?
Zhu Gong had no choice but to send his eldest son and wrote a letter to his old friend Zhuang Sheng. He also said to the eldest son: After arriving in Chu, I will send the daughter to Zhuang Sheng's house. Listen to him and do not have any disputes with him.
When the eldest son left, he also took several hundred yi of gold with him privately.
The eldest son arrived in Chu State and saw Zhuang Sheng's house close to the outer city of Chu Capital. He had to push back the weeds to reach Zhuang Sheng's house. Zhuang Sheng's living conditions were very poor.
But the eldest son still opened the letter and donated a thousand pieces of gold to Zhuang Sheng, exactly as his father asked.
Zhuang Sheng said: You can leave as soon as possible, but don't stay here!
When your brother is released, don’t ask why.
The eldest son left Zhuang Sheng's house and no longer visited Zhuang Sheng. However, he stayed in Chu State privately and gave the gold he carried to the dignitaries in charge of Chu State.
Although Zhuang Sheng lived in a poor alley, he was well-known in Chu State for his integrity and integrity, and everyone from the King of Chu on down respected him as their teacher.
Zhu Gong offered the gold, but he did not accept it intentionally. He just wanted to return it to Zhu Gong after the work was completed to show his trustworthiness.
summary: Fan Li served Gou Jian for over twenty years, destroying Wu and making Gou Jian hegemon. Recognizing that great fame was difficult to sustain and Gou Jian could not share happiness, Fan Li left by boat with valuables, never returning. He changed his name, farmed in Qi, accumulated wealth, became prime minister, then resigned, distributed his property, and moved to Taodi, calling himself Tao Zhugong. He farmed and traded, accumulating millions. His second son killed someone in Chu. He sent his youngest son with gold to bribe his old friend Zhuang Sheng, but his eldest son insisted on going. The eldest son delivered the gold but later retrieved it when he thought amnesty would free his brother. Zhuang Sheng, ashamed, told the Chu king that the amnesty was due to bribery. The king killed Zhu Gong's son first, then issued amnesty. Zhu Gong had expected this, knowing his eldest son valued money while his youngest would spend freely. Fan Li died of old age in Taodi.

translation:
Fan Li moved three times and became famous all over the world. He didn't just leave somewhere randomly. He became famous wherever he lived.
In the end, he died of old age in Taodi, so people in the world called him Tao Zhugong.
Tai Shigong said: Xia Yu's contribution was great. He channeled the nine great rivers and stabilized the land of Kyushu. To this day, the whole of Kyushu is safe and sound.
When his descendant Gou Jian arrived, he worked hard and thought far, and finally destroyed the powerful Wu State, marched north to the Central Plains, worshiped the Zhou Dynasty, and became the overlord.
Can you say that you are not virtuous?
This is probably the legacy of Xia Yu.
Fan Li moved three times and left a glorious reputation that will last forever.
Is it possible for a minister and a monarch to do this without becoming famous?
summary: Tai Shigong commented: Xia Yu's contributions were great, channeling rivers and stabilizing Kyushu. His descendant Gou Jian worked hard, destroyed Wu, and became overlord—truly virtuous, likely Xia Yu's legacy. Fan Li moved three times, leaving a glorious reputation.

translation:
Duke Huan of Zheng was the youngest son of King Zhou Li and the younger brother of King Zhou Xuan.
Twenty-two years after King Xuan ascended the throne, Youcai was granted the title of Zhengdi.
He was sealed for thirty-three years, and the people all loved him.
King You appointed him as Situ.
He made the people of Zhou Dynasty live in harmony, and the people were very happy. People in the Yellow River and Luoshui basins missed him.
When he was a Situ for a year, because King You doted on Bao Si and neglected political affairs, the problems became difficult to recover. Some princes betrayed King You. So Huan Gong asked Tai Shibo: "The royal family is in serious disaster. How can I escape from death?"
Tai Shibo replied: Only the east of Luoshui and the south of the Yellow River can live in peace.
Duke Huan asked: Why?
Tai Shibo replied: The kings of the neighboring countries of Guo, Hao, Guo and Hao in that area were greedy and liked to take advantage of small things, so the people did not obey them.
Now, you are Situ, and the people love you. If you really ask to live in that area, the kings of Guo and Hao will easily give you land if they see that you are legitimate.
If you really live in that area, the people of Guo and Hao will be your people. Duke Huan: I want to live in the Yangtze River Basin in the south. How about it?
Taishi replied: In the past, Zhu Rong controlled fire for the Gao Xin family and made great contributions, but his descendants did not prosper in the Zhou Dynasty. Chu State is his descendant.
If the Zhou royal family is weak, Chu will surely prosper.
If the state of Chu prospers, it will definitely not be beneficial to the state of Zheng.
Duke Huan said; I want to live in the west, how about it?
Tai Shibo replied: The people there are greedy and profit-seeking, and it is difficult to live there for a long time.
Duke Huan said: If the Zhou royal family is weak, which country will prosper?
Tai Shibo replied: Qi, Qin, Jin, Chu, right?
Qi State, whose surname was Jiang, was a descendant of Boyi, who assisted Yao in managing the ceremonial system.
Qin, whose surname is Ying, is a descendant of Boyi, who assisted Shun in bringing many tribes into submission.
As for the ancestors of the Chu State, they have also established meritorious deeds for the people of the world.
After King Wu of Zhou defeated King Zhou, King Cheng granted the Tang Dynasty to Shuyu. The mountains and rivers there were dangerous. With these virtuous descendants coexisting with the weak Zhou family, the Jin Kingdom would definitely be able to prosper. Duke Huan said: OK.
So he quickly asked King You for instructions and moved his people to the east of Luoshui. As expected, the kings of Guo and Xi donated ten cities to him, and he finally established the state of Zheng.
In the second year, Quan Rong killed King You and Duke Huan at the foot of Mount Li.
The people of Zheng supported Duke Huan's son Jutu, who was Duke Wu.
In the tenth year of Duke Wu's reign, he married the daughter of Marquis Shen as his wife, named Wu Jiang.
Wu Jiang gave birth to the prince Wusheng, but it was difficult to deliver the baby. After the birth, his wife did not like Wusheng.
Later, Wu Jiang gave birth to a younger son, Shu Duan, who was born naturally. His wife loved Shu Duan very much.
In the twenty-seventh year, Duke Wu fell ill. His wife asked him to make Duan the crown prince, but Duke Wu refused.
At that time, Duke Wu passed away and Wansheng came to the throne. This was Duke Zhuang.
summary: Duke Huan of Zheng, the youngest son of King Zhou Li, was granted the title of Zhengdi and served as Situ under King You. Loved by the people, he sought advice from Tai Shibo on escaping the Zhou royal family's impending disaster. Tai Shibo advised moving east of Luoshui and south of the Yellow River, where the greedy rulers of Guo and Hao would cede land. Duke Huan relocated his people there, establishing the state of Zheng. However, in the second year, Quan Rong killed King You and Duke Huan at Mount Li. Duke Huan's son, Duke Wu, succeeded him. Duke Wu's wife, Wu Jiang, favored their younger son Shu Duan over the crown prince Wusheng (Duke Zhuang). After Duke Wu's death, Duke Zhuang granted Shu Duan the capital, leading to rebellion. Duke Zhuang defeated Shu Duan, exiled Wu Jiang, but later reconciled with her through a tunnel.

translation:
At first, Ji Zhong was favored by Duke Zhuang. Duke Zhuang asked him to be a minister. Duke Zhuang asked Ji Zhong to marry a beautiful woman from Deng State for him and gave birth to Prince Hu. Therefore, Ji Zhong made Hu the king. This is Duke Zhao.
Duke Zhuang once married a woman from the Yong family of the Song Dynasty and gave birth to Li Gongtu.
Women of the Yong family are very favored by the monarch.
When Duke Zhuang of Song Dynasty heard that Ji Zhong supported Hu, he sent someone to trick Ji Zhong into arresting him, and threatened him: If you don't make Tu the king, you will be executed.
The king of Song also arrested Tu Qiu for taking bribes.
Ji Zhong agreed to the Song Dynasty and swore an alliance with the Song Dynasty king.
He was going to take Tu Tu back to his country and make Tu Tu his king.
Duke Zhao suddenly heard that Ji Zhong had proclaimed his younger brother Tu as king due to threats from the Song Dynasty. On Dinghai in the ninth month, he suddenly fled to the Wei Kingdom.
On the day of Jihai, he suddenly came to Zhengdu and took the throne. This was Duke Li.
In the fourth year of Li Gong's reign, he offered sacrifices to Zhong Zhuanquan.
Duke Li was concerned about this matter and secretly asked Ji Zhong's son-in-law to kill Ji Zhong.
Yong Jiu's wife was Ji Zhong's daughter. When she found out about this, she asked her mother: Which one is closer, father or husband?
The mother said: There is only one father, but there are many choices for husbands!
Ji Zhongnu told Ji Zhong about this, but Ji Zhong killed Yong Jiu and exposed his body in the busy market.
Duke Li was helpless with Ji Zhong, but he was very angry with Yong Jiu, saying: After discussing with the woman, he deserved to die. In the summer, Duke Li was driven to live in Queyi on the border.
Ji Zhong welcomed Zhao Gonghu, and on Yihai day in the sixth month, Hu returned to Zhengdu and ascended the throne.
In the autumn, Duke Li of Zheng relied on the people of the city to kill Uncle Shan, the official of Liyi, and settled in Liyi.
When the princes heard that Duke Li had escaped, they attacked Zheng Guo, but they left without defeating Zheng Guo.
The State of Song gave Duke Li a large number of troops and asked him to stand guard in Liyi. Therefore, the State of Zheng stopped attacking the city.
In the second year of Duke Zhao, when Duke Zhao became the crown prince, his father, Duke Zhuang, wanted to make Gao Qumi his minister. The prince suddenly disliked Gao Qumi. Duke Zhuang did not listen to Hu's advice and finally made Qumi his minister.
When Zhaogong came to the throne, Qumi was worried that Zhaogong would kill him. On Xinmao day in October in winter, Qumi and Zhaogong went hunting and shot Zhaogong in the countryside.
Ji Zhong and Qu Mi did not dare to accept Duke Li, so they made Zhao Gong's younger brother Zi Qi the king instead, and they called him Zi Qi. He had no posthumous title.
In the seventh month of the first year of Ziqian, Duke Xiang of Qi met with the princes at the first stop. Zheng Ziqian went to the meeting, assisted by Gao Qumi, who followed Ziqian there. Ji Zhong excused himself from illness.
The reason why Ji Zhong did this was because Zi Qi once fought with Xianggong of Qi when he was a prince, and the two sides became enemies. When the princes met, Ji Zhong asked Zi Qi not to go.
Zi Qian said: The state of Qi is strong and Duke Li lives in Yue. If I don't go, Qi will lead the princes to attack me and ask Duke Li to return to the capital.
summary: Duke Zhuang's reign saw conflicts with Zhou, Song, and Wei. He defeated King Huan of Zhou in battle but refrained from pursuing him. After Duke Zhuang's death, his son Duke Zhao briefly ruled but was ousted by Duke Li, who was backed by Song. Duke Li killed Ji Zhong but was later driven out, and Duke Zhao returned. Duke Zhao was assassinated by Gao Qumi, leading to a succession of short-lived rulers. Duke Li eventually returned, executed those who betrayed him, and reigned until his death. His son Duke Wen succeeded him.

translation:
In the twenty-fourth year, Duke Wen had a concubine named Yan Ji. She dreamed that the Emperor of Heaven gave her an orchid and said: I am Bo Min.
I am your ancestor.
Use this orchid to be your son. The orchid has a strong and mellow aroma.
Yan Yan told Wen Gong about this dream, and Wen Gong slept with her. And gave her bluegrass as a voucher.
So Yan Ji gave birth to a son, named Lan.
In the thirty-sixth year, Duke Chong'er of Jin passed by the state of Zheng, and Duke Wen of Zheng was not polite to him.
Uncle Zhan, Wen Gong's younger brother, said: "Chong'er is a wise man and has the same surname as us. He passed by you when he was in poverty. You cannot be rude to him."
Duke Wen said: "There are many fugitive princes from the princes passing by here. How can I receive them according to the courtesy?"
Uncle Zhan said: "If you don't treat him politely, kill him. If you don't kill him, if he returns to the country, he will be a worry to the state of Zheng."
Duke Wen did not listen to Uncle Zhan's advice.
In the spring of the thirty-seventh year, Duke Chong'er of Jin returned to Jin and ascended the throne. He was Duke Wen of Jin.
In the autumn, the State of Zheng invaded the State of Hua, and the State of Hua only obeyed Zheng's orders. Soon, the State of Hua joined the State of Wei, so the State of Zheng attacked the State of Hua again.
King Zhou Xiang asked Bo Fu to intercede on behalf of the Hua Kingdom. Zheng Wengong resented King Hui for fleeing to Yue. It was Wen Gong's father, Li Gong, who escorted King Hui back to the throne. However, King Hui did not reward Duke Li with a salary for the throne. He also resented King Xiang for joining the Wei Kingdom and the Hua Kingdom. Therefore, Wen Gong did not listen to King Xiang's intercession for the Hua Kingdom and instead imprisoned Bo Fu.
King Xiang was very angry and united with the Zhai people to attack Zheng State, but failed to win.
In winter, the Zhai people attacked King Xiang of Zhou, and King Xiang fled to Zheng State. Zheng Wengong asked King Xiang to live in Chi.
In the thirty-eighth year, Duke Wen of Jin sent King Xiang of Zhou back to Chengzhou.
In the forty-one year, Zheng Guo helped Chu State attack Jin State.
Because Jin Wengong passed by Zheng and Zheng was rude to him, Zheng betrayed Jin and helped Chu.
Forty-three years ago, Duke Wen of Jin and Duke Mu of Qin jointly besieged the capital of Zheng. They attacked Jun Zheng for helping Chu to attack Jin, and Wen Gong passed by Jun Zheng for his rude crime.
At the beginning, Zheng Wengong had three wives and five beloved sons, all of whom died early due to their crimes.
Zheng Wengong hated Zi Xia and drove away the princes.
Zilan fled to Jin and followed Duke Wen of Jin to besiege Zhengdu.
At that time, Zilan served Duke Wen of Jin with great respect, and Duke Wen of Jin favored him very much. He acted secretly in Jin and took the opportunity to ask to return to Zheng to be the crown prince.
At this time, the state of Jin wanted to get Shu Zhan and kill him.
Duke Wen of Zheng was very frightened and did not dare to tell Uncle Zhan. When Uncle Zhan heard about this, he told Zheng Jun: I once told you that I wanted to kill Chong'er, but you didn't listen to me. Jin has finally become a worry for our country.
But the reason why Jin State besieged the capital of Zheng was because of me. If I die, I can pardon Zheng State. This is my wish.
So Uncle Zhan committed suicide.
The people of Zheng gave Uncle Zhan's body to the State of Jin.
Duke Wen of Jin said: I definitely want to see Lord Zheng and insult him before leaving.
The people of Zheng were worried about this, so they sent someone to tell Qin privately: Defeating Zheng is good for Jin, not Qin.
summary: Duke Wen's reign involved conflicts with Jin and Chu. He was rude to Chong'er (later Duke Wen of Jin), who later besieged Zheng. Duke Wen's son Zilan, favored by Jin, became crown prince and later Duke Mu. Duke Mu's reign saw Qin's failed attack on Zheng, exposed by merchant Xian Gao. Zheng allied with Jin against Qin. After Duke Mu's death, Duke Lin was killed by Zigong over a turtle soup dispute. Duke Xiang succeeded him, facing Chu attacks and shifting alliances between Jin and Chu. Duke Xiang surrendered to Chu but was spared by King Zhuang.

translation:
After discussing this with Zichan, Duke Ping and his uncle praised him and said: Yes, you are truly worthy of being a knowledgeable gentleman!
Give your son a generous gift.
In the summer of the twenty-seventh year, Duke Jiang of Zheng went to pay homage to the king of Jin.
In the winter, the state of Zheng was afraid that King Ling of Chu was powerful, so he paid homage to the state of Chu, and Zichan followed him.
In the twenty-eighth year, Zheng Jun fell ill and sent Zichan to meet with the princes and make an alliance with King Ling of Chu in Shen. King Chu killed Qi Guo Qingfeng.
In the thirty-sixth year, Duke Jian passed away, and his son Ding Gongning came to the throne.
In autumn, Duke Dinggong paid homage to Duke Zhao of Jin.
In the first year of Ding AD, the prince of Chu State Qi Ji killed the king of the country, King Ling, and established himself as king. This was King Ping.
King Ping wanted to do something benevolent and moral among the princes, so he returned all the land that King Ling had invaded from Zheng to Zheng.
In four years, Jin Zhaogong passed away. The six ministers of Jin became stronger and the country's power weakened.
Zichan said to Han Xuanzi: To hold power must be based on benevolence, righteousness and morality, and do not forget the reasons for the consolidation of power.
In the sixth year, a fire broke out in the state of Zheng, and Duke Din wanted to pray to ward off the disaster.
Zichan said: It is better to practice virtuous government.
In the eighth year, Prince Jian of Chu State fled to Zheng State.
In the tenth year, Prince Jian discussed with Jin State to attack Zheng State.
Zheng Guo killed Prince Jian, and Prince Jian's son fled to Wu.
In the eleventh year, Duke Dinggong arrived in Jin.
Jin and Zheng negotiated to kill the rebellious ministers of the Zhou royal family and send King Jing back to Zhou.
In the thirteenth year, Duke Ding passed away and his son Xiangong Hui came to the throne.
Duke Xian died in the thirteenth year, and his son Sheng Gongsheng ascended the throne.
At this time, the six ministers of Jin became stronger and invaded Zheng's territory, causing Zheng to decline.
In the fifth year of Duke Sheng's reign, the Prime Minister of Zheng died. The people of Zheng all cried, mourning for him as they mourned for their own relatives.
Zichan is the youngest son of Zheng Chenggong.
Be kind and caring to others, serve the king with loyalty and honesty.
Confucius once passed by the state of Zheng and was as close as brothers to Zichan.
When he heard that Zichan had died, Confucius cried sadly: Zichan's benevolence is really a legacy from ancient times!
In the eighth year, the Fan and Zhongxing clans of Jin rebelled against Jin. Jin asked Zheng for help, and Zheng rescued them.
The Jin State therefore attacked the Zheng State and defeated Zheng's army at Tieba.
In the fourteenth year, Duke Jinggong of Song Dynasty destroyed Cao State.
Twenty years later, Tian Chang of the State of Qi killed his own monarch, Duke Jian, and Tian Chang became the Prime Minister of the State of Qi.
In the twenty-second year, King Hui of Chu destroyed the state of Chen.
Confucius passed away.
In the thirty-sixth year, Zhibo of Jin State attacked Zheng State and captured nine cities.
In the thirty-seventh year, Duke Sheng passed away, and his son Duke Ai came to the throne.
In the eighth year of Duke Ai, the people of Zheng killed Duke Ai and made Chou, the younger brother of Duke Sheng, the king of the country.
In the third year of Gong Gong's reign, the three Jin Dynasties destroyed Zhibo.
In the thirty-first year, Gonggong passed away, and his son Yougong came to the throne.
summary: Later rulers included Duke Cheng, who was captured by Jin for allying with Chu, and Duke Li, who was poisoned by Zi Si. Duke Jian's reign featured Zichan, a wise minister who stabilized Zheng through diplomacy and reforms. Zichan's advice to Jin's Duke Ping on gods and governance earned him praise. After Zichan's death, Zheng declined under pressure from Jin's six ministers and Han's invasions. Duke Sheng's reign saw Zichan's death, mourned by all. Confucius wept for Zichan, calling his benevolence a legacy from ancient times.

translation:
In the first year of Yougong, Han Wuzi attacked Zheng Guo and killed Yougong.
The people of Zheng appointed You Gong's younger brother as the king of the country. This was Duke Fang.
In the fifteenth year of Gong Gong's reign, Han Jinghou attacked Zheng Guo and captured Yongqiu.
Zheng Guo built the capital.
In the 16th year, Zheng Guo attacked South Korea and defeated the Korean army in Fushu.
In twenty years, Han, Zhao, and Wei became vassal states.
In the twenty-third year, Zheng Guo surrounded Yangzhai in South Korea.
In the twenty-fifth year, Zheng Jun killed Yang, the Prime Minister of the country.
In the twenty-seventh year, Ziyang's followers killed Gong Xi and made You Gong's younger brother Yi the king of the country. This was Zheng Jun.
Two years after Zheng Junyi took the throne, the people who were occupied by Zheng Guo rebelled and returned to Korea.
In the eleventh year, South Korea attacked Zheng Guo and captured Yangcheng.
In the twenty-first year, Marquis Ai of Han destroyed the State of Zheng and annexed it.
Tai Shigong said: As the saying goes, people who rely on power and interests to bond together will become estranged when the power and interests end. This is exactly the case with Fu Xia.
Although Fu Xia kidnapped and killed Zheng Zi and accepted Li Gong back as king, Li Gong eventually abandoned him and killed him. What is the difference between this approach and Jin's Rick?
But if someone like Xun Xi sticks to his integrity, he will not be able to save Xi Qi even if he dies.
Because accidents happen, there are many reasons!
summary: Zheng's final years were marked by internal strife and Korean aggression. Duke Ai was killed, and subsequent rulers faced Korean attacks. In the twenty-first year of Zheng Junyi's reign, Marquis Ai of Han destroyed Zheng, annexing its territory. Tai Shigong reflected on the fickle nature of power and loyalty, citing Fu Xia's betrayal of Zheng Zi and Li Gong's eventual execution of him, comparing it to Jin's Rick. He noted that even steadfast figures like Xun Xi could not prevent disaster, as unforeseen events often alter outcomes.

translation:
Prime Minister Chen Ping was a native of Humiao Township, Yangwu County.
Chen Ping's family was poor when he was a boy, but he loved studying. His family had 30 acres of land, and he lived with his brother Chen Bo.
Brother Chen Bo usually farmed at home, leaving Chen Ping to study abroad.
Chen Ping is tall and handsome.
Someone said to Chen Ping: How could a poor family eat and become so fat?
Chen Ping's sister-in-law was angry that Chen Ping didn't take care of the family and was not engaged in labor and production. She said: "It's just eating bran and throat vegetables. It's better to have such a brother-in-law than not."
When Uncle Chen heard these words, he divorced his wife and kicked her out of the house.
When Chen Ping grew up and it was time to marry a wife, no one from a wealthy family would marry his daughter to him, and Chen Ping felt ashamed to marry a daughter-in-law from a poor family.
After a long time, there was a rich man named Zhang Fu in Hufu. His granddaughter married five times, and each husband died. No one dared to marry her again.
Chen Ping wanted to marry her.
There was a funeral in the township. Because Chen Ping's family was poor, he went to help with the funeral. He went early and came back late to earn more money to supplement his family's income.
Zhang Fu met him at the mourning house and fell in love with the tall and burly Chen Ping; for this reason, Chen Ping left the mourning house very late.
Once, Zhang Fu followed Chen Ping to his home. The Chen family was in a remote alley near the outer city wall. They used a shabby mat as the door, but there were many wheel marks left by noble people outside the door.
After Zhang Fu returned home, he said to his son Zhang Zhong: I plan to marry my granddaughter to Chen Ping.
Zhang Zhong said: Chen Ping is poor and not engaged in productive labor. Everyone in the county laughs at what he does. Why did you marry your granddaughter to him?
Zhang Fu said: How could a man as handsome as Zhang Ping remain poor and humble for a long time?
Finally, he married his granddaughter to Chen Ping.
Because Chen Ping was poor, the Zhang family lent him money to hire him and gave him money to buy banquets to get married.
Zhang Fu warned his granddaughter: Don't serve others disrespectfully because the Chen family is poor.
Serve your elder brother Chen Bo as you serve your father, and serve your sister-in-law as you serve your mother.
After Chen Ping married a girl from the Zhang family, his wealth became increasingly abundant and his contacts became wider and wider.
Kushangli, where Chen Ping lived, worshiped the earth god. Chen Ping was the person who presided over the cutting of the meat. He distributed the sacrificial meat evenly.
The fellow villagers said: Well, the Chen family’s children are really good at cutting up sacrificial meat!
Chen Ping said: Alas, if I were allowed to rule the world, I would divide the meat like this!
After Chen Sheng raised an army, he proclaimed himself king in Chen County, sent Zhou Shi to pacify the Wei area, established Wei Jiu as the king of Wei, and fought with the Qin army in Linji.
Before that, Chen Ping had bid farewell to his brother Chen Bo and went to Linji with some young people to work under Wei Wang Jiu.
The king of Wei appointed him as his servant.
Chen Ping spoke to the King of Wei, but the King of Wei did not listen. Some people said bad things about him, so Chen Ping had no choice but to flee.
After a long time, Xiang Yu captured the land and reached the edge of the Yellow River. Chen Ping went to Xiang Yu and followed Xiang Yu into the Pass to conquer Qin. Xiang Yu gave him the title of Qing.
summary: Chen Ping, a native of Humiao Township, Yangwu County, was born into poverty but loved studying. His brother Chen Bo farmed while Chen Ping studied abroad. Tall and handsome, Chen Ping faced criticism for his lack of labor, leading his sister-in-law to complain. Chen Bo divorced her upon hearing this. When Chen Ping sought marriage, wealthy families refused him, and he hesitated to marry a poor woman. Eventually, he married Zhang Fu's granddaughter, who had been widowed five times. Zhang Fu, impressed by Chen Ping's appearance and potential, lent him money for the wedding, advising his granddaughter to serve the Chen family respectfully. After marriage, Chen Ping's wealth and connections grew. Chen Ping presided over cutting sacrificial meat for the earth god, distributing it evenly, and remarked, "If I ruled the world, I would divide it like this." During the Chen Sheng uprising, he served Wei Wang Jiu but left after his advice was ignored. He then joined Xiang Yu, who appointed him Lord Xinwu. Fearing execution after a failed campaign, Chen Ping fled to the Han king, Liu Bang, who made him a captain. Despite slander from generals like Zhou Bo and Guan Ying about his past and alleged bribery, Chen Ping defended himself, and Liu Bang rewarded him generously, appointing him to supervise the army.
