translation:
Chen Ping spent a lot of gold to create discord among the Chu army. He threatened among the generals that Zhongli Mei and others, as generals of King Xiang, had made a lot of contributions, but they could not allocate territory and become kings. They planned to join forces with the King of Han to eliminate King Xiang, divide the land of Chu, and make each of them king.
Xiang Yu became suspicious and no longer trusted Zhong Limei and others.
King Xiang had already suspected Zhong Limei and others, so he sent envoys to the Han army to find out.
The king of Han prepared a sumptuous banquet and ordered people to bring it in.
When he saw the envoy from the King of Chu, the King of Han pretended to be surprised and said: I thought it was Yafu's envoy, but it turned out to be the envoy from the King of Chu!
He also asked people to take away the wine and food, and replaced them with poor food to serve to the envoy of the King of Chu.
After the King of Chu's envoy returned, he reported the situation to King Xiang.
As expected, King Xiang was greatly suspicious of Kia's father.
Fan Zeng wanted to capture Xingyang City quickly, but King Xiang did not trust him and refused to obey.
When Fan Zeng heard that King Xiang was doubting him, he said angrily: "The major events in the world are basically settled. The king can do it himself!"
I beg to resign and return home!
Before he reached Pengcheng when he returned to his hometown, he died of a sore attack on his back.
Chen Ping then asked two thousand women to leave the east gate of Xingyang City at night. The Chu army launched an attack, and Chen Ping and the King of Han fled out of the city through the west gate of Xingyang City.
The King of Han then entered Guanzhong, collected the scattered soldiers and marched eastward again.
The next year, Han Xin, the Marquis of Huaiyin, defeated the State of Qi and proclaimed himself King of Qi. He sent an envoy to report the incident to the King of Han.
The king of Han was furious and scolded Han Xin.
Chen Ping secretly stepped on the King of Han's toes, and the King of Han also realized it, so he entertained the King of Qi's envoy generously and sent Zhang Zifang to immediately make Han Xin the King of Qi.
The king of Han granted the town of Hufu to Chen Ping.
The King of Han adopted Chen Ping's ingenious tactics and finally destroyed the Chu State.
Chen Ping once followed the King of Han as a lieutenant in the army to put down the rebellion of King Zang Tu of Yan.
In the sixth year of the Han Dynasty, someone reported that Han Xin, the king of Chu, was planning to rebel.
Emperor Gao asked the generals, who said: Send troops quickly to bury this kid alive.
Emperor Gao remained silent.
Emperor Gao asked Chen Ping, but Chen Ping declined again and again and asked: What did the generals say?
The emperor told Chen Ping what the generals said.
Chen Ping asked: Does anyone else know about the person who wrote a letter to report Han Xin's rebellion? The emperor said: No.
Chen Ping asked: Does Han Xin himself know about this situation? The emperor said: I don’t know.
Chen Ping said: Which of your Majesty's elite troops is better than that of Chu?
The emperor said: Not as good as them.
Chen Ping asked: Is there any of your Majesty's generals who can surpass Han Xin in using troops?
The emperor said: There is no one like him.
Chen Ping said: Now your Majesty's army is not as elite as the Chu State, and the generals are not as talented as Han Xin. If you send troops to attack him, you will encourage him to fight against us. I am privately worried about your Majesty's safety.
The emperor said: What should we do?
Chen Ping said: In ancient times, the emperor visited various places and met with the princes.
There is Yunmengze in the south. Your Majesty can pretend to travel to Yunmeng and meet with the princes in Chen County.
Chen County is on the western border of Chu State. When Han Xin heard that the emperor was traveling with good intentions, he must have thought that everything was fine, so he went to the outskirts to greet his majesty.
When he came to pay his respects, His Majesty took the opportunity to capture him. This was something that only a strong man could do.
Emperor Gao thought his strategy was good, so he sent envoys to inform the princes to meet in Chen County, saying that I was about to patrol Yunmeng south.
The emperor set off immediately.
The trip had not yet arrived at Chen County, and as expected, King Han Xin of Chu greeted him on the road to the outskirts.
Emperor Gao had prepared warriors in advance. When he saw Han Xin coming, he immediately took him down, tied him up, and put him in the passenger car.
Han Xin shouted: Now that the world is at peace, I should have been cooked and killed!
Emperor Gao turned around and said to Han Xin: "Stop shouting!"
Your rebellion is already very clear!
The warrior tied Han Xin's hands behind his back.
Emperor Gao then met with the princes in Chen County and all pacified Chu.
Emperor Gao returned to Luoyang, pardoned Han Xin, conferred him the title of Marquis of Huaiyin, and cut talismans with meritorious ministers to determine rewards.
At that time, he and Chen Ping broke the talisman and wanted the Chen family to be passed down from generation to generation forever, and he was granted the title of Huyouhou.
Chen Ping declined and said: This is not my credit.
The emperor said: I adopted your master's strategy and defeated the enemy. What is the credit if it's not yours?
Chen Ping said: If it weren't for Wei Wuzhi, how could I be an official in the court?
The emperor said: It can be said that you, sir, have never forgotten your roots.
So Wei Wuwu was rewarded.
The next year, Chen Ping followed Emperor Gao as a lieutenant in the army to attack the rebel King Xin of Han in Daidi.
The Han army marched in a hurry to Pingcheng, where they were besieged by the Xiongnu and had no food for seven days.
Emperor Gao adopted Chen Ping's ingenious plan and sent people to Chanyu's Yan family to clear the way, and then he was able to relieve the siege.
After Emperor Gao escaped, the plan proposed by Chen Ping has been kept strictly confidential, and no one in the world knows the inside story.
Emperor Gao returned south and passed by Qu Ni. He climbed up the city tower and saw the large houses in the county seat. He said: "This county is so spectacular!"
I have traveled all over the world and I have only seen Luoyang and this county like this.
He turned around and asked the censor: "What is the household registration of Qu Ni?"
The censor replied: At the beginning of the Qin Dynasty, there were more than 30,000 people. During the years of war, many people fled and went into hiding. Now there are only 5,000 people.
At that time, Emperor Gao ordered the imperial censor to change the title of Chen Ping to the title of Qu Nihou, allowing him to enjoy the tax income of every household in the county, and cancel the food fiefdom of Humo Township that had been previously granted.
After that, Chen Ping followed Emperor Gao as a lieutenant in the army to conquer Chen Xi and Yingbu.
He came up with six strange strategies in total, and each time he proposed a strategy, he increased the number of fiefs, a total of six times.
summary: Chen Ping advised Liu Bang to use gold to sow discord among Xiang Yu's ministers, leading to Xiang Yu's suspicion of Fan Zeng and others. Fan Zeng resigned and died. Chen Ping then helped Liu Bang escape Xingyang by sending women out the east gate while they fled west. Later, he advised against attacking Han Xin directly, instead capturing him during a meeting in Chen County. Liu Bang granted Chen Ping the title of Huyouhou, which Chen Ping attributed to Wei Wuzhi's recommendation.
rel_path: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家

translation:
Wang Ling had a good relationship with Yong Chi. Yong Chi was the enemy of Emperor Gao. Wang Ling had no intention of following Emperor Gao, so he was granted the title late and was named Marquis of Anguo.
An Guohou became the right prime minister. Two years later, Emperor Xiaohui died.
The Empress Dowager Lu wanted to make a member of the Lu family king, so she asked Wang Ling about it, and Wang Ling said: No.
Asked Chen Ping again, Chen Ping said: Yes.
Empress Dowager Lu was angry, so she pretended to promote Wang Ling to the emperor's tutor, but actually did not reuse Wang Ling.
Wang Ling became angry and resigned due to illness. He stayed behind closed doors and never met the emperor. He died seven years later.
After Wang Ling was dismissed from the post of prime minister, Empress Dowager Lu transferred Chen Ping to the right prime minister and appointed Piyang Hou Shenshi as the left prime minister.
Prime Minister Zuo does not have an office and often handles government affairs in the palace.
Shen Shi is also from Peixian County.
When the King of Han was defeated west of Pengcheng, the Chu army captured the King of Han's father and Empress Lu as hostages, forcing them to serve Empress Lu as retainers.
He later followed the Han army to defeat Xiang Yu and was granted the title of Marquis, and was favored by Empress Dowager Lu.
When he became the Prime Minister of Zuo and lived in the palace, all officials had to use him to decide national affairs.
Lu Yan often slandered Chen Ping many times because he had made plans for Emperor Gao to arrest Fan Kuai: Chen Ping ignored government affairs when he was prime minister, drank fine wine every day, and played with women.
After hearing this, Chen Ping started drinking and having fun more and more.
When Empress Dowager Lu heard about this, she was secretly happy.
She said to Chen Ping in front of Lu Yan: As the saying goes, "The words of children and women cannot be trusted. It depends on how you treat me."
Don't be afraid that Lu Yan will say bad things about you.
Empress Dowager Lu made a member of the Lu family king, and Chen Ping pretended to obey.
After the death of Empress Dowager Lu, Chen Ping conspired with Taiwei Zhou Bo, and finally killed all the Lu family and installed Emperor Xiaowen on the throne. Chen Ping was the main planner of this matter.
After examining the food, he was dismissed from the post of Prime Minister Zuo.
After Emperor Xiaowen came to the throne, he believed that Taiwei Zhou Bo had made great contributions by personally leading troops to annihilate the Lu clan. Chen Ping wanted to give up the title of Prime Minister You to Zhou Bo, so he retired due to illness.
Emperor Xiaowen had just ascended the throne and felt that Chen Ping was strangely ill, so he went to inquire about him.
Chen Ping said: During the reign of Emperor Gaozu, Zhou Bo's contribution was not as good as mine, Chen Ping.
When it came time to annihilate the Lu family, my contribution would not be as good as Zhou Bo's.
I am willing to give up the position of Prime Minister You to Zhou Bo.
So Emperor Xiaowen appointed Jianghou Zhou Bo as Prime Minister of the Right, ranking first; Chen Ping was transferred to Prime Minister of the Left, ranking second.
Chen Ping was given a thousand pieces of gold as a reward, and three thousand households were granted food fiefs.
After a period of time, Emperor Xiaowen gradually became more familiar with national affairs. When he was interviewed by ministers, he asked Zhou Bo, the right prime minister: How many cases were judged in the country in a year?
Zhou Bo apologized and said: I don’t know.
Emperor Xiaowen asked again: How much is the country's annual expenditure on money and grain?
Zhou Bo apologized again and said he didn't know. He was so anxious that he was sweating profusely and felt ashamed that he couldn't answer.
So the emperor asked Chen Ping, Prime Minister Zuo.
Chen Ping said: There is a person in charge who is responsible.
The emperor said: Who is in charge?
Chen Ping said: If your Majesty asks about the status of the judgment case, you can ask the Tingwei; if you want to ask about the income and expenditure of money and food, you can ask the history of Zhi Su Nei.
The emperor said: If each has a person in charge, then what is it that you are in charge of?
Chen Ping apologized and said: I am truly terrified!
Your Majesty did not know that I was of low intelligence, so I reluctantly held the position of prime minister.
The position of prime minister is to assist the emperor to regulate yin and yang and comply with the four seasons, to nurture all things to grow in time, to calm the barbarians and princes externally, to care for and unite the people internally, so that the ministers and officials can fulfill their duties.
After hearing this, Emperor Xiaowen praised him for his good answer.
The Right Prime Minister Zhou Bo was greatly ashamed. After he retired from the court, he complained to Chen Ping and said: Why don't you teach me how to answer these words in normal times?
Chen Ping smiled and said: "You are in a position, don't you know your responsibilities?"
If Your Majesty asks about the number of thieves in Chang'an City, will you have to make up the numbers to answer?
At this time Jianghou Zhou Bo knew that his talents were far inferior to Chen Ping.
After a while, Jianghou Zhou Bo was ill and asked to be relieved of the post of Prime Minister You, and Chen Ping took on the entire post of Prime Minister alone.
In the second year of Emperor Xiaowen's reign, Prime Minister Chen Ping passed away, and his posthumous title was Xianhou.
summary: Chen Ping devised six secret strategies, including rescuing Liu Bang from a Xiongnu siege at Pingcheng. After Liu Bang's death, Chen Ping avoided Empress Lu's suspicion by pretending to indulge in drinking and women. He conspired with Zhou Bo to eliminate the Lu clan and install Emperor Xiaowen. Chen Ping later ceded the position of Right Prime Minister to Zhou Bo, citing Zhou Bo's greater role in suppressing the Lu family. When Emperor Xiaowen questioned the prime ministers about state affairs, Zhou Bo faltered, while Chen Ping explained the prime minister's role in regulating yin and yang and ensuring officials fulfilled their duties. Zhou Bo resigned, and Chen Ping served as sole prime minister until his death in 166 BC.
rel_path: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家

translation:
His son Gonghou Chenmai succeeded him.
Chen Mai died after reigning for two years, and his son Chen Hui, Marquis of Jian, succeeded him.
Chen Hui died in the 23rd year of his reign, and his son Chen He succeeded him.
In the twenty-third year of Chen He's reign, he committed the crime of seizing other people's wives and was sentenced to death. The feudal state was abolished.
Chen Ping once said: I often use secretive strategies, which is taboo in Taoism.
If my descendants are deposed, they will stop and will not rise again in the end. This is because I secretly accumulated a lot of troubles.
Afterwards, Chen Ping's great-grandson Chen Zhang relied on his relationship with the Wei family to hope to inherit the original title of the Chen family, but this failed in the end.
Tai Shigong said: When Prime Minister Chen Ping was young, he originally liked the teachings of Huangdi and Laozi.
As he sliced ​​the sacrificial meat on the chopping block, his ambitions were already high.
He wandered between Chu and Wei, and finally surrendered to Emperor Gao.
He often comes up with ingenious ideas to resolve numerous crises and eliminate disasters in the country.
During the reign of Empress Lu, many things happened, but Chen Ping was still able to avoid disasters, stabilize the Han Dynasty, maintain a glorious reputation throughout his life, and was called a virtuous prime minister. Isn't this a good beginning and a good end?
Without wisdom and strategy, who could achieve this?
summary: Chen Ping's descendants inherited his title but lost it due to crimes. He once remarked that his secretive strategies were taboo in Taoism, predicting his descendants' decline. Sima Qian praised Chen Ping for his wisdom and ability to navigate crises, maintaining a glorious reputation as a virtuous prime minister.

translation:
Things cannot develop fully in both aspects. It will probably take until the fall of Chen State that his descendants will prosper, right?
Duke Li of Chen married a woman from the State of Cai, who committed adultery with a man from the State of Cai. Duke Chen Li also went to the State of Cai many times to have sex with other women.
In the seventh year, the three younger brothers of Prince Huan, who was killed by Duke Li, were named Yue, Lin, and Chujiu. They asked the Cai people to seduce Duke Li with beautiful women. Then the three of them killed Duke Li together with the Cai people, and Li Yue became the king, which is Duke Li.
Duke Li was the son of Duke Huan.
Duke Li died five months after he ascended the throne, and his second brother Lin succeeded him as Duke Zhuang.
Duke Zhuang died after reigning for seven years, and his youngest brother Chujiu succeeded him as Duke Xuan.
In the third year of Xuangong's reign, King Wu of Chu passed away, and the state of Chu began to become stronger.
In the seventeenth year, King Zhou Hui married Chen Jun's daughter as his queen.
In the twenty-first year, Duke Xuan later gave birth to a son named Ji, whom he favored. Duke Xuan wanted to make him the prince, so he killed the original prince Yu Kou.
The imperial bandit had always liked Li Gong's son Wan, but Wan was afraid that he would be harmed, so he fled to Qi.
Duke Huan of Qi wanted Chen Wan to be his minister. Chen Wan said: As a minister living abroad, I am lucky enough not to do hard work. It is the favor you have given me. I dare not hold a high official position.
Duke Huan asked him to be an official of work and integrity.
Qi Yizhong wanted to marry his daughter to Chen Wan, so he first performed a divination. The divination said: Husband and wife are like male and female phoenixes flying together, with loud and clear chirps.
The descendants of the surname Gui will thrive in the country of the surname Jiang.
After the Five Dynasties, he will be prosperous and his status will be on par with the chief ministers.
Eight generations later, no one can compare with it.
In the thirty-seventh year, Duke Huan of Qi attacked the State of Cai, and the State of Cai was defeated. The Qi soldiers took advantage of the situation and invaded the territory of the State of Chu, heading south to Zhaoling. The army passed by the State of Chen when returning to Qi.
Chen Guo's official Yuan Taotu suspected that the Qi army was harassing them across the border, so he deceived Duke Huan of Qi and said that it would be better to return to Qi via the east road along the coast.
The road to the east was very dangerous. When Duke Huan of Qi learned the truth, he was furious and had Yuan Taotu arrested.
This year, Duke Xian of Jin forced his own prince Shen Sheng to death.
Forty-five years later, Duke Xuan died, and his son Qian succeeded him as Duke Mu.
In the fifth year of Duke Mu, Duke Huan of Qi passed away.
In the 16th year, Duke Wen of Jin defeated the Chu army in Chengpu.
In this year, Chen Mugong died, and his son Gong Gongshuo succeeded to the throne.
In the sixth year of Duke Gong of Chen, Shang Chen, the crown prince of Chu, killed his father, King Cheng of Chu, and established himself as king, King Mu of Chu.
In the eleventh year, Duke Mu of Qin passed away.
In the eighteenth year, Gonggong Chen passed away and his son Lingping Guo succeeded to the throne.
In the first year of Chen Ling, King Zhuang of Chu came to the throne.
In the sixth year, Chu State conquered Chen State.
In ten years, the state of Chen made peace with the state of Chu.
summary: The lineage and history of the State of Chen, founded by Duke Hu, a descendant of Emperor Shun. After Shun’s death, his descendants held intermittent titles until King Wu of Zhou enfeoffed Guiman (Duke Hu) in Chen to continue Shun’s sacrifices. The succession of Chen rulers is detailed, including Dukes Shen, Xiang, Xiao, You, Li, Wu, Yi, Ping, Wen, Huan, Li, Zhuang, Xuan, Mu, Gong, Ling, Cheng, Ai, Hui, Huai, and Min. Key events include Duke Li’s son Wan fleeing to Qi after fearing persecution, where his descendants later rose to power. During Duke Xuan’s reign, internal strife led to the killing of Crown Prince Yu Kou. Duke Ling’s adultery with Xia Ji and subsequent murder by her son Xia Zhengshu prompted King Zhuang of Chu to invade Chen, initially annexing it but later restoring it after advice from Minister Shen. Chen later broke its alliance with Chu, leading to repeated Chu invasions. Duke Ai’s death involved a succession crisis where his brother Zhao killed the crown prince, leading to Chu’s destruction of Chen under King Ling. King Ping of Chu later restored Chen by enfeoffing Wu (Duke Hui). The state was finally destroyed by King Hui of Chu during Duke Min’s reign. The text also briefly covers the Qi state (descendants of Yu), noting its fall 34 years after Chen. It concludes with a reflection on the enduring legacy of Shun’s descendants, contrasting their prosperity with the decline of Yu’s line, and mentions other ancient states like Teng, Xue, and Zou as minor and unrecorded.

translation:
Chen Sheng, a native of Yangcheng, was named She.
Wu Guang, a native of Yangxia, was given the courtesy name Uncle.
When Chen She was young, he was hired to plow the fields with others. Once when he stopped plowing and went to rest on the ridge of the field, he lamented and resented for a long time and said, "If anyone becomes rich in the future, let's not forget each other."
The companions who were employed with him smiled and replied: You are hired to plow the fields, how can you be rich? Chen She sighed and said: Alas!
How can small birds such as swallows and sparrows understand the lofty aspirations of geese and swans!
In July of the first year of Qin II, the poor living on the left side of the lane were recruited to defend Yuyang. A total of 900 people were stationed in Daze Township.
Chen Sheng and Wu Guang both joined the ranks of this expedition and became village commanders.
It happened to be raining heavily and the roads were blocked. They probably missed the deadline to reach Yuyang.
After the prescribed time limit, everyone should be beheaded according to the law.
Chen Sheng and Wu Guang discussed it and said: Now it is death to escape, and it is death to rise up and do a great cause. It is also death. Is it good to die for national affairs?
Chen Sheng said: The world has been suffering from the rule of the Qin Dynasty for a long time.
I heard that the second emperor was the youngest son of the first emperor. He should not succeed to the throne. The one who should succeed was the young master Fusu.
Because Fusu repeatedly advised the emperor, the emperor sent him to lead troops to station in other places.
Now some people heard that he was not guilty of any crime, but was killed by the second emperor.
The common people heard that he was very virtuous, but they didn't know that he was dead.
Xiang Yan was originally a general of the Chu State. He had made many meritorious deeds and loved his soldiers. The people of Chu State loved him.
Some people thought he was dead, others thought he was on the run and hiding.
Now, if we use the names of Princes Fusu and Xiang Yan to call for uprising to the people of the world, many people will respond.
Wu Guang thinks it is right.
So he went to divine good and bad luck. The fortune teller knew their intentions and said: "You can succeed in everything and make achievements."
But have you ever asked ghosts and gods about good or bad luck?
Chen Sheng and Wu Guang were very happy. They tried to figure out what the fortune teller meant by asking ghosts and gods about good or bad luck, and said, "This is to teach us to establish prestige among others first."
So he wrote the words "King Chen Sheng" on a piece of white silk with cinnabar, and stuffed it into the belly of the fish caught by others in a net.
The garrison soldier bought the fish and cooked it. He found the silk book in the fish belly and naturally felt very strange about it. Chen Sheng also secretly sent Wu Guang to an ancient temple overgrown with vegetation near the station, lit a bonfire at night, and imitated the voice of a fox and shouted: "Great Chu Xing, King Chen Sheng." The garrison soldiers were frightened when they heard this cry in the middle of the night.
The next morning, there was a lot of discussion among the garrison troops, and everyone was pointing and looking at Chen Sheng.
Wu Guang has always cared about others, and many people were willing to serve him.
Once, the county captain escorting the team was drunk. Wu Guang deliberately threatened to escape many times to anger the county captain, provoke him to humiliate him in public, and anger everyone.
summary: Chen Sheng, a native of Yangcheng, and Wu Guang, from Yangxia, were conscripted in July of the first year of Qin II to defend Yuyang, along with 900 others stationed in Daze Township. Heavy rain blocked the roads, causing them to miss the deadline, which meant execution by law. Chen Sheng and Wu Guang discussed that fleeing or rising up both led to death, but dying for a national cause was preferable. Chen Sheng noted the world’s suffering under Qin rule, suggesting using the names of Prince Fusu and Chu general Xiang Yan to rally support, as both were respected. Wu Guang agreed. They consulted a fortune teller, who hinted at establishing prestige through supernatural means. Chen Sheng wrote “King Chen Sheng” on silk, hid it in a fish, and had Wu Guang mimic a fox’s cry at night, shouting “Great Chu will rise, King Chen Sheng.” The garrison soldiers were startled and discussed it the next day.

translation:
As expected, the county lieutenant whipped Wu Guang, and the county lieutenant drew his sword again. Wu Guang rose up, grabbed the sword, and killed the county lieutenant.
Chen Sheng assisted Wu Guang and killed two county captains together.
Then he summoned his subordinates and said: "Everyone has encountered heavy rain here. Everyone has missed the deadline to go to Yuyang. If you miss the deadline, you will be beheaded according to regulations."
Even if they are not beheaded, six out of ten people will definitely die while guarding the border in the future.
Besides, as long as a man dies, he must be famous for future generations. Are princes, generals and ministers all born noble?
After hearing this, all the subordinates said in unison: We are willing to obey the orders.
So Chen Sheng and others staged an uprising in the name of Prince Fusu and Chu general Xiang Yan to comply with the people's wishes.
Everyone showed their right arms as a sign, under the banner of "Great Chu".
They also built a high platform to take the oath and used the general's head as a sacrifice.
Chen Sheng appointed himself as general and Wu Guang as captain.
First they attacked Daze Township, and after that they attacked Qixian County.
After Qixian was captured, he sent Ge Ying from Fuli to lead his troops to capture the area east of Qixian.
They attacked Qi, Feng, Kuzhe and Qiao in succession and captured them all.
As they marched, they continued to replenish their troops and expand their ranks. By the time they reached Chen County, they had six to seven hundred chariots, more than a thousand cavalry, and tens of thousands of infantry.
When Chen County was attacked, the county guards and magistrates there were not in the city. Only the county magistrate who stayed behind led the troops and fought with the rebels under the city gate.
As a result, the county magistrate was defeated and died, so the rebel army entered the city and occupied Chen County.
A few days later, Chen Sheng ordered the three elders in charge of education and local heroes to be summoned for a meeting.
Everyone present said: General, you are wearing armor and holding sharp weapons. You have attacked the unprincipled king, destroyed the tyrannical Qin Dynasty, and re-established the Chu State. In terms of merit, you should be called the king. Chen She then proclaimed himself king and named his country Zhang Chu.
At this time, the people in various counties and counties who suffered due to the governance of the officials of the Qin Dynasty responded to Chen She by hijacking the officials to judge their crimes and killing them.
So Wu Guang was appointed as the acting king and led the generals to attack Xingyang westward.
He ordered Wu Chen, Zhang Er, and Chen Yu from Chen County to capture the original jurisdiction of Zhao, and ordered Deng Zong from Ruyin to capture Jiujiang County.
At this time, thousands of rebels from the Chu region gathered together, too many to count.
Ge Ying arrived at Dongcheng and established Xiang Qiang as King of Chu.
Ge Ying later heard that Chen Sheng had proclaimed himself king, so he killed Xiang Qiang and reported back to Chen Sheng.
As soon as he arrived in Chen County, Chen Sheng killed Ge Ying.
Chen Sheng ordered Wei people Zhou Shi to go north to capture the places that originally belonged to the Wei state.
Wu Guang surrounded Xingyang.
Li You was appointed as the governor of Sanchuan County to defend Xingyang, but Wu Guang could not attack it for a long time.
Chen Sheng summoned the heroes of the country to discuss countermeasures and appointed Cai Ci, the Lord of Shangcai Renfang, as the Shangzhu Kingdom.
summary: Wu Guang, known for his care, provoked a drunken county captain, who whipped him and drew his sword. Wu Guang killed the captain, and Chen Sheng helped kill two others. Chen Sheng addressed the troops, stating that missing the deadline meant beheading, and even if spared, many would die guarding borders. He declared that princes and generals were not born noble. The troops pledged obedience. They rebelled in the names of Fusu and Xiang Yan, baring their right arms under the banner “Great Chu.” They built an altar, sacrificed the captain’s head, and Chen Sheng declared himself general, Wu Guang as captain. They attacked Daze Township and Qi County, then sent Ge Ying to capture eastern areas, taking Qi, Feng, Kuzhe, and Qiao. As they marched, their forces grew to six to seven hundred chariots, over a thousand cavalry, and tens of thousands of infantry by the time they reached Chen County. The county magistrate was killed, and they occupied the city. Chen Sheng summoned local elders and heroes, who praised him for attacking the tyrannical Qin and re-establishing Chu, urging him to become king. He proclaimed himself king of Zhang Chu. People in various counties responded by killing Qin officials. Wu Guang was appointed acting king to attack Xingyang westward. Chen Sheng ordered Wu Chen, Zhang Er, and Chen Yu to capture Zhao, and Deng Zong to take Jiujiang. Ge Ying killed Xiang Qiang, whom he had made king of Chu, after hearing of Chen Sheng’s kingship, but Chen Sheng executed Ge Ying. Zhou Shi was sent north to capture Wei lands. Wu Guang besieged Xingyang but failed to take it. Chen Sheng appointed Cai Ci as Shangzhu Kingdom and Zhou Wen as general to lead troops west. Zhou Wen gathered forces, reaching Hangu Pass with thousands of chariots and hundreds of thousands of soldiers, but was defeated by Qin’s Zhang Han, who recruited criminals and slaves. Zhou Wen fled and committed suicide after repeated defeats.

translation:
At this time, countless generals went to various places to attack cities and occupy territory.
Zhou Shi went north to capture the city and reached Di County. Tian Dan, a native of Di County, killed the magistrate of Di County and proclaimed himself the king of Qi. He relied on the power of Qi to counterattack Zhou Shi.
Zhou Shi's army was defeated and retreated to Wei, intending to make Ningling Junjiu, a descendant of King Wei, king of Wei.
At that time, Jiu was with King Chen and could not return to Wei.
After Wei was pacified, everyone wanted to support Zhou Shi as King of Wei, but Zhou Shi refused to accept it.
The envoys went back and forth between King Chen and Zhou City five times. King Chen agreed to make Ningling Jun Jiu the king of Wei and sent him back to Wei.
Zhou Shi finally became the prime minister of Wei.
General Tian Zang and others jointly planned and said: Zhou Zhang's army has been defeated, and the Qin Dynasty's army will arrive sooner or later. Our army surrounds Xingyang City and cannot conquer it. If the Qin army comes, it will be defeated.
It is better to leave less troops, enough to surround Xingyang, and lead all the elite troops to meet the Qin army.
Now the false king Wu Guang is arrogant and rude, and does not know the tactics of using troops to fight. We cannot discuss with him. If we don't kill him, the matter may fail.
Therefore, they falsely reported that King Chen had ordered Uncle Wu to be killed and his head was dedicated to King Chen.
King Chen sent an envoy to give Tian Zang the official seal of Ling Yin of Chu State and appointed him as the general.
Tian Zang sent his general Li Gui and others to surround Xingyang City, and he led his elite troops westward to Aocang to meet the Qin army.
Fighting with the Qin army, Tian Zang died in the battle and the army was defeated.
Zhang Han marched to Xingyang City to attack Li Gui and others, defeated them, and Li Gui and others died in the battle.
Deng Yue, a native of Yangcheng, led his troops to station in Jiacheng, but was defeated by a force led by Zhang Han's general. Deng Yue led his army to flee to Chen County.
Wu Xu, a Zhi man, led his troops to station in Xu County, but Zhang Han's army defeated him. Wu Xu's army broke up and fled to Chen County.
King Chen killed Deng and said.
When Chen Sheng first became king, Qin Jia from Ling County, Dong Jie from Zhi County, Zhu Jishi from Fuli, Zheng Bu from Qilu, and Ding Ji from Xu County all formed an army to rebel against Qin. They led their troops and besieged the governor of Donghai County named Qing in Tancheng.
After King Chen heard about it, he sent Wu Pingjun as a general to supervise and lead all the armies under Tan City.
Qin Jia refused to accept this order and established himself as Grand Sima, not wanting to be subordinate to Lord Wuping.
Then he told his military officials: Mr. Wu Ping is young and does not understand military affairs. Don't listen to him!
Then he killed Wu Pingpan under the pretense of King Chen's order.
After Zhang Han defeated Wu Xu, he then attacked Chen County. Cai Ci, the king of Chen's state, was killed in the battle.
Zhang Han then led troops to attack Zhang He's troops stationed in the west of Chen County.
King Chen personally came out to supervise the battle, but the Chu army was still defeated and Zhang He was killed.
In December, King Chen retreated to Ruyin. When he returned to Xiachengfu, his coachman Zhuang Jia killed him and surrendered to the Qin army.
After Chen Sheng's death, he was buried in Dang County, and his posthumous title was King Yin.
General Lu Chen, a former minister of King Chen, organized a "Cangtou Army" with their heads wrapped in green scarves. They attacked Chen County from Xinyang. After conquering, they killed Zhuang Jia and made Chen County the capital of Chu.
At first, when King Chen first arrived in Chen County, he ordered Song Liu, a native of Zhi County, to lead troops to pacify Nanyang and then march to Wuguan.
After Song Liu captured Nanyang, news came that King Chen had been killed, so Nanyang was taken back by the Qin army.
Song Liu could not enter Wuguan, so he went east to Xincai. Unexpectedly, he encountered the Qin army again. Song Liu led his troops and surrendered to the Qin army.
The Qin army escorted Song Liu to Xianyang and dismantled his car to show the public.
When Qin Jia and others heard that King Chen's army had been defeated and fled, they made Jing Ju king of Chu and led their troops to Fangyu, preparing to attack the Qin army near Dingtao.
So he sent Gongsun Qing as an envoy to Qi State to meet with Qi King Tian Dan, hoping to unite with him to march together.
King Qi said: I heard that King Chen was defeated and his life and death are still unknown. How could the State of Chu declare itself king without coming to me for instructions?
Gongsun Qing said: Qi established a king without asking Chu for instructions. Why did Chu ask Qi for instructions before establishing a king?
What's more, Chu was the first to revolt against Qin, so he should give orders to the world.
Tian Dan killed Gongsun Qing.
The left and right captains of the Qin army led their troops to attack Chen County again and occupied it.
After General Lu Chen failed to escape, he regrouped his troops.
He joined forces with the army led by Yingbu, who had been a thief in Poyang and was named Dangyang Lord, and attacked the army of Qin's left and right captains again, defeated them at Qingbo, and once again made Chen County the capital of Chu.
Just when Xiang Liang supported King Huai of Chu, his grandson Xin became King of Chu.
Chen Sheng was king for a total of six months.
After becoming king, Chen County was made the capital.
Once upon a time, a fellow who had been hired to plow fields with him heard that he had become king. He came to Chen County, knocked on the palace door and said, "I want to see Chen She."
The officer guarding the palace gate wanted to tie him up.
After he repeatedly explained, he was released, but still refused to inform him.
When King Chen went out, he blocked the road and called Chen She's name.
After hearing this, King Chen summoned him and took a carriage back to the palace with him.
summary: Wu Chen proclaimed himself King of Zhao in Handan. Chen Sheng, angered, imprisoned Wu Chen’s family but released them on Cai Ci’s advice, sending congratulations to Zhao. Zhao’s generals advised against marching west, instead expanding north into Yan. Han Guang became King of Yan. Zhou Shi was defeated by Tian Dan, who declared himself King of Qi. Zhou Shi made Ningling Jun Jiu King of Wei. Tian Zang killed Wu Guang, claiming Chen Sheng’s order, and led elite troops west but died in battle. Zhang Han defeated other Chu forces. Chen Sheng killed Deng Yue and Wu Xu after their defeats. Qin Jia killed Wu Pingpan and made Jing Ju king of Chu. Zhang Han attacked Chen County, killing Cai Ci. Chen Sheng was defeated and killed by his charioteer Zhuang Jia in December. He was buried in Dang County with the posthumous title King Yin. Lu Chen killed Zhuang Jia and made Chen County Chu’s capital. Song Liu surrendered to Qin and was executed. Chen Sheng reigned for six months. His former friend visited but was killed for speaking of past events, causing others to leave. Chen Sheng appointed Zhu Fang and Hu Wu, who harshly punished officials, leading to his failure. Despite his death, his uprising led to Qin’s downfall. Emperor Gaozu of Han later honored his tomb.
