translation:
Who can receive this favor but my King Xian!
If the soul has a spirit, it will keep this favor and honor.
Alas! Forty-five years after Liu Cang was established, his son Huai Wang Liu Zhongsi. In the second year, the emperor divided the Dongping Kingdom and granted Liu Shang, Liu Zhong's younger brother, the title of King of Rencheng, and the remaining five were named marquises.
◆The biography of Liu Shang, the filial king of Rencheng, Liu Shang, the filial king of Rencheng, was granted the title in the first year of Yuanhe, and he ate the three counties of Rencheng, Kangfu and Fan. He died in the eighteenth year of his reign and was succeeded by Liu An, the king of Zizhen.
◆Liu Yanzhuan, the pledge king of Fuling, Liu Yan, the pledge king of Fuling, was granted the title of Duke of Huaiyang in the fifteenth year of Jianwu, became a king in the seventeenth year, and went to the fiefdom in the twenty-eighth year.
In the 30th year, the imperial court placed the four counties of Changping, Xihua, Xinyang and Fule in Runan under the Huaiyang Kingdom.
Liu Yan was arrogant and extravagant by nature and treated his subordinates harshly.
During the Yongping period, someone wrote to Liu Yan, his brother Xie, and his sister, Princess Guantao's son-in-law Han Guang, to recruit cunning people to make prophecies and offer sacrifices in temples.
The case was handed over for examination, and Han Guang and Xie were killed. Their confessions were implicated, and there were many capital crimes and emigrations.
A superior petitioned for Liu Yan's death. Emperor Xianzong believed that Liu Yan's crime was less serious than that of Liu Ying, the king of Chu, so he specially extended his favor and granted him the title of King of Fuling instead, giving him the salary of two counties.
Liu Yan had already moved to a feudal state, and he held grudges several times.
During the early years of the founding of the People's Republic of China, someone accused Liu Yan and his son Liu Li of treason. Someone asked Liu Yan to be summoned in a carriage to Tingwei to be imprisoned.
Suzong issued an edict: The king committed treason and injustice last time, and the circumstances were as serious as those of Uncle Guan and Uncle Cai of the Zhou Dynasty, and Huainan of the Han Dynasty.
The scriptures have justice, and the laws have clear punishments.
The late emperor couldn't bear the kindness of a kiss, and he violated the law and suffered it for the king. Everyone in the crowd was puzzled.
Now the king has no intention of repentance, his rebellious heart has not changed, and the rebellion has been broken from within, starting with his son Li, which is indeed not what this dynasty likes to hear.
I feel sorry for you and cannot bear to punish the king. Now I am demoting you to the title of Marquis of Fuling and taking the salary of a county.
This kind of sin was brought upon himself, so be warned!
The crimes of Liu Yi and others were pardoned and no investigation was carried out. An emissary was sent to guard Liu Yan's country and they were not allowed to interact with the officials.
In the first year of Zhanghe, the emperor visited Jiujiang and gave Liu Yan a letter and a chariot to meet him in Shouchun.
The emperor looked at Liu Yan and his wife and children, and felt very sad, so he issued an edict: In the past, the Zhou Dynasty had a thousand and eight hundred nobility titles, and half of them were surnamed Ji, in order to consolidate the royal family.
On my southern tour this time, I headed towards the Huaihe and Haihai areas, intending to stop at Fuling, so I met with the marquis. Seeing Hou Zhiyi decline and his body not as good as before, I felt very sad, happy and sad at the same time.
Now the restored prince is the king of Fuling, and four more counties have been enfeoffed, adding to the previous five counties.
◆In the biography of Liu Jing, the Si King of Guangling, Liu Jing was granted the title of Duke of Shanyang in the fifteenth year of Jianwu, and became the king in the seventeenth year of his reign.
Liu Jing has an impatient, insidious and harmful personality. He is talented and likes grammar.
After the death of Emperor Guangwu, the coffin was in the front hall. Liu Jing cried but did not mourn. Instead, he wrote a flying letter, sealed with a square bottom, and sent Cangtou to pretend to be the king of the East China Sea. Liu Qiang's uncle Dahonglu Guo Kuang wrote to Liu Qiang: The king is innocent and has been denounced many times, while his brothers have been bound to prison.
summary: Liu Yan, King Zhi of Fuling, was arrogant and harsh. He was accused of making prophecies and was demoted to Marquis of Fuling. He later plotted rebellion again and was demoted again. He was eventually restored as king by Emperor Zhanghe.

translation:
The Queen Mother neglected her duties and did not guard the North Palace. When she was old, she was repelled and lived far away. She was deeply regretted at home and the noses of those who rejoiced were sore.
Later, the Empress Dowager's body was found in the hall, and Luoyang officials arrested and executed the guests one after another. There was even a family with three corpses lying in the hall. It was extremely sad!
Now there is mourning in the world, and the bows and crossbows are fully equipped. A few days ago, Liang Song ordered Hu Benshi to say: If an official is wronged due to cheap things, he should do it immediately, and do not stick to the regular system, because it is difficult to get a title again!
Lang Guan was grieving privately and was heartbroken for Wang Han.
Today the servants are trying to engrave the King of Thieves for merit, but is there a limit?
If the people of the two countries are united, millions of people can be gathered, and the king will be the commander-in-chief, and the courage will be unparalleled. The achievements will be easier than Mount Taishan to crush an egg, and it will be lighter than four horses carrying a feather. This is the army of Tang and Wu!
Xuanyuan star has white energy this year. Astrologers and good people all say that those with white energy will lose their place as the heroine of Xuanyuan.
Then he went out to the west in front of the Taibai Star, and at noon the troops started to rise.
Also, the Prince's star is black in color and often turns red on the solstice.
Black is a disease, red is a soldier, and the king works hard to achieve success.
The great ancestor was the pavilion chief, and your majesty was born in Baishui. What's more, the king is your majesty's eldest son, so where is his deputy?
Above, I hope that everything in the world will be done, and below, I use snow to remove the shame of sinking and avenge my dead mother.
With sincerity, gold and stone are opened.
You should be prepared for the chilling atmosphere of the autumn frost, and don't be a sheep and be controlled by others. At that time, even if you want to be a sheep, will you be able to get it?
I saw all the physiognomists talking about the noble appearance of the king and the method of the emperor.
The leader of the people is dead, and the people of Lu Yan are still thieves. If they want to have hope, let alone the king!
The king who has been appointed is established by heaven and cannot be obtained by man.
Now the new emperor has arranged that the strong one will be on the right.
May the king do what the Great Patriarch and Your Majesty wishes, and not be like Fusu and call the general Lu Hutian!
Liu Qiang was very frightened after receiving the letter. He grabbed the envoy, sealed the letter and presented it to him.
Xianzong believed that Liu Jing was his brother from the same mother, so he concealed his story and sent Liu Jing to live in Henan Palace.
At this time, the Xiqiang rebelled, and Liu Jing was frustrated. He hoped that the world would be disturbed by the Qiang disaster, so he secretly consulted with the fortune teller.
After the emperor heard about it, he changed the title of Liu Jing to King Guangling and sent him back to his fiefdom.
Later Liu Jing called Xiang Gong again and said: I look like the late emperor.
The late emperor conquered the world at the age of thirty, and I am thirty now. Can I raise an army?
Xiang Gong reported it to the officials. Liu Jing was afraid and tied himself up and was thrown into prison.
summary: Liu Jing, King Si of Guangling, was impatient and insidious. After Emperor Guangwu's death, he wrote a seditious letter to Liu Qiang, urging him to rebel. Liu Qiang reported him. The emperor concealed the matter. Liu Jing later consulted fortune tellers and claimed to resemble the late emperor, leading to further investigations. He eventually committed suicide.

translation:
The emperor again favored him and did not pursue the matter. He issued an edict not to allow Liu Jingchen to serve as an official, but his food and rent were still the same as before. He sent a prime minister and a lieutenant to protect him.
Liu Jing still did not change.
Later, witches were used to offer sacrifices and curses, and a supervisor reported him and requested that he be killed. Liu Jing committed suicide. Liu Jingli died in the 29th year. The emperor took pity on him and gave him the posthumous title King Si. ◆The biography of Liu Heng, Huai Gong of Linhuai, Liu Heng was established in the fifteenth year of Jianwu. He died before becoming king and became king. He had no children and was removed from the country.
◆Zhongshan Jianwang Liu Yanzhuan, Liu Yan, was granted the title Duke Feng Yigong of Zuo in the 15th year of Jianwu, and became king in the 17th year. Yan was the youngest son of Empress Dowager Guo and stayed alone in the capital.
In the 30th year, he was granted the title of King of Zhongshan.
In the winter of the second year of Yongping, the kings came to meet Piyong and returned to Tibet after their affairs. They ordered Liu Yan to return to the fiefdom with them, and to follow them with tiger and beni official cavalry.
Liu Yan went to Shu and resigned, and Xianzong reported back: "Every prince must have his right and left when leaving the country, so at the meeting in Jiagu, Sima Yi followed."
Now there are hundreds of officers and cavalry from each of the five countries, marching in order. They are all barbarian cavalry from the Northern Army. Their soldiers are good at shooting. Their bows are not empty, and they will definitely hit the canthus.
Those who have civil affairs must be equipped with military equipment. This is the meaning of re-employment. There is no need for the king to refuse!
The emperor believed that Liu Yan was favored by the Empress Dowager Guo, so she favored him and gained exclusive access to the capital.
In the fifteenth year, Liu Yan's concubine Han Xu made a mistake, and Liu Yan hanged her to death. The prime minister raised a memorial and was removed from Anxian County.
During the Yuanhe period, Suzong returned Anxian County to Zhongshan. Liu Yanli lived in the fifty-second year and died in the second year of Yongyuan. Liu Xiansi, King of Ziyi. ◆The biography of King Lang Ya Xiao Wang Liu Jing, Liu Jing, was granted the title of Duke of Langji in the fifteenth year of Jianwu, and became the king in the seventeenth year of his reign.
Liu Jing was respectful and filial by nature, and loved the study of Confucian classics. Emperor Xianzong was particularly fond of him and rewarded him with special favors. No one could compare with him.
In the second year of Yongping, six counties including Gai, Nanwuyang and Hua in Taishan and Changyang, Luxiang and Dongmou in Donglai were added to Langyi.
It took five years to go to the fiefdom.
Queen Guanglie died, and the emperor gave all the gold and treasure left by the Queen Mother to Liu Jing.
Liu Jing established his capital in Ju, and he was fond of building palaces and palaces. He used extremely skillful means to decorate the walls and walls of the palaces with gold and silver.
He wrote poems and poems many times to praise his merits and virtues. The emperor praised him and wrote down to the historians.
In the Liu Jing Kingdom, there is the Chengyangjing Wang Temple, where officials worship.
The god repeatedly warned that the palace was inconvenient, so Liu Jing wrote that he would move the palace to Kaiyang and exchange the five counties of Hua, Gai, Nanshiyang, Houqiu and Ganyu for Kaiyang and Linyi in the East China Sea. Suzong agreed.
summary: Liu Heng, Duke Huai of Linhuai, died before becoming king, and his state was abolished. Liu Yan, King Jian of Zhongshan, was the youngest son of Empress Dowager Guo and stayed in the capital. He was favored by the emperor. He once hanged his concubine and was punished by losing a county. He died in the 2nd year of Yongyuan. Liu Jing, King Xiao of Langya, was respectful and filial, fond of Confucian classics. He was especially favored by Emperor Xianzong. He built magnificent palaces and wrote poems praising virtues. He died after 31 years of rule.
