translation:
Preface to the Biography of Dang Guo, Confucius said: Their natures are similar, but their habits are far apart.
This means that people's likes and dislikes are the same in nature, but their education and environment make people's temperament and conduct very different.
Therefore, a virtuous person teaches others to cultivate their character, overcome dissolute behavior, be cautious in making friends, control bias, and be fair in dealing with situations.
Although people's emotions are vastly different, and their culture and quality are also different, as for cultivating talents and revitalizing customs, the principles are the same. In the chaos of the weekend, customs are superficial and hypocritical, the country is out of order, and disciplines are lax. There are also people who use the name of benevolence to achieve their own goals and rely on loyalty to make their careers successful.
If the behavior is in line with the law, even the cruel and brutal people will have to submit; if the words are irrational, the base and ignorant people can also feel it.
The things left by the wise people of the past are worth learning.
As tyranny declines, fraud occurs.
The strong prevail through decisive victory, while the weak suffer due to deceit.
Some even received tens of thousands of gold for half an idea, and some received treasures for one word.
Some people were born as common people and became high officials, and were promoted to ministers. People who are eloquent and resourceful, who show off their talents in order to gain fame and wealth, come unexpectedly.
Since then, lovers have been fighting each other. As time goes by, this trend is irreversible and the evils cannot be reversed.
By the time Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty rose to power with his sword, people who advocated force had sprung up. The laws were relaxed and the etiquette was simple and unobtrusive. They inherited the style of the four monarchs of Xinling, Pingyuan, Chunshen, and Mengchang. Everyone cherished the mentality of aggression and condescension, despised life and death, valued loyalty, and repaid each other if they had grievances and virtues. Orders were given to private individuals, and power was in the hands of ordinary men. It became a social custom to let the knights be the best.
Since Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, Confucianism has been promoted, and scholars of Confucianism and Confucianism can be found everywhere. There was even a debate about the Six Arts in Shiqu Pavilion, and those who agreed with me became friends; those who disagreed attacked me. People who value literature are at their peak at this time.
When Wang Mang took power and deceived himself, he finally usurped the throne of the Han Dynasty. Those who are loyal to the Han Dynasty and have a righteous mind are ashamed to serve as an official for Wang Mang, those who regard seclusion as an honor and are willing to be poor.
Although Guangwu was revived and Han Dynasty was re-established, his wiseness to protect himself and his uprightness and self-restraint still made everyone envious of him. The important issue of being an official and not being an official is of great importance in current affairs!
In the era of Emperor Huan and Emperor Ling, the monarchy was in chaos and politics was corrupt. The lifeline of the country was in the hands of the eunuchs. Scholars thought it was shameful to be with them. Therefore, the common people were indignant, and the virgins discussed freely, flaunted their honor, praised each other, evaluated the ministers, and discussed the gains and losses of governing. The upright atmosphere became widespread.
What the top likes, the bottom likes more. To correct the crookedness, it must be straightened. This is the truth!
summary: Confucius stated that human natures are similar but habits diverge greatly, meaning education and environment shape conduct. Virtuous people teach others to cultivate character, overcome dissolute behavior, and be cautious in making friends. During times of chaos, customs became superficial, and some used benevolence and loyalty as tools for personal gain. By Emperor Gaozu's rise, martial advocates emerged, inheriting the style of the four lords—Xinling, Pingyuan, Chunshen, and Mengchang—where people valued loyalty and vengeance. Under Emperor Wu, Confucianism flourished, with scholars debating the Six Arts at Shiqu Pavilion, forming factions based on agreement or disagreement. When Wang Mang usurped the Han throne, loyal scholars refused to serve him, preferring poverty and seclusion. Although Guangwu revived the Han, the issue of serving in office remained critical. During Emperors Huan and Ling's reigns, eunuchs controlled the government, and scholars considered it shameful to associate with them. Commoners became indignant, and upright scholars freely discussed governance, praising each other and criticizing ministers. This righteous atmosphere spread widely, but eventually led to the disaster of the Party禁锢, as seen with Fan Pang and Zhang Jian.

translation:
Isn't it true that Fan Pang, Zhang Jian, etc., suffered from bad governance during the Qing Dynasty, and finally fell into the disaster of the Party's control?
In the past, Emperor Huan was the Marquis of Liwu. He learned from Zhou Fu in Ganling and became the emperor. He promoted Zhou Fu to be the minister.
At that time, Yin Fangzhi of Henan, who was in the same county as Zhou Fu, was very famous in the court. The people in the village made two songs: Fang Bowu is the rule in the world, and Zhou Zhongjin was awarded the seal because of his division.
The guests from the two families ridiculed each other, so they each made friends, which gradually became enemies. As a result, Ganling was divided into northern and southern parts, and the name of the party members began to exist.
Later, the prefect of Runan, Zongzi, appointed Cao Fanpang, and the prefect of Nanyang, Cheng Jin, also appointed the meritorious Cao Cenri. The two counties also composed a ballad saying: Fan Mengbo, the prefect of Runan, is the master of Nanyang Zongzi.
Nanyang Prefect Cen Gongxiao, Hongnong Cheng Jindan sat and whistled.
Therefore, rumors spread to the Imperial College, and there were more than 30,000 students there. Guo Linzong and Jia Weijie were the leaders, and they all respected each other with Li Ying, Chen Fan, and Wang Chang.
There is a rumor in the school: Li Yuanli is a model in the world, Chen Zhongju is not afraid of force, and Wang Shumao is a handsome man in the world.
In addition, the Bohai clan has advanced, and Fufeng and Wei Qiqing all dare to speak out and are not afraid of the powerful.
From the ministers down, everyone who was not afraid of their accusations came to accept them one after another.
At that time, Zhang Cheng in Hanoi was good at fortune telling. He used the wind in all directions to predict good and bad luck. He speculated that the court would grant amnesty, so he taught his son to kill people.
Li Ying was the Yin of Henan and urged the arrest of Zhang Cheng. Soon, when the imperial court pardoned him and exempted him from arrest, Li Ying became even more angry and arrested and executed him.
At first, Zhang Cheng used astrology to make friends with eunuchs, and the emperor once asked Zhang Cheng about his divination.
Therefore, Zhang Cheng's disciple Lao wrote a letter and falsely accused Li Ying and others of adopting Taixue travellers, making friends with students in various counties, causing trouble, forming cliques, slandering the court, and disrupting customs.
So the emperor became angry, promulgated the prefectures, arrested party members, and announced to the whole world that they shared the same hatred with the enemy. So Li Ying and others were arrested.
There were more than 200 Chen Chen's followers mentioned in the confession. Some of them escaped but were not caught, and rewards were offered for their capture.
People were sent out to search and hunt, and there was an endless stream of people on the road.
The next year, Shangshu Huo, Chengmen Colonel Dou Wu and others all petitioned the emperor to reconsider, and the emperor's anger was somewhat relieved.
So those arrested were sent back to the countryside without charge and were banned from employment for life. The names of party members are written in the palace.
Since then, the upright people have been abandoned, and the bad people have similar odors and collude together.
People in the country who pursue high integrity and integrity praise each other, refer to celebrities in the world, and set a label. The first one is called Sanjun, the second is called Bajun, the third is called Bagu, the fourth is called Baji, and the fifth is called Bachu, which is similar to the ancient Ba Yuan and Ba Kai.
Dou Wu, Liu Shu and Chen Fan were called the "Three Monarchs".
summary: The party incident began when Emperor Huan, formerly Marquis of Liwu, studied under Zhou Fu and later promoted him. Yin Fangzhi of Henan was also famous, and their guests ridiculed each other, forming factions that divided Ganling into northern and southern parts. Later, Prefect Zongzi of Runan appointed Fan Pang, and Prefect Cheng Jin of Nanyang appointed Cen Ri. Ballads spread to the Imperial College, where over 30,000 students followed leaders Guo Linzong and Jia Weijie, respecting Li Ying, Chen Fan, and Wang Chang. Rumors praised Li Yuanli as a model, Chen Zhongju as fearless, and Wang Shumao as outstanding. Others like the Bohai clan and Fufeng Wei Qiqing dared to speak against the powerful. Cen Hao, from Nanyang, studied at Taixue and befriended Guo Linzong. He served as a meritorious officer under Wang Jin, arresting and killing over 200 corrupt individuals. Emperor Huan imprisoned Wang Jin, and Cen Hao fled, later dying in the Jiangxia Mountains.

translation:
Jun means to be the sect of one generation.
Li Ying, Xun Yi, Du Mi, Wang Chang, Liu You, Wei Lang, Zhao Dian, and Zhu were called the eight heroes.
Jun means a hero among people.
Guo Linzong, Zongci, Basu, Xia Fu, Fan Pang, Yin Xun, Cai Yan and Yangzhi are called Bagu.
Gu means being able to use one's own moral character to support others. Zhang Jian, Cen Rizhi, Liu Biao, Chen Xiang, Kong Yu, Yuan Kang, Tanfu and Zhai Chao are called eight and eight.
And, it means being able to guide others to follow the religion.
Du Shang, Zhang Miao, Wang Kao, Liu Ru, Hu Muban, Qin Zhou, Fan Xiang, and Wang Zhang were called the "Eight Chefs", which meant that they could save people with money.
In addition, Zhu Bing, a native of Zhang Jian's hometown, wrote a letter to Zhang Jian and twenty-four people from his hometown to act as cronies and to harm the country.
Zhang Jian, Tan Bin, Chu Feng, Zhang Su, Xue Lan, Feng Xi, Wei Xuan and Xu Qian were the eight heroes; Tian Lin, Zhang Yin, Liu Biao, Xue Yu, Wang Fang, Liu Zhi, Xuan Jing and Gongxugong were the eight heroes; Zhu Kai, Tian, ​​Shudan, Xue Dun, Song Bu, Tang Long, Ying Zi and Xuan Bao were the eight heroes. The carved stones were erected in the suburbs. We are all friends, Zhang Jian is too handsome.
Emperor Ling issued an edict to arrest Zhang Jian and others, but Zhu Bing's name was not included in the edict.
To maintain confidentiality. Therefore, Cao Jie in the Great Changqiu period signaled the relevant officials to report the arrest of the former party members Xian Sikong Yufang, Taipu Du Mi, Changle Shaofu Li Ying, Sili Colonel Zhu E, Yingchuan Prefect Basu, Pei Prime Minister Xun Yi, Hanoi Prefect Wei Lang, Shanyin Prefect Zhai Chao, Rencheng Prime Minister Liu Ru, and Taiwei Fan Pang. More than 100 people died in prison.
Some of the others died before being captured, and some escaped without being captured.
From then on, anyone who had resentments, framed each other, or even had a slight personal grudge would be classified as a clique.
Youzhou and counties followed the orders from above, and some of them had no contact with them at all, and were also implicated.
Six to seven hundred people were killed, exiled, and banned.
In the fifth year of Xiping's reign, Cao Luan, the prefect of Yongchang, wrote a letter loudly calling for justice for the party members. His words were legitimate and consistent with the facts.
The emperor was furious after reading the memorial and immediately issued an edict to the officials. Yizhou arrested Cao Luan in a carriage and sent him to Huaili prison to be beaten to death.
So he issued an order to the prefectures and counties to examine party disciples, old subordinates, fathers, sons and brothers. Those who were in office were removed from their posts and banned from serving as officials, which involved five generations.
In the second year of Guanghe's reign, Shanglu Changhe Haishu wrote: Li, the brothers of Congzu separated and their property was also divided. The kindness has been neglected, and mourning is also the end of alienation. Now the party members have imprisoned the five clans, which is no longer in line with the laws and regulations. Father, son, brother, are not implicated in the crime; it also violates the regular laws.
After seeing this, the emperor came to his senses, and all the prison terms imposed by the party since his ancestors were lifted.
In the first year of Zhongping, the Yellow Turban bandits arose. Lu Qiang, the official of the Central Committee, said to the emperor: The party has been imprisoned for such a long time, and many people are dissatisfied.
If the sin is not forgiven for a long time, it is easy to conspire with Zhang Jiao, causing great chaos and regret. The emperor was frightened by what he said, so he pardoned the party members and the family members who had been executed and moved back to their original counties. Later, the Yellow Turban Rebellion, the government fell apart, and the country's principles and regulations disappeared.
In total, the crony incidents began in Ganling and Runan and ended with Li Ying and Zhang Jian. Within the four seas, people were in dire straits and displaced. For more than 20 years, all those affected were good people in the world.
summary: Zhang Cheng of Hanoi, skilled in fortune-telling, predicted an amnesty and had his son kill someone. Li Ying, as Henan Yin, arrested and executed Zhang Cheng despite the amnesty. Zhang Cheng's disciple falsely accused Li Ying and others of forming cliques, slandering the court. The emperor arrested over 200 party members, with some escaping. The next year, officials petitioned for reconsideration, and the arrested were sent home but banned from office for life. Thereafter, upright people were abandoned, while the wicked colluded. Those pursuing high integrity praised each other, creating labels: Sanjun (Three Monarchs), Bajun (Eight Heroes), Bagu (Eight Supports), Baji (Eight Guides), and Bachu (Eight Assistants). Dou Wu, Liu Shu, and Chen Fan were Sanjun; Li Ying, Xun Yi, Du Mi, Wang Chang, Liu You, Wei Lang, Zhao Dian, and Zhu were Bajun; Guo Linzong, Zongci, Basu, Xia Fu, Fan Pang, Yin Xun, Cai Yan, and Yangzhi were Bagu; Zhang Jian, Cen Rizhi, Liu Biao, Chen Xiang, Kong Yu, Yuan Kang, Tanfu, and Zhai Chao were Baji; Du Shang, Zhang Miao, Wang Kao, Liu Ru, Hu Muban, Qin Zhou, Fan Xiang, and Wang Zhang were Bachu. Zhu Bing, a native of Zhang Jian's hometown, wrote to accuse Zhang Jian and twenty-four others of being cronies. Emperor Ling issued an edict to arrest them, but Zhu Bing's name was omitted for secrecy. Cao Jie signaled officials to arrest former party members, and over 100 died in prison. Others escaped or died before capture. Anyone with personal grudges was classified as a clique, and six to seven hundred people were killed, exiled, or banned. In the fifth year of Xiping, Cao Luan wrote to defend party members but was beaten to death. An edict then examined party disciples, old subordinates, and relatives, banning five generations from office. In the second year of Guanghe, He Haishu argued that imprisoning five clans violated laws, and the emperor lifted all prison terms. In the first year of Zhongping, the Yellow Turban rebellion arose, and Lu Qiang warned that long imprisonment might cause party members to join the rebels. The emperor pardoned them, but the government later collapsed. The party incidents lasted over twenty years, affecting all good people in the world.

translation:
◆The biography of Liu Shu, courtesy name Zhongcheng, was from Lecheng County, Hejian County.
His grandfather, Liu Cheng, was the school captain of Sili School.
After Liu Shu learned the Five Classics when she was young, she lived in seclusion and set up a monastery to teach, often to hundreds of students.
The prefectures and counties invited each other with courtesy, and even the five prefectures refused to go.
In the second year of Yongxing, Situ Zhongfan recommended Liu Shuxian as a good and upright person, but he declined due to illness.
When Emperor Huan heard that Liu Shu was famous, he scolded the prefectures and counties and carried the sick Liu Shu to the capital in a sedan chair.
Liu Shu had no choice but to go to Luoyang. She was the best in the world in answering the emperor's questions and was awarded the title of Yilang.
Liu Shu also stated that the gains and losses in current affairs and the reasons why disasters occurred were all valid.
If you are promoted to minister again, you will be able to adopt loyal advice and make suggestions to the emperor, which will be of great benefit.
He was promoted to Shizhong and Hubenzhonglangjiang.
He expressed his urgent opinion to the emperor that the eunuch should be dismissed, but although the emperor did not adopt it, he did not accuse him.
Because Liu Shu was a sage in the clan, she respected him especially. When she encountered doubts and difficult decisions, she often asked him secretly.
After Emperor Ling ascended the throne, the eunuchs falsely accused Liu Shu of conspiring with Dou Wu and others and threw him into prison. Liu Shu committed suicide.
◆The biography of Li Ying, whose courtesy name is Yuanli, was born in Xiangcheng County, Yingchuan County.
His grandfather was named Taiwei at the time of Emperor An.
His father was named Yi and served as the Prime Minister of Zhao.
Li Ying was aloof and unsociable. He only regarded Xun Shu and Chen Chen from the same county as his mentors and friends.
At first, Li Ying was recommended as Xiaolian, and was recruited by Situ Hu Guang and promoted to Gaodi. He was promoted to governor of Qingzhou.
The county guards and magistrates were afraid of Li Ying's majesty and insight, so most of them abandoned their official posts and left after hearing the news that Li Ying had come to Qingzhou.
Li Ying was recruited again and transferred to the post of Yuyang Prefect.
Soon he was transferred to the post of governor of Shu County, but his mother requested not to take up the post because of her old age.
He was transferred to the rank of Colonel Hu Wuhuan.
Xianbei invaded the border many times, and Li Ying often took the risk to defeat them and drive them away every time.
The enemy is very afraid. He was dismissed from office due to official duties and returned to his hometown, Lunshi County, where he often taught thousands of students.
Fan Ling from Nanyang asked to be his disciple, but Li Ying declined him and refused to accept.
Fan Ling later relied on flattery to cling to the eunuchs and obtained the high position of Taiwei. He was humiliated by people with integrity.
Xun Shuang once went to visit Li Ying and drove a carriage for Li Ying. When he came back, he happily said: Today I drove a carriage for Li Jun.
Li Ying was admired to this extent.
In the second year of Emperor Huan's Yongshou reign, Xianbei invaded Yunzhong. Emperor Huan heard that Li Ying was talented, so he recruited him as a general to conquer Liao.
Previously, the Qiang people took captives to Shule and Qiuci, and invaded and plundered Zhangye, Jiuquan, and Yunzhong counties many times. The people suffered many disasters from them.
summary: Liu Shu, from Hejian, studied the Five Classics and taught hundreds of students. He declined multiple invitations but was eventually carried to Luoyang, where he answered the emperor's questions and was appointed Yilang. He advised dismissing eunuchs, but the emperor did not adopt it. After Emperor Ling ascended, eunuchs falsely accused Liu Shu of conspiring with Dou Wu, and he committed suicide in prison.

translation:
Recently I heard that the emperor was angry and demoted and dismissed the minister Chen Fan. People and ghosts conspired together. They thought that the emperor should be on the 25th day of Zhenguan to benefit the adults. He didn't want the Yi Gua sun to come out at the beginning of the day. The sun was not clear and the rainbow was shining. He abandoned the gentleman and became the villain.
When the earth's Qi is closed today, the sage hides, and the wise man sees danger and throws himself into distant harm.
Although it is less famous, it is in line with my private wishes. I am very happy to miss you, but I don’t feel hateful about it.
I hope you will have nothing to do and rest in peace, live in seclusion in Hengmen, let things rise and fall, and change with the times.
Soon after the death of Emperor Huan, Chen Fan became the Taifu and presided over the government together with the general Dou Wu. They conspired to kill various eunuchs, recommended and appointed celebrities from all over the world, and appointed Li Ying as the Shaofu of Changle.
When Chen Fan and Dou Wu failed, Li Ying and others were dismissed from office.
Later, the Zhang Jian incident occurred and the party members involved were arrested. The people from the same town said to Li Ying, "You can go."
Li Ying replied: If you are a king, you will not avoid disaster, and if you are guilty, you will not escape punishment. This is my moral integrity.
I am already sixty years old. Death and life are determined by fate. Where can I go?
He took the initiative to go to the prison designated by the emperor's edict and was tortured to death. His wife and children were exiled to the border. Students, former subordinate officials and their fathers and brothers were all banned from serving as officials.
At this time, Jing Gu, the son of Jing Yi from Shu County who was serving as the imperial censor, was Li Ying's disciple, but he was not included in the party list, so he was not punished.
Jing Yi said with emotion and pride: "I originally thought that Li Ying was virtuous and sent his son to be his teacher. How could I just settle for nothing just because I left him out of the list?"
So he petitioned to be dismissed and go home.
At that time, people believed that he had a righteous sentiment. ◆The biography of Du Mi, named Zhou Fu, was a native of Yangcheng County, Yingchuan County.
He is a deep and simple man, and he had ambitions and customs when he was young.
He was promoted by Situ Hu Guang, and was promoted slightly to the prefect of Daijun. He was recruited by the imperial court, and was promoted to the prefect of Taishan and the prime minister of Beihai three times.
If any of the eunuchs' sons committed evil acts, they would be arrested and interrogated.
Once, Du Mi went to Gaomi to inspect spring plowing production and provide relief to the poor. He found that Zheng Xuan was a talented person as a township assistant, so he called him to act as a county official and sent him to study.
Later, Du Mi left his official position and returned home. Every time he visited the governor, he stated his opinions and asked for many things. Liu Sheng from the same county also returned to his hometown from Shu County, but he stayed behind closed doors and made no requests.
Wang Yu, the prefect, said to Du Mi: Liu Jiling is really a noble man, and many of the officials recommend him.
Du Mi knew that Wang Yu was irritating him, so he replied: Liu Sheng was a doctor, and the prefect treated him with the courtesy of a guest, but he knew the good and did not recommend it, and did not say anything after hearing bad news. He hid the true feelings for himself, like a cicada. This is a guilty person.
Now I will go up to the wise men who are committed to justice, and I will correct the bad men who violate the law, so that the prefect can win rewards and punishments, and the good reputation can be promoted. Isn't this a ten thousandth help to you?
Wang Yu was ashamed and admired him, and respected him even more.
summary: Li Ying, from Yingchuan, was aloof and regarded Xun Shu and Chen Chen as mentors. He was recommended as Xiaolian and became governor of Qingzhou, where corrupt officials fled upon hearing of his arrival. He later served as Colonel Hu Wuhuan, defeating Xianbei invaders. As Henan Yin, he arrested and executed Zhang Cheng despite the amnesty, angering the emperor. During the party disaster, Li Ying was arrested and tortured to death at age sixty. His wife and children were exiled, and his students were banned from office. Du Mi, from Yingchuan, was deep and simple. He served as prefect of Daijun and Taishan, arresting eunuchs' sons who committed evil acts. He discovered Zheng Xuan's talent and sent him to study. After the party broke out, he was dismissed and later committed suicide during a party summons.

translation:
Later, Emperor Huan conquered and worshiped him as Shangshu Ling, promoted to Henan Yin, and transferred to the Imperial Servant.
After the party broke out, he was dismissed from office and returned to his hometown. He and Li Ying were both convicted. Their reputation and behavior were comparable, so people at that time also called them Li Du.
Later, Chen Fan, the Taifu, assisted the government, and then became the Taifu.
The next year, he was summoned for party affairs and committed suicide.
◆The biography of Liu You, the uncle named Liu You, was from Anguo County, Zhongshan County.
Anguo County later belonged to Boling.
Liu You began to promote filial piety and integrity, and supplemented the minister's position. He is familiar with historical events and is particularly good at writing. He usually provides advice to the emperor and responds quickly, which is appreciated by his colleagues.
When he was appointed as the city magistrate, Yanzhou praised him as an outstanding talent. He was promoted to the governor of Yangzhou.
At this time, Liang, the prefect of Kuaiji, was the disciple of General Liang Ji.
Liu You exposed his crime, and Liang Min was scolded for this.
Liu You was also promoted to the governor of Hedong.
At that time, most of the county magistrates and chiefs were the sons of eunuchs, who were harmful to the people.
When Liu You took office, he removed those powerful and violent people who should be removed from their posts, sentenced those who should be sentenced, vindicated unjust and false cases, and set a model for politics in Hedong, Hanoi, and Sanhe in Henan.
He was promoted again, and in the fourth year of Yanxi's reign, he was appointed Shangshu Ling. He was also promoted to Henan Yin and was transferred to the Si Li Xiaowei.
At that time, the powerful and wealthy children who returned to the capital from the prefectures and counties would change their clothes and hide their treasures as soon as they reached the border.
Liu Youwei visited the court.
Ren Zongzheng, the chief agricultural officer of Santiao.
At that time, the ministers Su Kang and Guan Ba ​​were in power in the imperial court, occupying the country's fertile lands and beautiful industries, mountains, forests and lakes. The people were poor and the states and counties dared not say a word.
Liu You moved the documents to the area they occupied and confiscated them according to law.
Emperor Huan was furious and sentenced Liu You to Zuo School for forced labor.
Later, when he was pardoned and visited the three ministers again, he often excused himself because of illness and asked to return to the fields.
The imperial edict was issued to the officials, so Dumen disappeared.
When the three princes were vacant, the emperor all preferred Liu You, who was slandered and ignored.
Yan Du wrote to Liu You and said: In the past, the Taibo made three concessions, and the people missed him. The youngest son of Yanling bowed, and the Chinese praised his noble style.
You have the virtue of Zang Boyu who said, "If a country has no way, it can be rolled up and cherished". You understand Ning Wuzi's spirit of "if a country has no way, it can be foolish."
Pure sincerity and self-improvement are extremely valuable. At the beginning of Emperor Ling's reign, Chen Fan assisted the government and appointed Liu You as the Yin of Henan.
After Chen Fan failed, Liu You was deposed and returned to his hometown, where he died at home.
The next year, party members were massacred, but Liu You was lucky to be spared.
◆Biography of Wei Lang. Wei Lang was named Shaoying and was a native of Shangyu County, Kuaiji County.
He became a county official when he was young.
His brother was killed by a villager, and Wei Lang took revenge in the county with a knife during the day. So he fled to the state of Chen.
He studied "Spring and Autumn Pictures" with Dr. Gu Zhongxin, and then went to Taixue to study "Five Classics". Li Ying, the elder of the capital, and others all competed to associate with him.
He was promoted to Situ Mansion and promoted to Pengcheng Order.
At that time, the eunuch's son was serving as the prime minister of the country and his actions were illegal. Wei Lang reported to the court many times. The emperor's favored ministers were very angry and wanted to slander him.
When they met the Jiuzhen thieves, they jointly recommended Wei Lang to be appointed the Jiuzhen Captain.
After taking office, Wei Lang rewarded his officers and soldiers, defeated the county thieves, and beheaded 2,000 people.
Emperor Huan commended him for his contribution and appointed him as Yilang.
Soon, he was promoted to Sima.
He stated his political opinions many times and made contributions to the court.
He became the prefect of Hanoi, and his politics was a model for Hedong, Hanoi and Sanhe in Henan.
The minister ordered Chen Fan to recommend Wei Langgong to be Zhongzhiliang, who could be appointed to a confidential position, and then be recruited as minister.
summary: Liu You, from Zhongshan, was familiar with history and skilled in writing. He exposed crimes of Liang Ji's disciple and removed corrupt officials in Hedong. As Si Li Xiaowei, he confiscated lands occupied by powerful ministers, angering Emperor Huan, who sentenced him to labor. After pardon, he returned to seclusion and died at home, spared from the party massacre. Wei Lang, from Kuaiji, avenged his brother's murder and studied at Taixue. He served as Jiuzhen Captain, defeating thieves and beheading 2,000. As prefect of Hanoi, his governance was exemplary. During the party disaster, he was dismissed and later committed suicide at Niuzhu.

translation:
In case of party disaster, he was dismissed from office and returned home.
Wei Lang was reserved and serious by nature, and kept the rules behind closed doors. No one in his family saw any signs of laziness in him.
Later, Dou Wu and others were killed, and Wei Lang was summoned urgently due to party troubles. He walked to Niuzhu and committed suicide.
He wrote several books called "Wei Zi".
◆The biography of Xia Fu, whose courtesy name is Zizhi, was from Yuxian County, Chenliu County.
When he was young, he was a scholar with upright words and deeds.
The Gao family and the Cai family in the same county were both wealthy, and the people in the county were afraid of him and served him carefully. Only Xia Fu, although he lived in the same family as Gao and Cai, did not associate with them, so he was hated by the wealthy people.
At the beginning of Emperor Huan's reign, he spoke out and said no.
Although Xia Fu did not associate with the eunuchs, he was feared by the eunuchs because of his reputation. He, Fan Pang, Zhang Jian and others were all framed by the eunuchs. The imperial court issued an edict to go to the prefectures and counties to arrest him as the leader of the party.
Zhang Jian and others fled for their lives. In the places they went through, everyone who came into contact with them was arrested and interrogated. People involved in interrogation were all over the world.
Xia Fu paused and sighed and said: "The sin is your own fault. It hurts good people in vain. One person escapes to die, and the disaster affects thousands of families. What are you doing alive!"
So he cut off his beard, changed his appearance, ran to Linlu Mountain, concealed his name, and became a servant of the smelting family.
After working with chimney soot, his appearance was ruined and exhausted. After two or three years, no one knew it was him.
Later, Xia Fu's younger brother Xia Jing took a car and pursued the silk to Niyang City.
When he touched Xia Fu, he couldn't recognize him. When he heard Xia Fu's voice, he discovered Xia Fu and knelt down to Xia Fu.
Xia Fu tried to avoid talking to him, so Xia Jing chased him to the hotel and slept with Xia Fu.
At night Xia Fu quietly called Xia Jing: "I was framed by the powerful eunuch because I kept the right path and hated evil."
If you want to stay safe and save your life, why did you come to me with your things? You are bringing trouble upon me!
We left at dawn.
He died before the party ban was lifted.
◆Zong Ci's biography, Zong Ci's courtesy name was Xiaochu, and he was a native of Anzhong County, Nanyang County.
In order to promote filial piety and honesty, the government summoned him nine times to conquer him with virtue, but he refused.
Later he served as a military commander.
At this time, the prefect came from a powerful and wealthy family, and corruption and bribery were very serious, so Zong Ci abandoned the county magistrate and left.
The imperial court summoned Yilang, but he did not arrive and died on the road.
The scholar-bureaucrats in Nanyang all respected his righteous deeds.
◆Basu biography, Basu courtesy name Gongzu, a native of Gaocheng County, Bohai County.
He was first promoted as Xiaolian, and successively served as the magistrate of Shen County and the magistrate of Beiqiu County. However, he resigned due to illness because the county governor was unpopular.
When he was appointed to the Duke's Mansion, he was promoted to Yilang.
He conspired with Dou Wu, Chen Fan and others to kill the eunuchs. Dou Wu and others were killed, and Basu was also banned from serving as an official because of the party's disaster.
Later, Cao Jie, the minister of the Central Committee, heard that Ba Su had participated in the plot to kill the eunuch and arrested him.
Basu took a bus to the county by himself.
The county magistrate saw Basu and went into the cabinet to untie the seal ribbon and wanted to go with him.
summary: Xia Fu, from Chenliu, was upright and did not associate with wealthy families. He was framed by eunuchs as a party leader. While fleeing, he cut his beard, changed his appearance, and worked as a servant in a smelting family for years. His brother discovered him, but Xia Fu left at dawn and died before the party ban was lifted. Zongci, from Nanyang, refused multiple government summons. He served as a military commander but abandoned his post when the prefect was corrupt. He died on the road while being summoned as Yilang. Basu, from Bohai, conspired with Dou Wu and Chen Fan to kill eunuchs. After their failure, he was banned from office. Cao Jie arrested him, and Basu surrendered himself, saying he would not escape punishment. He was killed, and the governor carved a stone to record his deeds.

translation:
Basu said: As a minister, I dare not conceal my plans, and I will not escape punishment if I am guilty.
I have not concealed my involvement in the murder of the eunuch, how dare I escape punishment?
Because he was killed, the governor Jia Cong carved a stone inscription to record his deeds.
◆Biography of Fan Pang, named Meng Bo, who conquered the Qiang people in Runan.
When he was young, he honed his integrity and was highly praised by the state. He praised the four elements of filial piety, integrity and honor: honesty, simplicity, humility and frugality.
At this time, there was a famine in Jizhou and thieves were on the rise, so Fan Pang was appointed as an envoy to the Qing Dynasty to investigate the situation of thieves.
Fan Pang boarded the chariot and took the bridle with a high spirit and ambition to clarify the world.
When he arrived at the prefecture and county, the governor knew that he was corrupt and violated the law. When he heard the news, he abandoned his official position and left.
What Fan Pang exposed was what public opinion demanded to be dealt with, and Sheng Guang Luxun was in charge.
At this time, Chen Fan was appointed Guang Luxun, and Fan Pang met Chen Fan on official occasions. Chen Fan did not stay with him, but Fan Pang held a grudge and abandoned his official post.
When Guo Linzong heard that Chen Fan was being reprimanded, he said: "Can a person like Fan Mengbo be treated according to public etiquette?"
Now that he is gone, it will make him famous. Isn't that a bad thing for himself?
Chen Fan then apologized to Fan Pang.
He was also recruited by Taiwei Huang Qiong.
Later, the emperor ordered the three government officials to listen to the history of the good and bad, the people's suffering, and report to the court. Fan Pang reported to the governor and more than twenty people from the powerful party of two thousand stones.
The minister blamed Fan Pang for too many impeachments and suspected that he was seeking personal revenge.
Fan Pang replied: If what I am impeaching is not corruption and violence, which has caused great harm to the people, is it for the purpose of dirtying Jianzha?
Because there is not enough time, those who need to be impeached first will be impeached first, and those that have not been thoroughly reviewed should be implemented later.
I heard that if farmers weed the grass, good grains will flourish; if loyal ministers remove the traitors, the country's politics will be clear.
If what I say is untrue, I am willing to be severely punished.
Officials cannot question him.
Fan Pang saw that the country was in a difficult time and knew that his ideals could not be realized, so he committed a crime and left.
The prefect Zongzi had heard about Fan Pang before and asked him to act as a meritorious official and make political appointments.
Fan Pang was in office and strictly enforced the rule. He hated bad people and bad deeds with deep hatred.
Anyone who is unfilial or unfaithful, or behaves unbenevolently and righteously, will be expelled and will not work with them, and even their footprints will be wiped clean.
Deliberately recommend those who are upright and upright, and promote those who have been buried.
Fan Pang's nephew Li Song of Xiping, a descendant of the public family, was abandoned by the village. Tang Heng, the official of the Central Committee, introduced Li Song to Zongzi, who appointed Li Song as an official.
Fan Pang thought Li Song was not suitable and suppressed it.
Zongzi was so angry that he vented his anger on Shu Zuo Zhu Ling and whipped him.
summary: Fan Pang, from Runan, was appointed envoy to investigate thieves in Jizhou. He exposed corrupt officials and was praised for his integrity. During the party disaster, he was imprisoned and tortured. After release, he returned south but was later arrested again. His mother encouraged him to die for a good reputation, and he was executed at age thirty-three.

translation:
I already have a good reputation, and if I seek longevity exams, is it possible to have both?
He knelt down to receive instruction, then bowed and resigned.
He turned back to his son and said: I want you to do evil, but you can't do evil; I want you to do good, but I don't want to do evil, and this is the result!
Everyone on the road shed tears when he heard this. He was thirty-three years old at the time.
Officials commented: Li Ying stood up in a filthy and dangerous situation, and had a righteous heart. He used it to encourage popular customs, encourage high moral conduct to humiliate authority, and establish a clean and honest atmosphere to destroy the power of nobles. Even though he was in prison and his family was ruined, he never looked back. As for the son's death, the mother was happy for her son's sacrifice. How heroic!
Confucius said: Has the Tao been abandoned?
Or is it destiny?
◆The biography of Yin Xun, whose courtesy name is Boyuan, was born in Gongxian County, Henan Province.
It has been the home of officials for generations.
His uncle Yin Mu is a Situ, his brother Yin Song is a Taiwei, and many of the Yin family occupies important positions. Yin Xun only adheres to the integrity and integrity and does not use status and power to overwhelm others.
The prefectures and counties were conquered many times, promoted filial piety and integrity, and moved to Handan three times, with extraordinary political achievements.
Later, he was promoted to high rank and moved to the ministerial order in the fifth year.
Emperor Huan killed the general Liang Ji, and Yin Xun participated in the plan and was granted the title of Marquis of the capital.
Moved to runan prefecture.
The letter was written to explain to Fan Pang that Yuan Zhong and others suggested that he be imprisoned and not allowed to be an official because of the party disaster.
Soon, he recruited generals to be chief craftsmen and transferred them to agricultural departments.
Because of Dou Wu and other incidents, he was thrown into prison and committed suicide.
◆Cai Yan's biography, Cai Yan's courtesy name is Meng happy, a native of Xiang County, Runan County.
When he was young, he was proficient in Confucian classics, taught his disciples, and educated the villagers with courtesy.
When there were disputes in the village, they often went to Cai Yan's house to ask for settlement. After Cai Yan mediated, everyone said they had no objection.
He was promoted to the title of Xiaolian and the governor of Jizhou.
Ju Yuan, the official in charge of the imperial office, asked Cai Yan to nominate his younger brother as a maocai, but Cai Yan refused and ordered him to be arrested and asked to deliver letters.
He also impeached Cao Ding, the Prime Minister of Hejian, for embezzling millions of dollars in stolen goods.
Cao Ding is the younger brother of Zhongchang Shi Cao Teng.
Cao Teng sent General Liang Ji to write a letter to Cai Yan asking him to intercede, but Cai Yan ignored him. Cao Ding was therefore convicted and sent to Zuo School for labor reform.
The imperial court recruited Cai Yan to serve as Yi Lang and Fu Jie Ling.
Liang Ji heard that Cai Yan was talented and asked him to meet him. Cai Yan was ill and refused to go, so Liang Ji hated him.
At this time, Nanyang Governor Cheng Wang Jin and others were interrogated by the court captain for taking in the eunuchs. Cai Yan and Yilang Liu Yu came to rescue them.
Emperor Ling ascended the throne and was appointed Yilang again. He died of illness.
◆The biography of Yangzhi, the descendant of Yangzhi, was a native of Liangfu County, Taishan.
Generations are the family of officials.
summary: Yin Xun, from Henan, adhered to integrity despite his family's power. He participated in killing Liang Ji and was granted marquis. He wrote to explain Fan Pang's case but was later imprisoned and committed suicide due to Dou Wu's incident. Cai Yan, from Runan, was proficient in Confucian classics and mediated village disputes. He refused to nominate a eunuch's relative and impeached corrupt officials. He died of illness after Emperor Ling ascended.

translation:
When Yang Zhi was young, he was upright and knowledgeable. He was promoted as Xiaolian and conscripted into Taiwei Li Gu's mansion. Because of his excellent performance, he was promoted to a high rank and was appointed as Shi Yushi.
When Li Gu was executed, Yang Zhi was banned from being an official for many years because he was Li Gu's old official.
Because of his outstanding performance, he was promoted to the provincial governor of Jizhou.
Report cases of corruption and corruption, and wherever they go, corruption and perversion of the law will disappear.
He was promoted to Huben Zhonglang General, Chengmen Xiaowei, and Shangshu Ling three times.
At this time, Taiwei Zhang Hao, Situ Fanling, Da Honglu Guo Fang, Tai servant Cao Ling, and Da Sinong Feng Fang all had marriages with eunuchs, got together, and openly bribed eunuchs. Yang Zhi petitioned them one by one to remove them and expel them, but the emperor did not accept it.
Former Taiwei Liu Chong, Sili Colonel Xu Bing, Youzhou Governor Yang Xi, Liangzhou Governor Liu Gong, and Yizhou Governor Pang Ai were honest and upright in public affairs. Yang Zhi recommended them and promoted them. The emperor commended him and appointed him as Henan Yin.
He received salary on a daily basis, often ate dry rice and vegetables, and suppressed powerful people. All the officials in the capital were afraid of him. When troubles with the party occurred, he was removed from office, and he was imprisoned as an official. He died at home.
◆Zhang Jianzhuan, Zhang Jianzi Yuanjie, a native of Gaoping, Shanyang, a descendant of Zhao Wang Zhang Er.
His father, Zhang Cheng, was the governor of Jiangxia. Zhang Jian was initially recommended as a talented person by the villagers. He thought that the governor was not suitable for him, so he refused to go because of illness.
In the eighth year of Yanxi's reign, the governor Zhai Chao asked him to be the postal supervisor in the east.
At this time, Zhongchang Shihou Lan's family was in Fangdong, and he was cruel to the people and lawless.
Zhang Jian exposed the crimes of Hou Lan and his mother and asked the court to execute them.
Hou Lan withheld Zhang Jian's seal, but the emperor did not see it, so he and Hou Lan became enmity.
Zhu Bing, a native of the country, was flattering, despicable and nasty by nature. Zhang Jian looked down upon him and hated him. He wrote a letter to accuse Zhang Jian and twenty-four people in the same county of being friends. The court then ordered Zhang Jian to be arrested and Zhu Bing's name to be cut off to show that he was keeping it secret.
Zhang Jian ran for his life and ran away in embarrassment. Wherever he ran, when it got dark, he would stay in any house. No one disrespected his reputation and character. Even though his family was ruined, they were still willing to take him in.
Later he went into exile in Donglai and stayed at Li Du's home.
Waihuang ordered Mao Qin to lead troops to his home. Li Du called Mao Qin and said: "Zhang Jian is famous all over the world. It is not his fault to escape."
Even if you see Zhang Jian, can you bear to capture him?
Mao Qin stood up and caressed Li Du and said: "It is shameful for Zang Boyu to think that he is a gentleman alone. Why do you only focus on benevolence and righteousness?"
Li Du said: Although I, Li Du, say I love righteousness, you have gained half of it today!
Mao Qin sighed and left.
Li Du was able to send Zhang Jian out of the fortress, and Zhang Jian was finally saved from death.
summary: Yangzhi, from Taishan, was upright and knowledgeable. He reported corruption cases and recommended honest officials. He suppressed powerful people as Henan Yin but was removed during the party disaster and died at home.

translation:
Dozens of people were executed in every house where Zhang Jian passed by, and all their clan relatives were killed, leaving the county in ruins.
In the first year of Zhongping, the party's imprisonment was lifted, and Zhang Jian returned to his hometown.
The generals and three princes all recruited him and recommended him with sincerity. He had the characteristics of the official carriage of the imperial court and was appointed to pay homage to the Shaofu, but he was not accepted.
In the early years of Emperor Xian's reign, the people were in famine, and Zhang Jian's family was relatively wealthy, so he shared his property with his fellow villagers. There are hundreds of people who survive on these properties.
In the early years of Jian'an, the imperial court recruited him as a guard, but he accepted it as a last resort.
Zhang Jian saw that Cao Cao had usurpation ambitions, so he closed his door and hung up his car.
More than a year later, he died in Xuzhou at the age of eighty-four.
The historian commented: In the past, Wei Qi avoided death, Yu Qing resigned and fled with him, Ji Bu fled for his life, and the Zhu family was willing to hide him and save him.
Zhang Jian offended the emperor and fled everywhere for his life. When people in the world heard about his integrity, they all liked his ambition and competed to be the host to take him in.
There are probably dozens of cases where he abandoned his city, lost his official position, and destroyed his body and clan. Isn't Zhang Jian still a virtuous person?
However, Zhang Jian tried to block the river with just one palm of his hand, and finally caused trouble because of his hatred for unkind people. This shows how overestimating his ability is!
◆Cen Hao's biography, Cen Hao's courtesy name was Gongxiao, and he was a native of Jiyang County, Nanyang County.
His father, Cen Yu, served as the governor of Nanjun and was killed for corruption.
When Cen Hao was young and not well-known, he went to see Zong Ci of the same county. Zong Ci was recruited for being a good man. The house was full of guests. They thought Cen Hao was not a good family son and were unwilling to meet him.
Cen Hao stayed outside the door for many days before being brought in.
Zong Ci talked to him and praised him greatly, so he took him to Luoyang to study at Taixue.
Cen Hao had superb talents, and Guo Linzong, Li Gongshu, etc. all became friends with him. Li Ying and Wang Chang said that he had the ability to govern the country. Although he was in the countryside, he was high-spirited and had the ambition to govern the world.
When the prefect, Hongnongcheng, came to the Jin Dynasty, he wanted to establish his authority. After hearing Cen Hao's name, he asked him to serve as a meritorious officer, and also appointed Zhang Mu as a thief officer.
King Cheng Jin trusted Cen Hao and Zhang Mu, rewarded good deeds and corrected mistakes, and purged the palace.
There was a wealthy businessman named Zhang Xun in Wan County, who was a relative of Emperor Huan's beauty. He could carve some ingenious and interesting things, and often gave them to eunuchs with bribes. As a result, he also obtained a prominent official position. With his skills, he could do whatever he wanted.
Cen Hao and Zhang Mu persuaded Wang Jin to arrest Zhang Xun and others. Later, when they were pardoned, Cen Hao still killed them and arrested their clan guests. He killed more than 200 people before reporting to the court.
So the wife of Zhang Xun, the official in charge of Zhang Xun, sent a letter to complain.
Emperor Huan was furious and conscripted King Jin into prison and died in prison.
Cen Hao and Zhang Mu were hiding between Qi and Lu.
summary: Zhang Jian, from Shanyang, exposed Hou Lan's crimes but was framed by Zhu Bing. He fled for his life, with many houses sheltering him despite the risk of execution. Dozens were killed for hiding him. After the party ban was lifted, he returned home and shared his wealth with villagers. He died at age eighty-four during Jian'an.

translation:
Meet pardon and come out.
Later, he was elected by the state and county, and he was not accepted by the three governments.
After Li Gu and Du Mi were killed, he fled again and was heard to have died in the Jiangxia Mountains.
◆Chen Xiang's biography, Chen Xiang's courtesy name is Zilin, a native of Shaoling County, Runan County.
Grandfather Chen Zhen, Sili Xiaowei.
Chen Xiang was famous for his social skills when he was young.
He was promoted to Xiaolian, and Taiwei Zhou Jing promoted him with a high rank and appointed him as Shi Yushi.
At this time, on the first day of the first lunar month of the lunar calendar, Liang Ji, the general, showed his unkempt appearance and unkempt appearance. Chen Xiang reported to the emperor that Liang Ji was disrespectful to the emperor because of his good fortune, so he should be arrested and punished. People at the time thought he was a strange person.
He was promoted to prefect of Dingxiang, conscripted as Yilang, and promoted to governor of Yangzhou.
The emperor reported that Wang Yong, the prefect of Yuzhang, was a senior official, and Xu Shen, the prefect of Wu County, had committed corruption in office, and both were expelled from the imperial court.
Xu Shen is the younger brother of Xu Huang, the imperial minister.
As a result, his reputation grew.
He was also appointed as Yilang to supplement the imperial censor Zhongcheng.
He was interrogated by the Huangmen Beisi Prison due to party misfortune, but was exonerated because there was no evidence, and died at home.
◆The biography of Kong Yu, whose courtesy name was Yuan Dynasty, was from Lu County, Lu State.
Kong Ba, the seventh generation ancestor, served successively as Jiuqing when he became emperor, and was granted the title of Marquis.
From Kong Ba to Kong Yu, the title of nobility continued, and there were fifty-three ministers and ministers, including seven princes.
When Kong Yu was a child, he studied "Shang Shu" and was summoned by the general Liang Ji, but he did not respond.
Taiwei Ju Fangzheng disagreed with the emperor's questions, so he resigned due to illness.
Later, he was banned from serving as an official due to party disaster.
When Emperor Ling came to the throne, he conscripted Yilang in a public car to supplement the Luoyang order. Because of the death of his teacher, he abandoned his official position and died at home.
◆The biography of Yuan Kang, whose courtesy name is Zhongzhen, was born in Chonghe County, Bohai County.
When he was young, he studied in Taixue and was very close to Guo Linzong.
Raise filial piety and integrity, and then move to Yingyin Order. Known for his ability.
He was promoted to Taishou of Taishan.
Many surnames in the county were engaged in illegal activities. When Yuan Kang took office, he acted aggressively, got angry, and promulgated strict laws. No one dared to break the law.
Those who had invaded other people's fields and houses in the past were quickly returned to their original owners.
At this time, Zhang Jian of Shanyang killed Hou Lan's mother, who was often serving as a servant. Yuan Kang investigated her clan guests, some of whom were hidden in Taishan. He always hated eunuchs, so he arrested them all without missing or running away.
Hou Lan hated Yuan Kang to the extreme. He falsely accused Yuan Kang, Yanzhou Governor No. 5 and Duwei Hujia of surrendering, and summoned Yuan Kang to Tingwei Prison. He was commuted to the death penalty and demoted to Rinan.
Yingyin and Taiyangzhi waited until the court appealed for Yuankang and were pardoned. They were sent back to their own county and died at home.
◆Tanfu Zhuan, Tanfu Ziwenyou, a native of Xiaqiu, Shanyin County.
When I was young, I was Zhusheng. Although my family was poor, I had high ambitions and did not accept benefits from the wealthy people in the village.
summary: Chen Xiang, from Runan, reported Liang Ji's disrespect and was promoted to governor of Yangzhou. He expelled corrupt officials but was imprisoned during the party disaster. He was exonerated and died at home. Kong Yu, from Lu, studied "Shang Shu" and refused Liang Ji's summons. He was banned from office due to the party disaster and later died at home after serving as Luoyang magistrate. Yuan Kang, from Bohai, was strict as Taishan prefect, returning stolen lands. He arrested Hou Lan's clan guests hiding in Taishan. Hou Lan falsely accused him, and Yuan Kang was sentenced to death but later pardoned. He died at home.

translation:
In order to promote filial piety and honesty, the government called for him many times, but he still failed.
Jingshe teaches students, and hundreds of people often come to study from far away.
During the reign of Emperor Huan, he was recruited with a doctorate degree, but he was not successful.
When Emperor Ling came to the throne, Taiwei Huang Qiong promoted him to be Fangzheng. He answered the emperor's questions and met the requirements of the administration at that time. He was promoted to Yilang and supplemented the county magistrate of Meng.
Because the county guard was unpopular, he abandoned his official position and returned home.
The family has no property, but they live in the same clothes as their children and grandchildren, and eat by the sun.
He died at home at the age of eighty.
◆The biography of Liu Ru, whose courtesy name is Shulin, was from Yangping County, Dongjun.
Guo Linzong once said that although Liu Ru stuttered in speech, he was very smart and had an essence as white as jade.
He was promoted to be filial and honest, and he was promoted to a high rank due to his outstanding performance.
During the reign of Emperor Huan, disasters often occurred, and he issued edicts to ask for outspoken opinions. Liu Ru secretly wrote ten articles, expressing the gains and losses of the court with great loyalty and sincerity.
Emperor Huan could not accept it and appointed him as the Prime Minister of the city.
Soon, he was appointed Yilang.
After encountering Dou Wushi, he was imprisoned and committed suicide.
Jia Biao's biography, Jia Biao's courtesy name is Weijie, a native of Dingling County, Yingchuan County.
When he was young, he traveled to the capital. He had extraordinary integrity and impassioned generosity, and was as famous as Xun Shuang, a native of the same county.
He began to serve as an official in the state and county, promoted filial piety and integrity, and served as the county magistrate of Xinxi.
The people were poor and did not raise their children. Jia Biao established a strict legal system. Those who did not raise their children were as guilty as murdering people.
There were robbers and murderers in the south of the city, and women and children in the north. Jia Biao went to the scene of the crime to deal with it, and Shi Shi wanted to take Jia Biao to the south of the city.
Jia Biao got angry and said: "It is common sense for thieves and bandits to harm others; it is contrary to nature and human nature for a mother and her son to kill each other."
So he drove to the north of the city and punished the woman.
When the thieves in the south of the city heard about it, they also tied themselves up and went to the county to surrender.
Within a few years, thousands of people were raising children and they were all called "Jia Gongzhang". Those who gave birth to boys were named "Jia Zi" and those who gave birth to girls were named "Jia Nu".
In the ninth year of Yanxi's reign, a party disaster broke out. Taiwei Chen Fan opposed it but failed. All officials in the court felt chilled by it and did not dare to say anything more.
Jia Biao said to his colleagues: If I don't go westward, the disaster will not be relieved.
So he went to Luoyang and told the city gate captain Dou Wu, Shangshu Huo, Dou Wu and others to appeal to the emperor, and Emperor Huan therefore pardoned the party members.
Li Ying came out and said: I was able to avoid the party disaster because of Jia Sheng's strength!
At one time, Cen Hao was on the run due to party troubles, and his relatives and friends hid him. Jia Biao stayed behind closed doors and refused to accept him. People at that time hated him.
Jia Biao said: "The Biography" says: Act according to time and do not harm future generations.
summary: Tanfu, from Shanyin, was poor but had high ambitions. He taught hundreds of students and refused multiple summons. He died at home at age eighty. Liu Ru, from Dongjun, was intelligent despite stuttering. He wrote ten articles on governance but was imprisoned and committed suicide after Dou Wu's incident. Jia Biao, from Yingchuan, was known for his integrity. As Xinxi magistrate, he punished those who did not raise children and stopped infanticide. During the party disaster, he appealed to Dou Wu and Huo, leading to the party members' pardon. He refused to shelter Cen Hao and was banned from office, dying at home.

translation:
Gongxiao brought the blame on himself for threatening the emperor to commit crime. Just because I cannot treat each other with hostility and hate him, how can I shelter him and hide him?
Due to party troubles, he was prohibited from becoming an official and died at home.
At first, the three Jia Biao brothers were all famous, and Jia Biao was the best. Therefore, there is a legend in the world: Among the three tigers of the Jia family, Wei Jie is the most angry. ◆The biography of He Yong, named Boqiu, was a native of Xiangxiang County, Nanyang County.
When he was young, he traveled to the capital to study.
Although He Yong is a junior, Guo Linzong, Jia Weijie and others are very close to him. Famous Imperial Academy.
His friend Yu Weigao had not avenged his father and was seriously ill and was about to die. He Yong went to see him. Yu Weigao cried to him. He Yong was moved by his righteousness and avenged him. He sacrificed the head of his enemy to the grave of Yu Weigao's father.
After Chen Fan and Li Ying failed, He Yong was framed by the eunuchs because of his friendship with Chen Fan and Li Ying. He then changed his name and fled to Runan County.
Wherever he went, he gathered heroes and became famous in Jingzhou and Yuzhou.
Yuan Shao admired his character, secretly interacted with him, and became his sworn friend.
At this time, the party was in trouble and many people in the world suffered. He Yong often went to Luoyang privately to discuss with Yuan Shao.
For some poor and helpless people, help them survive the disaster.
For some people who were being hunted, he made great suggestions, allowing them to escape or hide, and saved many people from party disasters.
After the party disaster was resolved, He Yong was recruited by Sikong Mansion.
In every meeting of the three governments, He Yong was always recommended as the leader.
Promoted several times.
Dong Zhuo was in power and forced He Yong to become a long history officer. He refused to accept it on the pretext of illness, and conspired with Sikong Xunshuang, Situ Wang Yun and others to kill Dong Zhuo.
Xun Shuang died, and He Yong was arrested by Dong Zhuo for other matters, and he died of sorrow and anger.
At first, when He Yong saw Cao Cao, he sighed and said: The Han family is about to perish, and this man must be the one who will bring peace to the world.
Cao Cao was very happy.
He once praised Yingchuan Xun as the weapon of Wang Zuo.
Xun Ren served as the Minister of Secretariat and sent people to the west to meet his uncle Xun Shuang. He Yong's body was collected and buried next to Xun Shuang's tomb.
summary: He Yong, from Nanyang, avenged his friend's father and fled after Chen Fan and Li Ying's failure. He secretly helped many escape the party disaster. After the disaster ended, he was recruited but refused Dong Zhuo's offer. He conspired to kill Dong Zhuo but died of sorrow and anger after arrest. He once praised Cao Cao as the one to pacify the world.

translation:
Feng Yi, also known as Gongsun, was a native of Fucheng County, Yingchuan County.
He loves reading and is familiar with Zuo's Spring and Autumn Annals and Sun Tzu's Art of War.
When the Han army rose, Feng Yi supervised the five counties as a county magistrate, and guarded the city together with Miao Meng, the magistrate of Fucheng County, to resist the Han army for Wang Mang.
Guangwu took over the territory of Yingchuan, unable to attack his father's city, and stationed troops in Dongxiang.
Feng Yiwei traveled to the county and was captured by Han soldiers.
At that time, Feng Yi's cousin Feng Xiao and fellow county residents Ding Jinlin and Lu Yan all followed Guangwu, so they jointly recommended Feng Yi and was summoned by Guangwu.
Feng Yi said: My role alone is not enough to make people stronger or weaker.
There is an old mother in the city who is willing to go back and occupy five cities to repay her kindness with her service. Guangwu said: OK. Feng Yi went back and said to Miao Meng: "Now all the generals are strong men, most of them are tyrannical and tyrannical. Only General Liu does not plunder wherever he goes."
Judging from his words and deeds, he is not a mediocre person, so he can surrender to him. Miao Meng said: I live and die with you, and I respectfully listen to your opinions. When Guangwu returned to Wan in the south, more than ten people from Gengshi generals led their troops to attack the father city, but Feng Yi could not hold on. When Guangwu became the commander of the Sili school and passed by the father city, Feng Yi and others opened the door and offered cattle and wine to welcome him.
Guangwu ordered Feng Yi to be the principal for the time being, and Miao Meng to be the principal.
Feng Yi then recommended Yaoqi, Shushou, Duan Jian, Zuo Long and others from Tongyi. Guangwu all made them his governors and followed him to Luoyang.
Gengshi wanted to send Guangwu to capture Hebei several times, but all the generals thought it was impossible.
At this time, Cao Xu, the son of Cao Jing, the prime minister of the left, was the minister, and the father and son were in power. Feng Yi persuaded Guangwu to make a good marriage with them.
Later, when he crossed the Yellow River and headed north, Cao Xu helped him a lot.
Since Guangwu's brother Bosheng was killed by Gengshi, Guangwu did not dare to show his sadness. He often lived alone, did not eat food and wine, and often cried on his pillow and mat.
Feng Yi kowtowed to Guangwu alone to comfort him and comfort him.
Guangwu stopped him and said, "Don't talk nonsense." Feng Yi therefore took the opportunity again and said to Guangwu: "The whole world suffers from Wang Mang and has been thinking about the Han Dynasty for a long time."
Now Gengshi's generals are rampaging and tyrannizing the civilians, plundering wherever they go, leaving the people disappointed and unable to support anyone. Now the Lord can do his own thing without asking for instructions and perform kindness. When the Jie and Zhou Dynasties were in chaos, we saw the contribution of King Tang and Wu of Shang Dynasty. When people are hungry and thirsty for a long time, they can easily be full. Officials should be dispatched urgently, prisoners should be released after trial, widows should be raised, and those who flee and surrender should be exempted from crime. Secretly, he submitted to Guangwu a list of those who were of the same mind as the two thousand stone chief officials and who were not attached to him.
When Wang Lang got up, Guangwu galloped southeast from Ji County, traveling day and night, and arrived at Wuluoting in Raoyang County.
At this time, the weather was very cold and everyone was hungry and tired, so Feng Yi offered bean porridge.
Early the next morning, Guangwu said to the generals: I got Feng Yidou porridge yesterday, and my hunger and cold were relieved. When they arrived in Nangong County, there was a strong wind and rain. Guangwu drove the car into the empty house beside the road. Feng Yi held the firewood, Deng Yu burned the firewood, and Guangwu turned to the stove to bake his clothes.
Feng Yi entered the wheat rice and dodder shoulder again.
So he crossed the Hutuo River to Xindu and worshiped Feng Yi as a partial general.
Thus he defeated Wang Lang and was granted the title of Marquis Ying.
Feng Yi was a humble man who did not boast about his achievements. When he met generals on the road, he often steered his car out of the way.
summary: Feng Yi, also known as Gongsun, was from Fucheng County, Yingchuan. He was well-read in the Zuo's Spring and Autumn Annals and Sun Tzu's Art of War. When the Han army rose, he served as a county magistrate and defended the city for Wang Mang alongside Miao Meng. Guangwu (Liu Xiu) captured Yingchuan but could not take Fucheng. Feng Yi was captured by Han soldiers while traveling. His cousin Feng Xiao and others recommended him to Guangwu. Feng Yi offered to return to the city and secure five counties in exchange for service. He persuaded Miao Meng to surrender to Guangwu, noting that Guangwu did not plunder like other generals. When Guangwu passed by, Feng Yi and Miao Meng opened the gates and welcomed him with gifts. Guangwu appointed Feng Yi as a principal, and Feng Yi recommended several others for positions. Feng Yi advised Guangwu to build ties with Cao Xu, which proved helpful when Guangwu crossed the Yellow River northward. After Guangwu's brother Bosheng was killed, Feng Yi comforted him and urged him to act independently, perform kindness, and win over the people. When Wang Lang rebelled, Guangwu fled south, and Feng Yi provided him with bean porridge and other food during the harsh journey. Feng Yi was later made a partial general and granted the title of Marquis Ying after defeating Wang Lang. He was known for his humility, often hiding under a tree during discussions of merit, earning the nickname "General Big Tree." His troops were loyal to him, and Guangwu valued him highly.

translation:
I only ask Shenda Guangwu, may he accept my strategy to help the country and the people. Li Yi stopped fighting with Feng Yi after he read the book, so Feng Yi was able to attack Tianjingguan in the north, capture the two Dang cities, and then go south to thirteen counties east of Chenggao in Henan. All the settlements were pacified, and more than 100,000 people surrendered.
He fought with Wu Bo in the countryside, defeated and beheaded Wu Bo, and killed more than 5,000 people. Li Yi closed the door and refused to save him.
When Feng Yi saw that Li Yi kept his promise, he reported it to Guangwu.
Guangwu deliberately revealed Li Yi's letter to let Zhu Kun know.
Zhu Tuna was angry and sent someone to assassinate Li Yi.
As a result, the people in the city were scattered, and many people left the city to surrender.
Zhu Tung then sent the rebellious general Su Mao to lead tens of thousands of people to attack Wen. Zhu Tung then led tens of thousands of people to attack Pingyang County to attack Feng Yi in succession.
Feng Yi sent his school lieutenant to lead the army, and joined forces with Kou Xun to attack Su Mao. Feng Yi therefore crossed the Yellow River to attack Zhu Jun, who escaped. Feng Yi pursued him to Luoyang and circled the city before returning.
After the proclamation was handed over and the documents were presented, all the generals came in to congratulate him and advised Guangwu to ascend the throne.
Guangwu summoned Feng Yi back to Gaochangyi to inquire about the news in all directions.
Feng Yi said: Zhang Xun and other three kings rebelled, Gengshi was defeated, and the world was left without a master. The worry of the country lies with the king.
We should listen to the opinions of everyone, for the sake of the country at the top and the people at the bottom. Guangwu said: Last night I dreamed of riding a red dragon to heaven. When I woke up, my heart was beating very hard. Feng Yi then fell to the ground and bowed again to congratulate him and said: "This is the influence of destiny on your spirit. The beating in your heart is the king's cautious personality."
Feng Yi discussed with the generals the issue of honorary titles. In the spring of the second year of Jianwu, Feng Yi was granted the title of Marquis of Yangxia. Feng Yi went to attack Yan Zhong and Zhao Gen, the thieves in Yangzhai, and defeated them.
He ordered Feng Yi to go home and go to the tomb to offer sacrifices. He ordered the Taizhong doctor to bring cattle and wine, and ordered the prefects, captains and other clans within two hundred miles to participate in the ceremony.
At this time, Chimei and Yancen violently disrupted the three auxiliaries, and the prefectures and counties supported their troops. The chief disciple Deng Yu could not calm down, so he sent Feng Yidai Deng Yu to attack.
Guangwu sent it to Henan and gave him a chariot and a seven-foot sword.
He ordered Feng Yi to say: The third auxiliary suffered the rebellion of Wang Mang and Gengshi, as well as the cruel treatment of Chimei and Yancen. The common people were in misery and had no place to rely on to appeal.
The purpose of conquering them now is not to seize land or destroy the city and massacre the soldiers and civilians in the city, but to quell the war and assemble the people.
The generals are not bad at fighting, but they are fond of robbing.
You are able to control the officials. I hope you will understand my will and do not let the counties suffer. Feng Yi kowtowed and accepted the order, leading his troops to the west. He spread his prestige everywhere he went. There were more than ten cases where Hongnong bandits were called generals, and they all led their troops to surrender to Feng Yi.
summary: Feng Yi wrote to Li Yi, a general under Gengshi, urging him to surrender by citing historical examples of those who changed allegiances. Li Yi, though hesitant due to past conflicts with Guangwu, agreed to stop fighting. This allowed Feng Yi to pacify several counties. Guangwu later revealed Li Yi's letter to Zhu Kun, who assassinated Li Yi in anger. Zhu Kun then attacked Feng Yi but was defeated. After Gengshi's fall, Feng Yi advised Guangwu to ascend the throne, citing a dream as divine will. In the second year of Jianwu, Feng Yi was made Marquis of Yangxia and sent to pacify the three auxiliary regions, where he defeated Chimei and other bandits.
