translation:
◆The biography of Chen Fan, whose courtesy name is Zhongju, was born in Pingyu, Runan.
My grandfather served as the governor of Hedong.
When Chen Fan was fifteen years old, he lived in a room with nothing to do, and it was very dirty inside and outside. His father's friend Xue Qin, who was from the same county, came to see him and said to Chen Fan: "Child, why don't you clean up to welcome the guests?"
Chen Fan said: When a real man is alive, he should sweep away the rubbish in the world. How can he only care about his own room?
Xue Qin knew that he had the ambition to clarify the world and admired him very much.
At first, he served as an official in the county and was elected as Xiaolian and awarded the title of doctor.
Because his mother passed away, he resigned from office and lived in mourning.
When the mourning period expired, the governor Zhou Jing called him to serve as a chariot, but because he had different opinions on his advice, he abandoned the talisman and left.
Later, the government recruited Fang Zheng, but he didn't go.
Taiwei Li Gu recommended him and promoted him to Yilang, and then he was promoted to the prefect of Le'an.
At this time, Li Ying was appointed as the governor of Qingzhou, and he was famous for his strict governance. After hearing the news, everyone in the subordinate city asked to leave. Chen Fan stayed alone because of his clean and honest performance.
Zhou Chu, a county man, kept himself clean and cared for himself. He was invited by the county guards before and after him, but he refused to go.
Only Chen Fan can recruit him. Chen Fan called him by his name instead of his name and respected him very much.
A bed was specially built for him. After Zhou Chu left, the bed was hung up.
The common man Zhao Xuan buried his relatives without closing the tomb passage, and lived in it for more than 20 years. The towns and cities praised his filial piety, and the states and counties treated him with courtesy several times. The county recommended him to Chen Fan and asked about his wife and children. They found out that Zhao Xuan's five children were all born during his mourning period.
Chen Fan then said angrily: "Sages make rituals, and moral people must abide by them, and unworthy people should also strive to do so."
And the number of sacrifices does not need to be too many, as too much would be disrespectful.
You are sleeping in the tomb, raising your children in the tomb, deceiving the world, stealing your reputation, confusing the people, and insulting the ghosts and gods. How is this unreasonable!
So his crime was punished.
General Liang Ji was a powerful man in the world. At that time, he sent a letter to Chen Fan, asking Chen Fan to handle private matters. The messenger was not allowed to see him, so he lied and asked to see Chen Fan. Chen Fan got angry and beat the messenger to death, and was sentenced to military service for his crime.
After a slight promotion, he was appointed as minister.
At this time, mountain bandits in Lingling and Guiyang were in harm's way, and the minister considered sending troops to fight. The emperor also ordered the prefectures and counties to select filial piety, integrity, and maocai as appropriate.
Chen Fan went to the Supreme Court to argue and refute, saying: In the past, when Emperor Gaozu established a great cause, the people in the country were relieved, and the officials raised the people as if they were their own sons.
Now the common people in the two counties are all the sons of the emperor. Isn't the cause of the harm to the sons caused by the corruption and cruelty of the local officials?
summary: Chen Fan, courtesy name Zhongju, was born in Pingyu, Runan. His grandfather served as Governor of Hedong. At fifteen, he lived in a dirty room. When his father's friend Xue Qin asked why he didn't clean it, Chen Fan replied that a real man should sweep away the world's rubbish, not just his own room. Xue Qin admired his ambition. Chen Fan began as a county official, was elected Xiaolian, and became a doctor. After his mother's death, he resigned to mourn. When the mourning period ended, Governor Zhou Jing summoned him, but Chen Fan left due to differing opinions. He later refused government recruitment. Taiwei Li Gu recommended him, and he became Prefect of Le'an. He remained in office while others fled from strict Governor Li Ying. Chen Fan recruited the reclusive Zhou Chu, treating him with great respect. He exposed Zhao Xuan's false filial piety—Zhao had lived in a tomb for over twenty years but fathered five children there—and punished him for deceiving the world. When General Liang Ji sent a messenger requesting private favors, Chen Fan beat the messenger to death and was sentenced to military service. He later became a minister. When mountain bandits threatened Lingling and Guiyang, Chen Fan argued against sending troops, stating that corrupt officials caused the unrest and that replacing them with virtuous men would resolve the problem without military action. He also criticized the expedient recommendation of talents. Because he offended the emperor's associates, he was sent to be Governor of Yuzhang.

translation:
We should strictly instruct the three government agencies to secretly evaluate the prefects, governors, and county magistrates. Those who are misbehaving in politics and harming the people should be reported to the court immediately, and people who are upright, virtuous, honest, honest, able to promote laws and love the people should be selected to replace them. This way, we don’t have to bother the army, and the thieves can naturally be put to rest!
In addition, there are more than 2,000 officials in the three departments. The subordinate officials in the three houses have exceeded the prescribed limit and have not been appointed. Only the good ones should be selected for official positions, and those who are stupid and lawless should be singled out and rejected.
In this way, why do you need to issue an edict to recommend talents expediently, thereby encouraging the trend of asking for help?
Because he offended the people around the emperor, he was released as the governor of Yuzhang.
Chen Fan had a serious and upright temperament and did not receive guests. The scholars and the people also respected his aristocracy.
He was recruited to serve as minister, and no one who saw him off walked out of the outer city gate.
When he was promoted to Dahonglu, he met Li Yun, the magistrate of Baima County, who spoke bluntly and remonstrated. Emperor Huan was furious and Li Yun should be executed. Chen Fan wrote a letter to save Li Yun, but he was dismissed and returned home.
He was appointed Yilang again, and a few days later, he was promoted to Guangluxun.
At that time, the titles and rewards exceeded the system, and the favored ministers and relatives in the palace were very powerful. Chen Fan then sent a letter to advise: I heard that those who serve the country do everything for the country; those who serve the emperor do everything to please the emperor.
Now that I have been favored by the emperor and am in the position of Jiuqing, if I see the emperor doing something bad and do not dissuade him, then I am just trying to please the emperor.
The princes have twenty-eight elephants above, and the elephants are hanging down in the sky, and the earth should be divided below. The royal family of Fanping, the emperor of the Han Dynasty made an agreement, and those who are not meritorious cannot be granted the title of marquis.
However, I heard that you remembered the small merits of Deng Zun, the father of Yin Deng Wansi in Henan, and re-granted the titles that had been extinguished by the ancestors of Huang Jun, the minister. The servants obtained the titles through improper means, and the favored ministers on the left and right obtained them. Rewards are received for unworthy merit, official positions are awarded without considering actual abilities, and actual merits are not assessed when dividing soil and enfeoffment. As a result, within a family, there are only a few people who can be enfeoffed, so the sun and the moon are lost, the yin and yang are disordered, the crops are not ripe, and the people's wealth is not abundant.
I know that the seal has already been carried out, and it will be useless to talk about it, but I sincerely hope that the emperor will stop it here.
Moreover, due to taxation in recent years, five to six out of ten people have been harmed. Thousands of people are hungry and cold, and their lives are difficult. However, there are thousands of palace maids, and various expenses such as eating meat, wearing finery, oil and makeup, etc. cannot be counted.
As the saying goes: "You can't steal a house with five daughters," because having too many daughters makes the family poor.
Now, won’t the ladies in the imperial court impoverish the country?
So the maids of Qing Palace got married, and the world's atmosphere also changed.
Chu women in the West Palace are worried and resentful. If they are kept together but not close to each other, they will definitely feel sad and suffer from floods and droughts.
Prisons are used to prohibit violations of laws and disciplines, and officials must manage them competently.
If law enforcement is unfair and officials are unpopular, the country's politics will be harmed.
Everyone in the world said that prisons were created because of public dissatisfaction, and titles were obtained because of bribery.
summary: Chen Fan was promoted to Dahonglu. When Emperor Huan wanted to execute Li Yun for blunt remonstrance, Chen Fan wrote to save him and was dismissed. He was later reinstated as Guangluxun. He advised Emperor Huan against excessive titles and rewards, particularly for Deng Zun and Huang Jun, warning that improper enfeoffments caused cosmic disorder, crop failure, and poverty. He noted that thousands of palace maids impoverished the country and urged their release. Emperor Huan adopted some advice, releasing five hundred maids and limiting titles.

translation:
If it wasn't smelly and dirty, where would the flies come from?
You should investigate the gains and losses, choose the loyal and do the good, and issue an edict to hand over matters such as selecting talents to the minister and the three public officials, so that rewards and punishments should be in charge. Isn't this something to be thankful for?
Emperor Huan adopted many of his opinions and released 500 maids. He only granted Huang Jun the title of Marquis of Guannei and Deng Wanshi the title of Marquis of Nanxiang. In the sixth year of Yanxi's reign, Emperor Huan came to Guangcheng Garden to hunt. Chen Fan advised him: I heard that the emperor only went to the garden to hunt in mid-autumn when he was offering sacrifices to heaven and earth. In accordance with the season, practicing weapons and shooting animals is helpful for sacrifices and is used to express filial piety.
If you violate these, you are considered to be overindulgent.
Therefore, Gao Tao taught Shun that he should not wander around without instruction, and Zhou Gong taught Cheng Wang that he should not wander around in the fields.
Yu, Shun and King Cheng should take this as a warning, let alone those whose virtues are not as good as those of their two masters!
When the world is at peace, we need to exercise moderation, not to mention the current difficulties of "San Kong".
The fields are empty, the court is empty, and the warehouses are empty. These are the so-called "three empties".
In addition, the war continues and the people are scattered in all directions. This is when you are sad and haggard and can't sleep at night. How can you show off your power and be fascinated by the scene of galloping horses and horses?
Moreover, it is rainy in early autumn, which is the time for the people to start sowing. Instead, they are required to drive birds and animals and do the hard work of opening roads. This is not the compassionate heart of a wise and sage king.
Qi Jinggong wanted to go to Langyi to watch the sea. Yanzi told Qi Jinggong that the people did not like to listen to the sound of flags and horses, shaking their heads and frowning, so Jinggong did not go.
King Mu of Zhou wanted to travel around the world and do whatever he wanted, and there were traces of his rutted horses everywhere. He sacrificed his father to read him the poem "Praying for Moves" to stop his thinking.
I really hate the harm caused by amusement!
The memorial was sent, but Emperor Huan did not accept it.
Since Chen Fan became Guang Luxun, he and Huang Wan, a general with five senses, were in charge of the election of officials and did not favor the powerful. Therefore, he was framed and accused by the children of the wealthy family, and he was dismissed from office and returned home.
Soon, he was recruited as a servant of Shangshu and transferred to Taizhong doctor.
In the eighth year of Yanxi's reign, Yang Bing was replaced as Taiwei.
Chen Fan declined and said: "Without mistakes or loss, I am not as good as Taichang Hu Guang in following the old classics; I am not as good as Yilang Wangchang in distinguishing the seven political principles of sun, moon, metal, wood, water, fire and earth and explaining the five classics."
I am smart, open-minded, and versatile in both civil and military affairs. I am not as good as the consumptive prisoner Li Ying.
Emperor Huan didn't allow it.
Su Kang, Guan Ba ​​and others were appointed again. They excluded and framed the loyal ministers and collaborated with each other.
Da Si Nong Liu, Ting Wei Feng Nui, and Henan Yin Li Ying were all punished for violating the emperor's will.
summary: Chen Fan advised against Emperor Huan's hunting at Guangcheng Garden, citing the "Three Empties"—empty fields, court, and warehouses—and ongoing wars. The emperor ignored him. As Guangluxun, Chen Fan and Huang Wan conducted elections without favoring the powerful, leading to false accusations and his dismissal. He was soon recalled as a servant and later became Taiwei, though he declined, citing his inferiority to Hu Guang, Wang Chang, and Li Ying.

translation:
Chen Fan took advantage of the court meeting to resolutely appeal to Li Ying and others, asking the emperor to pardon them and promote their titles.
Repeated appeals, the words are sincere.
Emperor Huan ignored him, so Chen Fan got up and left in tears.
At that time, Zhao Jin, the young eunuch, Zhang Si, the big bully of Nanyang, and others served the eunuchs and relied on their power to commit evil and break the law. Liu Wangzhi and Cheng Jin, the prefects of Taiyuan and Nanyang counties, interrogated them. Although the emperor had issued an order to pardon them, they still interrogated them to the end and executed them.
The eunuchs held a grudge against them. The officials followed the instructions and reported to the emperor that Liu Wangzhi and Cheng Jin should be executed for their crimes.
In addition, Zhai Chao, the prefect of Shanyang, confiscated the property of Zhongchang Shihou Lan, and Donghai Prime Minister Huang Fu executed Xu Xuan, the magistrate of Xiapi County. Zhai Chao and Huang Fu were both tortured by Kunpin and were taken to Zuoxiao for hard labor.
Chen Fan, together with Situ Liu Ju and Sikong Liu Mao, advised the emperor and asked for leniency for Liu Wangzhi, Cheng Jin, Zhai Chao, Huang Fu and others. Emperor Huan was unhappy and the officials impeached them. Liu Ju and Liu Mao did not dare to say anything more.
Chen Fan went up alone.
Said: I heard that Duke Huan of Qi's pursuit of hegemony mainly focused on managing internal affairs. In the Spring and Autumn Annals of Lu, even minor mistakes must be written down. He should cultivate himself first before he can ask others to do so.
Nowadays, thieves and bandits are rampant outside, which is a pain to the limbs; but internal chaos is a disaster to the heart.
I can't sleep, I don't have enough to eat, I'm really worried that the people around you are getting closer every day, the people who give good advice are increasingly alienated, the internal disasters are becoming more and more serious, and the external disasters are deepening.
The emperor succeeded to the throne through princes.
If a small family accumulates millions of wealth, their descendants will be ashamed to lose the inheritance of their ancestors. How much more if they own the whole world and receive it from their ancestors, do they want to slack off and not respect themselves?
If you really don’t cherish yourself, shouldn’t you think about the late emperor’s hard work in conquering the world?
Once upon a time, the Liangji clan and the five princes brought disasters to the world. God inspired your sage thoughts to arrest and execute them. The public opinion of the world hoped that society would have a little peace.
Those obvious warnings are right in front of us, and the lesson of overturning the car seems like yesterday, but the power of the eunuchs encourages each other to collude.
The young eunuch Zhao Jin, the big bully Zhang Si and others were wantonly corrupt and cruel, and they flattered your favored ministers, the former Taiyuan Governor Liu Wangzhi, and the Nanyang Governor Cheng Jin. They were arrested and executed. Although it was said that they should not be executed after pardon, I believe that their sincerity is to eliminate the falsehood for you.
So what do you have to be angry about?
The villain Taoist priest confuses you and makes you furious. If the penalty is too much, how much more to impose capital punishment and order to kill?
Also, Zhai Chao, the former governor of Shanyang, and Huang Fu, the prime minister of Donghai, abide by the law and hate evil as much as their enemies. Zhai Chao confiscated Hou Lan's property, and Huang Fu executed Xu Xuan. Both of them were convicted and punished for this, and they cannot receive your pardon. Hou Lan committed evil, and it was a blessing that only his property was confiscated. Xu Xuan committed a crime and died unjustly.
In the past, Prime Minister Shen Tujia summoned Emperor Wen's favorite ministers to reprimand him, and Luoyang ordered Dong Xuan to rebuke Emperor Guangwu's sister Princess Huyang in person. Emperor Wen asked Shen Tujia not to kill Deng Tong, and Emperor Guangwu also rewarded Dong Xuan heavily. There is no news that these two ministers were punished for their arbitrary actions.
The little ministers around you now maliciously harm the party members, fabricating charges at will, causing Liu Wangzhi and Cheng Jin to be imprisoned unjustly.
Hearing these words of mine, your favorite will cry again and complain.
You should cut off the interference of your favorite ministers in political affairs, accept ministers to work in the imperial court and ministerial provinces, and hold public meetings every five days, select upright and noble people, remove and repel evil people.
In this way, the sky is harmonious above and the earth is harmonious below. Is the beautiful fortune still far away?
Although you hate my words, those who help others have the desire to improve themselves, so they dare to risk their lives to report.
Emperor Huan read his memorial and became even more angry. Not adopted at all. Many people in the court hated him.
As a result, the eunuch hated Chen Fan even more. He selected talents to send memorials, but the eunuch immediately rebuked him in the name of the emperor and sent them back. Many officials under him, including the long history and below, were often punished on pretexts, because Chen Fan was a famous official in his generation and they did not dare to harm him.
Liu Wangzhi, whose courtesy name was Wenli, was from Gaotang, and Chengjin, whose courtesy name was Youping, was from Shaanxi County.
summary: Chen Fan defended Li Ying and others punished for violating the emperor's will, weeping as he pleaded. He argued for leniency toward officials who executed eunuch associates despite pardons, comparing them to loyal ministers of old. Emperor Huan grew angrier and ignored him. The eunuchs hated Chen Fan, but because of his reputation, they dared not harm him directly.

translation:
They are all famous for their Confucian skills. They dare to speak outright when they are in office, and they often criticize some bad things. At that time, they all died in prison.
In the ninth year of Yanxi's reign, Li Ying and others were imprisoned for trial due to party members' incidents.
Chen Fan therefore wrote a letter to strongly dissuade him, saying: I heard that a wise king trusts his ministers, but a king who has subjugated his country is unwilling to listen to the straight words of his ministers.
Therefore, Tang and Wu prospered because they had wise ministers like Yi Yin and Lu Wang; Jie and Zhou were confused and perished because they had no people.
From this point of view, the king is the leader, and the ministers are the members. They are the same body and use each other for good and evil.
I saw that the former Sili Colonel Li Ying, the Grand Servant Du Mi, the Grand Lieutenant Peng Fan Pang and others were upright and innocent, and they were devoted to the country.
Because they were loyal and violated your will, they were tortured and interrogated. Some were imprisoned and isolated, and some died or were exiled to places they shouldn't go.
What is the difference between shutting up the mouths of the world and turning the whole society into deaf and blind people and the burning of books and humiliation of Confucians in the Qin Dynasty?
Once upon a time, King Wu of the Zhou Dynasty destroyed the Shang Dynasty. He erected signs at the homes of loyal officials of the Shang Dynasty and built tombs for them.
Now that you are in charge of political affairs, you first kill wise and loyal ministers. Why are you so mean to good people, and why are you so kind to bad people? The slanderer makes smooth words and seems to be telling the truth, confusing those who listen and confusing those who see.
The vision of good or bad lies in knowing good, and the chance of success or failure depends on listening to words.
The ruler of human beings is in charge of the country's major affairs, controls the laws and regulations within the four seas, and his actions must not violate the laws and moral rules of the sages.
If you say the wrong thing, it will cause chaos in all directions. How much more to punish the innocent in prison and kill the innocent in the street!
Once upon a time when Xia Yu was patrolling Cangwu and saw people killing people on the street, he got out of the car and cried, "Thousands of people are guilty, but only one person is guilty!"
So Xia Yu prospered quickly.
In addition, Qingzhou and Xuzhou were suffering from hot and drought conditions, and the grains were not harvested. The people had to leave their homes, and even coarse grains were not enough to eat.
However, the palace is full of palace ladies, and all the national wealth is spent on them. The relatives have private families, are greedy for money and accept bribes. This is what Confucius said: Salary has nothing to do with the official position, and government orders come from the officials.
Once upon a time, at the end of the Spring and Autumn Period, the virtues of the Zhou Dynasty declined, and no disasters were seen for decades. This was because God had abandoned it.
God still misses the Han Dynasty, so he added some variation to inspire the emperor.
The key to eradicating demons and evil is that you strengthen your self-cultivation. I am in the position of the Three Lords, and I am worried that I have a heavy responsibility. I dare not accept my salary for free, greedy for life, and sit back and watch the rise and fall of the Han Dynasty.
If my suggestion is adopted, even if you kill me and leave my body with my body, I will not feel any hatred.
summary: When Li Ying was imprisoned for party affiliation, Chen Fan wrote a strong remonstrance, comparing the persecution to Qin's book burning. He warned that punishing the innocent would cause chaos and noted that droughts and famines plagued the land while the palace hoarded wealth. Emperor Huan dismissed Chen Fan for allegedly selecting inappropriate talents.

translation:
Emperor Huan was dissatisfied with what Chen Fan said. He dismissed Chen Fan on the pretext that the talents he selected were inappropriate.
In the first year of Yongkang, Emperor Huan died, and Empress Dou took charge of the government. She issued an edict saying: The people are born to establish a king to manage them. There must also be virtuous assistant ministers to consolidate the great cause of the Wang family.
The former Taifu Chen Fan was loyal, upright and magnanimous. Now Chen Fan was appointed as Taifu and managed the affairs of the minister.
At that time, there had just been a national mourning, and the heir to the throne had not yet been determined. The ministers were afraid of offending the powerful ministers in the court, so they pretended to be ill and refused to go to court.
Chen Fan wrote a letter to reproach them, saying: The ancients paid great attention to moral integrity and served the deceased monarch as if he were still alive.
Now that the emperor's heir has not been decided, and political affairs are becoming increasingly urgent, why do you, gentlemen, abandon the sufferings of the country and lie down at home to rest?
We are already lacking in righteousness, so how can we talk about benevolence?
All the ministers were frightened and went to the court to do their work.
After Emperor Ling ascended the throne, Empress Dowager Dou once again issued an edict to commend Chen Fan: to reward meritorious deeds to encourage good deeds, to praise righteousness and righteousness to encourage customs, and there is no virtue that cannot be repaid, as "Daya" chants.
Grand Tutor Chen Fan assisted the late emperor and served as a capital official for many years. He was both loyal and filial. His moral conduct was the best in his dynasty. He was outspoken in his loyalty and advice and continued to do so even when he was old.
Now Chen Fan is granted the title of Marquis of Gaoxiang, with a settlement of 300 households.
Chen Fan declined and said: "The messenger came to my home and awarded me the seal of the Marquis of Gaoyang Township. I was really scared and didn't know what to do."
I heard that humility is the brilliance of one's character and the conspicuousness of one's virtue.
However, I didn't dare to steal the name. I wanted to cede land and make a lord, mainly to commend merit. I thought over and over, and I have held various positions without particularly good merit.
Although I have no integrity, I still envy the noble character of a gentleman who does not follow the way to achieve it, and does not live in it.
If I refuse to accept a title and accept it shamelessly, making the emperor angry and causing disasters to the common people, where will I be?
I just want your Majesty to take pity on me as an old man, and stop being greedy.
Empress Dowager Dou refused, so Chen Fan resolutely refused and submitted memorials ten times, but finally he was not granted the title.
At first, Emperor Huan wanted to make his favorite Tian Gui the queen. Chen Fan thought that the Tian family was of humble origin and the Dou family was a good family. He was very determined to make the Dou family the queen. Emperor Huan had no choice but to make the Dou family the queen.
Therefore, after Empress Dowager Dou took charge of the government, she appointed Chen Fan.
Chen Fan and General Dou Wu, the father of Empress Dowager Dou, worked together to recruit celebrities and wise men to participate in national politics. People in the world stretched their necks to hope for peace in the world.
However, Zhao Rao, Emperor Huan's wet nurse, was always with Empress Dowager Dou in the morning and evening. The regular attendants Cao Jie and Wang Fu colluded with her to please the Empress Dowager.
The Queen Mother trusted them and issued many edicts to confer titles and officials on them. However, most of their minions were greedy and cruel. Chen Fan always hated these people and was determined to eliminate the eunuchs. It happened that Dou Wu also had a plan.
Chen Fan believed that he was obedient to people's wishes and had done meritorious deeds to the Queen Mother. He believed that his purpose could be achieved, so he first went to the Queen Mother.
Said: I have heard that speaking without integrity and behaving improperly means cheating God and letting down the world.
summary: After Emperor Huan's death, Empress Dowager Dou appointed Chen Fan as Grand Tutor. When ministers feigned illness during the succession crisis, Chen Fan reproached them, and they returned to court. Emperor Ling granted Chen Fan the title of Marquis of Gaoxiang with three hundred households, but Chen Fan declined ten times.

translation:
If you speak your mind frankly, you will be hated by those vicious villains, which will soon lead to disaster.
Weighing the two, I am willing to suffer disaster, but I dare not deceive God.
Now the public opinion in the capital is boiling and the streets are noisy. It is said that Hou Lan, Cao Jie, Gongcheng Xin, Wang Fu, Zheng Sa and others, together with Mrs. Zhao Rao and other female officials in the palace, are disturbing the world and following their promotions. Anyone who opposes them will be punished.
Now the ministers of the Manchu Dynasty are like driftwood in the river, floating here and there, coveting wealth and position, and fearing death.
When you started your regency not long ago, you obeyed God's will and implemented punishments. Su Kang and Guan Ba ​​were both punished and executed.
At that time, the sky and the earth were clear and bright, and people and ghosts were happy. Why did you indulge your attendants just a few months later?
There is no greater evil or treachery than them.
If they are not executed immediately, something will happen? It harms the country and the harm is unpredictable.
I hope to show my memorial to the people around you and let the bad guys in the world know that I hate them.
Empress Dowager Dou did not adopt it, and everyone in the court was shocked when they heard about it.
Chen Fan discussed with Dou Wu and wrote in "The Biography of Dou Wu".
When the incident was revealed, Cao Jie and others forged the Queen Mother's order to kill Dou Wu and others.
Chen Fan, who was in his seventies at the time, heard about the rebellion. He led more than eighty officials and students and rushed into the Chengming Gate with swords drawn. He raised his arms and shouted: "The general is loyal to the country, but the eunuchs are rebelling. How can you say that the Dou family does not abide by the principles of being a minister?"
Wang Fu came out of the palace at that time and happened to hear what he said, so he rebuked Chen Fan and said: The late emperor has just passed away and the tomb has not been built yet. What credit does Dou Wu have, while three brothers, father and son, are granted the title of marquis?
In addition, he took away many palace maids, drank and had fun, and collected hundreds of millions of wealth in one month.
If the minister is like this, is this the way of being a minister?
You are the pillar of the country, you bend the law for your own interests and form cliques. How can you catch the thieves?
So he ordered Chen Fan to be arrested.
Chen Fan drew his sword and yelled at Wang Fu loudly. Wang Fu's soldiers did not dare to approach him. So more troops surrounded Chen Fan and others dozens of times, captured Chen Fan, and imprisoned him in Beisi Prison, which was run by eunuchs.
The eunuch's knights kicked and stepped on Chen Fan, scolding Chen Fan: "Old man, can you still cut our staff and deprive us of extra income?"
He was killed on the same day and his family members were exiled to Bijing. The clan, disciples, and old subordinates were all dismissed from their posts and imprisoned.
Chen Fan's friend Zhu Zhen, who was from Chenliu, was the magistrate of Yuzhi County at the time. When he heard the news, he abandoned his official position and mourned Chen Fan, and his body was collected and buried. He hid Chen Fan's son Chen Yi in Ganling.
After the incident was discovered, Zhu Zhen was arrested and imprisoned, and his whole family was imprisoned. Zhu Zhen was severely tortured, but he would rather die than tell Chen Yi's whereabouts.
summary: Chen Fan and General Dou Wu planned to eliminate the eunuchs. Chen Fan warned the Empress Dowager about eunuch corruption, but she ignored him. When the plot was exposed, Cao Jie forged orders to kill Dou Wu. The seventy-year-old Chen Fan led over eighty officials and students into the palace, shouting against the eunuch rebellion. He was arrested, kicked and stepped on by eunuch soldiers, and killed that same day. His family was exiled, and his clan and disciples were imprisoned. His friend Zhu Zhen collected and buried his body, hiding Chen Fan's son Chen Yi. Zhu Zhen endured torture without revealing the son's location. Chen Yi later became Prime Minister of Lu.

translation:
Chen Yi was able to escape. Later, the Yellow Turbans launched an uprising, and the court pardoned the party members, so Chen Yi was found. Later, Chen Yi became the prime minister of Lu.
Zhu Zhen, courtesy name Bohou, first served as a prefecture official. He wrote a letter to expose Shan Kuang, the prefect of Jiyin, for embezzlement, and implicated Shan Kuang's brother Zhongchang, the chariot and cavalry general Shan Chao.
Emperor Huan ordered Shan Kuang to be arrested and handed over to Tingwei for interrogation. He reprimanded Shan Chao, and Shan Chao went to prison to plead guilty.
There is a proverb in Sanfu: A chariot is like a chicken, a horse is like a dog, and evil is like the wind.
The historian commented: During the reign of Emperor Huan and Emperor Ling, people like Chen Fan were able to establish a good reputation for their morals, speak out and comment on the dull reality, run through hardships and obstacles, and compete with the eunuchs in the same dynasty, which resulted in serious disasters.
It's not that they can't keep themselves clean and live in seclusion, but they are pitiful for ordinary people who regard staying away from the world as a noble thing and don't care about human ethics. They believe that escaping from the world is an unjust act, so they have been dismissed many times, but they still refuse to leave reality; they take advocating benevolence as their own duty, and although they know that this road is long, they are even more determined.
When it came time to meet Emperor Huan and Queen Mother Dou, he thought it was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to advise Dou Wu.
How solemn are the deeds of Yi Yin and Taigong in assisting the king that they pursue!
Although the matter did not succeed, their faith was enough to support the people.
The Han Dynasty was in chaos, but it did not perish. For more than a hundred years, it was the power of Chen Fan and others.
◆Biography of Wang Yun, also known as Wang Yun, Zi Shi, a native of Qi County, Taiyuan County.
He has been a state and county official for generations.
Guo Linzong of the same county once met Wang Yun and admired him very much. He said: "The king's life has improved rapidly, and Wang Zuo is so talented."
Become a close friend with him.
At the age of nineteen, he became a county official. At that time, Zhao Jin of Xiaohuangmen, Jinyang, was corrupt and domineering and was a serious problem to the county. Wang Yun captured and killed him.
Zhao Jin's brother flattered the eunuch and used it to make false accusations. Emperor Huan was furious and summoned the prefect Liu Wangzhi to be thrown into prison and died.
Wang Yun sent Liu Wangzhi back to Pingyuan for three full years, and then returned home.
When he became an official again, Lu Fo, a member of the county, was young and undisciplined. Wang Yun, the prefect Wang Qiu, summoned him to serve as a replacement. Wang Yun dared to offend Wang Qiu and failed to do so. Wang Qiu became angry, arrested Wang Yun, and wanted to kill him.
The governor Deng Sheng knew about it, and he galloped to deliver orders and was promoted to another driver.
Wang Yun became famous for this, but Lu Fo was abandoned because of it.
When Wang Yun was young, he was very serious and determined to make contributions to the country. He often recited scriptures and learned to ride horses and archery in the morning and evening.
The three princes all recruited him and he was appointed as the censor according to Situ Gao's rank.
In the first year of Zhongping, the Yellow Turban rebels rioted, and Wang Yun was specially selected as the governor of Yuzhou.
He recruited Xun Shuang, Kong Rong and others to work and wrote a letter to lift the party ban.
The crusade against the Yellow Turbans was won by Don Shuai. Along with General Huangfu Song from the left Zhonglang, Zhu Gen from the right Zhonglang and others, hundreds of thousands of Yellow Turban thieves were surrendered.
Among the thieves, Wang Yun obtained a letter from Zhang Rang, the official attendant of Zhongchang, and interacted with the Yellow Turban. Wang Yun completely exposed his adultery and reported it to the court.
Emperor Ling got angry and scolded Zhang Rang. Zhang Rang kowtowed and asked for forgiveness, but Emperor Ling actually did not punish him.
However, Zhang Rang held a grudge and slandered Wang Yun. The next year, he was arrested and imprisoned.
summary: The historian commented that during Emperors Huan and Ling's reigns, Chen Fan established a reputation for moral integrity, speaking out against corruption and competing with eunuchs despite great danger. Though his plans failed, his faith sustained the people, and the Han dynasty survived over a hundred years due to his efforts.

translation:
Kaixiao, courtesy name Jimeng, was from Chengji County, Tianshui County.
When he was young, he served as a state and county official.
Wang Mang's imperial advisor Liu Xin introduced Kai Xiao as his Yuanshi.
After Liu Xin died, Wei Xiao returned to his hometown.
His uncle, Kui Cui, had always been bold and chivalrous, and was supported by everyone.
When he heard that Gengshi was proclaimed emperor and that Wang Mang's troops were defeated, he planned to raise troops to respond to the Han army with his brother Wei Yi, Yang Guang from Shanggui, and Zhou Zong from Ji.
Wei Xiao stopped him and said: "Sending troops to fight is a dangerous thing!"
What sin does our clan have? Wei Cui refused to listen, so he gathered thousands of people to attack Pingxiang and killed Wang Mang's Zhenrong Dayin. Wei Cui, Yang Guang and others thought that if they wanted to take action, they should appoint a general to unify everyone's thoughts. They all said that Wei Xiao was well-known and loved scriptures, so they jointly recommended Wei Xiao as the general.
Wei Xiao resigned and had no choice but to say: "Fathers and wise men think highly of me, young man, and must use my opinion before I dare to obey." Everyone said: OK.
After Kuai Xiao was established, he sent an envoy to hire Fang Wang from Pingling as a military advisor.
Fang Wangzhi suggested to Kaixiao: "I want to obey the destiny of the people and support the Han Dynasty and start an uprising. Today, I am standing in Nanyang. Wang Mang is still guarding Chang'an. Although he wants to act in the name of the Han Dynasty, he has not actually received the order from the Han Dynasty. What will he do to convince everyone?"
We should quickly build a temple for Emperor Gaozu, worship him as a minister, and use the so-called "Shinto teachings" to seek help from humans and gods.
Moreover, etiquette may be added or deleted from time to time, and there is no standard between simplicity and splendor.
Cutting the ground to open a sign area, even if it is a hut with earthen steps, can still show respect.
Although it is simple and has no material equipment, the gods will not leave here. Kuai Xiao listened to his advice and built a temple in the east of the city to worship Gaozu, Taizong and Shizong.
Wei Xiao and others all called themselves ministers and deacons, and Zhu Shi held a jade in his hand to appeal to the gods.
After the blessing, various functional officials came and went in the court, some leading horses and wielding swords, some carrying plates and spoons, so they killed animals and formed an alliance.
Alliance Dao: There are a total of thirty-one generals with 16 surnames in the alliance, who follow the way of heaven and raise troops to assist Liu Zong.
If there is someone with evil intentions, the gods will destroy him.
Emperor Gaozu, Emperor Wen, and Emperor Wu caused his death, the clan was bloodbathed, and the race was destroyed. The officials marched forward with spoons containing the blood of the sacrifices. The guards held up their hands and bowed to the generals, saying: "The spoons are not stained with blood. If you don't drink the blood, you will deceive the gods and punish him according to the oath of the alliance." In this way, the blood of the sacrifice was applied on the mouth and the covenant was carried out exactly according to the ancient rituals.
At the end of the ceremony, a document was issued to all counties saying:
The first day of the seventh month of the first year of the Han Dynasty is Jiyou Day.
On the past day, General Wei Xiao, White Tiger General Wei Cui, Left General Wei Yi, Right General Yang Guang, Mingwei General Wang Zun, Yunqi General Zhou Zong, etc., sent a proclamation to the state shepherds, department supervisors, county pawns, company leaders, Dayin, Yin, Wei team officials, subordinate Zheng, and subordinate orders: Wang Mang, the former lord of Xindu, insulted and neglected the world, violated the Tao, and violated the principles. He poisoned Emperor Xiaoping and usurped the throne.
Pretending to be destined by heaven, he forged talismans and falsely said that he should replace the Han Emperor, deceiving the people and angering heaven.
summary: Kui Xiao, courtesy name Jimeng, was from Chengji County, Tianshui. He began his career as a local official and later served under Wang Mang's advisor Liu Xin. After Liu Xin's death, Kui Xiao returned home. His uncle, Kui Cui, a bold and chivalrous figure, planned to raise troops to support the Han dynasty after hearing of Gengshi's proclamation and Wang Mang's defeat. Kui Xiao initially advised against it, warning of the dangers of war, but Kui Cui proceeded, gathering thousands to attack Pingxiang. The group then appointed Kui Xiao as general due to his reputation and knowledge of scriptures. Kui Xiao accepted on condition that his advice be heeded.
rel_path: 后汉书/列传/隗嚣公孙述列传

translation:
Grand Sima Dong Zhong, Imperial Advisor Liu Xin, and General Wei Wang She all united to disintegrate from within; Si Ming Kong Ren, Nayan Yanyou, and Zhizong Chen Mao surrendered outside.
Today, there are more than two million soldiers in Shandong. They have pacified Qi, Chu, Xia Shu, and Han, and pacified Wan and Luo. They are based in Aocang, guarding Hanguan, and spreading their orders everywhere, proclaiming their reputation in Zhongyue.
Reviving the Han Dynasty to succeed Liu Si, enfeoffing all the kingdoms, following the old system of Emperor Gaozu, restoring the traditional virtues of Xiaowen, and quelling those who dare to disobey the order by force.
Send envoys to neighboring countries to restore their original titles.
Then he returned to reorganize his troops and put away the bows, arrows, and golden drums.
I specifically order the people to stay in their own place, live and work in peace and contentment, and they will live up to their responsibilities.
Wei Xiao then led an army of 100,000 to kill Chen Qing, the shepherd of Yongzhou.
Prepare to attack Anxi.
Wang Xiang, the Great Yin of Anding, was the son of Wang Mang's cousin Ping'ahou Wang Tan. He was quite popular in the Anding state, and no one in his county rebelled against him.
Wei Xiao then wrote to Wang Xiang, telling him the destiny of heaven, and repeatedly gave him instructions, but Wang Xiang never obeyed.
So they marched in, captured him, declared to the people, and then killed him, and all Anding surrendered.
At this time, someone in Chang'an City raised troops and killed Wang Mang.
Wei Xiao then sent his generals to seize Longxi, Wudu, Jincheng, Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, and Dunhuang, and captured them all.
In the second year of Gengshi, envoys were sent to recruit Wei Xiao, Wei Cui, Wei Yi and others.
Wei Xiao was about to meet with Gengshi. Fang Wang believed that Gengshi's future was still uncertain and resolutely stopped him, but Wei Xiao refused to listen.
Fang Wang wrote a letter of thanks and left, saying:
Generals like Yi Yin and Lu Shang will establish the achievements of the founding of the country and carry forward achievements that are not common in one generation. But now when major events are still being hastily established, heroes and heroes have not yet gathered together.
I am from a different county, and my faults have not yet been exposed. I originally wanted to follow Guo Wei's example in serving King Yan Zhao, so as to attract a great hero like Le Yi and join him under the general's command. Therefore, when you hired me, I came with the wind and did not refuse.
The general respects the talented with the highest virtue, widely adopts his plans, his actions are meritorious, and his troops can hit the key points. Now the foundation has been set, and the Prime Minister's great achievements are being achieved.
Nowadays, there are many talented people, and their wings are already full. I hope that I don’t have any virtue or talent above ordinary people. I am really ashamed to be ranked first among the guests.
Although I have a moral integrity and want to weigh the expediency of resigning and staying in my job, I will never abandon my original intention and have other ambitions.
Why?
After Fan Li helped Gou Jian destroy Wu, he accepted his guilt and took a boat to the five lakes. Jin Wengong's uncle's uncle also stopped on the river on the way back to the country with Wen Gong, apologized to Wen Gong and asked to resign.
With the virtues of Fan Li and Zifu, they have left their names in the history books of Yue and Jin. If they still blame themselves for requesting to return to their hometown, I hope that they have no merit, so it is very appropriate to resign.
summary: Following Fang Wang's counsel, Kui Xiao built a temple to honor Han emperors Gaozu, Taizong, and Shizong, where he and his allies performed rituals and swore an oath to assist Liu Zong, invoking divine punishment for betrayal. They issued a proclamation condemning Wang Mang for crimes against heaven, earth, and humanity, including usurpation, tyranny, and exploitation. Kui Xiao then led 100,000 troops, killing Yongzhou shepherd Chen Qing and capturing Anding after executing Wang Xiang. He later seized Longxi, Wudu, Jincheng, and other commanderies.

translation:
I heard that there is Longchi Mountain in Wushi County, with a small road leading to the south, connecting it with the Han Dynasty. There are often strange people and strangers there. In your spare time, you can seek out the truth.
May the general encourage him.
Wei Xiao came to Chang'an, and he was appointed as the right general. Wei Cui and Wei Yi still maintained their original titles.
In the winter of that year, Wei Cui and Wei Yi planned to rebel against Gengshi and return to the north. Wei Xiao was afraid of harming himself, so he reported the matter to Gengshi, and Wei Cui and Wei Yi were killed.
Gengshi felt that Kui Xiao was loyal to him, so he made him the imperial censor.
In the summer of the next year, Chimei entered the pass and was disturbed by Sanfu.
It was rumored that Guangwu was already located in Hebei, so Wei Xiao suggested to Gengshi that he should hand over the power to Liu Liang, Guangwu's uncle, but Gengshi refused to listen.
The generals wanted to kidnap Gengshi when he returned to the east, and Wei Xiao also participated in this plan.
After the incident was exposed, Gengshi sent someone to summon Wei Xiao. Wei Xiao claimed that he was ill and would not go away, so he and his subordinates Wang Zun and Zhou Zong led their troops to defend themselves.
Gengshi sent Jinwu Deng Ye to lead an army to surround Kaixiao, but Kaixiao closed the gate and refused to defend. At dusk, he could not hold on and broke the siege. Kaixiao and dozens of riders cut down the city gate at night and fled back to Tianshui.
Then he gathered his old troops, occupied the original territory, and called himself General Xizhou.
When the reform failed, all the senior scholar-bureaucrats in Sanfu fled to Tianshui to join Kaixiao.
Kui Xiao has always been honest and respectful, and he tries his best to introduce famous people as common people's acquaintances.
In the past, Wang Mang's Pinghe great Yin Chang'an Gu Gong was appointed as the official in charge, Pingling Fan Ku was appointed as his mentor, Zhao Bing, Su Heng, and Zheng Xing were the wine drinkers, Shen Tugang and Du Lin were the book holders, Yang Guang, Wang Zun, Zhou Zong and Pingxiang people were on patrol, Wang Jie from Heyang and Wang Yuan from Changling were the generals, and the relatives of Du Ling and Jin Dan were the guests.
From this, he became famous in Xizhou and became famous in Shandong.
In the second year of Jianwu's reign, the great Situ Deng Yuxi attacked Chimei and settled in Yunyang. Deng Yu Pi led his troops to rebel against Deng Yu and headed west toward Tianshui. Wei Xiao met the attack, defeated Feng Huanyin at Gaoping, and captured all the baggage.
Therefore, Deng Yu followed the emperor's will and sent a special envoy, Ji Jie Ming, to serve as the general of Xizhou, and he was able to dominate the political affairs of Liangzhou and Shuofang.
When Chimei went to Chang'an and wanted to go west to Long, Kaixiao sent general Yang Guang to attack and defeated Chimei. He also pursued and defeated Chimei between Wushi and Jingyang.
Wei Xiao not only made contributions to the Han Dynasty, but also accepted the title of nobility from Deng Yu, and was able to appoint his confidants. Many people advised him to be the envoy to the capital.
Three years later, Wei Xiao wrote to the capital.
Guangwu had always heard of his virtues and reputation, so he rewarded him with special etiquette, addressed him by name, and used the etiquette of a state guest to comfort and recommend him deeply.
At this time, Lü Kun, a native of Chencang, supported tens of thousands of people, and was connected with Gongsun Shu, and invaded the three assistants.
Wei Xiao once again sent troops to help General Feng Yi attack the west, drove Lu Qian away, and sent an envoy to report.
summary: In the second year of Gengshi, Kui Xiao was summoned to Chang'an and appointed Right General. After his uncle and brother plotted rebellion, Kui Xiao reported them, leading to their deaths, and was made Imperial Censor. When Chimei rebels threatened, Kui Xiao suggested Gengshi delegate power to Liu Liang, but was ignored. He later participated in a plot to kidnap Gengshi, which failed, forcing him to flee to Tianshui, where he declared himself General of Xizhou. He attracted many scholars and officials, gaining fame in the west. Under Guangwu, Kui Xiao initially cooperated, defeating Chimei and aiding General Feng Yi. Guangwu praised him in letters, offering rewards and urging unity against Gongsun Shu. However, Kui Xiao's generals, Wang Yuan and Wang Jie, advised him to maintain independence, citing the dangers of submitting to Guangwu. Kui Xiao agreed, sending his son as a hostage but secretly planning to dominate the region. Over time, his support waned as Guangwu's forces grew. In the sixth year of Jianwu, Guangwu ordered Kui Xiao to attack Shu, but he refused, citing difficult terrain. Guangwu then led a campaign against him, but Kui Xiao resisted, leading to defeats. He apologized but remained defiant. Guangwu's attempts to recruit him failed, and Kui Xiao allied with Gongsun Shu, who named him King of Shuoning. Kui Xiao invaded Anding but was repelled. Many of his generals, including Wang Zun, defected to Guangwu.
rel_path: 后汉书/列传/隗嚣公孙述列传

translation:
It happened that Wu Han and others retreated because they ran out of food, so Anding, Beidi, Tianshui, and Longxi returned to Weixiao.
In the spring of the ninth year, Kuai Xiao was sick and hungry. He went out of the city to boil soybeans and rice for food, and finally died of anger.
Wang Yuan and Zhou Zong made Kai Chun, the youngest son of Kai Xiao, king.
The next year, Lai She, Geng, Gai Yan and others attacked and fell. Zhou Zong, Xing Xun, Gou Yu, Zhao Hui and others surrendered with Kai Chun.
Zhou Zong, Zhao Hui and Zhu Wei moved to the east of the capital respectively, and Wei Chun, Xing Xun and Gou Yu moved to Hongnong.
Only Wang Yuan remained as a Shu general.
When the auxiliary general Zang Gong defeated Yancen, Wang Yuan led everyone to surrender to Zang Gong.
Wang Yuan, whose courtesy name was Huimeng, first served as magistrate of Cai County after the surrender, and later moved to the post of Prime Minister of Dongping. He was imprisoned and died for the crime of untruthfully cultivating land.
Niu Han, named Ruqing, was born in Di Dao. He was brave and talented and dominated the frontier.
After returning to the Han Dynasty, he was recommended by Du Lin, the great situ Sizhi, and Ma Yuan, the great minister of Taizhong, so he became a captain to protect the Qiang, and together with Lai She, he pacified Longyou.
In the 18th year, Kai Chun and dozens of his guests prepared to flee into Hu. When they arrived in Wuwei, they were captured and killed.
The historian commented: "Kui Xiao raised a banner to gather his clan, and established the Gaozu and Xiaowen temples as false gods. When you examine his first creation, you can see his style."
Later, it was finally isolated in a corner, between Han and Shu. Although Longdi was dangerous, it did not have the power of 20,000 people to fight against a million people. The two counties of Longxi and Tianshui were used to fight against Guangwu's powerful army, until they were exhausted in wisdom and strength, with no corvee and taxes. Finally, they died and the troops collapsed, and then they were able to pacify.
It can be seen that there is indeed something worth remembering about his conduct. This is the reason why heroes from all over the world gathered under his command, and the soldiers were loyal and committed suicide without regret.
Fame and reputation will become prominent, careers will wither, and various sins will occur. The success or failure of things depends on heaven and not on people. Perhaps I have not heard of anyone who can break this conclusion.
If Wei Xiao's fate is consistent with his luck, and the opponent he encounters is not a powerful opponent like Guangwu, then can we laugh more at comparing Wei Xiao with Xibo in history?
Gongsun Shu, courtesy name Ziyang, was born in Maoling, Fufeng. During the reign of Emperor Ai, he took his father Baoren as his minister.
Later, his father, Gongsun Ren, became the captain of Henan, and Gongsun Shu replaced him as the magistrate of Qingshui County. Gongsun Ren said that Gongsun Shu was young and sent his disciples to follow him to his post.
After more than a month, he returned home and said to Gongsun Ren: "Gongsun Shu is not someone waiting to be taught." Later, the eunuch took advantage of the report and asked him to take charge of five counties. As a result, the political affairs of these five counties were repaired, gangsters and bandits no longer occurred, and the county said that there were ghosts and gods.
Wang Mang, Tianfengzhong, was the leader of Jiang Zhengzheng. He lived in Linqiong and was also famous as Neng.
When Gengshi came to the throne, heroes raised troops in their respective counties to respond. Zongcheng from Nanyang called himself "General Huya" and invaded Hanzhong; Wang Cen, a businessman, also raised troops in Luo County and called himself "General Dinghan". He killed Wang Mangyong's pastor in response to Zongcheng, and tens of thousands of people were gathered.
When Gongsun Shu heard about it, he sent envoys to meet Zong Cheng and others.
Zongcheng waited until Chengdu, where he looted and tyrannized.
Gongsun Shu was disgusted, so he summoned the heroes of the county and said to them: "The whole world is suffering from Wang Mang's new wife. I have been thinking about the Liu family for a long time, so as soon as I heard that the Han general had arrived, I sent someone to greet him."
summary: In the eighth year, Guangwu's forces besieged Kui Xiao, who fell ill and died of anger. His son Kui Chun was made king but later surrendered. Kui Xiao's legacy was marked by his initial righteousness but eventual failure due to isolation and overreliance on natural defenses. Gongsun Shu, courtesy name Ziyang, from Maoling, rose to power during Wang Mang's decline. He defeated local rebels and declared himself King of Shu, later emperor, citing prophecies and omens. He expanded his territory, gathering troops and resources. Despite Guangwu's letters urging surrender, Gongsun Shu refused, believing in his destiny. His rule was marred by cruelty and poor governance, leading to internal dissent.

translation:
Only members of his Gongsun family could be officials and hold power, and the ministers complained endlessly.
In the eighth year, the emperor sent generals to attack Weixiao. Gongsun Shu sent Li Yu and more than 10,000 people to rescue Weixiao.
Wei Xiao failed and Li Yu's army was wiped out. The people of Shu were shocked and horrified when they heard the news.
Gongsun Shu was afraid and wanted to calm everyone down.
There is an old warehouse from the Qin Dynasty outside Guo, Chengdu, which was renamed Baidi warehouse. It has been often empty since Wang Mang's time.
Gongsun Shu then made people falsely claim that the valleys coming out of Baidi Cang were like mountains and mausoleums, and the people went to see it in empty towns.
Shu then gathered the ministers and asked, "Did Baidicang actually come out of the valley?" All the ministers said: No.
Narrated: False rumors cannot be trusted, and the same goes for rumors that Kui Xiao has been shattered. Soon after, Wang Yuan was surrendered to Shu, and he was appointed as general.
Next year, Wang Yuan and the leading army Huan'an refused to defend Hechi. They also sent Tian Rong, Da Situ Renman, and Nanjun prefect Cheng Xun to lead their troops down to Jiangguan. They defeated the Hanwei general Feng Jun and others, captured Wu, Yiling, and Yidao, and therefore defended Jingmen.
In the eleventh year, Cen Peng, the general who conquered the south, launched an attack. Ren Man and others were defeated. General Wang Zheng beheaded Ren Man and surrendered to Cen Peng.
Tian Rong left to protect Jiangzhou.
All the cities opened their doors and surrendered to Cen Peng, and Cen Peng drove to Wuyang.
Emperor Guangwu wrote a letter to Gongsun Shu, stating the blessings and misfortunes to show that he had no joke.
Gongsun Shu sighed after reading the letter and showed it to his confidants Tai Chang Shao, Guang Luxun and Zhang Long.
Long and Shao both urged Gongsun Shu to surrender.
Gongsun said: The rise and fall are fate.
Where is the emperor who surrenders? People on the left and right did not dare to speak anymore.
Han Zhonglang rushed to Lai She to attack Wang Yuan and Huan'an. Huan'an sent assassins to kill Lai She; Gongsun Shu also ordered Cen Peng to be assassinated.
In the twelfth year, Gongsun Shu's younger brother Gongsun Hui and son-in-law Shi Xing were both attacked by the great Sima Wu Han and the general Zang Gong of Fuwei, and died in battle.
From then on, the general was afraid and rebelled day and night. Although Gongsun Shu killed his entire family, he could not stop him.
Emperor Guangwu wanted Gongsun Shu to surrender, so he issued an edict to inform Gongsun Shu: In previous years, edicts were issued frequently to enlighten and show kindness. Don't doubt yourself because of the harm done to She and Cen Peng.
Now as long as you return as scheduled, you can ensure the integrity of the family; if you are confused and don't realize it, it will be like sending meat into the tiger's mouth, but there is no way to do it!
Your generals are tired, and all the officials want to go home and are unwilling to continue to garrison. There are countless notes in the edict, but I will not break my promise. Gongsun Shu finally had no intention of surrendering.
In September, Wu Han defeated and beheaded its chief disciple Xie Feng and its chief Jinwu Yuan Ji, and Han troops stationed in Chengdu.
Gongsun Shu said to Yancen: What should we do now? Cen said: A man should survive in death, how can he sit and wait for death?
summary: In the eleventh year, Guangwu's generals attacked, defeating Gongsun Shu's forces. He was wounded in battle and died, leading to the fall of his regime. Guangwu condemned the subsequent massacre of Gongsun Shu's family and officials. Historians noted that Gongsun Shu's downfall stemmed from his reliance on geography rather than virtue, echoing past failures.

translation:
◆Ma Yuan's biography: Ma Yuan was named Wenyuan and was a native of Maoling, Fufeng.
His ancestor Zhao She was a general of Zhao, with the title of Ma Fujun, and his descendants considered him a surname.
During the reign of Emperor Wu, he moved two thousand stones from Handan to Maoling.
Ma Tong, his great-grandfather, was granted the title of Chonghehou due to his meritorious service. His brother Ho Luo was implicated in the rebellion and was killed, so Ma Yuan's grandfather and father were not allowed to be prominent officials.
Ma Yuan's three elder brothers, Ma Kuang, Ma Yu, and Ma Yuan, were all talented. At the time of Wang Mang, they were all worth two thousand shi.
Ma Yuan was orphaned when he was twelve years old. He was young and ambitious, and his brothers thought he was strange.
He once taught him to learn Qi poetry, but Ma Yuan could not stick to the chapters and sentences, so he said goodbye to his brother Ma Kuang and wanted to farm and herd in the border counties.
Ma Kuang said: You have great talent, and you will be able to succeed later in the evening.
Good craftsmen don't tell people to use big wood, but just follow your preferences.
On the first anniversary of Ma Kuang's death, Ma Yuan wore mourning clothes and did not leave the tomb. He respected his widowed sister-in-law and would not enter the cottage until he had good hair and a good hat.
Later, he became the postal supervisor of the county and sent prisoners to Siming Mansion. The prisoners had serious crimes, so Ma Yuan took pity on him and let him go, then fled to the north.
After he was pardoned, he left his livestock behind. Many of his guests joined him, and hundreds of families joined him.
When he traveled to Longhan, he often said to his guests: A man's ambition should be stronger when he is poor and more heroic when he is old.
Because they are engaged in farming and grazing, they have thousands of cattle, horses and sheep, and tens of thousands of grains.
Then he sighed: Any property obtained from farming, animal husbandry and commerce is valuable because it can help others, otherwise you will be nothing more than a miser!
So he distributed all his property to his elder brother and his old friend. Living in sheepskin pants.
At the end of Wang Mang's reign, armies from all directions rose up. Wang Mang recruited heroes from his younger brother, General Wang Linguang. He recruited Ma Yuan and Yuan She from the same county as couriers and recommended them to Wang Mang.
Wang Mang took Yuanshe as the great Yin of Zhenrong, and Ma Yuan as the new great Yin.
When Wang Mang was defeated, Ma Yuan's brother Ma Yuan left the county with Ma Yuan to lead the Zengshan Company, and fled to Liangzhou.
When Shizu ascended the throne, the horsemen went to Luoyang first. When the emperor sent the horsemen back, they were still led by Zengshan Company and died in the official position.
Ma Yuan therefore stayed in Xizhou. Kuai Xiao respected him very much, regarded him as General Suide, and made joint decisions with him.
At this time Gongsun Shu proclaimed himself emperor in Shu, and Wei Xiao sent Ma Yuan to Shu to observe.
Ma Yuan and Gongsun Shu were from the same hometown, and they had always been good friends. He thought that Gongsun Shu would shake hands with him after he left, and he would be as happy as before. But this time Gongsun Shu showed his favor to the imperial guards and invited Ma Yuan to meet him. After paying homage, he took Ma Yuan to the residence, made Ma Yuan cloth clothes for him, gave him a hat, met with all the officials in the ancestral temple, and set up his old friend's seat.
summary: Ma Yuan, styled Wenyuan, was a native of Maoling, Fufeng. His ancestor Zhao She was a general of Zhao, and his descendants adopted the surname Ma. During Emperor Wu's reign, the family moved from Handan to Maoling. Ma Yuan's great-grandfather Ma Tong was granted the title of Chonghehou, but his brother was implicated in a rebellion and killed, preventing Ma Yuan's grandfather and father from holding prominent positions. Ma Yuan's three elder brothers were all talented and served as officials worth two thousand shi under Wang Mang. Orphaned at twelve, Ma Yuan was ambitious and unconventional. He left his studies to farm and herd in border counties, eventually amassing great wealth, which he distributed to his brother and friends, living frugally. During the end of Wang Mang's reign, Ma Yuan served as a county official and later fled to the north after releasing a prisoner. He was pardoned and became a successful farmer and herder. He joined Wei Xiao, who respected him and made him General Suide. Ma Yuan was sent to observe Gongsun Shu in Shu but was unimpressed by his pompous behavior, calling him a "frog in a well." He then went to Luoyang to meet Emperor Guangwu, who received him warmly. Ma Yuan praised the emperor's magnanimity and wisdom, comparing him favorably to Gaozu. He returned to Wei Xiao but eventually sided with Guangwu, writing letters to persuade Wei Xiao's generals to defect. Ma Yuan's military strategies were highly valued, and he led campaigns against the Qiang and other rebels, achieving significant victories.

translation:
At this time, the court officials thought that Jincheng was in the west of Poqiang, and the road was far away and there were many bandits, so they decided to abandon it.
Ma Yuan wrote a letter saying that most of the cities to the west of Poqiang are intact and strong and easy to defend; their fields are fertile and have good irrigation.
If the Qiang people are allowed to stay in Huangzhong, the harm will continue, so we cannot give up.
The emperor agreed, so he ordered the prefect of Wuwei to order all the residents of Jincheng in Wuwei to return to Jincheng.
There were more than 3,000 people who returned, so they all returned to their original towns.
Ma Yuanzou told them to appoint chief officials, repair the city walls, build small towns, open up paddy fields, and encourage farming and animal husbandry, so that the county can live and work in peace and contentment.
He also sent Qiang rich man Yang Fengxiao to persuade the Qiang people outside the Great Wall to come and get married.
Also, when the Wudu clan rebelled against Gongsun Shu and surrendered, Ma Yuandu petitioned their princes and princes to be reinstated and given seals and ribbons, which the imperial capital approved.
Undo Ma Chengjun.
In the thirteenth year, the Wudu Shenlangqiang and other tribes outside the Great Wall became bandits and killed the chief officials.
Ma Yuan led more than 4,000 people to attack them. When they arrived at Didao County, the Qiang were on the mountain. Ma Yuan's army occupied a favorable terrain and seized the water and grass of the Qiang army. If they did not fight with them, the Qiang army would be impoverished. The wealthy people led hundreds of thousands of households to escape from the outside of the wall. More than 10,000 people of all ethnic groups surrendered, so Longyou was quiet.
Ma Yuan focused on spreading favor and trust, being lenient to his subordinates, and appointing officials according to their positions, while he himself only focused on major issues.
Guests and old friends gradually gathered under his door.
When subordinate officials sometimes talked about external affairs, Ma Yuan always said: "This is the task of the chief historians and secretaries, so you don't need to tell me."
Feeling pity for me, I am able to enjoy my leisure time.
If the big surname bullies the small people and the cunning Qiang people disobey, it is the governor's business.
There were people in neighboring counties who wanted to take revenge. The officials and the people were panicked and said it was the Qiang people who had done it. The people rushed into the city.
Daochang Di came to the door and asked to close the city gate and send troops to attack. At this time, Ma Yuan was drinking with the guests and laughed and said: How dare the Shao Qiang come to attack me again.
Tell Taoist Master Di to go back and guard the house. Those who are timid and afraid of death can hide under the bed.
Later, the turmoil calmed down, and everyone in the county was convinced of Ma Yuan's courage.
He served in Longxi for six years and was called back to worship him as Huben Zhonglang.
At first, when Ma Yuan was in Longxi, he wrote a letter saying that five baht coins should be minted as in the past.
The imperial court transferred the matter to the offices set up by Taiwei, Situ and Sikong. The three palaces reported that it was unacceptable, so the matter was shelved. When Ma Yuan returned to the capital, he obtained the memorials from the previous three palaces from the government, debated more than ten points, explained them with the ultimatum, and stated the reasons in a table.
The emperor agreed, and the world relied on his convenience.
Ma Yuan returned to the capital and was summoned many times.
Ma Yuan paid attention to grooming his beard and hair, and his features were picturesque. He is good at answering questions and is especially good at telling stories about past lives.
Every time I talk about the elders from the three auxiliaries to the young people in the countryside, it is very touching.
When the crown prince and the attendants of the kings heard this, they all listened so much that they forgot to get tired.
summary: Ma Yuan served as Governor of Longxi, where he focused on spreading favor and trust, appointing capable officials, and encouraging agriculture and animal husbandry. He successfully pacified the region and proposed minting five-baht coins, which was implemented. He later led campaigns against the Wuxi barbarians in Wuling, but died of illness at age 62. After his death, he was falsely accused of bringing back treasures from the south, leading to the emperor's anger and the revocation of his marquis title. His family was disgraced until a letter from Zhu Bo, a former associate, helped clear his name. Ma Yuan's daughter later became empress, and he was posthumously honored as Marquis Zhongcheng. His sons included Ma Liao, Ma Fang, Ma Guang, and Ma Keqing, the latter dying young. The historian notes Ma Yuan's rise to fame and his tragic fall due to slander, reflecting on the perils of fame and the importance of self-reflection.

translation:
◆The biography of Ma Rong, whose courtesy name is Ji Chang, was born in Maoling, Fufeng. He will be the son of Ma Yan, a great craftsman.
The person is beautiful, talented, and good at speaking.
In the past, Jingzhao Zhixun lived in seclusion in Nanshan and taught students Confucianism. He should not be recruited and was well-known in Kansai. Ma Rong studied under him and became proficient in the classics.
Zhixun admired Ma Rong's talent and married his daughter to him.
In the second year of Yongchu, the general Deng Zhi heard that Ma Rong was famous and called him to be a minister. He didn't like this and refused to accept the order. He lived as a guest between Wudu and Hanyang in Liangzhou.
At this time, Qiang barbarians appeared and disturbed the border. The price of rice soared, and people starved to death on the roads west of Guan.
Ma Rong was hungry and sleepy, so he regretted it and said to his friend: There is an ancient saying: Holding the map of the world with your left hand and cutting its throat with your right hand, even a fool would not do such a thing that harms lives in the name of others.
Why? Life is the most precious.
Now, for fear of being ridiculed by the local people, the priceless body is destroyed, which is not in line with the principles of Lao and Zhuang. So he went to answer Deng Zhao's call.
In the fourth year, he became the school's calligrapher and went to Dongguan Dian School to collect secret books.
At this time, Empress Dowager Deng took power, and the Deng Zhao brothers assisted in the government.
Generally speaking, Confucian scholars, who are superficial, believe that virtue can be promoted and martial arts should be abolished, so they stopped the system of martial arts training and did not talk about the method of battle formation. Therefore, cunning thieves emerged in droves, taking advantage of the country's unpreparedness.
Ma Rong was very dissatisfied. He believed that the way of civil and military affairs was valued by sages. Metal, wood, water, fire, and earth were all used by people at the same time. One cannot be abolished. How could one not talk about martial arts?
In the second year of the Yuan Dynasty, he published "Guangcheng Ode" to satirize and admonish him.
The preface says: I heard Confucius said: Being extravagant and wasteful means being humble, being too simple and frugal is mean. Luxury and frugality are based on etiquette.
Therefore, "Cricket" and "Shanshu" both satirize the king not to enjoy himself too much and not to leave his carriages and horses unused.
The way of civil and military affairs is to compromise. Be happy but not excessive, worry but not tired. This is why the ancestors calmed the internal organs and nourished the spirit, and they will always practice it.
Therefore, how to use music is recorded in "Yu Mo", "Ji Ri Tian Hui" is also described in "Zhou Shi".
This is a sage king and a virtuous king. Is it to praise the prosperous age? Is it for luxury and lewdness?
Since Emperor An came to the throne, there was an earthquake. The emperor was alert to the disaster and worked hard himself. The forbidden garden was deserted and the musical instruments were discarded. He worked hard and thought for more than ten years, exceeding the etiquette system.
In addition, the empress dowager embodies the sincere and harmonious feelings of the nine clans of Tang Yao; the emperor practiced the filial piety of Yu and Chunhou, and rarely neglected to send people to express condolences if any of his relatives were sick.
Having peace of mind all the time and no entertainment is probably not the way to welcome Taihe and contribute to all blessings.
summary: Ma Rong, courtesy name Ji Chang, was born in Maoling, Fufeng, as the son of Ma Yan. He was handsome, talented, and eloquent. He studied under the recluse Zhixun in Nanshan, mastering the classics, and Zhixun married his daughter to him. In the second year of Yongchu, General Deng Zhi summoned him, but Ma Rong refused and lived as a guest in Liangzhou. During a Qiang rebellion, famine struck, and Ma Rong, facing hardship, regretted his refusal, citing the value of life from Laozi and Zhuangzi, and accepted Deng Zhi's call. In the fourth year, he became a calligrapher at Dongguan Dian School, collecting secret books.
