He called for a righteous uprising to restore order.

translation:
Chen Huya is Bozhi's son. He fled back in embarrassment. People among them should be afraid. I think Jiujiang can pacify him by spreading the proclamation.
He ordered the prisoners captured by the search to be rewarded generously by Su Longzhi, the owner of Bozhi's building, and asked him to convey the mission to Chen Bozhi.
Sun Lezu, the lord of Lushan City, Cheng Mao, and Xue Yuansi, the lords of Yingcheng City, successively requested surrender.
At first, when the city of Ying was closed, there were more than 100,000 generals, civil and military officials, and 78 out of 10 people died of beriberi. After the city gates were opened, Emperor Gaozu took pity on them and provided simple coffins for those who died.
Previously, Hu Wenchao, a native of Runan, revolted in Shiyang and asked to conquer Yiyang, Anlu and other counties to take the initiative. Emperor Gaozu sent the army leader Tang Xiuqi to attack Sui County and captured it.
Wang Sengjing, the governor of Sizhou, sent his son Zhensun as a hostage.
The entire area under Sizhou's jurisdiction was pacified.
Chen Bozhi sent Su Longzhi to reply and asked for permission not to march.
Emperor Gaozu said: Bo Zhi's words showed that he was hesitant in his heart. When he hesitated, he hurried to persecute him. He had nothing to do, so he would definitely not riot.
So Deng Yuan was ordered to lead his army and go down the river that day.
In August, the emperor sent Huangmenlang Su back to comfort the army.
Emperor Gaozu boarded the ship and ordered all the generals to go forward one by one, leaving Wei San, the prefect of Shangyong, to guard Ying City and conduct state affairs.
Deng Yuanqi was about to arrive in Xunyang, but Chen Bozhi was still suspicious, so he withdrew his troops and retreated to Hukou, leaving his son Huya to guard Basin City.
When Emperor Gaozu arrived, he put away his armor to express his submission and apologize.
In September, the emperor ordered Gaozu to pacify Shuxia and act arbitrarily.
This month, the Shaofu and Chief Shi Zheng Shaoshu were left to guard Jiangzhou City.
The vanguard troops were stationed in Wuhu, and Shenzhou, the governor of Southern Yuzhou, abandoned Gushu and fled. At this time, the army entered and occupied it, and sent Cao Jingzong and Xiao Yingda to lead cavalry and infantry to station in Jiangning.
Donghun sent the conquest general Li Jushi to lead the infantry to fight, but Jingzong repelled him.
So Wang Mao, Deng Yuanqi, and Lu Seng marched to occupy Chibiluo, with Cao Jingzong and Chen Bozhi as mobile troops.
On this day, Jiang Daolin, the lord of Xinting City, led his troops out of the city to fight, and the troops captured him on the battlefield.
The army was stationed at Tongla, and Wang Lu marched to occupy Langqiu, Cao Jingzong occupied Zaoji Bridge, Deng Yuanqi occupied Taoist Dune, and Chen Bozhi occupied Limen.
The rest of Daolin's troops retreated to the south of the pontoon, and the righteous troops advanced on them. Then they broke up and fled, retreated to Zhu Jue's defense, and relied on the Huaihe River to consolidate themselves.
At that time, layman Li still occupied the new pavilion base and asked Donghun to burn the cottages on the south bank to open a battlefield.
From the area west of Dahang and north of Xinting. Already flattened.
In October, Zhu Sengyong, the leader of the Stone Army in Donghun, led 2,000 navy troops to surrender.
Shuhun also sent the conscripting general Wang Zhenguo and the army commander Hu Huya to set up formations on the avenue south of the pontoon bridge. They were all equipped with elite soldiers and weapons, and there were still more than 100,000 people.
The eunuch Wang Yizi, holding a white tiger flag in his hand, supervised the troops and dismantled the pontoon bridge with his back to the river to cut off the return route.
Wang Mao, Cao Jingzong and others attacked directly towards the enemy. The soldiers fought desperately, one against a hundred, beating drums and shouting shook the world.
Zhenguo's army collapsed instantly, and those who were thrown into the Huaihe River died. The corpses were piled up as high as the pontoon bridge, and those who were later stepped on it to cross. When Zhu Jue's troops saw it, they all collapsed.
The righteous army pursued them to Xuanyang Gate, where Li Jushi led Xintinglei and Xu Yuanyu led Shufucheng to surrender. Shitou and Baixia's armies collapsed at night.
At Renwu, Emperor Gaozu guarded Shitou, ordered the army to surround the six gates, burned all the houses in the gates, and drove out all the people in the camps and government offices into the city, with a tribe of two hundred thousand people.
Qingzhou governor Huan He deceived Donghun to leave the city to fight, and took the opportunity to lead his army to surrender.
Emperor Gaozu ordered the troops to build long fortifications around the city.
At first, when the righteous troops were advancing, Donghun sent military commanders Zuo Sengqing to guard Jingkou, Chang Sengjing to guard Guangling, and Li Shuxian to guard Guabu. When Shen Zhou fled from Gushu, he was asked to garrison Podun as support for the northeast.
At this time, Emperor Gaozu sent an envoy to inform them, and they all led their troops to surrender.
So he sent his younger brother General Xiao Xiu to guard Jingkou, General Xiao Hui to guard Podun, and his cousin General Ningshuo Xiao Jing to guard Guangling.
Cai Wei, the governor of Wu County, abandoned the county and went to the righteous army.
On the morning of Bingyin in December, Zhang Dan, the concurrent guard, and Wang Zhenguo, the governor of North Xuzhou, beheaded Donghun and gave his head to the righteous army.
Emperor Gaozu ordered Lu Sengzhen to command the army to close the palace warehouses and books, arrest the maids and concubines, and forty-one subordinate officials under the rebel Wang Xi, and kill them all.
Queen Xuande ordered that King Fuling be deposed as Donghunhou, in accordance with the old rule of Donghunhou.
He appointed Gaozu as the Superintendent of the Zhongshu, the Commander-in-Chief of the two states of Yangnan and Xu, the military affairs department, the Grand Sima, the Secretary of Records, the Hussar General, and the Governor of Yangzhou. He was granted the title of Duke of Jian'an, with 10,000 households living in the city. Forty warriors with decorated swords were given to him. The military positions of Huangtie, Shizhong, and expedition were still the same; in accordance with the old practice of Sima Zun, King of Wuling in the Jin Dynasty, who acted in accordance with the emperor's will.
In Ji Mao, Emperor Gaozu entered the martial arts hall.
summary: The army advanced, defeating enemy forces at various locations. Gaozu's forces captured key cities, and many officials surrendered. In December, Donghun was beheaded, and Gaozu entered the martial arts hall, issuing orders for a general amnesty and reforms. He abolished harsh taxes and punishments, promoted frugality, and established new regulations. He was appointed as Grand Sima and Duke of Jian'an, later promoted to Duke of Liang with nine gifts.

translation:
Sitting and waiting for dawn is like the empress of Yin Dynasty, and forgetting to eat every day is more than Zhou Wen.
The customs are solemn and orderly, and the rituals and music interact smoothly.
In addition, forgiveness and forgiveness of sins can be used to conquer the world with good and bad fortunes without punishment, virtues and virtues can shine like stars, and the ultimate sense of justice can communicate with ghosts and gods.
As for the matter of leading the Green Heavenly Son, accepting the destiny that comes at the right time, facing the strong wind without being confused, and being willing to support this is the key.
To restore order to the five climates that have been disturbed, and to add weight to the already weak state power.
The place where prestige educates people, where the imperial system is implemented, they change their appearance and submit.
Praise kindness. The mountains of Kyushu have eliminated evil spirit, and the Yangtze River, Yellow River, Huaihe River, and Jishui River flow slowly and steadily.
The auspicious wind blows and the long rain subsides.
Black crustaceans swim among the fragrant grass and herbs, and "Spring and Autumn" is expounded in the literary garden on the outskirts.
From the great rivers of Kyushu, one rises to the sky, and on the high mountains there is a phoenix called an island.
There are many auspicious signs displayed by the heavens, and the auspicious symbols are clearly revealed.
As for comets appearing in Ziweiyuan, floods appearing in Mengyue, flying giant insects filling the fields, and long comets sweeping across the sky, signs of renewal have appeared, and signs of renewal must appear.
In addition, the king of Liang has an outstanding emperor's appearance, and Xuanyuan's appearance is like that of Yu Shun; the signs of being dominated by the king are indeed different. "Shangshu" says: God clearly recognizes his virtue and therefore gathers the destiny. The Book of Songs says: King Wen is above, and it is revealed to heaven.
Is the reason for the grace and harmony of heaven and earth just encompassing the whole world and gathering singers and litigants?
Therefore, I held the beautiful jade and bowed my head in meditation, remembering the sage.
In the past, when the virtue of water declined, my great ancestor accepted the destiny to replace the old dynasty. When I was alive, the throne of the emperor declined, and he passed on the throne with virtue of wood.
I search for ancient scriptures from far away, and think about the modern times. I have hundreds of officials far and near, and don’t go against my heart.
The envoys Chijie, Taibao, Shizhong, Zhongshujian, and Shangshuling, the founding lord of Runan County, Wang Liang, and Taiwei, Sanqi Changshi, and Zhongshuling, the founding lord of Xinwu County, Wang Zhi, are now sent to present the emperor's seal and ribbon.
The ceremony of accepting the throne was all based on the precedent of Tang Yao Tang who gave way to Lu Tan.
King Luan please ascend to the throne of emperor, rule all over the world, inherit the great achievements, and use it to repay God for his good destiny!
Emperor Gaozu submitted a memorial to the emperor to express his humility, but the memorial was not approved.
At this time, 819 people including Yuzhang, Wang Yuanlin and other officials of the Southern Qi Dynasty, as well as 117 people including Xiao Yun, the minister of the Liang Prince's Office, came forward to persuade them to join, but Gaozu Qianyang refused to accept it.
On the same day, Taishi ordered the blue sculpture to display a total of sixty-four astronomical phenomena and Fu Yuan prophecies. The things described were all clear and obvious. The ministers again petitioned, and Gaozu obeyed.
summary: Gaozu refused the title of King of Liang multiple times but eventually accepted after repeated requests from officials and auspicious signs. He implemented reforms in the election system, emphasizing talent over family background. In April, Queen Xuande issued an order for the abdication of the Southern Qi throne to King Liang, citing his virtues and achievements. Gaozu initially declined but eventually accepted, becoming Emperor Gaozu of the Liang Dynasty.

translation:
On the first day of the first lunar month in the spring of the first year of the ordinary year, the year was changed, and the whole country was granted amnesty. Civil and military officials were given grades for their achievements, and agricultural officials who were filial and loyal to the fields were given a rank of nobility. Extraordinarily poor families were not levied normal taxes, and the widows, widowers, and lonely people were all provided with assistance and compensation.
Bingzi, a solar eclipse occurs.
In Ji Mao, Xiao Hong, king of Situ Linchuan, was appointed as Taiwei and the governor of Yangzhou. Xiao Jing, the general of Anyou and the governor of Yangzhou, was appointed as the general of Anxi and the governor of Yingzhou.
When Shangshu Zuopushe Wang Lai resigned due to his mother's death, Jin Ziguanglu's doctor Wang Feng took over as Shangshu Zuopushe.
Gengzi, Funan and Goryeo each sent envoys to pay tribute to local specialties.
In the second month of Renzi, the star Canopus appeared.
Guichou appointed Zhixuan, the crown prince of the King of Korea, as General Ningshu and Zhiwuwang.
In March Bing and Wu, Gao Xi sent an envoy to pay tribute to local specialties.
In the fourth month of summer, the king of Henan sent envoys to pay tribute to local specialties.
At the end of June, Tong He, the guard general, was appointed as the chariot and cavalry general.
At the end of the seventh month of autumn, the Yangtze River, Huaihe River, and ocean all rose and overflowed their embankments.
In Xinmao, Xiao Lun, the king of Shaoling, the general of Xinwei, was appointed as the governor of Jiangzhou.
In August Gengxu, the star Canopus appeared.
In Jiazi, the new chariot and cavalry general Wei Tiao passed away.
In the ninth month of Yihai, a star appeared in the east in the early morning, shining brightly like a flame.
In the winter of October 1911, General Xuanhui of Changsha and Wang Shenye of Changsha were appointed as generals of the army.
Xin You appointed Xiao Gang, king of Yin Jin'an in Danyang, as General Pingxi and governor of Yizhou.
In the first month of the second year of Jiaxu, Xiao Zong, the governor of South Xuzhou and the king of Yuzhang, was appointed as the general of Zhenyou.
The new governor of Yizhou, King Xiao Gang of Jin'an, was appointed governor of Xuzhou.
Xin Si, the emperor personally offered sacrifices to the southern suburbs.
Shaoling said: The Chun Temple serves the solar terms and offers sacrifices respectfully. The pottery vessels are natural and honest, the black jade bis are complete in etiquette, and the care is based on the blessings of heaven's protection and care.
The competent authorities and counties will take care of those who are old and lonely, or those who are young and have lost their parents, and will provide food and clothing relief to them to maintain their livelihood.
In addition, a lonely garden was set up in the capital so that orphans would have a home and the elderly would not be in need.
If you die, bury him with dignity.
For particularly poor families, land tenant surveys are not levied.
Wuzi, amnesty to the world.
In the second month of Xinchou, the emperor personally offered sacrifices to Mingtang.
In March Gengyin, it snowed heavily, and the snow was three feet deep on the flat ground.
In the fourth month of summer, on Yi Mao, the altar in the southern and northern suburbs was rebuilt.
summary: In the first year of the ordinary year, the reign name was changed, and a general amnesty was granted. Civil and military officials were rewarded based on their achievements, and agricultural officials who were filial and loyal were given noble ranks. Extremely poor families were exempted from taxes, and widows, widowers, and orphans received assistance. A solar eclipse occurred. Xiao Hong, King of Linchuan, was appointed Taiwei and governor of Yangzhou, while Xiao Jing was reassigned to Yingzhou. Wang Lai resigned due to his mother's death, and Wang Feng succeeded him. Funan and Goryeo sent tribute. The star Canopus appeared. The crown prince of Korea was appointed General Ningshu. Gao Xi sent tribute. The King of Henan sent tribute. Tong He was appointed chariot and cavalry general. The Yangtze, Huai, and ocean waters overflowed. Xiao Lun was appointed governor of Jiangzhou. Canopus appeared again. Wei Tiao died. A bright star appeared in the east. Xiao Gang was appointed governor of Yizhou.

translation:
Bingchen, the edict said: "Respect and obey God, the sky will not be chaotic, personally hold the farm tools, work hard to show respect, go up and harmonize with the stars, and go down to teach the people to follow the seasons, distinguish the order of spring plowing, and it is not in the south according to the law."
The previous generations followed the rules and violated the etiquette. In the east, fertile fields were selected and established, hoping to comply with the old regulations.
On Guimao in the fifth month, a fire broke out in the Wanyan Palace and spread to burn down 3,000 houses in the harem.
Ding Si, the edict said: Princes, princes and ministers, I am now sending a watch and seal to celebrate the auspiciousness. Although it is the sincerity of all the officials to care for the country, I really feel a lot of shame in my heart.
If grace spreads all over rivers and mountains, benevolence covers animals and plants, the climate is harmonious in the four seasons, politics is peaceful, and auspiciousness descends from heaven, there is no need to feel ashamed. However, if there are many flaws in governance and simple education has not been formed, how can we reach out to the stars and receive blessings from the gods from afar?
This further shows my meager virtues and adds to my faults.
You can stop celebrating auspiciousness from now on.
In the sixth month of Ding Mao, General Xinwei and Yizhou Governor Wen Sengming betrayed the state and defected to Wei.
In the seventh month of Autumn, Dingyou gave the great craftsman Pei Sui Fu Jie to command all the armies to attack the north.
In Jiayin, Canopus appeared.
Huan Shuxing, the governor of Jingzhou in Wei State, led his troops to surrender.
On the eighth day of the lunar month, the land in Shigu Village, Zhongshiping County, split open and turned into a well, which was six feet six inches square and thirty-two feet deep.
In November of winter, Baekje and Silla each sent envoys to pay tribute to local specialties.
On the 10th day of the 10th century, the general Zhenshu, King Yulong of Baekje, was appointed as the general Ningshu.
In the spring of the third year of the first lunar month, Gengzi appointed Shangshu Ling Yuan Ang as the Superintendent of Zhongshu, Wang Chen, the prefect of Wu County, as Shangshu Zuopushe, and Shangshu Zuopushe Wang Fen as Youguanglu doctor.
Gengxu, an earthquake occurred in the capital.
Before long, he appointed General Xuanyi and Prince Xiao Xu of Luling as the governor of Yongzhou.
On Yimao in March, Xiao Ping, the king of Baling, passed away.
On Ding Mao, the fourth month of summer, Liu Duan, king of Ruyin, passed away.
On the first day of the fifth lunar month, a solar eclipse occurs, which is a total eclipse.
In Guisi, a general amnesty was issued to the whole country, and orders were issued to all directions. All the sufferings of the people were immediately reported to the public. The ministers and ministers each kept their seals to report, and the prime ministers of the prefectures and states recommended those who were virtuous, upright, and dared to speak the truth.
In Autumn and August, Xinyou, the construction of the altar in the southern and northern suburbs and the fields used for farming by the emperor were completed, and the craftsmen were rewarded in varying amounts.
Jiazi, Canopus appeared.
The countries of Poli and Baiti each sent envoys to pay tribute to local specialties.
In the tenth month of winter, Yuan Ang was awarded the title of General of the Central Guard.
In November, during the Sino-Japanese War, General Fujun, Kaifu Yitong Sansi, and leading general Shixing Wang Xiao Dan passed away.
summary: In the second year, Xiao Zong was appointed general. The emperor sacrificed to the southern suburbs, emphasizing proper rituals and care for the elderly and orphans. A lonely garden was established in the capital. The emperor sacrificed to Mingtang. Heavy snow fell. The southern and northern suburban altars were rebuilt. An edict stressed farming and seasonal order. A fire in the Wanyan Palace burned 3,000 houses. The emperor ordered an end to celebrating auspicious omens. Wen Sengming defected to Wei. Pei Sui was sent to attack the north. Canopus appeared. Huan Shuxing of Wei surrendered. A well formed in Shigu Village. Baekje and Silla sent tribute. The King of Baekje was appointed General Ningshu. In the third year, Yuan Ang was appointed Superintendent of Zhongshu. An earthquake occurred in the capital. Xiao Xu was appointed governor of Yongzhou. Xiao Ping and Liu Duan died. A total solar eclipse occurred. A general amnesty was declared, and virtuous people were sought. The suburban altars and imperial fields were completed. Canopus appeared. Poli and Baiti sent tribute. Yuan Ang was awarded a title. Xiao Dan died. Xiao Yuanzao was appointed leading general.

translation:
Xin Chou appointed Prince Zhan Shi Xiao Yuanzao as the leading general.
In the spring of the fourth year of the first lunar month, Xin Mao, the emperor personally offered sacrifices to the southern suburbs and granted amnesty to the world. All the poor and sick were provided with relief and compensation, and he issued orders to all directions to deal with cases and lawsuits in a timely manner.
On Bingwu, the emperor personally offered sacrifices to Mingtang.
On Gengwu in February, the star Canopus appeared.
In Yihai, the emperor personally cultivated the fields.
The edict said: Cultivating the fields is of great significance!
Sacrifices were produced from this, etiquette became prominent from this, and all the wise kings of ancient times prospered from this.
Reviewing the eight types of political affairs, carrying out land cultivation, ministering to hundreds of officials, respectfully performing etiquette, the etiquette of removing soil nine times is completed, and sacrifices continue.
In addition, the weather is good and the weather is changing. It coincides with seeing the beautiful moment, thinking about it and rewarding it.
It can be promulgated in various places to widely open up fertile land, public and private land, and make sure to fully reap the benefits of the land.
If there are those who want to return to farming but lack food and seeds, they will also be given loans and compensation, making sure they are generous and considerate.
The agricultural officer of Ren Xiaoti Litian was given a first-level title.
Relevant officials involved in farming selected a time to hold a banquet to express their condolences.
In the third month of Renyin, Xiao Zong, the king of Yuzhang, the general who Zhenyou, was appointed as the general of Pingbei and the governor of Yanzhou in the south.
In June Yichou, Yizhou was divided to form Xinzhou, Jiaozhou was divided to form Aizhou, Guangzhou was divided to form Chengzhou, Nandingzhou, Hezhou, and Jianzhou, and Huozhou was divided to form Yizhou.
In Autumn and August, Ding Mao, the star Canopus appears.
On Gengwu in the tenth month of winter, Yuan Ang, the eunuch of the Zhongshu and the general of the Zhongwei, was appointed as Shangshuling.
On Ji Mao, the guard general Chang Yi died.
On the first day of November, Guiwei, a solar eclipse occurs.
Taibai appears during the day.
On the day of Jiachen, Shangshu Zuopushe and Wang Chen passed away.
On Wuwu day of the twelfth lunar month, iron coins began to be minted.
Langya Xiuguo sent envoys to pay tribute to local specialties.
In the first month of the spring of the fifth year, Dr. Zuo Guanglu and Nanping Wang Xiaowei of Kaifu Yitong Sansi were appointed as generals of the Zhenwei. They were changed to Dr. You Guanglu and Yitong Sansi remained as before.
General Zhengxi, Kaifu Yitong Sansi, Jingzhou Governor Poyang King Xiao Hui was promoted to General of Hussars.
Xia Houyi, the Taifu Qing, served as the central guard.
Wang Feng, the doctor of Youguanglu, served as the doctor of Zuoguanglu, and was awarded special promotion.
In Xinmao, Xiao Zong, the general of Pingbei and the governor of southern Yanzhou, Yuzhang Wang, was promoted to the title of general of Zhenbei.
General Pingxi and the governor of Yongzhou, Xiao Gang, King of Jin'an, was promoted to General Anbei.
On the Gengwu day of February, Wang Fen, the doctor of Te Jin and Zuo Guanglu, passed away.
Ding Chou. Canopus appears.
In the third month of the third month of the year, Jiawu, the Han Dynasty was divided and the Liao Dynasty was established in Yangzhou.
summary: In the fourth year, the emperor sacrificed to the southern suburbs and granted amnesty. Canopus appeared. The emperor cultivated fields, issuing an edict on the importance of farming. Xiao Zong was appointed general. New provinces were established. Canopus appeared. Yuan Ang was appointed Shangshuling. Chang Yi died. A solar eclipse occurred. Wang Chen died. Iron coins were minted. Langya Xiuguo sent tribute.

translation:
Before long, the Crown Princess Wang passed away.
On Ding Mao, the bandit army captured the palace city and allowed the soldiers to plunder wantonly.

Bingshen, the earth shook again.

In this month, Ming Shaoxia, the governor of Qingji Prefecture, Zhan Haizhen, the governor of East Xuzhou, and Wang Fengbo, the governor of Northern Qingzhou, each offered their state cities to attach themselves to Wei.
On Bingchen in the fifth month, Emperor Gaozu passed away in Jingju Hall at the age of eighty-six.
Xin Si moved the coffin of Emperor Daxing to the front hall of Tai Chi.
In November of winter, Emperor Daxing was honored as Emperor Wu, and his temple name was Gaozu.
Yimao was buried in Xiu Ling.
Gaozu was born honest and filial.
When he was six years old, the Empress Dowager Xian passed away. He refused to drink water and rice soup for three days. He cried and suffered in pain. He was more than an adult, and his relatives both inside and outside were respected and surprised.
When Emperor Wen passed away, he was appointed as the advisor to King Yilidi and joined the army. He accompanied the army to the town of Jingzhou. When he heard the news, he handed in his resignation and hurried on at night without eating or sleeping. He traveled day and night, and there were strong winds and waves, and he did not stop for a short time.
Gaozu was originally strong and strong, but when he returned to the capital, he was so thin that his relatives and friends no longer recognized him.
I visited the house to worship my father, passed out for a long time, and vomited several liters of blood every time I cried.
During the period of mourning, rice is no longer eaten, only barley is eaten, only more than two liters per day.
Paying homage to the mausoleum, where the tears fell, the pine trees and weeds changed their colors.
When he was on the throne, he built the Great Aijing Temple in Zhongdan, the Shuqing Temple in Yixuanbian, and the Zijing and other halls in the court.
Seven temples were also set up, and they went there twice a month to display vegetarian food.
Whenever he bowed down, he would burst into tears, and his sadness would move everyone around him.
In addition, he has a quick mind and can conduct in-depth research on everything. He was fond of learning when he was young and was proficient in Confucianism and Taoism.
Although there are many things to do, he never leaves his hand to return books, lighting candles and studying by light, often until the fifth watch.
He wrote "Zhizhi Xiaojing Yi", "Book of Changes", as well as sixty-four hexagrams, two chapters of "Xici", "Wenyan", "Preface" and other chapters, "Yue She Yi", "Mao Shi Answers", "Spring and Autumn Answers", "Shang Shu Dayi", "The Doctrine of the Doctrine", "Confucius' True Words", "Laozi's Notes", a total of more than 200 volumes, all of which corrected the confusion of the previous Confucians and revealed the will of the ancient sages.
The princes and courtiers presented memorials to ask questions, and Emperor Gaozu explained them to them.
It also built the School of Decorative Guozi, increased the number of students, established five libraries, and established a doctorate in the "Five Classics".
In the early years of Tianjian, He Tongzhi, He Chang, Yan Zhizhi, Mingshan Bin and others expounded the emperor's will, and wrote the five rites of good fortune, bad luck, military, guest, and Jia, a total of more than a thousand volumes. As the emperor, Gaozu made decisions for him.
summary: In the third year, Liu Zhongli occupied the south bank. Wei Can died. Xiao Lun and Dalian gathered. Zhu Yi died. Fu Qi was appointed. Li Qianshi and Fansai were defeated. Mars stayed in the heart. Venus appeared. Xiao Hui and Xiao Tui arrived. Xiao Fan was appointed. Yang Yaren was defeated. The crown princess died. The palace was captured. Hou Jing claimed power. Reinforcements dispersed. Fu Qi died. An earthquake occurred. The emperor fell ill. Ming Shaoxia and others defected to Wei. The emperor died at age 86. He was honored as Emperor Wu. He was buried in Xiu Ling. The emperor was filial, learned, and frugal. He wrote many works and promoted Buddhism. He was diligent in governance. Historians praised his early reign but criticized his later reliance on favored officials, which led to decline.

translation:
On Bingyin in the summer of the first year of Tianjian, Emperor Gaozu ascended the throne in the southern suburbs.
An altar was set up to burn firewood and a sacrifice was made to inform the heaven: Xiao Yan, a minister of the emperor, took the liberty of sacrificing a black bull to clearly inform the emperor and God: The movement of the celestial phenomena shows that the Qi family has exhausted its energy and misfortune. Prosperity is about to come. In obedience to heaven's inspiration, I have been given the order to Xiao Yan.
To establish a monarch, only those who are worthy are given; destiny is not static, and emperors do not belong to one surname or clan.
Yaoxun of the Tang Dynasty ordered Yu Shun to take over, and the Han Dynasty declined and the Wei Dynasty rose, until the Shu Jin Dynasty and the Liu Song Dynasty followed the example of the past.
They all rule the country with the kindness of the Lord, and take nurturing the people as their highest achievement. Therefore, they can greatly protect the people and conquer the world.
At the end of the Qi Dynasty, the monarch was confused and cruel, and a group of greedy and deceitful traitors were praised and allowed to take power. They indulged in their evil and violent rebellion, wreaking havoc on our country, making the world fearful and uneasy, and would fall into the abyss.
All over the country, local governors were appointed as frontier officials. They knelt down and knelt down with their foreheads knocked on the ground. They were unable to correct the situation and lay down on firewood to be burned. They blamed everyone and refused to appeal.
I was excited to rush to the rescue, marched thousands of miles, and used my passion to resign my job to save the people's crisis.
He worked hard and gathered the crowd to swear an oath, wiped out powerful enemies, massacred and raped them, established a new monarch, and eradicated the confused old monarch.
So he relied on the running time to take charge of the country. It is indeed a great contribution to save the people in such a time-consuming manner.
Moreover, the sun and stars show auspiciousness, and the mountains and rivers show blessings, often in the wilderness and often in the suburbs.
The signs of replacing the old dynasty have appeared, and the period of change in the national destiny has arrived. Ethnic minorities with different customs have come to submit through translation, and they are fascinated by the people far and near, and they all meet happily.
So all the officials and ministers expressed their sincerity and believed that the emperor's decree was too difficult to humbly refuse.
Chang Yi no longer cared about his country and was granted the throne.
I have no virtue in my own mind, and my resignation is not allowed. I am forced by the favor of the emperor and heaven, and I am concerned about the wishes of the people. The throne cannot be empty for a long time, and the gods of the people cannot be without a master. Therefore, I rely on the court to entrust the world's willing support and inherit the blessings of being an emperor.
Use my meager talents and virtues to rule all nations, pursue my ordinary aspirations, and always be cautious and fearful in my heart.
Choose a good time, pay respectful tributes, go to the altar to receive Zen, offer sacrifices to God, spread welfare, promote great achievements, and pass on the throne to your descendants, so as to protect me forever.
Only holy gods can enjoy their sacrifices.
After the ceremony, the Dharma driver was equipped and driven to Jiankang Palace and to the front hall of Tai Chi.
summary: In the summer of the first year of Tianjian, Emperor Gaozu ascended the throne in the southern suburbs, offering a sacrifice to heaven to announce the mandate. The text declares that the Qi dynasty had exhausted its fortune, and prosperity was imminent, with heaven's inspiration bestowed upon Xiao Yan. It justifies the dynastic change by citing historical precedents like Yao, Shun, Han, Wei, and Jin, emphasizing that rulers are chosen based on worthiness, not hereditary right. The Qi monarch's cruelty and corruption led to chaos, prompting Xiao Yan to raise an army, defeat the tyrant, and establish a new ruler. Auspicious signs from the sun, stars, and mountains confirmed the shift in destiny, and officials urged him to accept the throne. Despite his humility, he yielded to heaven's will and the people's wishes, performing the Zen ritual and ascending to the Tai Chi Palace.

translation:
The edict said: The five spirits inherited each other, and the ancient sage kings were ordered to do so; the world was willing to support them, and the Yin and Zhou dynasties changed dynasties.
Although the Zen dynasty was different and the circumstances were different, they all knew the principles of Youxian and achieved remarkable results, and their benevolent policies spread far and wide.
All help the people to cultivate virtue, and virtue spreads to the people.
My knowledge is rudimentary and I don't know the truth, but my destiny is not in order. I am lucky enough to stabilize and help the economy. I take advantage of the opportunity and comply with everyone's wishes. I save the neglected discipline and make great contributions to China. I should feel guilty in remembering the relics of my predecessors.
The Qi family has signs of the dynasty being replaced, indicating that the order of imperial succession must be changed, respecting the allusions of the previous generation, and destiny gathering in me.
Reflect on your own shortcomings, refuse and refuse permission, fear God, and thus inherit great achievements.
He held the ceremony of burning firewood and raising smoke to offer sacrifices to heaven, acting as a king to recommend capable people, inheriting the traces of previous kings, and ruling the world, like crossing a big river and not knowing how to cross it.
At the beginning of the great cause, all things are reborn, and I want the emperor's favor to spread all over the world.
You can grant amnesty to the world.
The second year of Zhongxing in Southern Qi was changed to the first year of Tianjian.
Those who have made meritorious services among the people will be given a second-class title; civil and military officials will be given a second-class title; widows and widowers who are lonely and unable to stand on their own will be given five dendrobiums of grain each.
The arrears of rent, population tax, and old debts will no longer be collected.
Those who were not in line with the opinions of the villagers, and were charged with corruption, bribery, adultery, and theft were all cleared, their previous files were erased, and they were allowed to start over.
The emperor of Qi was granted the title of King Baling and enjoyed the rent of a county.
Set up the emperor's flag and ride on the fifth o'clock auxiliary car.
The calendar issued by the Southern Qi Dynasty will be followed.
The rituals and music system for worshiping heaven and earth in the suburbs are all based on the regulations of the Southern Qi Dynasty.
Queen Xuande of Southern Qi was changed to Princess Wen of Qi, and Queen Wang of Qi was changed to Princess Baling.
Shao Ling said: "The prosperity of fortune and the rise and fall of official titles are the old rules of the previous dynasties."
During the Southern Qi Dynasty, all the princes and princes who were ennobled had to have their title reduced and their enfeoffment removed.
Those who were of outstanding use in times of national calamity. There was another edict later.
Only King Ruyin of Song Dynasty was not demoted or exempted.
He also issued an edict: At the beginning of the national fortunes, when the auspicious and festive events have just begun, any remaining population of the robbers who have been confiscated by the government can be released without mercy.
All the exiled families were allowed to return to their homeland.
The deceased father's honorary title was added as Emperor Wen and his temple name was Taizu; his deceased mother was named Queen Xian.
The late concubine Xi was added as Queen De.
summary: An edict was issued granting amnesty, changing the era name from Zhongxing to Tianjian, and rewarding officials and the needy. The Qi emperor was demoted to King of Baling, with reduced privileges, while the Southern Qi's rituals and calendar were retained. Posthumous honors were given to Xiao Yan's parents and siblings, and various princes and dukes were appointed. The edict also condemned the Song dynasty's extravagance, ordering the release of palace servants and providing for the elderly. Foreign kings, including those of Goguryeo, Baekje, and Japan, were promoted in rank. Throughout the reign, the emperor emphasized moral governance, often citing ancient precedents. He ordered the burial of war dead, the release of elderly slaves, and the reduction of taxes for the poor. The text concludes with the emperor's continued focus on legal and administrative reforms, aiming to stabilize the realm and ensure the well-being of his subjects.

translation:
Renyin appointed Chariot and Cavalry General Xia Houxiang as Doctor Youguanglu.
The edict stated: "To achieve great success, promote virtue, and organize internal and external affairs, we should set up officials to separate duties, and admonish and supervise each other."
But recently, I have been sticking to the routine, only playing when I see something wrong, tolerate disobedience and contempt more often, dare not make suggestions and accept mistakes, the rules are becoming increasingly relaxed, and it has gradually become a custom. Nowadays, prime ministers and ministers can admonish or impeach officials based on rumors, following the old system of Yuanxi.
On the night of Yihai in May, thieves entered Nanye and Beiye, burned Shenhumen and Zongzhangguan, and killed Wei Weiqing Zhang Hongce.
In Wuzi, Chen Bozhi, the governor of Jiangzhou, rebelled. He appointed the leading general Wang Mao as the general to conquer the south and the governor of Jiangzhou, and led the army to conquer the rebels.
In the sixth month of Gengxu, Yang Shaoxian, the governor of Qinzhou in the north, was appointed the governor of Jitaizhou and the king of Wudu.
In the first month of the war, Chen Bozhi fled to the Northern Wei Dynasty, and Jiangzhou was pacified.
Liu Jilian, the former governor of Yizhou, rebelled against Chengdu.
In August of 1898, the three officials of Jiankang were established.
Yisi, general of Pingbei and governor of Xiliang Prefecture, Xiangshu Pengjin was promoted to general of Anxi and named King Dengzhi.
Ding Wei, Shaoling Zhongshu Supervisor Wang Ying and other eight people discussed and negotiated the law.
In this month, Cao Lang, the minister, was ordered to report the matter to the emperor as usual.
Linyi and Qianchaoli sent envoys to donate local products.
At the end of November in winter, a temple was built for his concubine.
In Jiazi, Prince Xiao Tong was made the crown prince.
In December Bingshen, Zhang Ji, the son of the emperor, was appointed as the general to protect the army.
In 1911, the guard general Zhang Ji was dismissed.
There was a severe drought that year, and every dou of rice cost 5,000 yuan, and many people starved to death.
On the first day of the first lunar month of the second year of the year, Shao Ling said: In the trial of cases, multiple inquiries and five methods must be used. These records are from the sage code. Litigation cases must be judged with compassion, and their significance is emphasized in the previous edicts. These are all for the purpose of applying criminal law with discernment and prudence, avoiding suspicion and injustice, achieving meritorious deeds and governing the world.
When I was in the vassal department, I often personally inspected and interrogated the prisoners' crimes, and sought reason and justice.
In the last days, the country's fortunes have declined, discipline has been weakened, and this kind of politics is lacking. Prisons are overstocked with prisoners and there is no way to appeal.
By good fortune, I was able to rule all the people. Even though I was fasting and staying in the propaganda room, I still paid attention to hearing the cases and ending the prisons. However, Jiuzhou was so remote that I could not visit and inspect it in person.
Not only one party is deeply worried about being tried unjustly.
You can order each state to conduct a trial in person once a month, conduct extensive inquiries and choose the right ones, and be sure to be accurate and trustworthy.
On Yimao, Shen Go was appointed as Shangshu Zuopushe; Fan Yun, the Minister of Civil Affairs, was appointed as Shangshu Youpushe; the former general Poyang King Xiao Hui was appointed as the governor of Southern Xuzhou; Shangshu Ling Yutai was appointed as Zuo Guanglu doctor; the right guard general Liu Qingyuan was appointed as the leader of the central army.
In Bingchen, Wang Liang, the new official of Zuo Guanglu and Shangshu Ling, was dismissed.
In the summer of April, Guimao, Shangshu deleted Lang Cai Fadu and submitted twenty volumes of "Liang Lv", thirty volumes of "Ling", and forty volumes of "Ke".
In the fifth month of Dingsi, Shangshu's right servant She Fan Yun died.
Yichou, Deng Yuanqi, the governor of Yisu, conquered Shengchi and granted Dong maggot amnesty.
Renshen prohibited all counties and counties from paying tribute to the emperor and the prince.
Only the various states and councils, whose position is the feudal official, are allowed to contribute the variety and amount of tribute determined according to the land conditions, if it is not produced locally. No tribute is allowed either.
In June of Dinghai, the imperial edict was issued that due to floods in Dongyang, Xin'an and Feng'an counties, which destroyed the residents' properties, envoys were sent to patrol around and measure the exempted taxes.
summary: Further edicts addressed governance, urging officials to observe customs, seek talented individuals, and reform legal practices. The use of money to atone for crimes was revived, and officials were instructed to report injustices. The text records the establishment of new offices, the promotion of generals, and the suppression of rebellions, such as Chen Bozhi's revolt in Jiangzhou. Natural disasters, including a severe drought and plague, led to high rice prices and widespread starvation. In subsequent years, the emperor focused on legal reforms, establishing the "Liang Lv" code and abolishing certain punishments. He promoted education, building schools and testing students, while also addressing economic issues like tax relief for flood victims. Military campaigns against the Northern Wei saw victories and surrenders, though some cities were lost. The emperor personally performed rituals, including sacrifices to heaven and the Mingtang, and issued amnesties.

translation:
A plague broke out in the summer of that year.
Appointed the newly appointed doctor Zuo Guanglu to serve as Situ and Shangshu Ling.
In the Jiawu period, Wang Ying, the supervisor of Zhongshu, was appointed as the right servant of Shangshu.
In autumn and July, Diechen, Yulang and Zhongtianzhu each sent envoys to offer local products.
In the winter of October, the Northern Wei Dynasty invaded Sizhou.
On Yimao in November, there was thunder, lightning and heavy rain, and the sky was dark and the earth was dark.
There was thunder and lightning again that night.
In Yihai, Shangshu Zuopu shot Shen Yue and resigned due to the death of his mother.
In the spring of the third year of the first lunar month of Wushen, Linchuan Wang Lushui, the later general and the governor of Yangzhou, was promoted to the rank of general of the Chinese army.
Guichou appointed Shangshu Youpushe Wang Ying as Shangshu Zuopushe, Prince Zhan Shiliu Hui as Shangshu Youpushe, and former Shangshu Zuopushe Shen Yue was the general of the town army.
In February, the Northern Wei Dynasty captured Liangzhou.
In March, frost comes and the grass wilts.
In the fifth month of Dingsi, the king of Funan, Chen Ruheyavarman, was appointed as the general of Annan.
On the Bingzi day of the sixth month, Shao Ling said: In the past, when the wise kings were in charge of governing the world, they would divine the good and bad luck of the expedition every year, personally patrol and inspect, and take into account the people's customs, government orders, and punishments.
In the last days, the customs have declined, and this method has been abandoned for a long time.
Although I want to travel to distant places tirelessly and observe the humble, but it is not easy to follow the ancient road today, so I wander around late in the day, feeling the same sympathy again.
In all Jiuzhou, people from far and near, some with remote waterways, some poor, weak, old and sick, had grievances and had no way to appeal. Therefore, civilian women in the Cambodian Sea caused disasters to the country, and lonely souls in the Western Lands went to the towers to appeal.
Thinking about this in my heart, I often sigh deeply in the middle of the night.
They can be ordered to patrol the prefectures separately. Those who have deep grievances and serious harm, and who are worried, angry, and depressed and have nowhere to go can be allowed to go to the envoys and report their own circumstances according to the original situation.
I hope that my sympathy and compassion will spread to all directions like the light of the sun and the moon, so that the viewing and hearing range will be farther and wider, and things will be as if I am personally handling them.
Guiwei, amnesty to the world.
At the end of July in the autumn, Xia Houxiang, the official of Guanglu, was appointed as the general of chariots and cavalry and the history of Hunan, and Yang Gongze, the governor of Xiangzhou, was appointed as the central guard army.
In Jiazi, the prince Xiao Zong was made the Prince of Yuzhang County.
In August, after the attack was over, the imperial edict was issued to place a maggot on the base of the pot lamp.
In September, the prince appointed Fulianchou, the eldest son of the King of Henan, as the general of Zhenxi, the governor of the two states of Qinhe in the west, and the king of Henan.
Northern Tianzhu sent envoys to offer local products.
In the winter of November, Jiazi, the edict said: The implementation of enlightenment shall be based on the specific conditions of different times and appropriate measures shall be formulated. The political integrity is different from the thinness, the punishment changes with the changes in the world, and the frivolity of the customs is different from the magnanimity.
In the past, the customs of the Shang Dynasty have not changed, and the people have been separated for a long time. They fell into the trap and were punished day and night.
If all are rectified, the streets will be full of criminals; if all are pardoned, it will be difficult to use them to serve the country. Therefore, the guilty should be allowed to pay for their sins and be used to save the lives of the people.
Now that the law and prohibition are known far and wide, the prisons are gradually emptying. From now on, perhaps the criminal law can be abandoned.
The use of money to remove legal punishment should be abolished. The statutes of atonement can be removed.
Infectious diseases are prevalent this year.
summary: The text details the construction of palaces, temples, and embankments, as well as the appointment and dismissal of officials. Notable events include the death of key figures like Shen Yue and Wang Ying, the coronation of the crown prince, and the establishment of new states. The emperor's efforts to curb corruption and promote agriculture are evident, with edicts encouraging the return of migrants and the fair distribution of land. Foreign envoys from Funan, Khotan, and other states regularly presented tribute.

translation:
The emperor's name is Fang Zhi, courtesy name is Huixiang, and his baby name is Fazhen. He is the ninth son of Shizu.
In the third year of Taiqing's reign, he was granted the title of Marquis of Xingliang.
In the first year of Chengsheng's reign, he was granted the title of King of Jin'an and was granted a residence of 2,000 households.
In the second year of Chengsheng's reign, he served as General Pingnan and Governor of Jiangzhou.
In November of the third year of Chengsheng, Jiangling fell. Taiwei Wang Sengbian, the governor of Yangzhou, and Chen Baxian, the governor of Xuzhou in Sikongnan, agreed to make Emperor Jing the Grand Prime Minister. In accordance with the emperor's will, they would welcome Emperor Jing back to the capital.
On February 2, the fourth year of Chengsheng's reign, he entered the imperial court from Xunyang.
Wang Sengbian, the Taiwei, was appointed as the Superintendent of Zhongshu, Lu Shangshu, General of Hussars, and the Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese and foreign military forces. Thirty people were appointed as Sikong Chen Baxian. Wang Zhen, the governor of Yuzhou, was appointed the governor of Jiangzhou, and the three divisions were together with him. Xiao Xun, the governor of Xiangzhou, was the Taiwei, and the three divisions were with Yitong.
In March, Qi sent Gao Huan, king of Shangdang, to send Xiao Yuanming, Marquis of Zhenyang, to be Liang's successor. When they arrived at Dongguan, they sent Pei Zhiheng, the prefect of Wuxing, to fight with him. Pei Zhiheng was defeated and died.
Taiwei Wang Sengbian led his army and was stationed in Gushu.
In April, Situ Lufa and Yi Yingzhou surrendered to Qi, and sent Jiangzhou governor Hou Wangzhen to attack him.
On July 23, Wang Sengbian took in Xiao Yuanming, the Marquis of Zhenyang, and crossed the river from Caishi.
On the 26th, he arrived in the capital and regarded Emperor Jing as the crown prince.
On September 27, Sikong Chen Baxian raised his troops, attacked and killed Wang Sengbian, and deposed Xiao Yuanming.
On the 29th, Emperor Jing officially ascended the throne.
On the 22nd day of the tenth month in the first year of Shaotai, an edict was issued: The royal family has lost its place, suffered disasters, the Western capital has been lost, the imperial court has been overthrown, the former emperor's palace has been displaced, the royal base has been overthrown, and there is no support within the borders of the country.
I was young and desolate, and when the fate of the country was in dire straits, I cried blood and pillowed on the enemy, determined to avenge my humiliation.
The great shame has not yet been revealed, and sooner or later you will be angry.
All officials and ministers should encourage each other with great righteousness, so that I can transcend ignorance and inherit the great cause.
Gu Wei's long-cherished intention was not to think about it.
Rely on the spirits of the ancestors, rely on the generals and prime ministers, defeat the evildoers, and express gratitude for the injustice.
Now that I have lost my life and put on a new life, my ancestors will be worshiped again to benefit the people. How can I be the only one!
The fourth year of Chengsheng was changed to the first year of Shaotai. The sentences of convicted criminals across the country were reduced or exempted, and the ministers of civil and military affairs at home and abroad granted them first-class titles.
He appointed Marquis Yuanming of Zhenyang as Situ, and was granted the title of Duke of Jian'an County, with a settlement of 3,000 households.
summary: The emperor, Fang Zhi (courtesy name Huixiang, baby name Fazhen), was the ninth son of Shizu. He was first made Marquis of Xingliang, then King of Jin'an with a 2,000-household fief. He served as General Pingnan and Governor of Jiangzhou. In the third year of Chengsheng, after Jiangling fell, Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian agreed to welcome him as emperor. When Emperor Jing came to the throne, he did not ask about Wei Wan's situation for more than a year. Wei Wan encouraged himself to be cautious every day.
Emperor Jing went on a tour to Shanglin, and ordered Zhonglang to be a charioteer. When he came back, he said, "Do you know why I can let you be a charioteer?"
Wei Wan said: I am a charioteer in the state of Dai. I was lucky enough to be promoted due to my merits and became a general of the rank and file. I don’t know why.
The emperor asked: I called you when I was the prince, why did you refuse to come?
He replied: This is really a capital crime, I am sick.
The emperor gave him the sword. Wei Wan said: The late emperor gave me six swords, and I dare not accept this reward again.
The emperor said: "Swords, people often exchange them, do you still keep them to this day?" Wei Wan said: "They are all here."
The emperor sent someone to fetch six swords. The swords were all well preserved and had never been worn.
When a Lang officer made a mistake and was criticized, Wei Wan often took the blame himself, did not argue with other generals, and often gave up his military merits to other generals.
The emperor believed that he was honest, loyal and magnanimous, so he appointed Wei Wan as the tutor of Liu De, the king of Hejian.
When the vassal states of Wu and Chu rebelled, the emperor issued an edict to appoint Wei Wan as general. He led the army in Hejian to attack the states of Wu and Chu and made military exploits. The emperor promoted him to lieutenant.
Three years later, Wei Wan was granted the title of Marquis of Jianling because of his military exploits.
In the second year, the emperor deposed the prince and executed Li Qing and others.
The emperor thought that Wei Wan was a kind elder and could not bear to send him, so he ordered Wei Wan to retire and return to his hometown, while Zhi Du was responsible for arresting Li Qing and others.
After the incident was over, the emperor appointed King Micellar as the prince and ordered Wei Wan to be the prince's tutor. Later, he was promoted to the imperial censor.
Five years later, when Tao Hou Liu She was replaced as prime minister, Wei Wan only reported routine matters and did not discuss anything else.
However, since he became an official until he was promoted to prime minister, he has been unable to build or abolish anything.
The emperor believed that Wei Wan was a kindhearted person and could assist the prince, so he respected and favored him and rewarded him with many things.
Wei Wan served as prime minister for three years. After Emperor Jing's death, Emperor Wu ascended the throne.
In the middle of the Jianyuan year, because officials imprisoned many innocent people when Emperor Jing was ill, Wei Wan refused to redress the grievances of the people, so he was dismissed.
After Wei Wan died, Mi was named Aihou.
His son Wei Xin inherited his title, but was convicted of insufficient tribute for sacrifices, and the princely state was abolished.
There is no doubt that he is from Nanyang. As a Langguan, he served Emperor Wen.
Someone of his fellow-shalangguan asked for leave to go home and mistakenly took away the gold of his fellow-shalangguan.
summary: Wei Wan, a charioteer from Dai, rose to Zhonglang General through merit and caution. He served Emperor Jing, who valued his honesty, appointing him as prince’s tutor and later prime minister. Wei Wan avoided innovation, focusing on routine, and was dismissed under Emperor Wu for failing to redress grievances. Zhi Busuo, a Lang official under Emperor Wen, was known for not defending himself against slander, such as false accusations of incest. He became Marquis of Sai for quelling the Wu-Chu rebellion but was dismissed with Wei Wan. Zhou Ren, a physician from Rencheng, served Emperor Jing as a doctor, known for secrecy and humility, refusing bribes and rewards. He retired with a pension. Zhang Shi (Zhang Ou), a son of a marquis, served as imperial censor under Emperor Wu, practicing leniency and weeping for condemned prisoners, retiring with honors. The text concludes with a praise emphasizing silent virtue and criticizing excessive displays like Shi Jian’s laundry or Zhou Ren’s torn clothes.
