For example, Zhang Tang used harsh and severe methods in handling the cases of King Huainan and King Jiangdu, wantonly slandered the princes, and alienated the emperor's closest relatives, thus making the kings of various feudal states feel uneasy. I already knew that Zhang Tang was cheating.
summary: Zhang Tang handled major rebellion cases, such as those of the Huainan, Hengshan, and Jiangdu kings, often arguing for severe punishments. He gained the emperor's favor by proposing financial policies like minting coins and monopolizing salt and iron, which strained the populace. His influence grew to the point where national affairs depended on him, leading to widespread blame from ministers and commoners. When the Xiongnu sought peace, Zhang Tang opposed the advice of Dr. Dishan, who advocated for marriage alliances. Dishan criticized Zhang Tang's deceitful and harsh methods, but the emperor sided with Zhang Tang, sending Dishan to a border fortress where he was killed by the Xiongnu. This incident intimidated other ministers.

translation:
At this time, the emperor changed his expression and said: If I send you to garrison a county, can you prevent the Huns from coming in and plundering it? Dishan said: No.
The emperor said: How about garrisoning a county?
Dishan replied: No.
The emperor then said: What about garrisoning a fortress?
Dishan himself estimated that after exhausting his defense, he would be handed over to the judicial officials for punishment, so he said: "Yes."
So the emperor sent Dishan to guard a castle on the border.
After more than a month, the Huns chopped off Dishan's head and left.
From then on, the ministers were shocked and frightened.
Zhang Tang's guest Tian Jia, although a businessman, has a virtuous character. When Zhang Tang was a junior official, he and Zhang Tang were money friends. When Zhang Tang became a senior official, Tian Jia blamed Zhang Tang for his moral faults and the demeanor of a loyal and generous man.
Zhang Tang served as the imperial censor for seven years and collapsed.
Li Wen, a native of Hedong, once had a quarrel with Zhang Tang, and later served as the censor Zhongcheng. He repeatedly discovered issues that could be used to harm Zhang Tang from the contents of court documents, leaving no room for him.
Zhang Tang had a favorite official named Lu Yeju. Knowing that Zhang Tang was aggrieved by this, he ordered someone to write an urgent memorial to report Li Wen's misdeeds. The matter was handed over to Zhang Tang. Zhang Tang tried and decided to kill Li Wen, but Zhang Tang knew in his heart that Lu Yeju had done it.
The emperor asked: How did the letter to report the emergency come about?
Zhang Tang pretended to be surprised and said: This is probably because Li Wen's acquaintances resent him.
Later, Lu Yeju fell ill and was lying in the landlord's house in the countryside. Zhang Tang went to visit his condition in person and massaged Yeju's legs and feet. People in the state of Tang were engaged in smelting and casting. King Zhao repeatedly litigated the government's appointment of iron officials, and Zhang Tang often attacked the king.
The king asked about Zhang Tang's private affairs.
Lu Yeju once reported to King Tiao. King Tiao resented him and wrote a letter to report: Zhang Tang is a minister, and Lu Yiju, a minor official, is ill. Zhang Tang went so far as to massage his legs and feet, suspecting that he and Lu Yeju had done bad things together.
This matter will be handed over to Tingwei.
Lu Yeju died of illness, and the problem involved his younger brother, who was imprisoned in the Directorate.
Zhang Tang also went to the director's office to interrogate other prisoners. He saw Lu Yeju's younger brother and wanted to help him secretly, but pretended to ignore him.
Lu Yeju's younger brother was ignorant and resented Zhang Tang. He sent a letter to report Zhang Tang and Lu Yeju's conspiracy, and jointly reported Li Wen.
The dispatch will be handed over to the public for processing.
Jiaxuan once had a estrangement with Zhang Tang. When he accepted the matter, he investigated the matter to the bottom of the matter and did not file a report.
It happened that someone secretly dug up the burial money buried in the tomb of Emperor Wen of the Han Dynasty. Prime Minister Qing Zhai went to court and agreed with Zhang Tang to apologize together. Before the emperor, Zhang Tang thought that only the prime minister visited the cemetery according to the four seasons and should apologize. It had nothing to do with me and he did not apologize.
After the prime minister apologized, the emperor sent the censor to investigate the matter.
summary: Zhang Tang's downfall began when his former friend Tian Jia criticized his moral faults. As imperial censor for seven years, he faced hostility from Li Wen, a censor Zhongcheng. Zhang Tang's favorite official, Lu Yeju, plotted against Li Wen, but the scheme unraveled when King Zhao reported Zhang Tang's inappropriate behavior toward Lu Yeju. Lu Yeju's brother later exposed their conspiracy. Additionally, Zhang Tang clashed with Prime Minister Qing Zhai over a tomb robbery, refusing to apologize and attempting to impeach the prime minister. Three chief ministers, including Zhu Maichen, conspired against Zhang Tang, accusing him of hoarding supplies and dividing wealth with subordinates. The emperor, believing Zhang Tang treacherous, sent envoys to question him. Zhang Tang refused to explain and, under pressure from envoy Yu, committed suicide. His family was found to have minimal wealth, and his mother insisted on a simple burial. The emperor later regretted his actions, executed the three chief ministers, and promoted Zhang Tang's son, Zhang Anshi.

translation:
Later, he was appointed as the Order of Ye Ting, and Emperor Xuan adopted him as the emperor's great-grandson in Ye Ting.
Zhang He felt sad that the prince was innocent and his great-grandson was orphaned, so he cared for him and cared for him with deep kindness.
When his great-grandson grew up, Zhang He taught school and ordered him to write "Shi". He married Concubine Xu for him and used his family wealth as a betrothal gift.
Strange things happened to my great-grandson many times, which can be found in "Xuan Di Ji".
Zhang He heard about it and explained it to An Shi and praised him for his intelligence.
An Shi immediately stopped Zhang He and believed that the young master should not praise his great-grandson while he was in power.
By the time Emperor Xuan came to the throne, Zhang He had died.
The emperor said to An Shi: Ye Tingling praised me throughout his life, and the general stopped him, which is what he did right.
The emperor commemorated Zhang Heen and wanted to posthumously confer him the title of Marquis of Ende and set up two hundred tombs.
Zhang He had a son who died early and had no offspring, so he made An Shi's youngest son Peng Zu his adopted son.
When Peng Zu was young, he studied scriptures with the emperor at the same table. He planned to reward him, so he first gave it to the Marquis of Guannei.
An Shi insisted on declining the reward, and also requested that the number of households guarding the tomb be reduced to thirty.
The emperor said: I rewarded Ye Tingling myself, not the general.
An Shi stopped then, not daring to say anything more.
The emperor then went down to Shao and said: Thirty tombs should be set up for Zhang He, the former Yeting order.
The emperor arranged his residence by himself, and lived in the south of Dou Wengshe in the west of the tomb, where the emperor used to play when he was a boy.
The next year, he went to Shao again and said: When I was young, Ye Ting ordered Zhang He to tutor me and study literature and classics. My kindness was outstanding and my contribution was profound.
"Poetry" says: There is no language that does not answer, and there is no kindness that does not repay.
Zhang He's disciple Peng Zu, the Marquis of Guannei in the Middle Kingdom, should be granted the title of Marquis of Yangdu, and Zhang He Mi should be given the title of Aihou of Yangdu.
At that time, Zhang He had an orphan grandson, Zhang Ba, who was seven years old. He was worshiped as a general of Sanqi Zhonglang, and was given the title of Marquis of Guannei, with a settlement of 300 households.
An Shi resigned from his salary because his father and son were granted the title of marquis and were prominent in their reign.
The emperor then issued an order to collect millions of Zhang's unnamed coins in the capital's treasury.
An Shizun was a prince, and he had thousands of households in the city. However, he was dressed in black silk, his wife personally spun the crops, and he had 700 servants. They were all skilled in doing things, managed the industry internally, and accumulated small amounts of property. Therefore, he was able to increase his industry and become rich and prosperous as a general.
The emperor respected and feared the general, but he was close to Ji Shi and tried his best to hide his feelings from Huo Guang.
In the spring of the fourth year of Yuankang, An Shi became ill. Shangshu returned it to the Marquis and begged for the bones to be returned to his hometown.
The Emperor said: The general is old and sick, and I have great pity on him.
Although you are unable to do things, you have traveled thousands of miles. As a minister of the late emperor, you know how to control chaos. I am unable to do so. I have been able to ask many times, why did you feel sad and write a letter to return the seal of General Wei Fuping?
It is not my wish to force me to forget my past!
I hope the general can eat hard, take medicine, and concentrate on his energy, so that he can support his life.
An Shi worked hard again and died in autumn.
The emperor presented a seal and ribbon, and sent light chariots and soldiers with the title of "Jinghou".
The land for the tomb was given to Du County, the tomb was dug, and the ancestral hall was built.
summary: Zhang Anshi, known for his meticulousness and loyalty, served under Emperor Zhao and Huo Guang. He was appointed as a general and marquis, playing a key role in deposing the King of Changyi and enthroning Emperor Xuan. Despite his high position, Anshi remained humble and cautious, often feigning illness to avoid political entanglements. He managed his household frugally, with his wife spinning crops and servants skilled in industry. His brother Zhang He cared for Emperor Xuan as a child, and after Zhang He's death, the emperor posthumously honored him. Anshi's descendants, including Zhang Yanshou and Zhang Lin, maintained the family's reputation for humility and frugality. Zhang Fang, a later descendant, was favored by Emperor Cheng but faced criticism for his arrogance and misconduct, leading to his dismissal. The Zhang family remained prominent through the Han dynasty, with many serving as high officials. The text concludes by praising the Zhang family's enduring favor and virtue, contrasting Zhang Tang's harshness with Anshi's righteousness and humility.

translation:
Zhang Er, a native of Daliang. When he was young, he was a diner of Wei Gongzi Wuji.
Later, he lost his household registration and became anonymous and wandered to the outside world. There was a daughter of a wealthy family in Waihuang who was very beautiful and looked down upon her husband, so she secretly escaped to the home of one of her father's former guests.
Her father's guest said: "You must marry a good husband, so marry Zhang Er."
So, she followed this advice, severed her relationship with her ex-husband, and married Zhang Er.
This woman's family gave Zhang Er a lot of money, which enabled him to make friends with many guests and become the magistrate of Waihuang County.
Chen Yu was from Daliang and loved Confucianism.
He visited Kuxing in Zhao State several times, where the wealthy Gongcheng family married his daughter to him.
Chen Yu was young, so he regarded Zhang Er as his father, and the two formed a life-and-death friendship.
When Emperor Gaozu was still a commoner, he had a relationship with Zhang Er.
After Qin destroyed Wei, it offered a reward of one thousand gold for the capture of Zhang Er and five hundred gold for the capture of Chen Yu.
So the two changed their surnames and came to Chendi together to serve as lowly gatekeepers.
One time, a minor official thought Chen Yu had made a mistake and beat him with a whip. Chen Yu was not convinced and wanted to resist, but Zhang Er secretly stepped on Chen Yu's feet to make him endure the beating.
When the clerk left, Zhang Er scolded Chen Yu and said, "What did I tell you back then?"
Now after receiving a little insult, you want to fight with a petty official?
Chen Yu admitted his mistake.
Chen She revolted in Qixian County and invaded Chen Di. Zhang Er and Chen Yu reported their names and asked to see Chen She.
Chen She and his cronies Hu Su had heard many times that Zhang Er and Chen Yu were capable, and were very happy to see them.
The heroes of Chen County advised Chen She: General, you are wearing strong armor and holding a sharp sword. You led the army to attack the violent Qin Dynasty and rebuilt the country of Chu. Your merits are immeasurable and you should be made the king of Chu.
Chen She asked Zhang and Chen what they thought of this, and they replied: General, you are brave and brave, putting your own life and death aside to eliminate harm for the people of the world.
Now he has just arrived in Chen and proclaimed himself king, revealing his selfishness in front of the world.
I hope that the general will not become the king, and quickly lead the troops to the west, and send people to establish descendants of the six countries and establish party members for himself.
In this way, the violent Qin can be eliminated without fighting, you can occupy Xianyang and issue orders to the princes everywhere, and the great cause of proclaiming emperor can be completed.
If he were to become the king in Chen County now, I am afraid that people in the world would become disloyal.
Chen She refused to listen, so he set up his own business.
Zhang Er and Chen Yu further advised King Chen: Your Majesty launched an uprising from Liang and Chu in order to invade Guanzhong and had no time to capture Hebei.
We have been to the State of Zhao before and are very familiar with the heroes of the State of Zhao. Please let us lead a team to capture the territory of the State of Zhao by surprise.
summary: Zhang Er, a native of Daliang, was once a retainer of Wei nobleman Wuji. After losing his household registration, he wandered to Waihuang, where a wealthy family's daughter left her husband on the advice of her father's guest and married Zhang Er with a substantial dowry. This allowed him to befriend many guests and become the magistrate of Waihuang County. Chen Yu, also from Daliang, was a Confucian scholar who married into a wealthy family in Zhao. He regarded Zhang Er as a father figure, and they formed a life-and-death friendship. When Emperor Gaozu was a commoner, he had ties with Zhang Er. After Qin destroyed Wei, a reward was offered for Zhang Er and Chen Yu, so they changed their names and became gatekeepers in Chendi. When a minor official whipped Chen Yu for a mistake, Zhang Er stopped him from retaliating, advising patience. When Chen She revolted, Zhang Er and Chen Yu joined him. They advised Chen She not to declare himself king prematurely but to establish descendants of the six states to win support. Chen She ignored them and made himself king. Later, they persuaded Chen She to let them lead troops to capture Zhao territory. They recruited soldiers and won over local heroes, capturing many cities. Wu Chen declared himself King of Zhao, with Chen Yu as general and Zhang Er as prime minister. Chen She initially opposed but later confirmed Wu Chen's title under advice.

translation:
King Chen followed his strategy and placed only the military officials and other family members under house arrest in the palace. He named Zhang Er's son Zhang Ao the king of Chengdu, sent envoys to congratulate Zhao, and urged the Zhao army to march westward and enter the pass.
Zhang Er and Chen Yu advised the military officials: Your Majesty, you are proclaimed king of Zhao State not because of Chu's wish, but because of expediency, you came to congratulate the king.
As long as Chu State destroys Qin, it will definitely send troops to attack.
I hope that King Tang will not send troops to the west, but will capture Yan and Dai in the north, and Hanoi in the south to expand his country's territory.
If Zhao was guarded by the Yellow River in the south and Yan and Dai were in the north, even if Chu defeated Qin, he would not dare to send troops to capture it.
King Zhao thought this was correct. Instead of sending troops westward, he sent Han Guang to attack Yan, Li Liang to attack Changshan, and Zhang Wei to attack Shangdang.
Han Guang entered Yan, and the people of Yan supported him as king of Yan.
King Zhao, Zhang Er, and Chen Yu led their troops to station at the border of Yan, preparing to attack Yan.
King Tang went out once and was captured by the Yan army.
The generals of the State of Yan imprisoned King Zhao as a hostage and demanded that the State of Zhao cede the land to Yan before returning it to King Zhao.
The envoys sent by Zhao were all killed by Yan, who insisted on letting Zhao cede territory.
Zhang Er and Chen Yu were worried about this.
A servant in the army said to his roommate: I am going on a mission for the second Duke to convince Yan that he can come back with King Zhao.
His roommates all laughed at him and said, "The envoys you sent were killed every time. How could you save King Tong?"
He came to the camp of the Yan army and was received by the general of the Yan army. The servant asked the Yan general: "Do you know what I want to do?"
Yan Jiang replied: I want to get your King Zhao back.
Question: Do you know what kind of people Zhang Er and Chen Yu are?
General Yan said: A worthy person.
Asked again: Do you know what their purpose is?
Yan Jiang replied: I want to save their king Tang.
Zhao's servant smiled and said, "You don't know what they really think."
At that time, Wu Chen, Zhang Er, and Chen Yu captured dozens of cities in the country without using any troops. All three of them wanted to ascend the throne of the king.
How can the status of a monarch and a minister be compared?
Considering that the general situation had just stabilized, he first established the military minister as king based on his age to stabilize the people of Zhao.
Now that the country is stable, the two of them also want to divide the country and become kings on their own, but the opportunity is not yet ripe.
Now you imprison King Tread. On the surface, the two of them want to save King Tread, but in fact they hope that Yan will kill King Zhao so that they can divide the land of Zhao and become king.
With the strength of Zhao State, it can easily defeat Yan State, let alone two wise kings united. If you attack the State of Yan on the charge of killing King Tiao, the State of Yan will soon be destroyed.
General Yan thought his words were reasonable, so he returned King Zhao.
The servant himself drove back with King Zhao.
After Li Liang captured Changshan, he came back and reported to King T'ao, who ordered Li Liang to capture Taiyuan.
Li Liang led his troops to Shiyi, but it was difficult to advance because Qin was heavily guarded at Jingxing.
summary: Wu Chen was captured by Yan forces, but a clever servant convinced the Yan general that Zhang Er and Chen Yu secretly wanted Wu Chen dead to divide Zhao, so Yan released him. Li Liang, a Zhao general, rebelled after feeling insulted by Wu Chen's sister, killed Wu Chen, and attacked Handan. Zhang Er and Chen Yu escaped, gathered troops, and established Zhao Xie, a descendant of Zhao royalty, as king. Li Liang was defeated by Chen Yu and fled to Qin general Zhang Han, who razed Handan.

translation:
Zhang Yan and Chen Shi said: The situation is urgent now. We can only keep our word through life and death. How can we care about what will happen in the future?
Chen Yu said: It doesn't matter if I die, but what's the benefit?
So they sent 5,000 men, led by Zhang Dao and Chen Shi, to attack the Qin army, but the entire army was destroyed.
During the rest of the time, Yan, Qi, and Chu heard that King Zhao was in danger and all came to help him.
Zhang Ao also regained the land of Dai in the north, recruited more than 10,000 people, and set up camp near Chen Yu's army.
Xiang Yu's army blocked Zhang Han's passage many times, causing Wang Li's army to lack food and grass.
Xiang Yu's entire army crossed the river and defeated Zhang Han's army.
Only then did the armies of various princes dare to attack the Qin army and captured Wang Li.
Zhang Er and Tan Xie were rescued from Julu. As soon as Zhang Er met Chen Yu, he blamed Chen Yu and asked where Zhang Yan and Chen Shi were.
Chen Yu said: Zhang Yan and Chen Shi asked me to fight to the death with the Qin army. I asked them to lead five thousand people to attack the Qin army to try, but the entire army was destroyed.
Zhang Er didn't believe it, thinking that Chen Yu had killed the two men, and questioned Chen Yu many times.
Chen Yu said angrily: I didn't expect your resentment towards me to be so deep!
Do you think I can't bear to part with this title of general?
So he took off the seal and asked to return it to Zhang Er, but Zhang Er refused to accept it.
When Chen Yu went to the toilet, a guest advised Zhang Er: "If you hear God's gift but refuse to accept it, there will be no good consequences."
Now Chen Yu is giving you the seal and ribbon. If you don't accept it, it will be unlucky to go against God's will.
Hurry up and accept it!
Zhang Er then wore Chen Yu's seal and ribbon and recruited Chen Yu's subordinates.
When Chen Yu came back and saw this situation, he complained that Zhang Er refused to give in, and left angrily.
Zhang Er then took over Chen Yu's army.
Chen Yu and hundreds of his followers went to the lakes and swamps along the Yellow River to engage in hunting and fishing.
From then on, there was resentment between Zhang Er and Chen Yu.
Zhao Xie, the king of Zhao, returned to Xindu.
Zhang Er followed Xiang Yu into the pass.
When Xiang Yu divided the princes, Zhang Er made many friends and many people praised him.
Xiang Yu often heard that Zhang Er was a virtuous person, so he separated a land from the Zhao Kingdom, made Zhang Er the King of Changshan, and established the capital of Xindu, which was renamed Xiangguo.
Chen Yu's old guests all told Xiang Yu: "Chen Yu and Zhang Er have also made great contributions to the state of Zhao."
Xiang Yu thought that Chen Yu did not follow him into the Pass, and when he heard that he was now in Nanpi, he conferred three counties near Nanpi on Chen Yu, and changed the title of Tang Wang Tang Xie to Dai Wang, and moved the capital to Dai County.
When Zhang Er returned to his kingdom, Chen Yu became even more angry and said: "Zhang Er and I have equal merits. Now he has been made a king, and I have been made a marquis."
When Tian Rong of the Qi State betrayed the Chu State, Chen Yu sent an envoy Xia Shuo to persuade Tian Rong: Xiang Yu is the ruler of the world, but it is unfair. He gave good lands to other kings and generals, but moved King Tread to a bad place. King Tread still lives in Dai County!
I hope you can lend me some troops and would like to use Nanpi as a vassal screen.
Tian Rongzheng wanted to establish party members, so he sent troops to Chen Yu.
Chen Yu recruited soldiers from three counties to attack Zhang Er, the king of Changshan.
Zhang Er was defeated and fled, saying: The King of Han and I have friendship, but Xiang Yu's power is strong, and I am entrusted by King Xiang, so I plan to go to Chu.
summary: Zhang Er and Zhao Xie were besieged in Julu by Qin forces. Chen Yu, stationed nearby, refused to send troops, believing his forces too weak. Zhang Er sent envoys to rebuke him, but Chen Yu only sent 5,000 men, who were annihilated. After Xiang Yu defeated the Qin army, Zhang Er blamed Chen Yu for the deaths of the envoys, leading to a bitter rift. Chen Yu offered his seal to Zhang Er, who accepted it after persuasion, taking command of Chen Yu's army. Chen Yu left in anger, and the two became enemies. The historian comments that Zhang Er and Chen Yu were initially life-and-death friends but turned against each other over power, illustrating the shame of fair-weather friendships.

translation:
Duke Gan said: When the king of Han entered the pass, the five stars in the sky gathered in the east well.
Shujing is a divided territory of Qin, and whoever arrives first will become hegemonic.
Although Chu is now powerful, the world still belongs to Han in the end.
So Zhang Er fled to Han Dynasty.
The king of Han led his troops to pacify the Three Qin Dynasties and surrounded Zhang Han in Feiqiu.
Zhang Er paid homage to the King of Han, who treated him very favorably.
Chen Yu defeated Zhang Er, regained all the land, and brought the king back from Dai County, where he was still the king. King Zhao was grateful to Chen Yu and named him acting king.
Chen Yu thought that the King of Zhao was weak and the country was in the early stages of peace, so he stayed to assist the King of Zhao, and sent the Prime Minister Guo Xia to garrison Dai.
In the second year of the Han Dynasty, King Shujin of Han attacked the state of Chu. He sent someone to inform Zhao, asking him to send troops to attack Chu together.
Chen Yu said: I will send troops only if the Han kills Zhang Er.
So the king of Han found a man who looked like Zhang Er, killed him, and gave his head to Chen Yu, who then sent troops to aid Mo.
As a result, the Han army was defeated by the Chu army west of Pengcheng. Chen Yu heard about Zhang Er's fake death and betrayed Mo.
Han sent Zhang Er and Han Xin to capture Zhao's Jingxing, killed Chen Yu at the bank of the Sang River, and pursued him to Xiangguo and killed the king of Zhao, Dan Xie.
In the summer of the fourth year, Mo made Zhang Er the king of Tong.
In the autumn of the fifth year, Zhang Er died, and the Han Dynasty named him Mi King Jing.
His son Zhang Ao inherited the throne and married Princess Lu Yuan, the eldest daughter of Emperor Gaozu, as his queen.
In the seventh year of the Han Dynasty, Emperor Gaozu came to Zhao from Pingcheng. King Tong personally served him with food and drinks in the morning and evening, with a very humble attitude and the courtesy of a son-in-law.
But Gaozu sat there and shouted and scolded him loudly, looking down on him very much.
The prime minister, Guan Gao and Zhao Wu, was over sixty years old. He was a former disciple of Zhang Er. He said angrily: Our king is really a cowardly king!
He advised Zhang Ao: "There are many heroes in the world, and the talented ones should be the first to be kings." Now you are very respectful to Gaozu, but Gaozu is rude to you. Please let us kill him for you.
After hearing this, King Zhao bit his finger and it bled, and said, "How could you say such a thing!"
My father lost his country, but it was Gaozu who helped him to restore his country, and De Ze was passed down to future generations. All this is the power of the emperor.
I hope you won't say such things again.
Guan Gao and more than a dozen people discussed among themselves and said: We were wrong.
Our king is a loyal elder who refuses to betray his obligations.
But we can't stand insults. Now Gaozu insults our King Zhao, so he wants to kill him. What does this have to do with our king?
If things succeed, let's vent our anger for the king; if things fail, then we should bear the blame ourselves.
In the eighth year of the Han Dynasty, Emperor Gaozu passed through Shuyuan and visited the country.
Guan Gao sent people to hide in the wall of Bairen County Hall, preparing to wait for an opportunity to kill Hu Zu.
summary: After Xiang Yu divided the realm, Zhang Er was made King of Changshan, while Chen Yu received only three counties. Chen Yu, resentful, allied with Tian Rong of Qi to attack Zhang Er, who fled to Han. The Han king treated him well. Chen Yu later demanded Zhang Er's death before aiding Han, but the Han king sent a fake head. After Han's defeat, Chen Yu learned the truth and abandoned Han. Han later sent Zhang Er and Han Xin to defeat and kill Chen Yu and Zhao Xie. Zhang Er was made King of Zhao and died in the fifth year of Han. His son Zhang Ao succeeded him and married Princess Lu Yuan.

translation:
When Emperor Gaozu arrived in Bairen and wanted to stay overnight, he suddenly felt something moved and asked: "What county is this?" Answer: Bairen County.
Zhitan said: The Bai people are forced by others.
So he left without staying overnight.
In the ninth year of Han Dynasty, Guan Gao's enemies learned of their plan and reported him.
So Gaozu arrested King Zhao and other people who were trying to rebel.
A dozen people including Chang Wu rushed to commit suicide by cutting their necks. Only Zhishang cursed angrily: Who told you to do this?
Now Yusi has not rebelled, but he has been arrested together. If you are dead, who will prove that King Zhao did not rebel?
Together with King Zhao, they were taken to Ken'an in a sealed prison car.
Guan Gao said to the jailer: "This is what we people did. King Zhao doesn't know."
The jailer beat him thousands of times with whips and stung him with red-hot iron. Guan Gao was covered with wounds, but he didn't say a word.
Empress Lu said several times that King Zhao was the husband of Princess Lu Yuan and would not rebel.
Emperor Gaozu said angrily: If Zhang Ao ruled the world, would he care about your daughter?
Tingwei reported Guan Gao's confession to Emperor Gaozu, and Emperor Gaozu said: "What a strong man!"
Anyone who is familiar with him can ask him privately.
Zhongdafu Xiegong said: I know him well. He is a person in Zhao who pays attention to honor and integrity and never breaks his promise.
Emperor Gaozu asked Xie Gongzhijie to ask in front of his chair.
Guangao raised his head and looked at Xie Gong, chatting happily as usual.
During the conversation, Duke Xie asked King Zhao if it was true that he had not rebelled.
Guan Gao said: How can a human being not love his parents, wife and children?
Now that all three members of my family are going to be executed for this, will I use my relatives to protect King Tang?
It is indeed because King Tang did not rebel, it was just what we did.
He told the whole story in detail and the situation that King Tong didn't know about at all.
So Duke Xie told Gaozu what Guan Gao said, and Gaozu pardoned King Zhao.
Emperor Gaozu appreciated Guangao's ability and courage to act and keep his word, so he asked Duke Xie to tell Guangao: "Zhang Ao has been released. The emperor appreciates you very much, so he pardons you."
Guan Gao said: The reason why I will not die is to prove that King Tang did not rebel.
Now that King Tong has been released, my responsibility has been fulfilled.
But as a minister with a reputation for usurpation, how could he still have the dignity to serve the emperor?
So he cut his neck and committed suicide.
After Zhang Fang was released from prison, he still respected Princess Lu Yuan as before, and was named Marquis of Xuanping by Emperor Gaozu.
At that time, Emperor Gaozu appreciated the guests of the king very much. They were either appointed as prime ministers of the princes or as county guards.
It is recorded in "The Biography of Uncle Tian".
By the time of Xiaohui, Gaohou, Emperor Wen, and Emperor Jing, the descendants of King Zhao's guests had become officials worth two thousand shi.
At the beginning, during the reign of Emperor Xiaohui, King Hui of Qi dedicated Chengyang County to Princess Lu Yuan and honored her as the Queen Mother.
In the first year of the reign of Emperor Gao, Empress Dowager Lu Yuan passed away.
Six years later, Zhang Ao, the Marquis of Xuanping, also passed away.
summary: Emperor Gaozu treated Zhang Ao rudely, angering his ministers Guan Gao and Zhao Wu, who plotted to kill Gaozu. Zhang Ao refused to participate. The plot failed, and Guan Gao took full blame, enduring torture to prove Zhang Ao's innocence. Gaozu eventually pardoned Zhang Ao and admired Guan Gao's loyalty, but Guan Gao committed suicide. Zhang Ao remained respectful to Princess Lu Yuan and was made Marquis of Xuanping. His descendants held various titles, though some were later stripped due to crimes.

translation:
Zhang Liang's courtesy name is Zifang, and his ancestors are Korean.
My grandfather opened land and became the prime minister of Han Zhaohou, King Xuanhui and King Xiangai.
His father, Zhang Ping, was the prime minister of King Li and King Hui.
In the twenty-third year of King Hui's reign, Zhang Ping died. Twenty years after his death, Qin subjugated Han.
Zhang Liang was young and had not been an official in Han.
When Han died, Zhang Liang had 300 slaves in his family. His younger brother died without being buried. He used all his family wealth to seek assassins to kill the King of Qin and avenge Han because his father had been the Prime Minister of Han for five generations.
Zhang Liang once studied etiquette in Huaiyang. He traveled eastward to meet Lord Canghai and found a strong man who made an iron vertebra weighing 120 kilograms.
The Emperor of Qin went on a tour to Bolang Sand. Zhang Liang and his assassins ambushed the Emperor of Qin and accidentally hit the passenger car.
Emperor Qin was furious and searched the world on a large scale, eager to find the thief.
Zhang Liang then changed his name and fled to Xiapi.
Zhang Liang once had time to take a leisurely stroll on the Xiapi Bridge. An old man, wearing coarse cloth, walked up to Zhang Liang and deliberately dropped his shoes under the bridge. He turned back and said to Zhang Liang: "Children, go down and pick up your shoes!"
Zhang Liang was surprised and wanted to beat him.
Because he was old, he endured it and went down to pick up shoes, so he knelt down and offered them to him.
The old man put on his feet and walked away with a smile.
Zhang Liang was very surprised.
The old man left for about a mile, then came back and said: Young people deserve instruction.
Five days later, at dawn, I'll be waiting for you in Xianbao.
Zhang Liang felt strange, knelt down and said: OK.
Five days later, Zhang Liang left at Pingming.
The old man had arrived first and angrily said: "I made an appointment with the old man and arrived late. Why?"
Come on, come see you early in five days.
Five days later, when the rooster crows, go.
The old man arrived first again and yelled angrily: "You're late, what's the matter?"
Go, come back early in five days.
Five days later, Zhang Liang went there in the middle of the night.
After a while, the old man also came and said with a smile: "It should be the same."
He took out a book and said: If you read it, you can become the teacher of the king.
Rise ten years later.
Thirteen years later, the young man came to see me. The yellow stone at the foot of Jibei Gucheng Mountain was me.
Then he left and disappeared.
After dawn, I read the book. It was "Tai Gong's Art of War".
Zhang Liang was surprised and often recited it.
Living in Xiapi, he loves to fight against injustice.
Xiang Bo once killed someone and took refuge with Zhang Liang.
Ten years later, Chen She and others started an uprising, and Zhang Liang also gathered more than a hundred young men.
Jing Ju established himself as the false king of Chu and stayed in Liu.
Zhang Liang wanted to follow him and met Pei Gong on the road.
Peigong led thousands of people to capture Xiapi, and Tuidan followed him.
Centipede worshiped the retired emperor and became the general of the stable.
Egg King lectured Pei Gong on "Tai Gong's Art of War" many times. Pei Gong was very happy and often adopted his strategies.
Zhang Liang told others, but they didn't understand.
Zhang Liang said: Pei Gong is probably a talent given by heaven.
Then he followed him and never left.
summary: Zhang Liang, courtesy name Zifang, was of Korean ancestry. His grandfather and father served as prime ministers to five generations of Han kings. After Qin conquered Han, Zhang Liang, though young and never an official, used his family wealth to hire an assassin to avenge Han. He ambushed the First Emperor at Bolangsha but struck the wrong carriage. Forced to flee, he changed his name and hid in Xiapi. On a bridge in Xiapi, an old man deliberately dropped his shoe and ordered Zhang Liang to retrieve it. Zhang Liang complied despite his initial anger. The old man later gave him a book, the "Tai Gong's Art of War," and predicted he would become a teacher to a king. Zhang Liang studied it diligently. During the uprisings, Zhang Liang gathered followers and joined Pei Gong (Liu Bang). He frequently advised Pei Gong using the Art of War, and Pei Gong often adopted his strategies. Zhang Liang believed Pei Gong was a heaven-sent talent and remained with him. He later persuaded Xiang Liang to establish Han Cheng as King of Han, and Zhang Liang became Han's Minister of Education.

translation:
Duke Pei went to Xue, met with Xiang Liang, and together they supported King Huai of Chu.
Zhang Liang persuaded Xiang Liang: "You have established a descendant of Chu. Mr. Han, Hengyang Jun, has become a virtuous man. He can be established as king and have many party members."
Xiang Liang sent Zhang Liang to find Han Cheng and establish him as King of Han.
Zhang Liang was appointed as Han Situ, and he and the King of Han led more than a thousand people to the west to conquer Han. They captured several cities, and Qin recovered them all. They went back and forth in Yingchuan to fight guerrillas.
When Pei Gong went south from Luoyang, Zhang Liang led his troops to follow Pei Gong and captured more than ten cities in Han to attack Yang Xiong's army.
Peigong then ordered Han Wangcheng to stay in Yangzhai, and he and Zhang Liang went south to capture Wan and west to enter Wuguan.
Pei Gong wanted to attack Qin's army at Ziguan with 20,000 men. Qiang Liang said: Qin's army is still strong and should not be underestimated.
I heard that the guard general is the son of a butcher, and is easily swayed by merchants and villains.
He hoped that Pei Gong would stay in the fort for the time being and send people ahead to prepare meals for 50,000 people. He also placed more flags on the mountains, set up suspicious soldiers, and sent Li Shiqi to seduce the Qin generals with heavy evidence.
The generals of Qin really wanted to unite and attack Shengyang in the west, and Pei Gong wanted to obey them.
Zhang Liang said: "This is just a rebellion by the generals. I'm afraid the soldiers will not obey."
It would be dangerous to disobey, so it would be better to attack them while they are lax.
Pei Gong then led his troops to attack the Qin army and won a great victory.
Chasing them to Lantian and fighting again, the Qin soldiers were completely defeated.
So when they arrived in Xianyang, Prince Qin Ying surrendered to Duke Pei.
When Pei Gong entered Qin, his palace was filled with curtains, dogs, horses, treasures, thousands of women, and he wanted to stay there.
Fan Sha advised him, but Pei Gong refused to listen.
Zhang Huang said: "Taiwan cannot reach the main road, so! Earthworms can get here."
To rid the world of cruel and cruel people, we should show our true colors through simplicity.
Now that they have just entered the Qin Dynasty, they are content to enjoy themselves, creating what people call "helping Jie to do harm."
Moreover, loyal advice is unpleasant to the ear but beneficial to action, and good medicine is bitter to the mouth and beneficial to the patient. I hope Pei Gong will listen to Fan Sha's words.
Pei Gong then went back to garrison Bashang.
Xiang Yu went to Hongmen to attack Pei Gong. Xiang Bo ran to Pei Gong's army at night and met with Zhang Liang in private, wanting to leave with him.
Zhang Liang said: I am sending Duke Pei to the King of Han. Now the matter is urgent, so it would be unjust to run away.
Then he told Pei Gong everything.
Pei Gong was horrified and said, "What should I do?"
Zhang Liang said: Does Pei Gong really want to betray King Xiang?
Pei Gong said: There is a villain who advised me to hold the pass and not let the princes in, but I can become the king of Qin, so I listened to him.
Zhang Liang said: Does Pei Gong think he can defeat King Xiang?
Pei Gong was silent and said, "What should we do now?"
Zhang Liang then invited Xiang Bo to see Pei Gong.
Pei Gong and Xiang Bo drank wine, congratulated him on his birthday and arranged marriage, and asked Xiang Bo to explain to Xiang Yu in detail that the reason why Pei Gong did not dare to betray King Xiang and controlled the pass was to guard against other thieves.
summary: Zhang Liang advised Pei Gong against attacking Qin's strong forces directly, suggesting instead to bribe the Qin general and attack when the troops were lax. This led to a great victory and Qin's surrender. When Pei Gong was tempted by the luxuries of Qin's palace, Zhang Liang urged him to leave, warning that indulgence would harm his cause. Pei Gong heeded this and returned to Bashang.

translation:
Xiang Yu later gave up, and the incident was recorded in "Yu Zhuan".
In the first year of the Han Dynasty, Pei Gong became the king of Han and took over the land of Bashu. He rewarded Zhang Liang with a hundred yi of gold and two measures of pearls. Zhang Liang dedicated all of them to Xiang Bo.
The king of Han then asked Zhang Liang to send generous gifts to Xiang Bo and asked him to request the land in Hanzhong.
King Xiang agreed.
When the King of Han went to the feudal state, Zhang Liang was sent to Baozhong and sent Zhang Liang back to Han.
Zhang Liang then persuaded the king of Han to burn down the plank road to show to the world that he had no intention of returning, so as to stabilize King Xiang's heart.
Then he asked Zhang Liang to go back.
While walking, burn the plank road.
When Zhang Liang returned to Han, he heard that Xiang Yu would not let Han Wangcheng return to his country because Zhang Liang followed the Han king, so he went east with him and went to Pengcheng to kill him.
At that time, the King of Han returned to pacify the Three Qin Dynasties. Zhang Liang wrote to Xiang Yu, saying: The King of Han neglected his duty and wanted to occupy Guanzhong. He stopped as agreed and did not dare to go east again.
He also sent Qi's counter-written letter to Xiang Yu, saying: Qi and Fang will destroy Chu together.
Xiang Yu therefore went north to attack Qi.
Zhang Liang returned to Han Dynasty from the small road.
The king of Han appointed Zhang Liang as the Marquis of Xin, and he attacked Chu from Shu.
When they arrived at Pengcheng, the king of Han failed and returned.
When he arrived at Xiayi, the King of Han dismounted his horse and leaned on the saddle and asked: "I want to give up Guan Yishu to others. Who can make meritorious deeds with me?"
Zhang Liang said: Jiujiang King Bu, a fierce general of Chu, had a conflict with King Xiang. Peng Yue and Qi King Tian Rong rebelled in Liang. These two people can be used in emergencies.
Among the generals of the Han Dynasty, only Han Xin could deliver important tasks and stand alone.
If the land of Guandong is to be given up to these three people, Chu can break it.
The King of Han then sent Sui He to persuade King Bu of Jiujiang, and also sent people to unite with Peng Yue.
When King Bao of Wei rebelled, he sent Han Xin to lead troops to attack north, and then captured Yan, Dai, Qi, and Zhao.
However, it was the power of these three people that finally defeated Chu.
Zhang Liang was often ill and did not lead troops specifically. He often served as a planning minister and was always by his side.
In the third year of the Han Dynasty, Xiang Yu urgently besieged the King of Han in Rongyang. The King of Han was worried and panicked, and planned with Li Shiqi to weaken the power of Chu.
Li Sheng said: In the past Tang defeated Jie and granted his descendants the title of Qi; King Wu killed Zhou and granted his descendants the title of Song.
Now Qin cannot follow the great road and has destroyed the six kingdoms, leaving no place to stand.
Your Majesty is really able to re-establish the descendants of the Six Kingdoms. They are all grateful to your Majesty for your virtue and righteousness and are willing to be your slaves.
If virtue and justice have been fulfilled, facing south and seeking hegemony, Chu will definitely come to court respectfully.
The king of Han said: OK.
Immediately engrave it, sir, and give it to them.
Before Li Sheng left, Zhang Liang came from outside to see the King of Han.
The king of Han was eating and said: "I have a retainer who is planning to weaken the power of Chu."
He told Zhang Liang all about Li Sheng's plan and said, "What do you think of Zifang?"
Zhang Liang said: Who planned this for Your Majesty?
summary: During the Hongmen Banquet crisis, Zhang Liang refused to abandon Pei Gong and helped reconcile with Xiang Yu through Xiang Bo. Later, when Pei Gong became King of Han, Zhang Liang advised burning the plank road to show no intention of returning east, stabilizing Xiang Yu. He also recommended using Han Xin, Peng Yue, and King Bu of Jiujiang to defeat Chu. Zhang Liang opposed enfeoffing descendants of the six kingdoms, arguing it would undermine support for the Han king. He convinced the king to destroy the seals prepared for this purpose. He also advised granting titles to Han Xin and others to secure their loyalty.

translation:
The emperor granted more than 20 titles to the great meritorious officials, but the rest could not be decided day and night and could not be divided among them.
The emperor lived in Luoyang South Palace. From the overpass, he saw the generals often whispering to each other.
The emperor said: What are you talking about?
Zhang Liang said: "Don't your Majesty know?"
This is treason.
The emperor said: The world has just stabilized, why rebel?
Zhang Liang said: Your Majesty rose from the common people and conquered the world with these people. Now that you have become the emperor, you have granted titles to people who were friendly to you, such as Xiao and Cao, and killed people you had always hated.
Nowadays, military officers calculate their merits and enfeoffment is not widespread enough in the world. These people were afraid that His Majesty would not be able to seal them all, and they were also afraid that they would be killed on suspicion of negligence, so they gathered to rebel.
The emperor then said worriedly: What should we do?
Zhang Liang said: Among the people the emperor always resents, all the ministers know, who is the most powerful?
The emperor said: Yong Chi and I have an old enmity. He has embarrassed me with many insults. I want to kill him because he has done so much and I can't bear it.
Zhang Liang said: "Now, hurry up and confer Yong Chi first to show it to the officials. When the officials saw that Yong Chi was conferred first, everyone became firm."
So the emperor served wine, made Yongchi the Marquis of Shifang, and quickly urged the Prime Minister and the Censor to calculate the reward for his merits.
After drinking, the officials all said happily: "Yong Chi has been granted the title of Marquis, so we don't have to worry anymore."
Liu Jing persuaded the emperor to build the capital in Guanzhong, but the emperor was hesitant.
The ministers on the left and right were all from Shandong, and they often advised the emperor to build Luoyang as the capital, saying: "Luoyang has Chenggao in front of it, Dixing in the west, and its back faces the river and faces Luoyang. It is strong enough to rely on."
Zhang Liang said: Although Luoyang has such a dangerous terrain, it is small in area, only a few hundred miles away, the land is not fertile, and it is surrounded by enemies on all sides. This is not a place to use force.
Guanzhong has Dihan on the left, Longshu on the right, thousands of miles of fertile fields, the abundance of Bashu in the south, and the benefits of livestock husbandry in the Hu land in the north. It is difficult to defend on three sides, and open one side to the east to control the princes.
When the princes are in peace, the rivers and Wei canals transport the world's supplies to the west to supply the capital; when the princes are in trouble, they can go down the river, which is enough to transport them.
This is the so-called golden city thousands of miles away, the land of abundance.
Liu Jing is right.
So the emperor set off that day and headed west to build his capital in Guanzhong.
Zhang Liang followed him into the pass. He was very sick, and he did not eat grains to cultivate his health. He stayed in seclusion for more than a year.
The emperor wanted to depose the prince and instead establish Mrs. Qi's son, King Zhao Ruyi.
Many ministers argued but failed to change the emperor's determination.
Queen Lu was afraid and didn't know what to do.
Someone said to Queen Lu: Marquis Liu is good at planning, and the emperor trusts him.
summary: After the Han dynasty was established, Zhang Liang was granted the title of Marquis of Liu. He declined a larger fief, citing his lack of military exploits. He advised the emperor to first enfeoff Yong Chi, a man the emperor resented, to reassure other generals and prevent rebellion. He also supported Liu Jing's proposal to make Guanzhong the capital, arguing its strategic advantages.

translation:
At this time, Shusun Tong had become the Taifu, and Zhang Liang was responsible for the work of the Young Tutor.
In the twelfth year of the Han Dynasty, the emperor returned from defeating Yingbu. He became even more ill and wanted to change the prince more and more.
Zhang Liang refused to listen to his advice and did not go to court because of illness.
Taifu Shusun quoted ancient stories and sacrificed his life to fight for the crown prince's throne.
The emperor pretended to agree to him, but still wanted to change the prince.
When there is a banquet, wine is served and the prince serves.
The four people followed the prince, all in their eighties, with snow-white hair and eyebrows, and distinguished clothes.
The emperor was surprised and asked: "What is this for?"
Four people came forward to answer, each saying his or her name.
The emperor was surprised and said: I invited you, you ran away from me, why are you hanging out with my son now?
The four said: Your Majesty despises the scholars and loves to scold them. We are righteous and will not be insulted, so we are afraid and run away.
Now I heard that the prince is benevolent and filial, respects and cherishes the scholars, and there is no one in the world who would not stretch their necks and be willing to die for the prince, so we came here.
The emperor said: I am honored to trouble you all and finally come to train and protect the prince.
The four of them finished their birthday wishes and left.
The emperor watched them off and called Mrs. Qi to point it out to her and said: I want to change to the prince. These four people will assist him. Their wings are already established and it is difficult to shake them.
Lu is really your master.
Mrs. Qi cried, and the emperor said: Dance Chu dance for me, and I will sing Chu songs for you.
Sings: The swan flies high and rushes thousands of miles.
The wings are ready and they can travel across the world.
Crossing the four seas, so what!
There are bows and arrows, but what’s the use?
After singing a few songs, Mrs. Qi sobbed and cried.
The emperor stood up and walked away, taking away the wine.
In the end, the prince was not replaced. This was due to Zhang Liang's recruitment of these four people.
Zhang Liang followed the emperor to attack Dai, and captured Mayi with a clever plan. When he established Xiao Xiangguo, he calmly discussed many things about the world with the emperor. He did not talk about the rise and fall of the world, so he did not record it.
Zhang Liang then declared: "My family has been the prime minister of Han for generations. When Han died, he spared no expense in his fortune to avenge Han's power against Qin. The world was shocked."
Now, with his three-inch tongue, he is the emperor's teacher, and he is granted the title of ten thousand households, and he is ranked among the nobles. This is the ultimate for common people, and it is enough for Zhang Liang.
I hope to give up the worldly affairs and travel with Chisongzi.
So he studied Taoism and wanted to practice and become an immortal.
When Emperor Gao died, Empress Lu thought Zhang Liang was virtuous, so she forced him to give him a salary, saying: "Life is like a fleeting moment, why do you suffer like this?"
Zhang Liang had no choice but to accept it reluctantly.
Died six years later.
Mi was given the title Marquis Wencheng.
summary: When the emperor wanted to depose the crown prince, Zhang Liang initially refused to intervene. Pressed by Empress Lü, he suggested recruiting four reclusive sages to support the prince. The emperor, seeing the prince had their support, abandoned the plan. Zhang Liang later withdrew from worldly affairs, studying Taoism and seeking immortality. He died six years after Emperor Gao, receiving the posthumous title Marquis Wencheng.

translation:
At first, Zhang Liang met the old man who gave him a book on the Xiapi Bridge. Thirteen years later, he passed through Jibei with Emperor Gao and found the yellow stone at the foot of Gucheng Mountain, which he took back and cherished as a sacrifice.
After Zhang Liang died, they were buried together in Huangshi.
Every time when visiting the tomb and Fula, sacrifices are made to Huangshi.
The son will undoubtedly inherit the throne.
In the third year of Xiaowen's reign, he was charged with disrespect. The country being eliminated.
Chen Ping was born in Wuxiang, Yangwuhu.
When I was a child, my family was poor, so I loved reading and studying the knowledge of Huangdi and Laozi.
There are thirty acres of land. Lives with his brother Chen Bo.
Chen Bo often farmed and asked Chen Ping to study abroad.
Chen Ping is tall and beautiful. There is Chen Ping in the world: Why are you so fat when you live in a poor family?
His sister-in-law hated Chen Ping for not farming at home and said, "It's just like eating chaff."
It’s better not to have such a brother-in-law!
When Uncle Chen heard this, he drove his wife away.
When Chen Ping grew up, he could marry a wife, but no one from the rich would marry him, and he would dislike the poor.
A long time later, a rich man in Hulu had a granddaughter. After marrying five times, her husbands died. No one dared to marry her. Su Na wanted to marry her.
There was a big funeral in the city, and the Suping family went to help with the funeral arrangements. They left early and came back late to get more rewards.
Zhang Fu saw him at the funeral and thought he was extraordinary. Chen Ping also left late for some reason.
Zhang Fu followed King Su to his home. He lived in a back alley behind the city wall and used a mat as the door, but there were many dignitaries' cars outside the door.
Zhang Fu went back and said to his son Dan Shi: I want to marry my granddaughter to Chen Ping.
Zhang Zhong said: Chen Ping was poor and did nothing, and everyone in the county laughed at his behavior. Why did you marry your daughter to him alone?
Zhang Fu said: Will a talented person like Chen Ping be poor for a long time?
Finally, he married his granddaughter.
Because Chen Qian's family was poor, they lent him money to hire him and gave him food and wine to finance his marriage.
Zhang Fu warned his granddaughter: Don't serve him carelessly just because he is poor.
Serve your brother Uncle Chen as you serve your father, and serve your sister-in-law as you serve your mother.
Chen Ping married Zhang's daughter, and his resources became richer and his contacts became more extensive.
A community ceremony was held in the village, with Chen Ping presiding over it, and the meat was divided evenly.
The elders in the village said: Chen Ruzi is really good at hosting this!
Chen Ping said: Alas, if Chen Ping were allowed to rule the world, he would be like this meat!
Chen She rose up and proclaimed himself king, sent Zhou Shi to capture the territory, appointed Wei Jiu as king of Wei, and went to war with the Qin army in Linji.
Previously, Chen Ping had bid farewell to his brother Chen Bo and followed some young people to serve Wei Wang Jiu as a servant.
I tried to persuade the King of Wei, but the King did not listen.
Someone framed him and Chen Ping fled.
When Xiang Yu reached the river, Chen Ping followed him. He followed him into the pass and destroyed Qin, and was given the rank of minister.
Xiang Yu went east to Pengcheng and proclaimed himself king, and the king of Han went back east to pacify the Three Qin Dynasties.
summary: Chen Ping, from a poor family, was known for his height and good looks. He married a wealthy woman after a local elder recognized his potential. During village festivals, he divided meat evenly, saying he would govern the world similarly.

translation:
King Yin rebelled against Chu, so Xiang Yu appointed Chen Ping as Lord Xinwu and led King Wei's retainers in Chu to attack. Yin surrendered and returned.
King Xiang asked Xiang Han to worship Chen Ping as the captain and gave him twenty yi gold.
Not long after, Han conquered Yin.
King Xiang was furious and wanted to kill those who suppressed Yin.
Chen Ping was afraid of being killed, so he sealed the gold and seal and sent someone to return it to King Xiang. Su Ping escaped from the road with his sword.
When crossing the river, the boatman saw that he was a handsome man traveling alone, and suspected that he was a fugitive general with gold and jade under his waist. He looked at him and wanted to kill Chen Ping.
Chen Ping was frightened, so he took off his clothes and helped row the boat naked.
The boatman knew he had no money, so he gave up.
Chen Ping then went to Kaiwu to surrender and seek an audience with the King of Han through Wei Chichi, and Mu summoned him.
At this time, Wan Shijun, Gentong Zuozhongjuan, accepted Su Na's visit.
Su Ping and ten others came forward together and gave them food.
The king said: The meeting is over and we can go back to the guest house.
Su Na said: I have something to say, and I can't say anything more than today.
So the king of Han talked with him and appreciated him very much, and asked: What official position do you have in Chu?
Chen Ping said: Become a captain.
On that day, Chen Ping was appointed as the captain, and he was asked to accompany him and take charge of guarding the army.
The generals were all in an uproar and said: One day, the king got a deserter from Chu. He didn't know his rank, so he immediately rode with him and asked him to guard the senior people!
After the King of Han heard about this, he favored Chen Hu even more and took him east to attack King Xiang.
When he arrived at Pengcheng, he was defeated by the Chu army and returned with his troops.
He gathered the scattered soldiers and went to Rongyang, appointed Chen Ping as the sub-general, subordinated to Han Wangxin, and garrisoned in Guangwu.
Zhou Bo, Guan Ying and others framed Chen Ping and said: Although Chen Ping is a handsome man, he is like the jade on his crown, but he may not be talented inside.
I heard that Chen Ping had an affair with his sister-in-law when he was at home. He was not tolerated when he served the king of Wei, so he fled to follow Chu. He failed to follow Chu, so he fled to follow Han.
Now the king respects him, gives him an official position, and lets him oversee the army.
I heard that Chen Ping used generals and sent those with more money to good places and those with less money to bad places.
Chen Ping is a capricious and rebellious minister, and I hope Wang will take notice.
The king of Han doubted him, blamed his ignorance, and asked: Is this possible?
Ignorance said: Yes.
The king of Han said: Why do you say he is a wise man?
He replied: What I am talking about is talent; what your Majesty is asking about is virtue.
Even if he has such virtues as Weisheng and filial piety, it will not be beneficial to the success of victory or defeat. How can your Majesty care about using him?
Now that Chu and Han are at war, I recommend a wise scholar just because his strategy can really benefit the country.
Is there anything suspicious about having an affair with a sister-in-law and accepting bribes?
The King of Han summoned Chen Ping and asked: I heard that your husband served Wei disobediently, served Chu and then left, and now he is friends with me. Can an honest man be so half-hearted?
Chen Ping said: I served the King of Wei, but the King of Wei could not listen to me, so I left him to serve King Xiang.
summary: Chen Ping served Wei and then Chu, but fled both when his advice was ignored or he feared execution. He joined Liu Bang, who appointed him a captain despite objections from other generals. Chen Ping explained his past changes of allegiance by saying his former masters could not use him properly. He proposed using gold to sow discord among Xiang Yu's advisors, leading to Xiang Yu's suspicion of his strategist Fan Zeng.

translation:
Answer: There were more than 30,000 households in Taiwan at the beginning. After many wars, many people fled and hid. Now there are more than 5,000 households.
So he issued an edict to the censor and changed the title of Shunuo Zuqu Nihou to enjoy the tax revenue of the whole county and exempted him from the previous feudal household.
Chen Ping followed them from the beginning, and after the world was peaceful, he often followed them as a guard lieutenant to attack Zang Tu, Chen Xi, and Yingbu.
A total of six clever tricks were made, and each time they were successful and increased the number of fiefs.
Some of the tricks are so secret that no one in the world has heard of them.
When Gao Di returned from pacifying Tingbu, he was injured and slowly returned to Chang'an.
King Lu Wan of Yan rebelled, and the emperor sent Fan Sha as prime minister to lead the attack.
After he left, someone said bad things about Fan Sha.
Emperor Gao was furious and said: "Fan Ha saw that I was seriously ill, so he wanted me to die!"
Using Chen Ping's strategy, he summoned Zhou Bo, the Marquis of Jiang, to receive the edict under his bed, saying: "Chen Ping sent Zhou Bo to replace Fan Sha to lead the army. When Chen Ping arrived in the army, he chopped off Fan Sha's head!"
The two of them accepted the imperial edict, and before they reached the army, they discussed on the road: Fan Sha is an old friend of the emperor and has made many contributions. He is also the husband of Empress Lu's sister Lu Xu. He is affectionate and noble. The emperor is angry and wants to kill him. I'm afraid he will regret it.
It would be better to imprison him and hand him over to the emperor, and let the emperor kill him himself.
When he was not in the army, he set up an altar and used talismans to summon Fan Sha.
When Fan Sha accepted the imperial edict, he tied him up, loaded him into a chariot and drove him to Chang'an, where he asked Zhou Bo to lead his troops to pacify Yan instead.
On the way to Chenping, I heard that Emperor Gao had passed away. I was afraid that Empress Lu and Lu Xu would be angry, so I took a ride to leave first.
An envoy ordered Chen Ping and Guan Ying to garrison Rongyang.
Chen Ping accepted the edict and immediately ran to the palace, crying sadly, and then reported his work in front of the body. Empress Lu took pity on him and said, "Go out and rest!"
Chen Ping was afraid that the slander would gain momentum, so he firmly requested to be allowed to stay on guard duty in the palace.
The Queen Mother appointed him as a doctor and taught the emperor every day.
After that, Lu Xu's slander did not take effect.
After Fan Sha arrived, he was freed from all charges and restored to his title.
In the fifth year of Emperor Hui's reign, Prime Minister Cao Shen passed away, An Guohou Wang Ling became the right prime minister, and Chen Hu became the left prime minister.
Wang Ling, a native of Pei.
At first, he was a magnate in the county. When Gaozu was humble, he served Wang Ling like his elder brother.
When Emperor Gaozu started an uprising in Pei and invaded Xianyang, Wang Ling also gathered thousands of party members and refused to obey Pei Gong in Nanyang.
When the king of Han returned to attack Xiang Ji, Wang Ling led his troops back to the desert.
Xiang Yu placed Wang Ling's mother in the army. When Wang Ling's envoy came, he asked her to sit facing the east, hoping to recruit Wang Ling to surrender.
summary: Chen Ping advised the emperor to capture Han Xin by feigning a visit to Yunmeng, rather than attacking him directly. He also helped the emperor escape a siege at Pingcheng using a secret plan. He served as a strategist for six major campaigns, each time increasing his fief.

translation:
Wang Ling's mother secretly sent the envoy, crying: I hope to tell Wang Ling for the old woman to serve the King of Han well. The King of Han is a kind and kind elder, and don't have second thoughts because of the old woman.
I died to see the messenger off.
He fell on his sword and died.
King Xiang was angry and killed Wang Ling's mother.
Wang Ling finally followed the King of Han to pacify the world.
Because he was friendly with Yong Chi, who was Gaozu's enemy, and Wang Ling had no intention of obeying Mo, he later granted Wang Ling the title of Marquis of Anguo.
Wang Ling was arbitrary and had no literary talent, and he liked to be outspoken. After serving as Prime Minister You for two years, Emperor Hui died.
Empress Gao wanted to make a man named Lu king and asked about the king's mausoleum.
Wang Ling said: Emperor Gao killed Baima Mengzhe and said: If he is not the Liu family but becomes king, the whole world will attack him together.
It is against the rules to make Lu the king now.
The Queen Mother was not happy.
When I asked the left prime minister Chen Ping and Jianghou Zhou Bo, they all said: Emperor Gao pacified the world and established his children as kings; now the Queen Mother is exercising the power of the emperor and wants to grant brothers surnamed Lu, and there is nothing wrong with it.
The Queen Mother is happy.
After retreating from the court, Wang Ling scolded Chen Ping and Zhou Bo, saying: We made a blood oath with Emperor Gao in the beginning, aren't you here?
Now that Emperor Gao has passed away, the Queen Mother is the heroine and wants to make Lu the king. You all are flattering and breaking the covenant. How can you have the shame to meet Emperor Gao underground!
Chen Ping said: "I am not as good as you in arguing in front of the court; you are not as good as me in preserving the country and stabilizing the descendants of the Liu family."
Wang Ling was speechless.
So Empress Dowager Lu wanted to depose Wang Ling, and promoted Wang Ling to the position of emperor's tutor on the surface, but in fact she took away his power of prime minister.
Wang Ling was angry, resigned due to illness, and stayed behind closed doors to attend court. He died ten years later.
After Wang Ling was dismissed, Empress Dowager Lu promoted Chen Ping to the position of prime minister of the right, and appointed him as the prime minister of the left by the Marquis of Piyang.
Eating it is also a good thing.
When the King of Han was defeated in the west of Pengcheng, the Chu army took the Emperor Taishang and Empress Lu as hostages, and used them as sacrifices to serve Empress Lu.
Later, after defeating Xiang Ji, he was granted the title of Marquis and was favored by Empress Dowager Lu.
When he becomes the prime minister, he does not assume any official duties and supervises the affairs of the palace. He is like a doctor, and all officials make decisions through him.
Lu Xuchang framed Chen Ping many times because he planned to arrest Fan Sha for Emperor Gao. He said: "As prime minister, I don't care about anything. I drink fine wine every day and molest women."
After hearing this, Chen Ping became more and more indulgent day by day.
When Empress Dowager Lu heard about it, she was secretly happy.
In front of Lu Xu, Chen Ping said: As the saying goes, women and children cannot be heard. I want to know what kind of relationship you have with me. Don't be afraid of being framed by Lu Xu.
Empress Dowager Lu appointed many people named Lu as kings, and Chen Ping pretended to obey.
When Empress Dowager Lu died, Chen Ping and Taiwei Zhou Bo conspired to finally kill the people named Lu and establish Emperor Wen. This was Chen Ping's plan.
summary: After Emperor Gao's death, Chen Ping pretended to indulge in wine and women to avoid suspicion from Empress Lü. He outwardly complied with her appointing Lü family members as kings, but later conspired with Zhou Bo to eliminate the Lü clan and establish Emperor Wen. As prime minister, he famously told the emperor that a prime minister's role is to oversee officials, not handle specific tasks.

translation:
Qedong made a living by weaving silkworm-rearing utensils. He often played the flute for people attending funerals, and used his talents as a leader.
When Emperor Gaozu had just become Duke of Pei, Bo followed him as Zhongjuan to attack Huling and attacked Fangyou.
Fang rebelled, fought with the enemy again, and defeated the enemy.
Attack Feng.
Attack the Qin army in Cishu. He came back and was stationed in Liuhexiao.
Attack Ci again and occupy it.
To capture Xiayi, first scale the city wall. He was given the title of Fifth Doctor.
Attacked Meng and Yu and occupied them.
Attack the rear army of Zhang Han's chariots and cavalry.
Capture the land of Wei.
He captured Yuanqi and Shujin, went to Li, and captured it.
To attack Zhisang, first climb the city wall.
Attack the Qin army in Axia and defeat them.
He pursued him to Puyang and captured Qicheng.
He attacked Duguan and Dingtao, captured Wanqu by surprise, and captured the county magistrate Shanfu.
He captured Linji with a night attack, attacked Shouzhang, went to Juan as a vanguard, and defeated Li You at the foot of Yongqiu City.
When attacking Kaifeng, he got to the city first and gained most of the credit.
After Zhang Han defeated Xiang Liang, Pei Gong and Xiang Yu led their troops eastward to Jie.
From the beginning of the uprising in Pei to the time he returned to Ci, it lasted one year and two months.
King Huai of Chu granted Duke Pei the title of Marquis of Wu'an and made him the governor of Jie County.
Peigong worshiped Zhou Bo as his assistant and ordered him to do so.
Following Peiping, he conquered the territory of Wei, and attacked Dongjun Wei in Chengwu, and was defeated. To attack Changshe, first climb the city wall.
Attack Yingyang and Fengshi, cross the river crossing, and attack Zauben's army in the north of Shibei.
Go south to attack Nanyang Shouling and occupy Wuguan and Xiguan.
Attack the Qin army in Lantian. To Xianyang.
Destroy Qin.
Xiang Yu came and made Peigong King of Han.
The king of Han granted Zhou Bojue the title of Marquis of Power.
He followed him into Hanzhong and became a general.
He returned to the army to pacify the Three Qin Dynasties and granted him food and virtue.
Attacking Huaili and being good at confrontation will have the highest merit.
Going north to attack Zhao Bi and Nei Shibao in Xianyang, he achieved the highest credit.
Rescue paint on the north side.
Attack Zhang Ping and Yao Yin's army.
Go west to pacify Dingyi.
Returned to capture Yun and Pinyang.
Besieged Zhang Han in Feiqiu and won. Attacked Yi Jijun to the west and won.
Attack Shangbang.
Head east to guard the Pass.
Attack Xiang Ji.
Attacking Quyu has the highest merit.
Go back to guard Aocang and chase Xiang Ji.
After Xiang Ji's death, he pacified Chudi's swimming and Shuhai counties in Shumian, occupying a total of twenty-two counties.
He returned to guard Luoyang and Luyang, and was rewarded with Zhongli as a food town together with Marquis Yingyin.
As a general, he followed Emperor Gaozu to attack King Zangcha of Yan and defeated him at the foot of Yi City.
Most of the soldiers he led served as Gaozu's pioneers.
Confer nobility as a lord, and analyze the talismans from generation to generation.
There are 8,280 households in Shiyijiang.
As a general, he followed Emperor Gao to attack King Xin of Han in Dai and captured the Huo people.
As a vanguard, he went to Wuquan, attacked the Hu cavalry, and defeated them north of Wuquan.
Turn to Tongqian to attack Han Xin's army and win.
Return to the army and surrender the six cities of Taiyuan.
Hu Qi attacked Han Xin at the foot of Jinyang City, won the victory, and occupied Jinyang.
Later, he attacked Han Xin's army at Bishi and won, chasing the defeated army for eighty miles.
He returned to attack the three cities of Loufan, and then attacked the Hu cavalry at the foot of Pingcheng. Most of the soldiers he led served as Gaozu's pioneers.
Zhou Bo was promoted to Taiwei.
Beaten the cattle and massacred the people of Mayi city.
The general who led his soldiers to kill Chen Xi surrendered on horseback.
He moved to Loufan to attack the troops of Han Xin, Chen Xi and Zhao Li and won.
Captured by Chen Xi, Song Zui and Yanmen were trapped.
Then they turned to attack and captured Yunzhong Shouyao, Prime Minister Ji Jie, and General Bo.
summary: Zhou Bo, a simple man from Pei, began as a funeral flutist. He followed Liu Bang from the start, distinguishing himself in battle by often being the first to scale city walls. He served as a general under Emperor Gao, pacifying many regions and capturing numerous enemy officials.

translation:
The seventeen counties of Yanmen County and the twelve counties of Yunzhong County were pacified.
Then he attacked Chen Xi in Lingqiu and won. They beheaded Chen Xi, Prime Minister Cheng Zong, General Chen Wu, and Captain Gao Xie.
Pingding Daijun nine counties.
King Lu Wan of Yan rebelled, and Zhou Bo, as prime minister, led Fan Sha's army and captured Ji. He captured Lu Wan's general Da, the prime ministers Yan, Shouxing, Taiwei Ruo, and the imperial censor Shi Tuhundu.
Defeated Lu Wan's army in Shanglan, and then attacked Lu Wan's army in Juyang.
After chasing the Great Wall, they pacified twelve counties in Shanggu, sixteen counties in Youbeiping, twenty-nine counties in Liaodong, and twenty-two counties in Yuyang.
Following Emperor Gao, they captured one prime minister, two prime ministers, three generals and two thousand stones. In addition, they defeated two armies, captured three cities, pacified five counties and seventy-nine counties, and captured one prime minister and one general.
Zhou Bo was a simple and honest man, and Emperor Gao believed that he could be entrusted with important tasks.
Zhou Bo didn't like reading. Every time he summoned scholars and debaters, he would sit facing east and urge: "Tell me quickly."
He simply lacks literary talent to this extent.
Zhou Bo pacified Yan and returned. Emperor Gao had passed away. He served Emperor Hui as a prince. In the sixth year of Emperor Hui's reign, the official position of Taiwei was established and Zhou Bo was appointed as Taiwei.
Ten years later, Queen Gao passed away.
Lu Lu appointed King Tong as the general of Mo Shang, and Lu Chan appointed King Lu as the prime minister. He controlled the power of the country and wanted to endanger the Liu family.
Zhou Bo, together with the prime ministers Chen Ping and Zhu Xuhou Zhang, killed everyone surnamed Lu.
The matter is in "Gaohou Ji".
They then plotted secretly, believing that the young emperor and the kings of Ji, Huaiyang and Hengshan were not the sons of Emperor Hui. Empress Dowager Lu used a trick to pretend that someone else's child was a prince, killed his mother, raised him in the harem, and asked Xiaohui to treat him like a son and establish him as a descendant to strengthen the power of the Lu family.
Now that the Lu surname has been eliminated, if the young emperor grows up and takes charge, we will all be exterminated. It is better to select virtuous princes as emperors.
Then he welcomed the acting king, Emperor Xiaowen.
Dongmou Hou Xingju, the younger brother of Zhu Xuhou Zhang, said: "I have no merit in killing Lu. Please let me clear the palace."
Then he and his servant Ruyin, Duke Teng, entered the palace.
Duke Teng stepped forward and said to the young emperor: "You are not the Liu family, so you do not deserve to be the emperor."
Then he turned around and waved away the halberds on his left and right, and they all put down their weapons and dispersed.
Several people refused to leave, and the eunuch ordered Zhang Shi to inform everyone, and then they left.
Duke Teng called for a chariot to carry the young emperor out of the palace.
The young emperor said: Where do you want to take me?
Teng Gong said: "Go to the Shaofu's residence."
Then he drove the emperor's chariot and horse to the residence to greet the emperor and reported: The palace has been cleared.
When the emperor entered Weiyang Palace, there were ten visitors holding halberds guarding the main entrance of the palace, saying: The emperor is here, what are you doing?
Can't go in.
The Taiwei went to report the matter, then led his troops to leave, and the Emperor went in.
That night, the officials divided into several groups and killed them at the residences of King Jichuan, Huaiyang, and Changshan and the young emperor.
summary: After Emperor Gao's death, Zhou Bo served as Grand Commandant. When Empress Lü died, he and Chen Ping plotted to eliminate the Lü clan. Zhou Bo, as commander of the Northern Army, rallied the soldiers by showing them his seal and declaring loyalty to the Liu family. They killed the Lü kings and established Emperor Wen. The historian comments that Zhang Liang, despite his wisdom, looked like a woman. Chen Ping used clever schemes to survive the Lü clan's rule. Zhou Bo, though crude, stabilized the Han dynasty, fulfilling Emperor Gao's prediction that he would secure the Liu family.

translation:
Emperor Wen ascended the throne and appointed Zhou Bo as the right prime minister. He was rewarded with five thousand catties of gold and food for ten thousand households.
More than ten months later, someone advised Zhou Bo: You have killed all the people surnamed Lu and established a king, which is powerful in the world. If you accept a large reward and are in a high position and are satisfied with it, great disaster will come.
Zhou Bo was afraid and felt he was in danger, so he apologized and asked for the seal to be returned.
The emperor agreed.
More than a year later, Prime Minister Chen Ping died, and the emperor appointed Zhou Bo as prime minister.
More than ten months later, the emperor said: Some time ago, I issued an edict to allow the princes to return to the feudal country, but many people did not go. The Prime Minister is my most important person and he wants to lead the princes back to the country for me.
Then he was relieved of his position and returned to the feudal country.
More than a year later, whenever the Hedong governor visited Jiang County, Jiang Hou Zhou Bo himself was afraid of being killed, so he often wore armor and asked his family members to meet him with weapons.
Later, someone wrote a letter accusing Zhou Bo of rebelling, and he was sent to Tingwei to arrest Zhou Bo and convict him.
Zhou Bo was scared and didn't know how to answer correctly.
The clerk slightly insulted him.
Zhou Bo gave the jailer a thousand catties of gold, and the jailer wrote on the back of the wooden slips for him to read. Ask the princess to testify.
