translation:
Isn’t it said in ancient books? When the weather is cold, we know that the pines and cypresses will wither.
Let Fu happy return to Chang'an, give Fu happy the former residence of Gao'an Marquis, occupy the special position, and participate in court meetings in the name of being invited by the court.
Although Fu happy was praised and rewarded on the surface, he was lonely, helpless and frightened. He was later sent back to his fiefdom and died of old age.
Wang Mang gave him the title of Zhenhou.
His son inherited the title, which was cut off after Wang Mang's defeat.
Praise said: Since Emperor Xuan, Emperor Yuan, Emperor Cheng, and Emperor Ai, the families of relatives have become particularly powerful, including the Xu family, the Shi family, the three Wang families, the Ding family, and the Fu family. They all have several people in the family, many generals, and are extremely wealthy. Only their prominent status is seen, but no outstanding talents are found in them.
The Yangping Wang family has some talent, likes to be busy, and loves fame. His power is especially strong, and he has been in high positions for the longest time even though he is not qualified.
However, by the time of Wang Mang, it was also destroyed.
Wang Shang was deposed because of his upright and firm moral integrity. He died of worry through no fault of his. Shi Dan and his son succeeded each other. Shi Gao was listed as one of the three princes because of his solemnity and loyalty.
Shi Dan assisted and guided the prince, covering up the bad things, praising the good things, and understanding the good intentions. Even the mature Confucians and wise scholars could not surpass him.
When he passed through the door and went straight into the bedroom, he treated the emperor with the utmost sincerity and offended the emperor's dignity. The emperor was moved and awakened, and changed his intention to establish a crown prince. Finally, he became the crown prince and stabilized the status of the queen mother. There is no speech that will not be treated accordingly. In the end, Stan was rewarded for his loyalty and steadfastness.
Fu happy sticks to his integrity without leaning in, and is rewarded with the final withering.
During the handover period between Emperor Ai and Emperor Hu, disaster or blessing came very quickly!
summary: The commentary notes that from Emperor Xuan to Emperor Ai, powerful families like the Xu, Shi, Wang, Ding, and Fu clans held high positions but lacked talent. Wang Shang was deposed for his integrity, dying blameless. Shi Dan's loyalty secured the crown prince's position, earning rewards. Fu Xi's steadfastness was recognized, but during the transition between Emperor Ai and Emperor Ping, fortune and misfortune shifted rapidly.
