Wei Lieutenant Li Guang stationed troops at Yunzhong as General Chao Cavalry, and Lieutenant Cheng Bushi stationed troops at Yanmen as General Chao Cavalry. They withdrew their troops in June.
In the fourth month of summer, he pardoned the world, rewarded the chief minister with the first level of viscount, and restored the clan status of the clans of the seven kingdoms that had been extinguished due to the crime of rebellion by the seven kingdoms.
In May, the imperial edict Xianliang said: I heard that in the old days of Tang and Yu, only sin robes were used to symbolize the five punishments, but the people could not break the law. Everyone obeyed the sun and the moon.
During the reign of King Cheng and King Kang of the Zhou Dynasty, criminal laws were put aside, virtues extended to birds and beasts, and education spread all over the world. When Su Shen from abroad came to the court, the northern canals were searched for service, and the Di and Qiang surrendered; the stars did not comet, the sun and the moon did not eclipse, the mountains did not collapse, and the rivers and valleys were not blocked; unicorns and phoenixes roamed the countryside, and books appeared in the Yellow River and Luoshui.
hehe! Only Pushi Deze can have such a prosperous time!
Today I have the honor to inherit the great authority. I get up early to seek and stay quiet at night to think. If I look at the ocean and sigh, I don't know how to reach the other shore.
Beautiful! How great!
Through those actions, the great cause and virtues of the late emperor were carried forward, and he was worthy of Yao and Shun at the top and the three kings at the bottom.
My nature is dull and my virtue cannot reach far. This is well known to all the doctors. Wise men understand the rise and fall of kings in ancient and modern times, and receive advice and inquiries. Please write them down in writing and compile them into a volume for my reading.
So Dong Zhongshu, Gongsun Hong and others stood out.
On July 30th in autumn, there will be a partial eclipse of the sun.
In the winter and tenth month of the second year, the emperor went to Yongdi to worship the Five Emperors.
In the spring, I issued an edict and asked the ministers: "I once decorated beautiful women to match the Xiongnu Chanyu, and rewarded them generously with gold coins, embroidery, and embroidery. However, after accepting the imperial edict, the Chanyu became arrogant and invaded endlessly."
summary: In the second year, officials Zhao Wan and Wang Zang committed suicide for failing to report to the Empress Dowager, and Prime Minister Dou Ying and Taiwei Tian Chong were dismissed. A partial solar eclipse occurred, and a night was as bright as day. Maoling-eup was established. In the third year, the Yellow River flooded, causing famine and cannibalism. Residents moving to Maoling received funds and land. A comet appeared in the northwest. King Liu Ming of Jichuan was deposed for murder. Minyue besieged Dong Ou, but Han forces caused their retreat. In the fourth year, red dust blew, drought struck, and comets appeared. In the fifth year, three-baht coins were abolished, half-liang coins issued, and Doctors of the Five Classics established. The emperor's grandmother died, locusts plagued, and two kings died. In the sixth year, fires at Gaozu Temple and Gaoyuan Bedroom led the emperor to blame himself. The Empress Dowager died, and a comet appeared. Minyue attacked South Vietnam, but the Yue people killed their king and surrendered.

translation:
I am deeply disturbed by the murders at the border.
Now I want to send troops to attack, what do you think?
Daxing Wang Hui suggested that we should attack.
In the sixth month of the summer, Han Anguo, the imperial censor, was appointed as the guard general, Weiwei Li Guang was the heroic cavalry general, Sun He, the great servant, was the light chariot general, Daxing Wang Hui was the general general, and the great official Li Xi was the caiguan general. They stationed 300,000 people in the valley of Mayi. They wanted to lure Shan Yu into the fortress and launched an attack unexpectedly.
After Shanyu entered the fortress, he immediately exited when he noticed something strange.
In June, withdraw troops.
General Wang Hui committed the crime of "not advancing the plan" and was imprisoned and died.
In the ninth month of autumn, the whole country was ordered to drink alcohol for five days to comfort the farmers.
In the spring of the third year, the Yellow River moved and flowed from the southeast of Dunqiu into the Bohai Sea.
In the fifth month of summer, five of Gaozu's meritorious officials were granted the title of marquis.
The Yellow River burst in Puyang and flooded sixteen counties. One hundred thousand soldiers were mobilized to block the floods for disaster relief, and Longyuan Palace was built.
In the winter of the fourth year, Wei Qihou Dou Ying was found guilty and his head was hung in public.
On the seventeenth day of the third lunar month in the spring, Prime Minister Chong died.
In April of summer, severe frost damaged crops.
In May, there was an earthquake and the world was forgiven.
In the first month of spring of the fifth year, Wang De of Hejian passed away.
In the summer, corvees from Bashu were recruited to build Nanyi Avenue, and tens of thousands of soldiers were mobilized to build Yanmen Pass.
In autumn and July, strong wind uproots trees.
On July 14, Queen Chen was deposed, and the witches who incited people and disrupted the court were arrested and beheaded.
August, plague of borers.
Among the officials and people, those who understood the affairs of the time and the art of the sages were recruited to Kyoto to take countermeasures, and the towns and counties along the way were provided with food expenses.
Order the envoys from each county to be the leader of their team when they come to Beijing. In the winter of the sixth year, taxes began to be levied on merchants' vehicles and ships.
In spring, a canal for transporting grain was excavated and connected to the Wei River.
The Xiongnu invaded the Shang Valley and plundered the people. The emperor sent the cavalry general Wei Qingbing out of the Shang Valley, the cavalry general Gongsun Aobing to come out, the light cavalry general Gongsun He out of Yunzhong, and the brave cavalry general Li Guang out of Yanmen.
Wei Qing went to Longcheng and captured 700 enemy heads.
Gongsun Ao and Li Guang were defeated due to command errors and returned home.
The emperor issued an edict saying: Yi and Di have been treacherous for a long time. In the past, the Xiongnu invaded the border many times, so generals were sent to command the frontline soldiers to meet the enemy. The ancient military law is to control the army when going out, and to strengthen the brigade when entering.
Due to the sudden invasion of the Xiongnu this time, our army's officers and men had a new meeting, and there was no coordination between the top and bottom. The generals Gongsun Ao who sent the troops out of Daijun, and Li Guang who sent the troops out of Yanmen were of low quality. The captain also acted blindly against orders, so that he abandoned the army and fled, and the petty officials violated the ban.
summary: In the first year of Yuanguang, counties recommended one filial and incorrupt person each. Generals Li Guang and Cheng Bushi withdrew troops. The emperor pardoned the world and restored clans of the Seven Kingdoms. He issued an edict praising ancient rulers and seeking advice, leading to the rise of Dong Zhongshu and Gongsun Hong. In the second year, the emperor worshipped the Five Emperors and discussed attacking the Xiongnu. Generals stationed 300,000 troops at Mayi to lure the Xiongnu Chanyu, but he escaped. General Wang Hui died in prison. In the third year, the Yellow River changed course, and five meritorious officials were made marquises. Flooding in Puyang led to disaster relief. In the fourth year, Dou Ying was executed, Prime Minister Chong died, frost damaged crops, and an earthquake occurred. In the fifth year, King Wang De of Hejian died, roads were built, and Queen Chen was deposed. Talented individuals were recruited. In the sixth year, taxes on merchants' vehicles began. The Xiongnu invaded, and General Wei Qing captured 700 heads, while Gongsun Ao and Li Guang were defeated. The emperor pardoned soldiers for disciplinary violations.

translation:
This memorial was adopted.
In December, Liu Fei, King of Jiangdu, passed away.
On March 13th in the spring, Queen Wei was established.
The edict was issued: I have heard that if the heaven and earth do not change, transformation will not be possible; if the yin and yang do not change, things will not flourish.
"Yi" says: Only by adapting to the situation can the people's spirit be lifted up.
"Poetry" says: Understand the changes of heaven and earth without losing the way, choose the good and follow it.
I appreciate the Tang, Yu, and Yin and Zhou dynasties, and am willing to learn from historical experiences and lessons.
Now the world is amnesty and the people are reformed.
Some were prosecuted for committing crimes and fleeing in fear of crime or owing official property for a long time. Those who committed the crime three years ago before Emperor Xiaojing were exempted from prosecution.
In the autumn of the first year of Yuanshuo, the Huns invaded western Liaoning and killed the prefect of western Liaoning. They also invaded Yuyang and Yanmen, defeated the captains, and killed and plundered more than 3,000 people.
General Wei Qing was sent out of Yanmen, and General Li Xi was sent to replace him, and he captured thousands of enemy heads.
Nanlu, Huijun of Dongyi, and others led 280,000 subjects to submit to the Han and established Canghai County.
King Liu Yu of Lu and King Liu Fa of Changsha both died.
In the winter of the second year, King Huainan and King Sichuan were given a few sticks to avoid going to court.
In the first month of spring, an edict was issued saying: The king of Liang and the king of Chengyang are my brothers. I would like to grant my second brother a title of food. Please accept it. When the princes and kings ask for a seat for their children, I will personally review the list and ensure that they have the title of prince.
So the original vassal state was divided into some food towns, and all the princes and brothers were granted the title of marquis.
The Xiongnu entered Shanggu and Yuyang, killing and plundering more than a thousand officials and people.
The imperial court sent generals Wei Qing and Li Xi out of Yunzhong to Gaoque, and then to Fuli. They captured thousands of enemy heads, recovered Henan, and established Shuofang and Wuyuan counties.
On March 30th, there was a partial solar eclipse.
In the summer, 100,000 people were recruited to migrate to Shuofang County.
They also moved the upper-class people of the county and households with assets of more than three million to Maoling.
In the autumn, King Yan committed suicide because he was guilty of the crime.
In the spring of the third year, the organizational structure of Canghai County was abolished.
In March, an edict was issued saying: Punishment is used to prevent adultery, and respect for virtue is to show the importance of talent. Today's people have not been cultivated in education, and I am happy to work with the scholar-bureaucrats to renew the Han Dynasty's imperial career, and to be respectful and unremitting.
Can forgive the world.
In summer, the Xiongnu invaded Dai and killed the prefect. Invading Yanmen, killing and plundering more than a thousand people.
On the second day of June, the Empress Dowager passed away.
In autumn, the conquest of the southwestern barbarians was exempted and Shuofang City was built.
The people of the country were ordered to drink alcohol for five days to comfort the people.
In the winter of the fourth year, I visited Ganquan.
In the summer, the Huns came to Dai, Dingxiang and Shangjun, killing and plundering thousands of people.
In the spring of the fifth year, a severe drought occurred.
summary: In the first year of Shuo, the emperor issued edicts promoting virtue and talent, ordering officials to recommend filial and incorrupt individuals. Queen Wei was established. In the first year of Yuanshuo, the Xiongnu invaded, and Wei Qing captured thousands of heads. Dongyi submitted, and Canghai County was established. In the second year, the emperor granted titles to princes' sons. Wei Qing recovered Henan, establishing Shuofang and Wuyuan counties. People were moved to Shuofang and Maoling. In the third year, Canghai County was abolished, and the Xiongnu invaded Dai and Yanmen. The Empress Dowager died. In the fourth year, the emperor visited Ganquan. In the fifth year, drought struck, and Wei Qing captured over 15,000 Xiongnu heads. The emperor promoted education and set up doctoral disciples. In the sixth year, Wei Qing defeated the Xiongnu in the desert, but Zhao Xin surrendered and Su Jian fled. The emperor established martial arts reward officers.

translation:
General Wei Qing led six generals and more than 100,000 soldiers to set out at Shuofang and Gaoque, and captured more than 15,000 Xiongnu heads.
In the sixth month of the Xia Dynasty, an edict was issued saying: I once heard that people were taught to use etiquette and cultivated people to enjoy music. Nowadays, etiquette has become corrupted and music has collapsed. I am very sorry.
Therefore, the erudite and virtuous people gathered in Kyoto, and the ceremonial officials gave lectures. They collected and cited erudite texts, cited omitted articles, and promoted or destroyed rites, setting them as an example for the world.
The Taichang official should consider setting up the virtuous people who participated in this academic ceremony as doctoral disciples. This can not only promote education in the countryside, but also reward talents.
Prime Minister Gongsun Hongzou asked the doctor to set up disciples, and more and more people learned etiquette.
In autumn, the Xiongnu came to power and killed the captain.
In the spring and February of that year, General Wei Qing led six generals and more than 100,000 soldiers to ride out of Dingxiang and beheaded more than 3,000 enemies.
After returning to the division, the troops and horses rested and reorganized in Dingxiang, Yunzhong, Yanmen and other places.
Forgive the world.
In April of summer, Wei Qing once again led six generals and soldiers to the desert at the southern border of the Xiongnu and won a complete victory.
Former general Zhao Xin was defeated and surrendered to the Huns.
The right general Su Jian's troops collapsed and he fled back alone to redeem himself as a civilian.
In June, he issued an edict saying: I heard that the five emperors did not follow the old rules of the past, and the three generations did not follow the laws of the previous generation. The historical era in which they lived had changed, but the moral policies they established were consistent.
In the past, Confucius treated Duke Ding of Lu as a person who wanted to please those who were far away, and Duke Ai of Lu, who focused on political governance and saving money. This was not because the requirements were different, but that the specific situation determined the top priority.
Today China is unified but the north is unrest. I miss you very much.
At that time, the general Wei Qing patrolled Shuofang, conquered the Xiongnu, and beheaded 18,000 enemies. Some imprisoned people and those who had committed crimes were rewarded with victory on the front line, and were exempted from crime.
Now the general has once again achieved brilliant results, beheading 19,000 enemies. This time he took the initiative to receive the reward and wanted to sell it. If he does not comply with the order, he will not be allowed to do so.
Regulations can be formulated accordingly.
Officials in charge of martial arts requested the emperor to set up martial arts reward officers to reward warriors.
In the winter and tenth month of the first year of Yuanshou, he went to Yong to offer sacrifices to the Five Emperors. He obtained a white unicorn and wrote "The Song of Bailin".
In November, Liu An, the king of Huainan, and Liu Ci, the king of Hengshan, rebelled and were executed.
Tens of thousands of party members were executed.
In December, there was heavy rain and snow, and civilians froze to death.
In the fourth month of summer, there is a general amnesty for the whole world.
On April 21st in summer, the crown prince was established.
He was given a title of two thousand stones, the right concubine's eldest son, and the first rank of title to the person who succeeded his father as the head of the family.
The edict was issued: I heard that Gao Tao's advice to Yu was to know people first. Only those who can know people are sages. Emperor Yao thought it was very difficult to know people.
Generally speaking, the king is the heart, and the people are like the limbs. When a limb is injured, the heart mourns.
summary: In the first year of Yuanshou, the emperor obtained a white unicorn and wrote a song. Kings of Huainan and Hengshan rebelled and were executed. The crown prince was established. The emperor issued edicts rewarding filial piety and caring for the elderly. Generals Huo Qubing and Gongsun Ao captured thousands of Xiongnu heads. The Xiongnu king Kunxie surrendered, and Wuwei and Jiuquan counties were established. In the third year, a comet appeared, and the emperor pardoned the world. In the fourth year, Wei Qing and Huo Qubing defeated the Xiongnu in Mobei, with heavy casualties. Li Guang committed suicide. In the fifth year, half-liang coins were scrapped, and five-baht coins issued. In the sixth year, the emperor established princes and issued edicts on currency reform. He sent officials to inspect the country and relieve the needy.

translation:
In the ninth month of autumn, General Huo Qubing passed away.
In the summer and fifth month of the first year of Yuanding, he pardoned the whole country and ordered the whole country to drink happily for five days to comfort the people.
Get the tripod above the Fen River.
Peng Li, the king of Jidong, was guilty and moved to Shangyong.
In the winter of November of the second year, Zhang Tang, the imperial censor, committed suicide.
In December, Prime Minister Zhuang Qingzhai was imprisoned and died.
In the spring of the second year of Yuanding, Bailiang Terrace was built.
In March, there was heavy rain and snow.
In summer, there were floods, and thousands of people in Guandong starved to death.
In the ninth month of Autumn, an edict was issued saying: It is benevolence to treat people both far and near as one, and it is righteousness not to be afraid of hardships and dangers. Although it is not a good year for the capital today, the wealth and resources of the mountains, forests, ponds and lakes should be exploited together with the people.
The current flood disaster is moving to the south of the Yangtze River, and the winter is coming. I am worried that the people in the south of the Yangtze River will be hungry and cold.
In the Jiangnan area, fire plowing and water plowing were carried out, and Bashu grain was immediately transferred to Jiangling. Doctors and middlemen were sent to various places to inspect and inform the victims that Shu grain had arrived, so as to relieve their worries.
Any officials or people who have made outstanding achievements in famine relief must report their deeds to the court in detail.
In the winter of the third year, Hangu was moved to Xin'an, and the original address was Hongnong County.
In November, it was ordered that anyone who exposed tax evasion would be rewarded with half of the amount they should pay.
In the spring of the third year of Yuanding, a fire broke out in Yanglingyuan.
In the summer of April, there was hail, and famine broke out in more than a dozen counties in Kanto, and cannibalism occurred.
When Liu Shun, the king of Changshan, passed away, his son Bo Xun succeeded him. He was found guilty and moved to Fangling.
In the winter and tenth month of the fourth year, I visited Yong and offered sacrifices to the Five Emperors. I was rewarded with the rank of baron, a hundred women, cattle, and some wine.
Depart from Xiayang and arrive at Fenyin.
On November 8, Hou Tu Temple was built on the east bank of Fenyin.
After the ceremony, we arrived at Xingyang.
Returning to the capital from Luoyang, he issued an edict: "The Queen's sacrifice will be carried out in Jizhou, and we will look at the Luoshui River of the Yellow River. We will inspect Yuzhou and inspect the old sites of the Zhou Dynasty. The Zhou temple has been closed for worship for a long time."
After asking the local elders, he found Ji Jia, a descendant of the Zhou Dynasty.
Now Jia is granted the title of Zhou Zinanjun to inherit Zhou's sacrifices.
In the second month of spring, Liu Sheng, the king of Zhongshan, passed away.
In the Xia Dynasty, Luan Da, a scholar of alchemy, was appointed Marquis of Letong and became a general.
In June, I got the tripod next to Houtu Temple.
In autumn, it is said that horses are born in Wowa water.
Composed the songs "Baoding" and "Tianma" to celebrate the occasion.
Prince Liu Shang of Changshan was made King of Surabaya.
In the winter of the fifth year and in the tenth month, I was lucky enough to go to Yong to offer sacrifices to the Five Emperors?
Then we crossed Longshan Mountain, ascended Tongshan Mountain in the sky, and returned to the Zuli River in the west.
On the first day of November, the winter solstice, Li Tai?
In Ganquan County.
summary: In the first year of Yuanding, a tripod was found in the Fen River. In the second year, officials died, and Bailiang Terrace was built. Floods caused starvation. In the third year, the emperor moved Hangu and ordered tax evasion rewards. In the fourth year, he built Hou Tu Temple and granted titles to Zhou descendants. In the fifth year, he sacrificed to the sun and moon, found a tripod, and composed songs. In the sixth year, Nanyue rebelled, and the emperor sent generals to suppress it. The Western Qiang and Xiongnu invaded. In the first year of Yuanfeng, the emperor patrolled the border, shocking the Xiongnu. Dongyue submitted, and people were moved. He climbed Mount Song, built altars, and issued edicts on reforms.

translation:
In December, sacrifices are held at Mount Gaoli at the foot of Mount Tai and at the Hou Tu Temple.
It faces the Bohai Sea in the east and looks forward to offering sacrifices to Penglai.
Returning to Kyoto in the spring, he was sent to Ganquan Palace by the governors.
In February, the Zhang Palace was built.
In the fifth month of summer, the calendar was revised, using the first month as the first month of the year, using yellow as the color, using straight characters for seals, unifying official names, and harmonizing music and rhythm.
General Gongsun Ao was sent to build a city outside the fortress to accept the surrender.
In autumn and August, he patrolled Anding County and sent General Li Guangli of the Second Division to recruit the criminals from all over the world who were sent into exile to guard the border and march westward to Dawan.
Locusts flew from the east to Dunhuang.
In the first month of spring of the second year, Prime Minister Shi Qing passed away.
In March, the emperor traveled to Hedong to worship the Houtu God.
The people were ordered to drink for five days to rejoice, pray for five days, and offer sacrifices in temples, the specifications of which were the same as those of the wax festival.
In the fourth month of summer, an edict was issued saying: I offered sacrifices to Jieshan and prayed for blessings on the land, and the spiritual light induced me to pardon criminals below death row in Fenyin and Anyi.
In May, the officials and people’s horses were registered to supplement the horses for carriage and riding.
Autumn, locust plague.
He sent Junji General Zhao Ponu with 20,000 cavalry out of Shuofang to attack the Xiongnu, and the entire army was wiped out.
In the winter of December, Erkuan, the imperial censor, passed away.
In the first month of spring of the third year, the emperor went eastward to patrol the sea.
In the fourth month of summer, on the way back, he built a seal on Mount Tai and offered sacrifices to Mount Shilu.
Guang Luxun and Xu Ziwei were sent to build a series of fortresses outside the Wuyuan Great Wall, northwest to Luqu Mountain, and guerrilla general Han Shuo led the troops to garrison.
Lu Bode, the captain of Qiannu, built his residence in Yancheng.
In autumn, the Xiongnu invaded Dingxiang and Yunzhong, killing and plundering thousands of people, and destroying the pavilions and barriers built by Guangluxun. They also entered Zhangye and Jiuquan and killed the captains.
In the spring of the fourth year, Li Guangli, the general of the Second Division, beheaded the King of Dayuan and won a horse that had sweated thousands of miles. The imperial court wrote "Song of the West Pole Pegasus" to celebrate.
In autumn, the Guangming Palace rises.
In winter, I will be lucky to return to the center.
The captain who moved to Hongnong set up a tax card at Wuguan to collect entry and exit tariffs to provide the daily needs of customs officials and guards.
In the first month of spring in the first year of Tianhan, the emperor came to Ganquan and offered sacrifices to Mount Tai in the suburbs.
In March, he came to Hedong to offer sacrifices to Hou Tu.
The Huns returned the Han envoys and sent envoys to offer tribute.
In the fifth month of summer, there is a general amnesty for the whole world.
In autumn, the city gates were closed to search for those who violated the law and wasted money, and the criminals were assigned to guard the Wuyuan border.
In the spring of the second year, I traveled to the East China Sea and returned to China.
In the fifth month of summer, the General of the Second Division led 30,000 cavalry out of Jiuquan and fought against King Youxian of the Xiongnu in the Tianshan Mountains, beheading more than 10,000 of the enemy.
He also sent General Yin Muyu out of Xihe, and Li Ling, the Cavalry Commander, sent 5,000 infantrymen out of Yanbei to fight Shanyu and beheaded more than 10,000 enemies.
Li Ling was defeated and surrendered to the Huns.
summary: In the first year of Taichu, the emperor revised the calendar and built a palace. In the second year, he sacrificed to Houtu. In the third year, he built fortresses. In the fourth year, Li Guangli beheaded the King of Dayuan. In the first year of Tianhan, the Xiongnu returned envoys. In the second year, Li Guangli fought the Xiongnu, but Li Ling surrendered. Witchcraft was investigated. In the third year, the emperor sacrificed at Mount Tai. In the fourth year, he sent generals against the Xiongnu. In the first year of Taishi, Gongsun Ao was executed. In the second year, the emperor obtained a white unicorn and changed gold forms. In the third year, he visited the East China Sea. In the fourth year, he sacrificed at Mount Tai. In the first year of Zhenghe, witchcraft occurred. In the second year, the crown prince fled and committed suicide. In the third year, Li Guangli surrendered to the Xiongnu. In the fourth year, the emperor plowed land and repaired Mount Tai. In the first year of Hou Yuan, he pardoned the world. In the second year, he made Prince Fuling crown prince and died in Wuzha Palace.

translation:
In March, Li Guangli, the general of the Second Division, led 70,000 troops out of Wuyuan, Shang Qiucheng, the imperial censor, led 20,000 troops out of Xihe, and Hou Ma Tong led 40,000 cavalry out of Jiuquan.
Shangqiu formed an army and went to Junji Mountain to engage the enemy and beheaded many of them.
Ma Tong's troops reached the Tianshan Mountains, but the Huns retreated and took advantage of the situation to conquer the chariot division.
Generals Shang and Ma both withdrew their troops and returned to the court.
Li Guangli was defeated and surrendered to the Huns.
In June, Prime Minister Liu Quyou was imprisoned and beheaded because his wife was involved in witchcraft.
In autumn, there was a locust plague.
In September, Gongsun Yong and Hu Qian were found guilty of treason and were executed.
In the first month of spring of the fourth year, I came to Donglai and looked at the sea.
On the third day of February, a meteorite fell in Yongdi, and its sound was heard four hundred miles away.
In March, the emperor plowed the land in person.
On the way back, he climbed Mount Tai and repaired the seal.
On March 26, a sacrifice was held in Mingtang.
On the 29th, sacrifices were made to Shilu Mountain.
In June of summer, I returned to Ganquan.
On August 30th in autumn, a partial solar eclipse occurred.
In the first month of spring of the first year of Hou Yuan Dynasty, he drove to Ganquan to worship the god of Mount Tai in the suburbs, and then came to Anding.
Wang Kun of Changyi passed away.
In February, an edict was issued saying: I saw a spiritual light from heaven during the festival in the suburbs. When I was patrolling to the north, I saw a group of cranes roosting. At that time, it was not the time for trapping and killing, so I did not go hunting.
When worshiping at Taishan Temple, auras and divine shadows appeared together.
Therefore forgive the sinners in the world.
In June of Xia, Shang Qiucheng, the imperial censor, committed suicide.
The servant Shemang Heluo and his younger brother Hou Matong conspired to rebel. The prince-in-law Jin Rishidan, the commander of the carriage, Huo Guang, the commander of the chariot, and Shangguan Jie, the commander of the cavalry, joined forces to conquer.
In autumn and July, there were earthquakes and magma gushes out from time to time.
In the spring of the second year and the first month of the first lunar month, all princes and kings came to the emperor in Ganquan Palace, and the emperor rewarded the clan.
In February, I came to Wuzha Palace in Zhouzhi County.
On February 12, Prince Fuling was made the crown prince.
On the 14th, Emperor Wu died in Wuzha Palace. The funeral was held in the front hall of Weiyang.
On the second day of March, he was buried in Maoling.
Ban Gu commented: The Han Dynasty was founded in a turbulent period when heroes were vying for the throne. Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty brought order to the chaos, and Emperor Wen and Emperor Jing made recuperation and recuperation his top priority. However, there was still a lack of achievements in the cultural affairs of ancient rituals.
In the early days of Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, he resolutely dismissed hundreds of schools of thought and advocated Confucianism alone. He also sought advice from others, recommended talented people, and gave them opportunities to make contributions.
summary: Ban Gu commented: Emperor Wu dismissed hundreds of schools, promoted Confucianism, established Imperial College, and reformed rituals. He inherited ancestral achievements but lacked frugality, which even praised emperors could not surpass.

translation:
Empress Gao, the Lu family, gave birth to Emperor Hui, who assisted Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty to pacify the world. Her father and brother had three marquises under Emperor Gaozu.
After Emperor Hui succeeded to the throne, he honored Empress Lu as the Queen Mother.
The Queen Mother made the daughter of Princess Lu Yuan, the sister of Emperor Hui, the Queen. She had no children, so she made the son of a beauty in the harem the Prince.
Emperor Hui died, and the prince was established as emperor. The emperor was young, and Empress Dowager Lu came to the court to perform the emperor's affairs and grant amnesty to the world.
Later, four of his brother's sons, Lu Tai, Lu Chan, Lu Lu, and Lu Tai's son Lu Tong were made kings, and six Zhu Lu were made princes.
The specific details can be found in "Book of Han·Biography of Wai Qi".
In the first month of the spring of the first year of Empress Lu's reign, she issued an edict saying: It turned out that Emperor Xiaohui intended to abolish the harsh laws that punished serious crimes and three clans, and regarded wrong words as evil words. He died before the resolution was resolved.
It has now been announced that it will be abolished.
In February, the people were rewarded with titles of nobility, one level for each household.
For the first time, an official with an annual salary of two thousand shi was set up to encourage the world's filial piety.
On the fourth day of May in the summer, a fire broke out in the Congtai of Zhao Palace.
Liu Qiang, the son of Emperor Xiaohui's harem, was made the King of Huaiyang, Liu Buyi was the King of Hengshan, Liu Hong was the Marquis of Xiangcheng, Liu Chao was the Marquis of Zhi, and Liu Wu was the Marquis of Huguan.
In autumn, peaches and plums bloom.
In the spring of the second year of Empress Lu's reign, she issued an edict saying: Emperor Gao unified the world and granted fiefs and feudal lordships to all the meritorious officials. All the people were safe and sound, and no one was immune from his kindness.
I consider that in the future, due to the passage of time, no one will remember his fame and honor, and will not be able to respect his great righteousness and pass it on to future generations.
Now I want to rank the status of each prince in the court according to the size of his merits. I will hide the merit book in the ancestral temple of Emperor Gao and pass it down from generation to generation. His descendants will inherit their merits and titles hereditary. Please work with the princes to submit a proposal.
Prime Minister Chen Ping reported: I have discussed with Jianghou Zhoubo, Quzhouhou Lishang, Yinhou Guanying, Anguohou Wang Ling, etc., that the princes were favored and were rewarded with rents and food. Your Majesty also extended extra favors and assigned grades based on merit. Please keep the merit book in the high temple.
Empress Lu approved this memorial.
On the 27th of the first lunar month of spring, an earthquake occurred and a landslide occurred in Wudu Road.
On June 30th in summer, there was a partial solar eclipse.
In the seventh month of autumn, Liu Buyi, the king of Hengshan, passed away and eight baht coins were used again.
In the summer of the third year of Empress Lu's reign, the Yangtze River and the Han River overflowed, flooding more than 4,000 houses.
In autumn, stars appear during the day.
In the summer of the fourth year of Empress Lu's reign, the young emperor secretly knew that he was not the empress's biological child, so he complained. The Empress Dowager put him under house arrest in a long alley.
summary: Empress Gao, of the Lu family, was the mother of Emperor Hui and assisted Emperor Gaozu in pacifying the realm. After Emperor Hui ascended, she became the Queen Mother. She arranged for her granddaughter, the daughter of Princess Lu Yuan, to be the Queen, who had no children, so a son from a harem beauty was made prince. Upon Emperor Hui's death, this prince became emperor, but due to his youth, Empress Dowager Lu ruled in his stead, granting amnesty and promoting her relatives: four of her brother's sons were made kings, and six others were made princes. In the first year of her reign, she abolished harsh laws and rewarded the people. She established officials to encourage filial piety. In the second year, she ordered merit rankings for princes to be preserved in the ancestral temple. Natural events occurred: earthquakes, solar eclipses, and floods. In the fourth year, the young emperor, aware he was not the Queen's biological son, complained and was imprisoned. The Empress Dowager replaced him with Liu Hong, King of Hengshan. In the fifth year, Wei Tuo, King of Nanyue, declared himself emperor. In the sixth year, there was a general amnesty and construction at Changling. The Xiongnu invaded in the seventh year, and several kings died or were imprisoned. In the eighth year, Empress Lu died in Weiyang Palace.

translation:
At this time, Zhu Xuhou Liu Zhang, son of King Qi Hui, was in Kyoto. He was Lu Lu's son-in-law. When he learned of the plot, he immediately sent someone to inform his brother King Qi, asking him to send troops to the west.
Liu Zhang prepared to work with Taiwei Zhou Bo and Prime Minister Chen Ping as internal correspondents to kill Zhu Lu.
The King of Qi then raised an army, and instigated King Langya and King Liu Ze to mobilize the troops of his country to join forces and march westward.
Lu Chan, Lu Lu and others sent General Guan Ying to lead the troops to stop the attack.
Guan Ying went to Xingyang, sent people to inform the King of Qi and united with him, waiting for the Lu family to launch a coup before carrying out the execution.
Taiwei Zhou Bo conspired with Prime Minister Chen Ping. He believed that Ji, the son of Li Shang, the Marquis of Qu Zhou, was closely related to Lu Lu, so he sent people to force Li Shang to order his son Li Ji to deceive Lu Lu and said: Emperor Gao and Queen Lu jointly established the world. The nine kings established by the Liu family and the three kings established by the Lu family were discussed by the ministers.
The discussions and decisions have been informed to all the princes and kings, and all the princes and princes have expressed their approval.
Today, the Queen Mother has passed away and the Emperor is young. You are not in a hurry to defend your own kingdoms, but you have gathered troops to stay in Kyoto as generals, which has aroused the suspicion of the ministers and princes.
Why not immediately return the general's seal, pass the military power to the Taiwei, ask Liang Wang Lu Chan to return the prime minister's seal, explain it clearly to the ministers, and then return to the feudal country?
In this way, the troops can retreat, the ministers can rest assured, and they can sit back and be king of a country thousands of miles away. This is the benefit of all times!
Lu Lu agreed to his plan and sent someone to tell Lu Chan and his elders.
Some feel uneasy and have different opinions without making a decision.
Lu Lu believed in Li Ji and went with him to persuade Zhu Lu. They arrived at the home of Lu Xu's sister, Empress Lu.
Lu Xunu said angrily: As a general, you gave up military power, and the Lu family will die without a burial place.
She took out all the jewels and jade and threw them in the hall. She said, "I don't have to keep these things for others!"
In August, Cao Lan, Marquis of Pingyang, served as the imperial censor and met with Prime Minister Lu Chan to discuss state affairs.
The doctor ordered Jia Shou to return Qi, so he accused Lu Chan and said: If you didn't go to your feudal country as soon as possible, can you still leave now if you want to?
Tell Lu Chan specifically about Guan Ying's alliance with Qi and Chu.
After Pingyang Hou Cao Lan heard about it, he hurriedly informed Prime Minister Chen Ping and Taiwei Zhou Bo.
Bo wanted to join the Northern Army, but failed. Marquis Jitong of Xiangping was in charge of Fujie, so he falsely sent military orders in the name of the emperor to let Zhou Bo enter the camp and take charge of the Northern Army.
Zhou Bo also sent Li Ji and Dianke Liu Jie to persuade Lu Lu. They said: The emperor sent a Taiwei to take over the Northern Army. If you want everyone to return to the feudal country, you should resign the general and leave, otherwise disaster will be imminent.
Lu Lu took off the general's seal and gave it to Liu Jie, and handed over the military power to Taiwei Zhou Bo.
Zhou Bo entered the Chinese army's tent and sent an order to the army: Support Lu's right side and Liu's left side.
The officers and men were all left-handed.
summary: After her death, Lu Lu and Lu Chan, holding military and political power, plotted rebellion. Zhu Xuhou Liu Zhang, son of King Qi, learned of this and coordinated with his brother, King Qi, and officials Zhou Bo and Chen Ping to counter them. King Qi raised an army, and General Guan Ying, sent to stop him, instead allied with him. Zhou Bo, using deception, gained control of the Northern Army by tricking Lu Lu into surrendering his command. Lu Chan, attempting a coup, was killed by Liu Zhang. The Lu family was then exterminated. The ministers, believing the young emperor and his brothers were not Emperor Hui's sons, killed them and enthroned Emperor Wen. Ban Gu noted that under Empress Gao, the world was peaceful, with reduced warfare and punishments, allowing the people to prosper in farming.

translation:
Han Gaozu was a native of Zhongyangli, Fengyi, Peixian County, and his surname was Liu.
His mother once closed her eyes and took a nap on the embankment of a pond, and unexpectedly met the god in her dream.
At that time, there was thunder and lightning and the sky was dark. His father Taigong went to Tangba to meet his mother and saw a dragon crawling on his mother's body.
Soon after, she became pregnant and gave birth to Han Gaozu.
Emperor Gaozu had a high nose, raised eyebrows, a beautiful beard, and seventy-two black moles on his left thigh.
He is kind, generous and broad-minded.
Usually informal, but unwilling to engage in ordinary productive labor.
When he grew up, he served as a minor official and became the chief of Sishang Pavilion. But he looked down upon the officials in the government.
Emperor Gaozu loved wine and sex.
He often went to Wang Po and Wu Ma's hotel to buy wine on credit, and sometimes he was extremely drunk. Wang Po and Wu Ma saw strange phenomena appearing on his body while he was lying drunk.
Every time Gaozu drank wine on credit, the hotel always doubled the price of the wine. Later, seeing his mysterious atmosphere when he was drunk, when settling the wine bill at the end of the year, the two families often tore up the IOUs and waived his wine debt.
Emperor Gaozu once went to Xianyang, the capital of Qin, to do corvee service and saw the majesty of Qin Shihuang with his own eyes. He sighed and said: A real man should be like this!
Lu Gong of Shanfu County was a good friend of the magistrate of Pei County. Because he was hiding from his enemies, he stayed in the magistrate's apartment and later moved his family to Pei County.
Some prominent people in Peizhong heard that a friend of the county magistrate had moved to Pei, and they all went to congratulate him.
Xiao He is the county magistrate's assistant and is responsible for collecting gifts. I say to all the prominent figures: Anyone who can contribute less than one thousand yuan will sit down in the hall.
Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty was the chief of the pavilion at this time. He usually looked down on these people, so he mischievously wrote his name on the red envelope and said "ten thousand yuan in congratulations", but actually did not give a penny.
When the gift package was delivered, Lu Gong was surprised to see the generous gift and went to the gate to greet him personally.
Lu Gong was good at fortune-telling, and when he saw Gaozu's extraordinary appearance, he also respected him very much. He led him into the living room and invited him to sit on the throne.
Xiao He said: Liu Ji usually only talks big words and seldom accomplishes good things.
Emperor Gaozu had long looked down on these prominent figures in the county, so he sat on the throne without humility and looked at ease.
When he was half drunk, Lu Gong asked Gaozu to stay with his eyes. When the banquet was over, he asked Gaozu to stay and slow down.
Lu Gong said to Emperor Gaozu: I have been studying physiognomy since I was young. I have seen many people, but none of them are as noble as yours. I hope you will take care of yourself. I have a biological daughter who is willing to marry you.
After the guests left, Ms. Lu yelled at Mr. Lu and said, "You always said that my daughter was blessed in life and would marry a noble man in the future."
Peiling is on good terms with you, but you want to marry my daughter but you refuse. Why do you want to marry me to Liu Ji today?
Lu Gong smiled and said: This is not what you women know.
summary: Han Gaozu, originally named Liu Ji, was born in Peixian County. His mother dreamed of a god during a thunderstorm, and his father saw a dragon on her, leading to his birth. He had a distinctive appearance with a high nose, raised eyebrows, a beautiful beard, and seventy-two black moles on his left thigh. He was generous and broad-minded, disliking ordinary labor, and served as a minor official, often looking down on others. He loved wine and women, frequently buying wine on credit from Wang Po and Wu Ma, who noticed strange phenomena when he was drunk and eventually forgave his debts. While performing corvée in Xianyang, he saw Qin Shihuang and declared, "A real man should be like this."

translation:
In the end, he married his daughter to Gaozu.
Gong Lu's daughter was later Empress Lu, and gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui of Han and Princess Lu Yuan.
Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty once resigned as the pavilion chief and went home to work on the farm.
Queen Lu and her two children lived in a small shed in the field. An old man who was passing by asked him for water, and Queen Lu even let him have a meal.
The father-in-law looked at Empress Lu's compliments and said: "My wife is a noble person in the world."
Empress Lu asked him to look at the faces of the two children. He looked at Emperor Xiaohui and said: The reason why my wife became a noble person is because of this son.
He looked at Princess Lu Yuan again and said that she would be a noble person in the future.
After the father-in-law left, Gaozu returned from another farmhouse. Empress Lu told him about the past, saying that the father-in-law, my mother and my son were all high-ranking ministers.
Emperor Gaozu asked where his father-in-law was, and Empress Lu said: "He has not gone far."
Emperor Gaozu chased his father-in-law and asked him about his life.
The father-in-law said: Just now, I said that my wife and son are so noble in life, it is all due to your great blessing. Your life is priceless.
Emperor Gaozu quickly thanked him and said: "As the old gentleman said, I will always remember your kindness."
After Emperor Gaozu ascended the throne, the whereabouts of this father-in-law was unknown.
The emperor of the Han Dynasty was the chief of the pavilion and wore a bamboo hat. He sent the thief-catching pavilion soldiers to Xuedi to learn the craftsmanship of making bamboo hats. He often wore this kind of hat and still wore it when he was in a high position. Later, this kind of bamboo hat was called "Liu Shi Guan".
Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty sent servants to Lishan Mountain for Peixian County as the pavilion chief. Many servants escaped on the way.
When he thought about Lishan, they might all run away, so he went to Fengxi Zezhong Pavilion, asked the servants to stop and rest, invited everyone to drink, and let all the servants go at night. He said: Everyone should just run away!
I will fly far away from now on!
Among the servants, there were more than ten vigorous men who were willing to go with Gaozu. Emperor Gaozu took advantage of the drunkenness and led everyone to escape from the Zezhong trail, and sent one person to explore the road ahead.
The pathfinder came back and reported: There is a big snake blocking the road ahead. Let's go back.
Emperor Gaozu said drunkenly: Warriors march forward, why should they be afraid?
So he went forward himself, drew his sword and killed the snake. The snake was cut into two pieces, and the road was passable.
After walking for several miles, Emperor Gaozu was drunk and sleepy, so he lay down on the road.
Someone caught up from behind and passed by where Gaozu killed the snake. He saw an old mother crying by the roadside at night.
The man asked the reason, and the old mother said: Someone else killed my son.
This person said: Who killed my mother’s son?
The old mother said: My child is the son of the White Emperor. He turned into a big snake and blocked the road. When he met the son of the Red Emperor, he was beheaded, so I am crying here.
This person thought that the old mother was talking nonsense and wanted to cross-examine her, but she disappeared in the blink of an eye.
When this man caught up with Gaozu, Gaozu had already woken up.
summary: Lu Gong, a friend of the Pei County magistrate, moved to the area, and Liu Ji falsely claimed a gift of ten thousand yuan at a gathering. Lu Gong, skilled in physiognomy, recognized Liu Ji's noble appearance and married his daughter to him, despite his wife's objections. This daughter later became Empress Lu, mother of Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan. After resigning as pavilion chief, Liu Ji worked on a farm. An old man predicted that Empress Lu and her children would be noble, and that Liu Ji's destiny was priceless. Liu Ji later wore a distinctive bamboo hat, known as the "Liu Shi Guan." As pavilion chief, Liu Ji was tasked with sending servants to Lishan, but many escaped. He released them all, and over ten strong men chose to follow him. While fleeing, he killed a large snake blocking the path. An old woman later claimed the snake was the son of the White Emperor, killed by the son of the Red Emperor, which Liu Ji took as a sign of his destiny. Qin Shihuang heard of an emperor's cloud in the southeast and toured to suppress it. Empress Lu could always find Liu Ji by following a cloud above his hiding place, further convincing others of his destiny.

translation:
This person told Gaozu about this, and Gaozu was secretly happy and believed that he would become a big success.
Those who followed him also grew in awe of him.
Qin Shihuang once heard someone say: There is the emperor's cloud in the southeast. So the First Emperor made an eastward tour to suppress this cloud.
Emperor Gaozu sometimes hid in the mountains and rivers of Mangdang. When Empress Lu and others went to look for him, it was always easy to find him.
Emperor Gaozu felt strange and asked the reason. Queen Lu said: There is a layer of clouds above where you are staying. If you look for the place where the clouds are, you will find it.
Gaozu was very happy again.
The children of Peizhong also heard this legend, and many people wanted to attach themselves to him.
In the autumn and seventh month of the first year of Qin II, Chen She revolted in Qixian County, arrived in Chendi, and proclaimed himself the king of Chu.
He sent Wu Chen, Zhang Er, and Chen Yu to capture Zhao's territory.
In August, Wu Chen proclaimed himself King of Zhao.
In various counties and counties, major officials were killed one after another in response to Chen She.
In September, the magistrate of Peixian County wanted to respond to Chen She in Peixian County. His aides Xiao He and Cao Shen came forward and said: As an official of the Qin Dynasty, you now want to betray the Qin Dynasty and lead the children of Peizhong to revolt. I am afraid that everyone will not listen.
I hope you can recruit those who have fled, and you can get hundreds of people. With the power of these people, you can appeal to the worried children of Peizhong, and the children of Peizhong will not dare not listen.
So the magistrate of Peixian County sent Fan Kuai to invite Gaozu.
At this time, Gaozu already had hundreds of people.
When Fan Kuai and Gaozu came with their troops, Peiling went back on his word. He was afraid that Gaozu would seize his power, so he closed the city and wanted to kill Xiao He and Cao Shen.
Xiao He and Cao Shen were afraid and secretly crossed the city wall to seek refuge with Gaozu.
Emperor Gaozu then wrote a silk book and shot it on the city. The book told the elders of Peixian County: The whole world has been bullied by the Qin Dynasty for a long time.
Although you, the elders, are guarding the city for Pei Ling today, as soon as the rebels from various places arrive, they will use force in Pei land.
If you can kill Pei Ling now, elect a leader who is popular among the people, and join the rebel army, you can ensure the safety of your family. Otherwise, the whole family will suffer, which is meaningless.
So the elders of Peizhong led their children to kill Peiling, opened the city gate to welcome Gao Zu, and recommended Gao Zu to be the magistrate of Peixian County.
Emperor Gaozu thanked him and said: Today is a time of great chaos in the world, and heroes are revolting one after another. If the leaders are not selected properly, they will be completely defeated.
I am not a person who is greedy for life and afraid of death, but I am deeply afraid that my virtue and ability will be shallow and I will not be able to protect you, my fathers and brothers.
This is a big deal, please choose another capable person.
Xiao He and Cao Shen were both civil servants. They were worried about their wealth and life. They were afraid that if they failed to do something, the Qin Dynasty would exterminate the nine tribes in the future, they tried their best to recommend Gaozu.
The elders of Peixian County all said: If you hear some strange things about Liu Ji, you may become a nobleman. We have asked the gods for divination, and they all said that there is no one more suitable than Liu Ji.
summary: In the first year of Qin II, Chen She rebelled, and the Pei County magistrate considered joining. Xiao He and Cao Shen advised him to recruit fugitives, including Liu Ji. When Liu Ji arrived with followers, the magistrate reneged and tried to kill Xiao He and Cao Shen, who fled to Liu Ji. Liu Ji shot a message into the city, urging the elders to kill the magistrate and join the rebellion. They did so, and Liu Ji was elected Duke of Pei after multiple refusals. He honored Huangdi and Chiyou, used red flags, and quickly expanded his army to 3,000 men. Other rebellions followed, including Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu in Wu.

translation:
Xiang Liang recalled all the young generals who were elsewhere.
In the sixth month, Duke Pei arrived in Xuedi, and together with Xiang Liang, he made Sun Mixin, the king of Chu Huai, the king of Chu Huai.
Qin general Zhang Han broke out and killed Wei Wang Jiu and Qi Wang Tian Dan in Linji.
In July, it rained continuously.
Duke Pei attacked Kang's father.
Zhang Han surrounded Qi general Tian Rong in Dong'a County. Peigong and Xiang Liang led troops to rescue Tian Rong and defeated Qin general Zhang Han in Dong'a.
Tian Rong led his troops back, and Peigong and Xiang Yu pursued the Qin soldiers to Chengyang County. They bloodbathed Chengyang and garrisoned in the east of Puyang. They fought against Zhang Han again and defeated the Qin soldiers again.
Zhang Han regained his strength and defended Puyang, digging trenches to divert water and stabilize himself.
Peigong and Xiang Yu then moved their troops to attack Dingtao.
In August, Tian Rong established Tian Dan Zi Tian Shi as the King of Qi.
Before Dingtao was captured, Peigong and Xiang Yu took the land to Yongqiu, fought with the Qin soldiers, defeated the Qin soldiers, and killed Li You, the governor of Sanchuan.
Returned to attack Waihuang, but failed to capture it.
Xiang Liang defeated the Qin army twice and showed his pride.
Song Yi reminded him, but Xiang Liang didn't listen.
The Qin Dynasty sent additional troops to Zhang Han.
In September, Zhang Han secretly attacked Xiang Liang's garrison in Dingtao in the dark, defeated Xiang Liang's army, and killed Xiang Liang.
It was rainy and rainy from July to September.
Pei Gong and Xiang Yu were attacking Chenliu. When they heard that Xiang Liang was dead, the soldiers were frightened, so they and their general Lu Chen led troops eastward and moved King Huai of Chu from Xuyi to Pengcheng.
Lu Chen garrisoned to the east of Pengcheng, Xiang Yu garrisoned to the west of Pengcheng, and Peigong garrisoned to Dang County.
Wei Bao, Wei Jiu's younger brother, established himself as King of Wei.
In the ninth month of the leap year, King Huai merged the armies of Lu Chen and Xiang Yu and put him under his direct command. He appointed Pei Gong as the governor of Dang County and granted the title of Marquis of Wu'an to command the troops of Dang County.
Xiang Yu was appointed Duke of Lu, Marquis of Chang'an, Lu Chen was appointed Situ, and Lu Chen's father Lu Qing was appointed Ling Yin.
After Qin general Zhang Han defeated Xiang Liang, he thought that the rebel Qin forces in Chu were no longer a threat, so he crossed the river and went north to attack Zhao Wangxie and defeated Zhao Wangxie.
King Zhao retreated to defend Julu City, and Qin General Wang Li's troops surrounded Julu.
King Zhao asked King Huai of Chu for help many times, and King Huai appointed Song Yi as general, Xiang Yu as deputy general, and Fan Zeng as junior general. Lead the troops north to rescue Zhao Jun.
Originally, King Huai had made an appointment with the generals, and whoever could conquer Guanzhong first would be crowned king.
During this period, the Qin army was powerful and often took advantage of its victory to pursue the rebels. The generals were afraid of its power and did not dare to enter the pass.
Only Xiang Yu hated the Qin army for defeating and killing Xiang Liang. He was very angry and was willing to enter the pass with Peigong west.
Some of King Huai's veterans said: What kind of person is Xiang Yu? He was fierce and good at killing. When Xiangcheng was captured, there were almost no survivors in Xiangcheng. Everywhere Xiang Yu passed by was destroyed.
Moreover, the Chu army's many attempts to advance against the former Chu kings Chen She and Xiang Liang all ended in failure. It would be better to send another generous elder to march westward with righteousness and inform the fathers and brothers of Qin.
summary: Liu Ji's forces grew through various battles, including victories at Huling, Fangyu, and Xue. He faced setbacks, such as Yong Chi's betrayal to Wei, but regained Feng. He joined Xiang Liang, who made Sun Mixin King of Chu Huai. After Xiang Liang's death, Liu Ji and Xiang Yu moved King Huai to Pengcheng. King Huai appointed Liu Ji as Marquis of Wu'an and ordered that whoever first entered Guanzhong would be king. Liu Ji was chosen for his kindness, while Xiang Yu was deemed too violent.

translation:
If we do not capture Wancheng now, if Qin Dynasty is strong enough to defend in front of us and Wan soldiers attack behind us, this will be a dangerous road.
Pei Gong led his troops to detour and attack Wancheng at night. All flags and drums ceased, and before dawn, Wancheng was surrounded by three layers.
The governor of Nanyang County wanted to kill himself, but his close aide Chen Hui said: It is not time to die yet.
So Chen Hui went across the city to see Pei Gong. He said: I heard that I have made an appointment with someone: the man who first entered Xianyang, the capital of Qin, honored me as king, and now I am attacking Wancheng.
There were dozens of strongholds in Wan County. The soldiers guarding the city thought they would be executed if they surrendered, so they all climbed to the city to defend it.
If the troops attack all day long, both sides will suffer a lot of casualties; if they give up attacking Wan and lead their troops westward, the Qin soldiers in Wan will be completely behind them.
A single attack on Wan would delay the promise that whoever enters Xianyang first would be the king; a single step of abandoning Wan would leave behind the possibility of pursuers.
For the sake of his subordinates, it is better for me to allow the Wancheng garrison to surrender, make the county garrison a marquis, and still order him to stay where he is. Move his forces westward.
The cities in the front that have not yet been captured will definitely respond to the news and welcome the next step. You will be able to pass smoothly with just one step without any worries. Pei Gong said: Very good.
In the seventh month, the governor of Nanyang, Ji Qi, surrendered. Pei Gong granted him the title of Marquis of Yin, and granted Chen Hui the title of Qianhu.
Leading troops to the west, the momentum is like breaking bamboo.
When the troops arrived at Danshui, Qin Gao Wuhou Ji and Xianghou Wang Ling surrendered.
Returning to attack Hu Yang, he met Fan Jun's general Mei Jie and joined forces with him to attack Zhe County and Li County, but they all surrendered.
Pei Gong ordered the troops not to plunder wherever they passed. The people of Qin welcomed him very much and sent Wei people Ningchang to Qin to persuade them to surrender.
In the same month, Qin general Zhang Han led the entire army to surrender to Xiang Yu, and Xiang Yu named Zhang Han King Yong.
Xiaqiu Gong Shenyang captured Henan.
In August, Peigong captured Wuguan. Entering the suburbs of Qin.
Qin Prime Minister Zhao Gao was frightened, so he killed Qin II and sent an envoy to see Pei Gong, wanting to make an agreement to divide the Guanzhong land equally, but Pei Gong refused.
In September, Zhao Gao made Ziying, the son of his second brother, king.
Ziying killed Zhao Gao and sent generals to lead troops to guard Shanyao Pass.
Pei Gong wanted to attack, but Zhang Liang stopped him and said: Qin's army is strong and should not be underestimated.
It is suggested to send people to plant more flags on the nearby mountains to make the soldiers suspicious, and then send Li Shiqi and Lu Jia to the Qin camp to act as lobbyists to lure them.
The general of Qin really wanted to make peace with Pei Gong, and Pei Gong agreed.
Zhang Liang said: This is just a buffer strategy for Qin's generals who want to rebel against Qin and are afraid that their soldiers will not obey. It is better to take advantage of Qin's unpreparedness and launch an attack.
So Peigong led his troops to bypass Shanyao Pass, cross the Huangshan Mountains, and attack the Qin army. Then they marched to Lantian and attacked from the north. The Qin army was defeated again.
In the tenth month of winter in the first year of Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty, Pei Gong led his troops to reach Bashui River.
Qin Prince Ying drove a plain chariot and a white horse, with a ribbon tied around his neck, and the emperor's jade seal seal, and surrendered to Pei Gong beside the Zhidao Pavilion. Some of the generals suggested that Pei Gong kill the King of Qin. Pei Gong said: Originally, the reason why King Huai of Chu sent me to pass was because I can tolerate people. Besides, the King of Qin has surrendered, so it is not good to kill him.
summary: Liu Ji advanced westward, defeating Qin forces and accepting surrenders. He entered Wuguan and reached Bashui, where Qin Prince Ying surrendered. Liu Ji spared him, entered Xianyang, and issued the "three chapters of the law," abolishing harsh Qin laws. He refused gifts from the people, winning their support. He guarded Hangu Pass against Xiang Yu, who grew angry. Xiang Yu's uncle Xiang Bo warned Zhang Liang, leading to the Hongmen Banquet, where Liu Ji narrowly escaped assassination. Xiang Yu later entered Xianyang, killed Prince Ying, and burned the palaces, disappointing the people.

translation:
Xiang Yu assigned 30,000 soldiers to the King of Han. Chu and other vassal states had tens of thousands of people who admired the King of Han and were willing to follow him.
Zhang Liang bid farewell to the King of Han and returned to Korea. The King of Han personally sent Zhang Liang to Baozhong. When saying goodbye, Zhang Liang suggested that the King of Han burn down the plank road. Firstly, to prevent other princes from peeking into Hanzhong, and secondly, to express to Xiang Yu that the King of Han had no intention of leaving Hanzhong anymore.
When the King of Han arrived at Nanzheng, all his officers and men sang in unison and wanted to return to the east; many of them fled back.
Han Xin, the captain of Zhisu, also left with the people returning from the east.
Xiao He chased Han Xin and recommended him to the king of Han. Xiao He said: If you really want to conquer the world, there is no one with whom to discuss except Han Xin.
So King Zhaijie of Han went to the platform to worship generals, worshiped Han Xin as a general, and asked for advice on how to conquer the world.
Han Xin replied: Xiang Yu broke the original agreement and changed the title of king to Nanzheng. This is treating the king as a sinner and migrating.
The king's soldiers are all from Shandong, and they hope to fight back to their hometown day and night. If they can use their energy in time, they will definitely win.
If we wait until the world is stable and the people are in their own places, there will be no morale left.
The top priority is to lead troops eastward.
At the same time, it also comprehensively stated Xiang Yu's strategies that could be combined with those of the Three Qin Dynasties.
The King of Han was very satisfied and made arrangements according to Han Xin's plan. He sent Xiao He to stay in Hanzhong to collect money and grain from Ba and Shu to supply military supplies.
In May, the King of Han led troops from Gudao County to attack Yongdi. King Zhanghan of Yong met the Han soldiers in Chencang.
King Yong was defeated and retreated; did the battle end well again? In the county, Zhang Han's troops were defeated again and rushed to Feiqiu.
The king of Han pacified Yongdi in time.
He marched eastward to Xianyang, surrounded the waste hill that Zhang Han refused to defend, and then sent various generals to expand his territory.
Qi general Tian Rong was furious when he heard that Xiang Yu had moved King Tianshi of Qi to Jiaodong and made Tiandu the king of Qi. He led the Qi troops to intercept Tiandu, but Tiandu was defeated and surrendered to Chu.
In June, Tian Rong killed Tian Shi and proclaimed himself king of Qi.
At this time, Peng Yue garrisoned troops in Juye, with more than 10,000 soldiers but no one to belong to.
Tian Rong awarded Peng Yue the seal of general and ordered him to attack from Liang.
Peng Yue killed Tian An, the king of Jibei, and Tian Rong occupied the entire area of ​​Qi, Jibei, and Jiaodong.
Han Guang, King of Yan, also refused to move to Liaodong.
In the eighth month of autumn, Zang Tu, the new king of Yan, killed Han Guang and occupied his territory.
Sima Xin, king of Sai, and Dong Yi, king of Zhai, both surrendered to the Han.
At the beginning, the son after Xiang Liang established Korea became the king of Han, and Zhang Liang became the disciple of the king of Han.
Xiang Yu did not allow Zhang Liang to return to Han because he had followed the King of Han, and King Cheng of Han had not made any military exploits. He took him to Pengcheng and executed him.
At this time, Xiang Yu heard that the King of Han had annexed Guanzhong, and that Qi and Liang had rebelled against him. He was furious, so he sent Zheng Chang, the original Wu commander, as the King of Han to resist the Han soldiers.
He ordered Xiao Gongjiao to attack Peng Yue, but was defeated by Peng Yue.
During this period, Zhang Liang was touring Han and sent a letter to Xiang Yu, saying: The king of Han wants to capture Guanzhong. If he fulfills his promise to enter Guanzhong first, he will stop advancing and will not dare to continue to advance eastward.
Therefore, Xiang Yu had no intention of going west for the time being, and instead attacked Qi Wang Tianrong in the north.
In September, the King of Han sent generals Xue Ou and Wang Sui out of Wuguan to join the troops guarding Wang Ling in Nanyang, and went from Nanyang to Pei to meet the Taigong and Empress Lu.
When Xiang Yu heard the news, he sent troops to intercept them in Yangxia. Wang Ling and others were unable to advance.
In the winter of October of the second year of Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty, Xiang Yu sent Wang Yingbu of Jiujiang to kill Emperor Yi in Chen County.
Chen Yuhuai resented Xiang Yu for not making him king, so he asked Qi King Tian Rong to borrow troops to attack Changshan King Zhang Er.
Zhang Er was defeated and surrendered to the Han Dynasty. The king of Han gave him a grand courtesy.
Chen Yu welcomed Dai Wang Xie and returned Zhao land, and Dai Wang Xie made Chen Yu the acting king.
Zhang Liang secretly came to the King of Han from Han, and the King of Han made him the Marquis of Chengxin.
The King of Han arrived in Shaanxi County to comfort the elders outside the Pass.
King Shenyang of Henan surrendered to the Han, and the Han established Henan County here.
Han Taiwei Han Xin was sent to attack Han, and Han King Zheng Chang surrendered.
In November, Taiwei Han was granted the title of King of Han.
The King of Han returned to Hanzhong, with his capital in Yueyang, and sent generals to seize the enemy's land and conquer Longxi.
summary: Xiang Yu violated the agreement, making Liu Ji King of Han in Ba, Shu, and Hanzhong, while dividing Guanzhong among three Qin generals. Liu Ji resented this but was dissuaded from attacking. He burned the plank road to show no intention of leaving Hanzhong. Han Xin, recommended by Xiao He, was made general and advised an eastern campaign. Liu Ji defeated Zhang Han and expanded, while rebellions by Tian Rong and others weakened Xiang Yu.

translation:
I mourned personally, and the whole army, all dressed in plain clothes, gathered all the soldiers from Guanzhong, gathered the soldiers of Sanhe, and went south along the Han River into the Yangtze River, hoping to follow the princes and kings to arrest the culprits of the regicide.
In the fourth month of summer, Tian Heng, the younger brother of King Tian Rong of Qi, recovered tens of thousands of people who had been defeated by Xiang Yu, and made Tian Guang, the son of Tian Rong, the king of Qi.
Although Xiang Yu had already heard about the Han king's eastward advance, he had already sent all his troops to attack Chu. He wanted to destroy Qi and then attack the Han army. Therefore, the Han king took the opportunity to annex the troops of Wei, Yin and other five princes and attack Chu eastward.
When the troops arrived in Waihuang, Peng Yue led 30,000 people to surrender to the Han.
The King of Han made Peng Yue Prime Minister of Wei. Let him pacify Liang Di.
The king of Han then entered Pengcheng, the capital of Chu Xiang. Collected Xiang Yu's beauties and treasures, and held a cocktail party to celebrate the victory.
After hearing the news, Xiang Yu sent another general to attack, and led 30,000 elite troops from Huling, Lu, to Xiao County. They attacked the Han army in the early morning and fought on the Sui River east of Pengcheng Lingbi.
The soldiers of Chu surrounded the king of Han three times.
A strong wind came from the northwest, breaking trees and breaking houses, flying sand and rocks, making the day look like night, and the Chu army was in chaos. The king of Han took advantage of the chaos and broke through the siege with dozens of cavalry to escape.
Traveling through Peixian County, he sent people to look for his family members, but the whole family had fled and their whereabouts were unknown.
The King of Han met his son Xiaohui and his daughter Lu Yuan on the way, and they boarded a chariot and left in panic.
The Chu cavalry chased the King of Han. Seeing the critical situation, the King of Han pushed his children out of the carriage.
Teng Gong put the two men in the car again and finally escaped from the tiger's mouth.
Shen Shiqi, the father of the Han Dynasty, the Grand Duke, and his wife, Empress Lu, escaped from the trail and met the Chu army. Xiang Yu placed them as hostages in the army.
When the princes saw that the Han army was completely defeated, they all fled.
King Xin of Sai and King Yi of Zhai surrendered to Chu, and King Qiong of Yin died.
Zhou Luhou, the brother-in-law of the King of Han, led troops and horses to station in Xiayi County, and the King of Han went there to settle down.
Gradually the scattered soldiers were gathered and stationed in Dang County.
The king of Han went west through Liang and arrived at Yucheng County. He said to Sui He, who asked to see him, "Master, go and persuade Yingbu, king of Jiujiang, to raise an army to rebel against Chu. Xiang Yu will leave his troops to attack Yingbu."
As long as Xiang Yu can keep his troops for a few months, I will surely conquer the world.
Sui He was ordered to persuade Yingbu, and as expected, Yingbu rebelled against Chu.
In the fifth month, the troops of the King of Han were assembled in Xingyang. Xiao He recruited all the old, weak and underage people in Guanzhong to join his army.
Han Xin also gathered his soldiers to join forces with the King of Han. At this time, the King of Han regained his military power.
He fought with the Chu army between Jing and Suo in the south of Xingyang and defeated the Chu army.
The Han army built walls on both sides of the road leading to the river to transport grain from Aocang, which was near the river and leaning on the mountain.
At this time, Wei Wangbao asked for leave and returned to his hometown in the name of visiting his mother's illness.
After returning home, he blocked the ferry and defended the Chu army against the Han army.
In the sixth month, the king of Han returned to his capital, Yueyang. On the sixth day of the lunar month, he established the crown prince and pardoned the sinners.
He ordered all the sons of the princes in Guanzhong to gather in Yueyang as guards.
They diverted water to attack Feiqiu, but Feiqiu surrendered and King Yong Zhanghan committed suicide.
Yongzhou was pacified, and there were more than eighty counties, located on the river, Weinan, Zhongdi, Longxi, and Shangjun.
The ancestral officials were ordered to worship the mountains and rivers of gods in the four directions of heaven and earth, and to perform ancestral sacrifices on time.
Send sergeants from Guan to guard the border fortress.
summary: Liu Ji's forces grew, and he captured Pengcheng, but Xiang Yu counterattacked, defeating him. Liu Ji regrouped in Xingyang, using strategies like Sui He persuading Yingbu to rebel. He faced a famine in Guanzhong and sent Han Xin to conquer Wei, Zhao, and Qi. After a series of battles, including the siege of Xingyang, Liu Ji escaped using a decoy. He regained Chenggao and confronted Xiang Yu at Guangwu, listing ten crimes. Xiang Yu shot him, but he feigned a minor injury.

translation:
The King of Han fell down due to an arrow injury. Zhang Liang asked the King of Han to get up and go to condolences the soldiers, so as to stabilize the soldiers and prevent the Chu army from attacking after the victory.
When the King of Han went to inspect the military camp, his condition worsened and he immediately rushed back to Chenggao.
In November, Han Xin and Guan Ying defeated the Chu army, killed the Chu army general Long Qie, chased them to Chengyang, and captured Qi Wang Tian Guang.
Tian Heng, Prime Minister of Qi, proclaimed himself King of Qi and defected to Peng Yue.
The king of Han made Zhang Er the king of Zhao.
After the King of Han recovered from his illness, he traveled westward to the Pass and came to Yueyang, where he visited the local elders and held a banquet.
The head of Sima Xin, the former king of Si, was cut off and hung in Yueyang Market for public display.
After staying for four days, he returned to the army and garrisoned in Guangwu.
Guanzhong soldiers rushed to the Chu-Han battlefield in large numbers, while Peng Yue and Tian Heng occupied the Liang area, attacking and harassing the Chu army and cutting off their food channels.
After Han Xin captured Qi, he sent someone to tell the king of Han: Qi is close to Chu and its power is too small. If I don't become an acting king, I'm afraid I won't be able to stabilize Qi.
The king of Han was furious and wanted to attack him.
Zhang Liang said: It is better to take the opportunity to make him the king of Qi and let him guard the land of Qi.
In the second month of spring, Zhang Liang was sent with the royal seal to make Han Xin the king of Qi.
In the seventh month of autumn, Yingbu was made King of Huainan.
In August, the calculation method began to be implemented.
The Beibei and Yan people sent a group of brave cavalry to assist the Han army.
The King of Han ordered: If a sergeant unfortunately dies in battle, a special person will be sent to dress him, put him in a coffin, and send him back to his hometown.
All the people in the world have sincerely surrendered.
Xiang Yu knew that he lacked helpers and was about to run out of food and grass. Han Xin led troops to attack the Chu army many times, and he was very worried.
The King of Han sent Duke Hou to Chu to persuade Xiang Yu to release the Grand Duke and Empress Lu.
So Xiang Yu and the King of Han agreed to divide the world equally, using the chasm as the dividing line, with the west returning to Han and the east returning to Chu.
In September, Xiang Yu released the Grand Duke and Empress Lu, led his soldiers to relieve the difficulties in Xingyang, and then returned eastward.
The King of Han also had plans to return west to Guanzhong, but Zhang Liang and Chen Ping dissuaded him, saying: The King of Han now owns most of the world, and princes from all over the country have come to join him. But now the Chu army is exhausted and has run out of ammunition and food. This is really the best opportunity given by God to destroy Chu. If we let go of Chu people at this time, we will be raising tigers and causing trouble.
The king of Han listened to their opinions.
summary: Liu Ji recovered, made Han Xin King of Qi, and Yingbu King of Huainan. With Xiang Yu's resources dwindling, they agreed to divide the world using the chasm. However, Zhang Liang and Chen Ping advised Liu Ji to attack, leading to Xiang Yu's eventual defeat.

translation:
In the winter of tenth month of the fifth year of Emperor Gaozu, the King of Han pursued Xiang Yu to the south of Yangxia, stopped advancing, and made an appointment with Qi King Han Xin and Wei Xiangguo Peng Yue to attack the Chu army. The Han King's troops reached Guling, but Han, Peng and others failed to meet up as scheduled.
Xiang Yu led the troops to attack the army of the King of Han and defeated the Han soldiers. The king of Han withdrew his troops and returned to the original fortress, digging a deep ditch to defend himself.
The King of Han worriedly said to Zhang Liang: "What should we do if the princes do not want to obey us?"
Zhang Liang replied: Even if the Chu army is defeated, Han Xin and Peng Yue will not gain the benefit of increasing their territory. It is reasonable for them not to join forces.
If the king can share the fruits of victory with them, they will come to join forces immediately.
The appointment of Han Xin as King of Qi was not out of the King's original intention. Han Xin still lacked confidence in the King.
Peng Yue originally pacified the Liang region, but later the king made Peng Yue the Prime Minister of Wei because King Bao of Wei came and surrendered.
Now that King Bao of Wei is dead, Peng Yue also wants to claim the throne himself, but the king has yet to make a decision.
If the area north of Suiyang to Gucheng could be allocated to Peng Yue and he could be crowned king, and the area east of Chen to the Bohai Sea could be allocated to King Han Xin of Qi, whose family was in Chu, he originally wanted to regain his homeland.
The king abandoned these two lands to allow Han and Peng to fight on their own, and Chu Xiang would be easily defeated.
So the King of Han sent envoys to inform Han Xin and Peng Yue of the above intentions.
As soon as the notice arrived, Han Pengdu led his troops to join forces.
In November, Liu Jia invaded Chu and besieged Shouchun.
The king of Han also sent people to lure Zhou Yin, the great commander of Chu, to surrender.
Zhou Yin rebelled against Chu and violently attacked six counties with troops from Shu County. He led troops from Jiujiang to cooperate with Yingbu and attacked Chengfu County. Yingbu and Liu Jia both joined forces with the King of Han.
